Bene Israyeli bose babonye umuriro n'ubuninahazwa bw'Umukama bimanuka kuri iyo Ngoro, baca bunamika amaso hasi kw'isaso, bakubita inkoro hasi, bashimagiza Umukama kuko ari mwiza, kuko ubuntu bwiwe bwamaho imyaka yose. Umwami n'igihugu cose bahereza imbagwa imbere y'Umukama. Umwami Salomo ahereza imbagwa z'ibitungwa bininibinini ibihumbi mirongo ibiri na bibiri, n'ibihumbi ijana na mirongo ibiri z'ibitungwa bitobito. Ni uko umwami n'igihugu cose binjira Ingoro y'Imana. Abaherezankuka bari mu bibanza vyabo, Abalevi na bo bafise ibicurarangisho vyo kuririmbira Umukama umwami Dawudi yari yarahinguye, kuko ubuntu bwiwe bwamaho imyaka yose. Dawudi ariko arahayagiza Imana aciye kuri abo Balevi, abaherezankuka baba bariko bavugiriza inzamba imbere yabo, Israyeli yose ihagaze. Salomo ahezagira ikibanza hagati mu kibuga cari imbere y'Ingoro y'Umukama; haba ari ho aherereza inkuka hamwe n'ibinure vy'imbagwa z'amahoro kuko uruhimbi rw'umuringa Salomo yari yarubatse rutashobora gukwirwako izo nkuka, ayo mashikanwa n'ivyo binure. Salomo ahimbaza uyo musi mukuru mu gihe c'imisi indwi, ari kumwe n'Abanyisrayeli bose. Bari ishengero rinini cane riva kw'irembo rya Hamati rigashika ku ruzi rwo mu Misiri. Ku musi ugira umunani bagira ikoraniro, kuko bari bahezagiye uruhimbi mu misi indwi, bagira umusi mukuru mu misi indwi. Ku musi ugira mirongo ibiri na gatatu w'ukwezi kugira indwi, Salomo arungika abantu mu mahema yabo bahimbawe, umutima wuzuye urweze kubera ivyiza Umukama yari yagiriye Dawudi, Salomo n'igihugu ciwe Israyeli. Ni uko, Salomo ahejeje kwubaka Ingoro y'Umukama n'ingoro y'umwami, hamwe n'ivyo Salomo yari yaripfuje gukora vyose mu Ngoro y'Umukama no mu ngoro yiwe, aratunganirwa. Umukama abonekera Salomo mw'ijoro, amubwira ati: «Narumvise igisabisho cawe, kandi naritoreye iki kibanza ngo kibe ingoro y'imbagwa. Ninugara amajuru imvura igatara, ninategeka inzige kurigita igihugu, ninarungika akaranda mu bantu banje, abantu banje izina ryanje ryambarijweko nibicisha bugufi bagasenga, bakarondera amaso yanje kandi bagaheba inzira zabo mbi, jewe, iyo ndi mw'ijuru, nzobumviriza ndabarekurire ibicumuro vyabo, nkize igihugu cabo. Ubu, amaso yanje agiye kwuguruka, kandi amatwi yanje yumve igisabisho kivugiwe muri iki kibanza. Ubu rero naratoye kandi ndatagatifuza iyi ngoro kugira ngo ibemwo izina ryanje na ntaryo. Amaso yanje n'umutima wanje bizokwama kuri yo imisi yose. Nawe niwagendera imbere yanje nk'uko so wawe Dawudi yahagendeye, ugakora vyose nk'uko nabigutegetse, niwazigama imigenzo yanje n'ingingo zanje, nzoshinga intebe y'ubwami bwawe, nk'uko nabisezeraniye so wawe Dawudi, nkavuga nti: “Ntuzokwigera ubura umuntu mu bawe atwara Israyeli”. Ariko, nimwagarariza, mugaheba imigenzo yanje n'amategeko yanje nashize imbere yanyu, nimwaja gukorera izindi mana n'ugukubita inkoro hasi imbere yazo, nzobakura kw'isi yanje nabahaye, n'ingoro nahezagiriye izina ryanje nzoyishiburira kure y'amaso yanje, mpeze ndayigire iciro ry'umugani n'agatwengo mu bihugu vyose. Iyi ngoro naho ari agakura, uwozoca hafi yayo wese azomaramara, avuge ati: “Ni kuki Umukama yagiriye gutyo iki gihugu n'iyo ngoro?” Bazovuga bati: “Ni uko bahevye Umukama Imana ya ba sekuru babo yari yabakuye mu gihugu ca Misiri, bagafatana n'izindi mana, bagakubita inkoro hasi imbere yazo, kandi bakazikorera; ni co gituma Umukama yabasutseko ayo mabi yose”.»

Imyaka mirongo ibiri yarangiye Salomo amaze kwubaka Ingoro y'Umukama, n'ingoro yiwe nyene irangiye. Hanyuma Salomo yongera kwubaka ibisagara Huramu yari yamuhaye, aca abigereramwo bene Israyeli. Salomo atera Hamati Tsoba, aca arahigarurira. Yubaka Tadimori mu bugaragwa, yubaka n'ibisagara vyose vy'ubushinguro i Hamati. Yubaka Beti Horoni ya ruguru na Beti Horoni y'epfo, ibisagara bizitijwe impome zikomeye ziriko n'inzugi n'ibihindizo. Yubaka na Bahalati, ibisagara vyose vy'ubushinguro vya Salomo, ibisagara vyose vy'imikogote, ibisagara vy'abagendera ku mafarasi, n'ico cose Salomo yari yashimye kwubaka i Yeruzalemu, i Libani no mu gihugu cose yaganza. Abantu bose bari basigaye mu Baheti, mu Bemori, mu Baperizi, mu Bahivi no mu Bayebusi badakomoka muri Israyeli, mu bahungu babo bari basigaye mu gihugu batari bahonejwe na bene Israyeli, Salomo yaciye abatwara, abazigira ku bikorwa vy'umuruho gushika n'ubu. Ariko muri bene Israyeli nta bo Salomo yakoresheje nk'abaja, kuko bari abantu bagenewe kurwana, abakuru b'intwazangabo ziwe, abakuru b'imikogote yiwe, n'abagendera ku mafarasi biwe. Abari abakuru b'intwazangabo z'umwami Salomo, bari amajana abiri na mirongo itanu bategeka mu gihugu. Salomo adugana umwigeme wa Farawoni, amuvana mu Gisagara ca Dawudi, amujana mu ngoro yari yamwubakiye, kuko yavuga ati: «Umugore wanje ntiyoba mu ngoro ya Dawudi, umwami w'Israyeli, kuko aho Isandugu ry'Umukama ryinjiye ni heranda.» Araheza Salomo aherereza Umukama inkuka ku ruhimbi rw'Umukama yari yarubatse imbere y'urwinjiriro. Yama azihereza ku musi ku musi akurikije ivyagenywe n'itegeko rya Musa, ku masabato, mu mboneko z'ukwezi no ku misi mikuru yagenywe gatatu mu mwaka ari yo: umusi mukuru w'Imikate itambiye, umusi mukuru w'Amayinga n'umusi mukuru w'Insago. Agena imigwi y'abaherezankuka mu bikorwa vyabo akurikije ingingo ya se wiwe Dawudi; agena n'Abalevi ku mirimo yabo y'uguhayagiza n'ugukorera imbere y'abaherezankuka bakurikije ivyagenywe, ku musi ku musi; agena n'abasangarembo bakuranwa ku migwi kw'irembo ryose kuko ari ryo ryari itegeko rya Dawudi, umuntu w'Imana. Ntibarenze itegeko ry'umwami ku vyerekeye abaherezankuka, Abalevi, ikintu ico ari co cose be no mu vyerekeye amatungo. Uko ni ko igikorwa cose ca Salomo categuwe gushika ku musi umushinge w'Ingoro y'Umukama washingwa no gushika kw'isozerwa ryayo. Ni uko, Ingoro y'Umukama iruzura. Hanyuma Salomo agenda i Hetsiyoni Geberi n'i Elati, ku nkombe y'ikiyaga mu ntara ya Edomu. Huramu amurungikanira abasuku biwe amato n'abasuku bazi ikiyaga. Bagenda muri Ofiri bari kumwe n'abasuku ba Salomo, bakurayo inzahabu zingana n'amatarenta amajana ane na mirongo itanu, bazizanira umwami Salomo.

Umwamikazi w'i Sheba, yumva bavuga ukuntu Salomo ari rurangiranwa, araheza aja i Yeruzalemu kugira ngo amugeragereshe ibisokozo bigoye. Yari kumwe n'ingabo nyinshi kandi zihambaye, ingamiya zikoreye ibimoga neza, inzahabu nyinshi cane, n'amabuye y'agaciro. Ashitse kwa Salomo, amuyagira iryari ku mutima ryose. Salomo amusigurira amajambo yose amubajije; nta jambo na rimwe rihinyitse Salomo atashoboye kumusigurira. Umwamikazi w'i Sheba abonye ubwitonzi bwa Salomo, akabona n'ingoro yari yarubatse, imfungurwa zo ku meza yiwe, uburaro bw'abasuku biwe, icubahiro c'abafasha biwe n'inyambaro yabo, abamuhereza inyobwa n'inyambaro yabo, inkuka yaherereza mu Ngoro y'Umukama, arumirwa. Abwira umwami ati: «Amajambo numvise bavuga mu gihugu canje, yerekeye amajambo yawe n'ubwitonzi bwawe, ni ay'ukuri. Sinari naremeye amajambo yabo gushika ndahishikiye ngo amaso yanje abibone; none raba nta n'igice c'ubwitonzi bwawe bwinshi bari baramenyesheje. Urarengeje ivyo numvise bavuga. Emwe, abantu bawe barahiriwe! Emwe, abasuku bawe barahiriwe bo bama bahagaze imbere yawe bumviriza ubwitonzi bwawe. Umukama Imana yawe nahezagirwe, we yagushimye akakuvyagiza ku ntebe yiwe y'ubwami, kugira ngo ube umwami ku bw'Umukama Imana yawe. Nkako urukundo Imana yawe ikunda Israyeli kugira ngo iyihangaze na ntaryo, rwatumye ikwimika ngo ube umwami wabo, ngo ushinge ingingo n'ubutungane.» Umwamikazi ashikanira umwami amatarenta ijana na mirongo ibiri y'inzahabu, ibimoga neza vyinshi cane n'amabuye y'agaciro. Nta bimoga neza binganya ubwinshi ivyo umwamikazi w'i Sheba yashikaniye umwami Salomo vyongeye gushikanwa. Vyongeye, abasuku ba Huramu n'abasuku ba Salomo bari bavanye inzahabu muri Ofiri, baje bazanye kandi ibiti vy'imilegumimu n'amabuye y'agaciro. Ivyo biti vy'imilegumimu, umwami abikoramwo ingazi z'Ingoro y'Umukama n'iz'ingoro y'umwami; abikoramwo kandi inanga n'amakembe vy'abaririmvyi. Nta biti nk'ivyo vyari bwigere biboneka mu gihugu c'Ubuyuda imbere y'aho. Umwami Salomo na we agabira umwamikazi w'i Sheba ico yipfuje gusaba cose, ata ho bisaniye n'ivyo yari yazanye. Hanyuma nya mwamikazi aragaruka asubira mu gihugu ciwe, kumwe n'abasuku biwe. Uburiba bw'inzahabu Salomo yaronka mu mwaka, bwangana n'amatarenta y'inzahabu amajana atandatu na mirongo itandatu, umuntu adaharuye ivyava mu bagenda barabunza, no mu rudandazwa rw'abacuruzi. Abami bose bo muri Arabiya n'ivyariho vy'umwami mu gihugu baguma bazanira Salomo inzahabu n'ifeza. Umwami Salomo acurisha inkinzo nininini amajana abiri mu nzahabu inoze; ku nkinzo yose hakoreshwa amashekeli amajana atandatu y'inzahabu inoze. Acurisha n'inkinzo ntonto amajana atatu mu nzahabu inoze; ku nkinzo yose hakoreshwa amashekeli amajana atatu. Umwami abishira muri ya ngoro yitwa Ikibira c'i Libani. Umwami akoresha kandi intebe y'ubwami nini mu masenge y'inzovu, ayisigako inzahabu ityoroye. Iyo ntebe y'ubwami yari ifise ingazi zitandatu, ikagira icuririzo gikozwe mu nzahabu. Yari ifise amaboko hirya no hino y'aho bicara, ikagira intare zibiri zihagaze iruhande y'ayo maboko, n'izindi ntare icumi na zibiri zari zihagaze hirya no hino y'izo ngazi zitandatu. Nta kintu na kimwe gisa n'ico cari bwigere gikorwa mu bwami na bumwe. Ibikoresho vyose umwami Salomo yakoresha mu kunywa vyari bikozwe mu nzahabu, n'ibikoresho vyose vyo muri ya ngoro yitwa Ikibira c'i Libani vyari bikozwe mu nzahabu ityoroye, kuko ifeza nta co yari imaze, mu gihe ca Salomo. Nkako amato y'umwami yaza araja i Tarashishi hamwe n'abasuku ba Huramu, kandi rimwe mu myaka itatu ayo mato yava i Tarashishi azanye inzahabu, ifeza, amasenge y'inzovu, inguge n'inyoni zitwa tuki. Umwami Salomo aba umwami aruta abami bose bo kw'isi mu butunzi no mu bwitonzi. Abami bose bo kw'isi barondera kubona Salomo kugira ngo bumvirize ubwitonzi Imana yari yashize mu mutima wiwe. Umuntu wese yaza azanye ishikanwa ryiwe, ibikoresho vy'ifeza, ibikoresho vy'inzahabu, ivyambarwa, ibirwanisho, ibimoga neza, amafarasi n'indogobwe, ivyo bikaba ku mwaka ku mwaka. Salomo yari afise impongore ibihumbi bine z'amafarasi n'imikogote hamwe n'abagendera ku mafarasi ibihumbi icumi na bibiri; abajana mu bisagara bibikwamwo imikogote n'i Yeruzalemu, hafi y'umwami. Araheza aganza abami bose, kuva ku ruzi Ewufrati gushika ku ntara y'Abafilisti no gushika ku rubibe rwa Misiri. Umwami akwiza i Yeruzalemu ifeza gushika aho imera nk'amabuye, agwiza n'amasederi gushika aho angana n'ibiti vy'imishikama vyo mu kiyaya. Amafarasi ya Salomo bayakura mu Misiri no mu bindi bihugu vyose. Ibisigaye vyerekeye Salomo, kuva ku ntango gushika ku mpera, mbega ntivyanditse mu vyavuzwe n'umuhanuzi Natani, mu vyabuwe na Ahiya w'i Silo no mu vyo rumenyi Yehido yabonye mu ndoto biraba Yerobowamu mwene Nebati? Salomo aganza Israyeli yose imyaka mirongo ine, aba i Yeruzalemu. Hanyuma Salomo ahamvya ba sekuru biwe, afubwa mu gisagara ca se wiwe Dawudi. Umuhungu wiwe Rehobowamu aca aba umwami mu kibanza ciwe.

Rehobowamu agenda i Sikemu kuko Israyeli yose yari yagiye i Sikemu ngo imwimike abe umwami. Igihe Yerobowamu mwene Nebati yavyumva, yari akiri mu Misiri aho yari yarahungiye ava imbere y'umwami Salomo. Yerobowamu aca arahunguka ava mu Misiri. Batuma abaja kumuhamagara. Hanyuma Yerobowamu arashika ari kumwe n'Israyeli yose, bashikiriza ijambo Rehobowamu, bavuga bati: «So wawe yaraturemereje umutwaro, ubu na we, nuturemurure ibikorwa biruhije vya so wawe, n'umutwaro yaturemereje, tuzoheza tugukorere.» Ababwira ati: «Muragaruke iwanje mu misi itatu.» Abo bantu baca baragenda. Umwami Rehobowamu ahanuza abakurambere bahora bakorera se wiwe Salomo mu gihe yari akiriho, avuga ati: «Mumpanuye iki noja kwishura abo bantu?» Bamushikiriza ijambo, bavuga bati: «Niwamerera neza abo bantu, ukabanezereza, ukababwira amajambo meza, bazokubera abasuku imisi yose.» Ariko Rehobowamu arakengera impanuro abakurambere bamuhanuye, aca ahanuza imisore bari barakuranye, kandi yamukorera. Hanyuma ayibwira ati: «Muhanuye iki nokwishura iki gihugu canshikirije ijambo kivuga kiti: “Turemurure umutwaro so wawe yaturemereje”?» Ya misore bari barakuranye imubwira iti: «Ng'uku uko uzobwira abo bantu bakubwiye bati: “So wawe yaraturemereje umutwaro none wewe nuwuturemurure!” Urababwira uti: “Urutoke rwanje rw'uruhererezi, ruravyibushe kurusha amafyigo ya data. Ubu rero, data yarabaremereje umutwaro, jeho nzokwongereza umutwaro wanyu! Data yarabahanishije ibimoko, jeho nzobahanisha ibimoko biriko amagera”.» Yerobowamu n'igihugu cose baza kwa Rehobowamu ku musi ugira gatatu, nk'uko umwami yari yabivuze ati: «Muzogaruke iwanje ku musi ugira gatatu.» Umwami yishura akaze, umwami Rehobowamu akengera impanuro ya ba bakurambere, abishura akurikije impanuro ya ya misore, avuga ati: «Nzobaremeka umutwaro uremereye kandi nzowongereza! Data yabahanisha ibimoko, jeho nzobahanisha ibimoko biriko amagera.» Umwami ntiyumviriza igihugu; kuko uko ibintu vyagenda vyatumwa n'Imana, kugira ngo Umukama arangure ijambo ryiwe yari yarabwiye Yerobowamu mwene Nebati, aciye kuri Ahiya w'i Silo. Israyeli yose irabona ko umwami atabumvirije, igihugu cishura umwami kivuga kiti: «Mbega intoranwa dufise kwa Dawudi, ni iyihe? Nta n'iragi dufise kwa mwene Yese! Israyeli we, umuntu wese nasubire mu mahema yawe! Dawudi na we, ubu raba inzu yawe!» Israyeli yose rero igenda mu mahema yayo. Bene Israyeli baba mu bisagara vy'Ubuyuda, Rehobowamu aba ari we abaganza. Umwami Rehobowamu atuma Hadoramu yari ashinzwe ibikorwa vy'umuruho, ariko bene Israyeli bamutera amabuye, arapfa; umwami Rehobowamu aca aranyaruka, yurira umukogote, ahungira i Yeruzalemu. Israyeli igarariza umuryango wa Dawudi, gushika n'ubu.

Rehobowamu ashitse i Yeruzalemu akoranya umuryango wa Yuda n'uwa Benyamini, atoramwo imisore ibihumbi ijana na mirongo umunani izi kurwana, kugira ngo irwanye Israyeli, ngo igarurire ubwami Rehobowamu. Niho rero Umukama yashikiriza ijambo Shemahiya, umuntu w'Imana, avuga ati: «Bwira Rehobowamu mwene Salomo, umwami w'Ubuyuda, na bene Israyeli bose bari mu Buyuda no mu Bubenyamini uti: “Ng'uku uko Umukama avuze: 'Ntimuduge kurwanya benewanyu. Umwe wese nasubire i muhira kuko ivyo bintu vyabaye bitumwe nanje'”.» Bumvise ijambo ry'Umukama, baciye bareka kuja kurwanya Yerobowamu. Rehobowamu aba i Yeruzalemu, yubaka ibisagara bikomeye mu Buyuda. Yubaka Betelehemu, Hetamu, Tekowa, Beti Tsuri, Soko, Hadulamu, Gati, Maresha, Zifu, Adorayimu, Lakishi, Hazeka, Tsoreya, Ayaloni na Heburoni. Ivyo ni vyo bisagara bikomeye vyo mu Buyuda no mu Bubenyamini. Arakomeza inzitiro z'impome, aca abishiramwo abatware, ibigega vy'ibifungurwa, amavuta n'umuvinyu. Mu gisagara cose harimwo inkinzo n'amacumu; arabikomeza cane rwose. Ubuyuda n'Ububenyamini biba ivyiwe. Abaherezankuka n'Abalevi bari muri Israyeli yose baza iruhande yiwe bavuye mu ntara yabo yose; nkako, Abalevi bari barahevye uburagiro n'amatongo vyabo, baja mu Buyuda n'i Yeruzalemu kuko Yerobowamu n'abahungu biwe bari barabakuye mu buherezankuka bw'Umukama. Yerobowamu yigenera abaherezankuka biwe bashinzwe ibitabo, ibigirwamana vy'amasuguru n'ibimasa yihinguriye. Mu nyuma zabo haza abavuye mu bisata vyose vy'Israyeli bafise umutima w'uguhurumbira Umukama Imana y'Israyeli, baca bagenda i Yeruzalemu, kugira ngo bahereze imbagwa Umukama Imana ya ba sekuru babo. Barakomeza ubwami bwa Yuda kandi barashigikira Rehobowamu mwene Salomo, igihe c'imyaka itatu, kuko yagendeye mu nzira ya Dawudi na Salomo ikiringo c'imyaka itatu. Rehobowamu yabira umugore yitwa Mahalati, umukobwa wa Yerimoti mwene Dawudi na Abihayili, umukobwa wa Eliyabu mwene Yese. Amuvyarira abahungu ari bo Yehushi, Shemariya na Zahamu. Mu nyuma ziwe yabiriye Mahaka, umukobwa wa Abusalomu, na we amuvyarira Abiya, Hatayi, Ziza na Shelomiti. Rehobowamu akunda Mahaka, umukobwa wa Abusalomu kuruta abagore biwe bose n'abahabara biwe; kuko yabiriye abagore icumi n'umunani, akagira n'abahabara mirongo itandatu; avyara abahungu mirongo ibiri n'umunani n'abakobwa mirongo itandatu. Rehobowamu aca agena Abiya, umuhungu yavyaye kuri Mahaka, ngo abe ari we aba mukuru muri benewabo kuko ari we yashaka ko aba umwami. Araheza agira ubwenge bwo gukwiragiza abahungu biwe mu ntara zose z'Ubuyuda n'iz'Ububenyamini, mu bisagara vyose bikomeye; abaha ivyo bazorya vyinshi, abasabira n'abagore benshi.

Ubwami bwa Rehobowamu bumaze gushinga imizi kandi na we nyene agatsimbatara, yaciye aheba itegeko ry'Umukama, na Israyeli yose ija kumwe na we. Mu mwaka ugira gatanu, Rehobowamu ari ku ngoma, Shishaki, umwami wa Misiri, atera Yeruzalemu, kuko bari bahemutse ku Mukama. Araheza atera afise imikogote igihumbi n'amajana abiri, abarwanira ku mafarasi ibihumbi mirongo itandatu n'abantu batagira igitigiri bavanye mu Misiri: Abanyalibiya, Abasukiyimu n'Abakushi. Yigarurira ibisagara bikomeye vyose vy'Ubuyuda, mbere ashika n'i Yeruzalemu. Umuhanuzi Shemahiya agenda kwa Rehobowamu n'abatware bo mu Buyuda bari bakoraniye i Yeruzalemu bahunze Shishaki, ababwira ati: «Ng'uku uko Umukama avuze: mwebwe mwarampevye, none nanje nabahevye ngo mugwe mu minwe ya Shishaki.» Abatware b'Israyeli n'umwami bicisha bugufi bavuga bati: «Umukama ni intungane.» Umukama abonye ko bicishije bugufi, ijambo ry'Umukama rishikira Shemahiya rivuga riti: «Bicishije bugufi, sinzobatikiza, nzobarokora riho, kandi n'ishavu ryanje ntirizokwisuka kuri Yeruzalemu riciye kuri Shishaki. Ariko bazoba abasuku biwe, bazoheza bamenye igikorwa canje n'igikorwa c'ubwami bw'ibihugu.» Shishaki, umwami wa Misiri, aduga kurwanya Yeruzalemu. Atwara amatungo y'Ingoro y'Umukama n'amatungo y'ingoro y'umwami, ayatwara yose. Atwarana n'inkinzo z'inzahabu Salomo yari yarakoze. Umwami Rehobowamu akora inkinzo z'imiringa zisubirira izo z'inzahabu, azishira mu minwe y'abakuru b'abacungerezi barinda urwinjiriro rw'ingoro y'umwami. Igihe cose umwami yagenda mu Ngoro y'Umukama, abo bacungerezi baraza, bakazijana, hanyuma bagahava bazigarukana mu cumba c'abacungerezi. Kubera ko umwami yari yicishije bugufi, ishavu ry'Umukama ryaciye riva kuri we, kugira ngo ntatikize rwose, kuko mu Buyuda hari hakiriyo ibintu vyiza. Umwami Rehobowamu aratsimbatara i Yeruzalemu kandi araganza. Nkako Rehobowamu yari afise imyaka mirongo ine n'umwe igihe yaba umwami, araheza aganza imyaka icumi n'indwi, ari i Yeruzalemu, igisagara Umukama yitoreye mu bisata vyose vy'Israyeli, ngo agishiremwo izina ryiwe. Nyina wiwe yari umuhamonikazi yitwa Nahama. Akora inabi, kuko atashize ku mutima ukurondera Umukama. Amajambo ya Rehobowamu, kuva ku ya mbere gushika ku ya nyuma, mbega ntiyanditse mu majambo y'umuhanuzi Shemahiya na rumenyi Hido, akandikwa uko yagiye arakurikirana? Intambara za Rehobowamu na Yerobowamu zagumyeho igihe cose. Hanyuma Rehobowamu ahamvya ba sekuru. Afubwa mu Gisagara ca Dawudi. Umuhungu wiwe Abiya aba ari we aba umwami mu kibanza ciwe.

Mu mwaka ugira icumi n'umunani, Yerobowamu ari ku ngoma, Abiya aba umwami w'Ubuyuda. Aganza imyaka itatu ari i Yeruzalemu. Nyina wiwe yitwa Mikaya, umukobwa wa Uriyeli w'i Gibeya. Hanyuma haba intambara hagati ya Abiya na Yerobowamu. Abiya atangura intambara ari kumwe n'ingabo z'intwari mu rugamba. Bari abagabo b'intwari ibihumbi amajana ane. Yerobowamu na we atonda ku rugamba ngo amurwanye, ari kumwe n'abagabo b'intwari ibihumbi amajana umunani, abarwanyi b'intwari. Abiya ahagarara hejuru ku musozi witwa Tsemarayimu uri mu mitumba ya Efurayimu, araheza avuga ati: «Nyumviriza Yerobowamu, na we Israyeli yose. Mbega ntimuzi ko Umukama Imana y'Israyeli yahaye ubwami Dawudi ngo aganze Israyeli na ntaryo, akabuha we n'abahungu biwe, mw'isezerano ry'umunyu? Yerobowamu mwene Nebati, umusuku wa Salomo mwene Dawudi, yarahagurutse, agarariza shebuja. Abantu ata co bamaze, abantu b'imburakimazi, baciye bakoranira iwe, barishigikira ngo bagararize Rehobowamu mwene Salomo; Rehobowamu na we, kubera ko yari akiri muto kandi ataragira umutima rugabo, ntiyashoboye guhangana na bo. Ubu muvuga ko muzohangana n'ubwami bw'Umukama buri mu minwe ya bene Dawudi. Muri ingabo isinzi kandi mufise amashuri y'inzahabu Yerobowamu yabahinguriye ngo ni zo mana zanyu. None ntimwataye hanze abaherezankuka b'Umukama, ari bo bene Aroni n'Abalevi, hanyuma mukigirira mwebwe nyene abaherezankuka nka kurya kw'ibindi bihugu vyo kw'isi? Uwo ari we wese yaza azanye impfizi, ikimasa, impfizi z'intama indwi ngo yatirwe, yaca aba umuherezankuka w'ibitari Imana. Tweho, Umukama ni we Mana yacu, kandi ntitwamuhevye; abaherezankuka bakorera Umukama ni bene Aroni n'Abalevi bari mu bikorwa vyabo. Imisi yose mu gitondo n'imisi yose ku mugoroba bama bahereza Umukama inkuka, ibimoga neza, bagatondeka imikate ku meza atyoroye, bagategura intebe y'amatara y'inzahabu n'amatara yayo, kugira ngo yame yaka imisi yose ku mugoroba, kuko twebwe twama tuzigama amabwirizwa y'Umukama Imana yacu, ariko mwebwe mukaba mwaramuhevye. Ehe Imana iri kumwe natwe ni yo iturongora be n'abaherezankuka bayo bafise inzamba z'ugutanga ikimenyetso c'ukurwanya mwebwe. Banyisrayeli mwe, ntimurwanye Umukama Imana ya ba sokuru banyu, kuko nta co muzoshikako.» Yerobowamu arungika abaja kubibundira ngo babatere babaturutse inyuma. Abanyisrayeli bari bahanganye n'Abayuda, abibunze na bo bakaba inyuma y'Abayuda. Abayuda barahindukira, babona urugamba rubugarije imbere n'inyuma, baraheza batabaza Umukama, abaherezankuka na bo bariko baravuza inzamba. Abantu bo mu Buyuda biha akamo. Hanyuma abantu bo mu Buyuda bamaze kwiha akamo, Imana itsindira Yerobowamu n'Abanyisrayeli bose mu maso ya Abiya n'Abayuda. Abanyisrayeli barahunga, bava imbere y'Abayuda, Imana na yo ibata mu minwe yabo. Abiya n'abantu biwe barabatsinda barabagotsa. Mu Banyisrayeli hatikira abantu ibihumbi amajana atanu b'intwari. Abanyisrayeli baracuba muri ico gihe, Abayuda bo baratsinda kuko bari bishimikije Umukama Imana ya ba sekuru babo. Abiya akinagiza Yerobowamu, anyaga ibisagara vyiwe ari vyo Beteli n'ibigwati vyaco, Yeshana n'ibigwati vyaco na Hefuroni n'ibigwati vyaco. Yerobowamu aguma aho ata bukomezi afise mu gihe ca Abiya. Umukama aramuhana, arapfa. Abiya we aratsimbatara, yabira abagore icumi na bane, avyara abahungu mirongo ibiri na babiri n'abakobwa icumi na batandatu. Ibisigaye vyerekeye Abiya, imigenzo yiwe n'amajambo vyiwe, vyanditse mu vyavuzwe n'umuhanuzi Hido. Abiya ahamvya ba sekuru biwe, bamushingura mu Gisagara ca Dawudi. Umuhungu wiwe Asa aba umwami mu kibanza ciwe. Ku ngoma yiwe, igihugu kiratekana mu gihe c'imyaka icumi.

Asa akora ivyiza n'ibigororotse mu maso y'Umukama Imana yiwe. Akuraho icitwa uruhimbi cose rw'abanyamahanga, ibitabo, amenagura inkingi z'amabuye, asenyura ibigirwamana vyitwa Ashera; ategeka Yuda kurondera Umukama Imana ya ba sekuru babo, n'ukurangura itegeko n'ayandi mabwirizwa. Mu bisagara vyose vy'Ubuyuda, akuraho ibitabo n'uruhimbi rwose rw'imibavu. Maze ubwami buratekana buhagarikiwe na we. Yubaka mu Buyuda ibisagara bizitijwe amabuye, kuko igihugu cari gitekanye kandi nta ndwano yigeze agira muri iyo myaka, kuko Umukama yari yamuhaye impore. Abwira rero Abayuda ati: «Nimuze twubake ibi bisagara, tubikikuze uruhome ruriko iminara, inzugi n'ibihindizo, umwanya tukirongoye igihugu, kuko twarondeye Umukama Imana yacu; twaramurondeye na we araduha impore hirya no hino.» Maze barubaka baraheza. Asa yari afise ingabo zigizwe n'abantu ibihumbi amajana atatu ziva mu Buyuda zitwara inkinzo n'amacumu, n'ingabo zigizwe n'abantu ibihumbi amajana abiri na mirongo umunani ziva kwa Benyamini, zitwara ibitembe kandi zizi kurasisha umuheto, abo bose bakaba abarwanyi b'intwari. Zerahi, umukushi, agenda kubatera n'ingabo zigizwe n'abantu umuriyoni hamwe n'imikogote amajana atatu, aragenda gushika i Maresha. Asa na we agenda kumutangira, batonda ku rugamba mu kiyaya ca Tsefata, hafi y'i Maresha. Asa araheza atakambira Umukama Imana yiwe, avuga ati: «Mukama, nta wundi atari wewe, ashobora gutabara hagati y'intwari n'uwutagira ubukomezi. Dutabare rero Mukama Mana yacu, kuko ari wewe twishimikije kandi tukaba twaje kurwanya izi ngabo kw'izina ryawe. Mukama, ni wewe uri Imana yacu. Ntureke ngo umuntu agutsinde.» Umukama atsindira Abakushi mu maso ya Asa n'Abayuda, Abakushi barahunga. Asa n'ingabo zari kumwe na we barabakinagiza gushika i Gerari. Abakushi baratikira, ntihagira n'umwe asigara ari muzima muri bo, kuko bahoneye mu maso y'Umukama no mu maso y'ingabo ziwe. Asa n'ingabo ziwe batwara ibinyagano vyinshi cane. Batikiza ibisagara vyose vyari bikikije Gerari, kuko vyari vyatekewe n'ubwoba ku gutinya Umukama; basahura ibisagara vyose, kuko harimwo ivyo gusahura vyinshi. Baraheza basambura impongore z'ibitungwa, banyaga ibitungwa bitobito vyinshi hamwe n'ingamiya, baraheza basubira i Yeruzalemu.

Umutima w'Imana uza kuri Hazariya mwene Hodedi, araheza agenda imbere ya Asa, amubwira ati: «Nyumviriza, Asa, namwe mwese Bayuda n'Ababenyamini! Umukama aba kumwe namwe igihe namwe muri kumwe na we. Nimwamurondera, azobiyereka. Nimwamuheba, na we azobaheba. Israyeli yamaze imisi myinshi itari kumwe n'Imana y'ukuri, ata muherezankuka yigisha, ata n'itegeko ririho. Ariko mu marushwa yabo baragaruye agatima ku Mukama Imana y'Israyeli, baramurondera, na we arareka baramutora. Muri ico gihe, nta mahoro yari ahari ku wasohoka no ku winjira, kuko hari uruhagarara rwinshi mu baba muri ivyo bihugu. Bama bariko baravungagurana, igihugu kirwana n'igihugu, igisagara kirwana n'igisagara, kuko Imana yari yabahanishije amarushwa y'ubwoko bwose. Ariko mweho, nimukomere ntimucike inkokora, kuko hariho impembo y'ibikorwa vyanyu.» Asa, amaze kwumva ayo majambo, n'inyigisho z'umuhanuzi Hodedi, aca aronka ubukomezi, akura ibigirwamana mu ntara yose ya Yuda n'iya Benyamini, no mu bisagara vyose yari yigaruriye ku musozi Efurayimu, yongera kwubaka uruhimbi rw'Umukama rwari imbere y'urwinjiriro rw'Umukama. Araheza akoranya Abayuda bose n'Ababenyamini, hamwe n'inyambukira zari kumwe na bo zava kwa Efurayimu, kwa Manase no kwa Simeho. Nkako abari bifatanije na we bava muri Israyeli bari benshi, aho baboneye ko Umukama Imana yiwe, ari kumwe na we. Bakoranira i Yeruzalemu mu kwezi kugira gatatu, mu mwaka ugira icumi na gatanu, Asa ari ku ngoma. Uyo musi bahereza imbagwa Umukama mu vyo bari basahuye bakazana: impfizi amajana indwi n'ibitungwa bitobito ibihumbi indwi. Bagira isezerano ry'ukurondera Umukama Imana ya ba sekuru babo, n'umutima wabo wose, n'umushaha wabo wose. Uwo wese atarondera Umukama Imana ya Israyeli yategerezwa kwicwa, kuva ku muto gushika ku mukuru, kuva ku mugabo gushika ku mugore. Baraheza barahira Umukama n'ijwi rirenga, batera impundu, bavuza urumbete n'inzamba. Hanyuma Abayuda bose buzura akanyamuneza kubera iyo ndahiro, kuko bari barahiye n'umutima wabo wose kandi barondeye Umukama n'ugushaka kwabo kwose, na we arareka baramutora, aca abaha impore hirya no hino. Umwami Asa akura na inakuru wiwe Mahaka mu bugabekazi kuko yari yahinguye ikigirwamana citwa Ashera. Asa atembagaza ico kigirwamana, akigira ubunywenywe, agituririra ku mugezi wa Kideroni. Ariko ibitabo ntivyazimanganye muri Israyeli, naho umutima wa Asa wagumye ugororotse igihe cose yamaze. Azana mu Ngoro y'Imana ibintu se wiwe yeguriye Imana hamwe n'ibintu yeguriye Imana we nyene; ifeza, inzahabu n'ibindi bikoresho. Nta ntambara yasubiye kuba gushika ku mwaka wa mirongo itatu n'itanu Asa ari ku ngoma.

Mu mwaka ugira mirongo itatu na gatandatu Asa ari ku ngoma, Bahisha, umwami w'Israyeli, aduga kurwanya Ubuyuda. Yubaka Rama kugira ngo abuze Asa, umwami w'Ubuyuda, kuza aramwinjirira mu bwami. Asa afata ifeza n'inzahabu mu matungo y'Ingoro y'Umukama no mu y'ingoro y'umwami, abirungikira Benehadadi, umwami wa Aramu, yaba i Damasi, avuga ati: «Nihabe isezerano hagati yanje nawe nk'uko ryamye hagati ya data na so wawe! Ehe raba ndakurungikiye ifeza n'inzahabu, none genda uhebe isezerano rya mwe na Bahisha, umwami w'Israyeli, kugira ngo amvireho.» Benehadadi yumvira umwami Asa, arungika abakuru b'ingabo ziwe kurwanya ibisagara vy'Israyeli. Batsinda Hiyoni, Dani, Abeli Mayimu n'ubushinguro bwose bw'ibisagara vya Nefutali. Bahisha acumva iyo nkuru, aca araheba kwubaka Rama, ahagarika igikorwa ciwe. Hanyuma umwami Asa ahitana Abayuda bose, baseha amabuye y'i Rama n'ibiti Bahisha yari yarubakishije, aca avyubakisha Geba na Mitsipa. Muri ico gihe, rumenyi Hanani aza kwa Asa, umwami w'Ubuyuda, amubwira ati: «Ko wishimiye umwami wa Aramu, ntiwishimire Umukama Imana yawe, none rero ingabo z'umwami wa Aramu zaguciye mu myanya y'intoke. Abakushi n'Abanyalibiya ugira ngo ntibari ingabo nyinshi, zifise imikogote n'abagendera ku mafarasi bahambaye cane? Ariko kubera ko wari wishimiye Umukama, yarabataye mu minwe yawe. Nkako amaso y'Umukama yama ariko arihweza kw'isi yose ngo akomeze abamwerekezako umutima ugororotse. Muri ivyo, wakoze nk'umusazi; ni co gituma, kuva ubu, hagiye kwama hari intambara iwawe.» Hanyuma Asa arashavurira uwo rumenyi, mbere amushira mu nzu y'ibohero kuko yari ashavujwe n'ayo majambo. Kandi ico gihe, Asa aca aza aracinyiza bamwebamwe bo mu gihugu. Ivyakozwe na Asa, kuva ku ntango gushika ku mpera, vyanditse mu gitabu c'abami b'Ubuyuda n'ab'Israyeli. Asa arwara amaguru mu mwaka ugira mirongo itatu n'icenda ari ku ngoma, gushika aho indwara yiwe ikomera cane. Ariko n'igihe yari arwaye, ntiyigeze yirukira Umukama, ahubwo yirukiye abandi bavuzi. Asa ahamvya ba sekuru biwe, apfa mu mwaka ugira mirongo ine na rimwe ari ku ngoma. Bamufuba mu mva yiwe yari yariyimbishirije mu Gisagara ca Dawudi. Bamuryamika ku buriri bwuzuye imibavu n'ubwoko bwinshi bw'ibimoga neza bivanze ku buhinga, kandi bamuturirira ibimoga neza vyinshi cane.

Umuhungu wiwe Yozafati aba umwami mu kibanza ciwe. Agira ubukomezi bwinshi kuri Israyeli. Akwiragiza ingabo ziwe mu bisagara bikomeye vy'Ubuyuda, ashira n'ivyariho mu gihugu c'Ubuyuda no mu bisagara vya Efurayimu vyari vyigaruriwe na Asa, se wiwe. Umukama aba kumwe na Yozafati kuko yagendeye mu nzira sekuru wiwe Dawudi yari yabanje kugenderamwo, ntiyirukira ibigirwamana vyitwa Bahali. Nkako yaguma arondera Imana ya sekuru wiwe, agendera amabwirizwa yayo, ntiyakora nka Israyeli. Umukama aratsimbataza inganji yiwe, Ubuyuda bwose bukaza burashikanira amashikanwa Yozafati. Aronka itunga n'ininahazwa ntangere. Umutima wiwe urahimbarwa n'inzira z'Umukama, arongera akura ibitabo n'ibigirwamana vyitwa Ashera mu Buyuda. Mu mwaka ugira gatatu ari ku ngoma, arungika abakuru biwe ari bo Benehayili, Hobadiya, Zakariya, Netaneyeli, Mikaya, ngo bigishe mu bisagara vy'Ubuyuda. Bari kumwe n'Abalevi ari bo Shemahiya, Netaniya, Zebadiya, Hasaheli, Shemiramoti, Yonatani, Adoniya, Tobiya na Tobi Adoniya. Bari kumwe kandi n'abaherezankuka ari bo Elishama na Yehoramu. Ni uko rero batanga inyigisho mu Buyuda, bitwaje Igitabu c'Itegeko ry'Umukama. Bakwiragira ibisagara vyose vy'Ubuyuda bigisha abantu. Ubwoba butewe n'Umukama bukwira ubwami bw'ibihugu vyose vyari bikikuje Ubuyuda, buraheza ntibwarwana na Yozafati. Bamwe mu Bafilisti bazanira Yozafati amashikanwa n'ifeza ry'ikori; Abarabu na bo nyene bamushikanira ibitungwa bitobito: impfizi z'intama ibihumbi indwi n'amajana indwi n'impfizi z'impene ibihumbi indwi n'amajana indwi. Ni uko rero, Yozafati aba mukuru cane, yubaka mu Buyuda inzu zikomakomeye n'ibisagara vy'ubushinguro. Arangura ibikorwa vyinshi mu bisagara vy'Ubuyuda, i Yeruzalemu naho ahafise abagabo b'abarwanyi, abarwanyi b'intwari. Ng'uru urutonde rwabo, hakurikijwe imiryango ya ba sekuru babo: kwa Yuda, mu bakuru b'imigwi y'igihumbi, Hadena ni we yari umukuru, akaba kumwe n'abarwanyi b'intwari ibihumbi amajana atatu. Igisongerezi ciwe yari Yohanani. Yari umukuru w'ingabo zigizwe n'abantu ibihumbi amajana abiri na mirongo umunani. Igisongerezi ciwe yari Hamasiya mwene Zikri. Yakorera Umukama bivuye ku gushaka kwiwe, akaba kumwe n'abarwanyi b'intwari ibihumbi amajana abiri. Kwa Benyamini havuye Eliyada, umurwanyi w'intwari. Yari kumwe n'abarwanisha imiheto n'inkinzo ibihumbi amajana abiri. Igisongerezi ciwe yari Yehozabadi. Yari kumwe n'ingabo zigizwe n'abantu ibihumbi ijana na mirongo umunani bambariye urugamba. Abo ni bo bakorera umwami, biyongera ku bo umwami yari yashize mu bisagara bizitijwe amabuye mu Buyuda bwose.

Yozafati aronka itunga n'ininahazwa ntangere. Yunga ubucuti na Akabu mu guhana umugeni. Haciye imyaka, amanuka kwa Akabu i Samariya. Akabu amubagira intama n'impfizi nyinshi, we n'abo bari kumwe. Yongera aramugondoza ngo aduge gutera Ramoti Galahadi. Akabu, umwami w'Israyeli abwira Yozafati, umwami w'Ubuyuda ati: «Mbega uzoza tujane kurwana i Ramoti Galahadi?» Amubwira ati: «Turi bamwe, jewe na wewe, ingabo zawe n'ingabo zanje ni zimwe, tuzojana ku rugamba.» Yozafati abwira umwami w'Israyeli ati: «Ndagusavye uyu musi ubanze ubaze ico ijambo ry'Umukama ribivugako!» Umwami w'Israyeli akoranya abahanuzi, bari nk'abagabo amajana ane, ababwira ati: «Tugende kurwana i Ramoti Galahadi, canke ndeke?» Bamubwira bati: «Genda, Imana izogita mu minwe y'umwami.» Yozafati avuga ati: «Mbega nta muhanuzi w'Umukama ari ngaha twocako mu guhanuza?» Umwami w'Israyeli abwira Yozafati ati: «Haracariho umuntu umwe twocako mu guhanuza Umukama, ariko jewe ndamwanka kuko atigera abona ineza ku binyerekeye, atari inabi gusa yama amburira. Na we ni Mishe mwene Yimula!» Yozafati avuga ati: «Umwami ntakavuge uko.» Umwami w'Israyeli ahamagara umukevyi umwe, amubwira ati: «Rengukana ningoga Mishe mwene Yimula!» Umwami w'Israyeli na Yozafati, umwami w'Ubuyuda, bicara umwumwe wese ku ntebe yiwe y'ubwami, bambaye ivyambarwa vy'ubwami, bari ku nama, mu rwinjiriro rw'irembo rya Samariya. Ba bahanuzi bose na bo bakaza baravuga ka bahanuzi imbere yabo. Sedesiyasi mwene Kenahana, yari yicurishirije amahembe mu vyuma, avuga ati: «Ng'uku uko Umukama avuze: aya ni yo uzoza uracumitisha Aramu gushika bahone.» Ba bahanuzi bose bahanura bimwe bavuga bati: «Genda i Ramoti Galahadi, uzotsinda, kuko Umukama azogita mu minwe y'umwami.» Intumwa yari yagiye guhamagara Mishe imushikiriza ijambo, ivuga iti: «Ehe rero, amajambo y'abahanuzi, yahurije kuri rimwe, na ryo rikabwira umwami ivyiza, none ndagusavye na we ijambo ribe irihuriza hamwe n'iryabo, uje kubura ivyiza.» Mishe avuga ati: «Ndarahiye Umukama muzima, ico Imana iza kuvuga, ni co nza kuvuga.» Ashitse aho umwami ari, umwami amubwira ati: «Mbega Mishe, tugende kurwana i Ramoti Galahadi, canke tureke?» Na we amubwira ati: «Gende, mwererwe, kuko bazotabwa mu minwe yanyu.» Umwami amubwira ati: «Nzokurahiza kangahe ngo ntihagire ikindi umbwira, kw'izina ry'Umukama atari ukuri?» Avuga ati: «Nabonye Israyeli yose ishwiragiye mu misozi nk'ubusho butagira umwungere. Niho Umukama yavuga ati: “Abo bantu ntibagira ba shebuja! Umwe wese niyisubirire i muhira iwe mu mahoro!”» Umwami w'Israyeli abwira Yozafati ati: «Sinari nakubwiye ko ata neza yigera abura ku binyerekeye atari inabi gusa?» Mishe avuga ati: «Ubu rero nimwumvirize ijambo ry'Umukama! Nabonye Umukama yicaye ku ntebe yiwe y'ubwami inteko zose zo mw'ijuru zihagaze iruhande yiwe, zimwe iburyo bwiwe, izindi ibubamfu bwiwe. Umukama avuga ati: “Mbega ni nde azohendahenda Akabu, umwami w'Israyeli ngo aduge aheze agwe i Ramoti Galahadi?” Umwe avuga uku, uwundi akavuga kuriya. Umutima urasokoroka uhagarara imbere y'Umukama, uvuga uti: “Ni jewe nzomuhendahenda”. Umukama awubwira ati: “Uzobigenza gute?” Na wo uvuga uti: “Nzogenda, mbe umutima w'ikinyoma mu kanwa k'abahanuzi biwe bose”. Umukama avuga ati: “Uramuhendahenda, kandi uzobishobora. Genda ubigenze gutyo”. Raba, ubu Umukama yashize umutima w'ikinyoma mu kanwa k'aba bahanuzi bawe. Umukama yakuvuzeko inabi.» Hanyuma Sedesiyasi mwene Kenahana aregereza, akubita Mishe kw'itama, avuga ati: «Umutima w'Umukama wavuye muri jewe kugira ngo ukuyagire, waciye hehe?» Mishe avuga ati: «Ewe, uzobibona umusi wagiye urava mu cumba uja mu kindi, winyegeza.» Umwami w'Israyeli avuga ati: «Fata Mishe, umusubize kwa Amoni, umukuru w'igisagara, no kwa Yowashi, umuhungu w'umwami. Uravuga uti: “Ng'uku uko umwami avuze: 'Nimushire uwo muntu mu nzu y'ibohero muheze mumugaburire indya z'agacinyizo n'amazi y'agacinyizoc gushika ngarutse amahoro'”!» Mishe avuga ati: «Ni ukuri, niwagaruka amahoro, Umukama ntazoba yavuze aciye kuri jewe.» Yongera avuga ati: «Yemwe bantu mwese nimuvyumve!» Umwami w'Israyeli na Yozafati, umwami w'Ubuyuda bagenda kurwana i Ramoti Galahadi. Umwami w'Israyeli abwira Yozafati ati: «Ngira niyoberanye mpeze ngende ku rugamba, ariko wewe niwambare ivyambarwa vyawe.» Umwami w'Israyeli ariyoberanya, hanyuma agenda ku rugamba. Umwami wa Aramu ategeka abakuru b'imikogote yiwe, avuga ati: «Ntihagire uwo murwanya, yaba muto, yaba mukuru, ariko murwanye umwami w'Israyeli gusa.» Abo bakuru b'imikogote babonye Yozafati bavuga bati: «Nta nkeka urya ni we mwami w'Israyeli.» Baca baramukikuza ngo bamurwanye, ariko Yozafati aca akoma induru. Umukama aramutabara, Imana ibigiza kure yiwe. Abakuru b'imikogote bamaze kubona ko atari umwami w'Israyeli, baca bamuva inyuma. Ariko umugabo umwe arasakisha arasisha umuheto, agema umwami w'Israyeli mw'iteranirizo ry'ibikingirizo vy'ivyuma yari yambaye. Umwami aca abwira uwatwara umukogote wiwe ati: «Hindukiza umukogote unkure aha hagati mu rugamba, numva vyanse.» Uyo musi intambara irakomera bituma umwami w'Israyeli aguma ahagaze mu mukogote wiwe imbere ya Aramu gushika ku mugoroba, hanyuma apfa harya izuba rirenze.

Yozafati umwami w'Ubuyuda, asubira iwe i Yeruzalemu mu mahoro. Yehu mwene rumenyi Hanani, aza gusanganira umwami Yozafati, amubwira ati: «Mbega utabara umubisha ugakunda abanka Umukama? Kubera ico, ishavu rizova ku Mukama, ryisuke kuri wewe. Ariko harabonetse ibintu vyiza iwawe, kuko waraturiye ibigirwamana vyitwa Ashera birazimangana mu gihugu, kandi ubwiriza umutima wawe kurondera Imana.» Yozafati aba i Yeruzalemu, yongera akaza aragendera igihugu, kuva i Berisheba gushika ku musozi Efurayimu, abagarura ku Mukama Imana ya ba sekuru babo. Ashinga abacamanza mu gihugu, mu bisagara vyose bikomeye vyo mu Buyuda, mu gisagara ico ari co cose. Abwira abo bacamanza ati: «Nimwihweze ico mugiye kugira, kuko ntimuzoca urubanza ku bw'umuntu, ariko ku bw'Umukama; azoba ari kumwe namwe mu gushinga ingingo. Ubu rero, ukwubaha Umukama nikubasage; nimugabe kandi mukore, kuko mu Mukama Imana yacu, nta karenganyo, nta nkunzi, nta kwakira igiturire biriho.» N'i Yeruzalemu, Yozafati, ahashinga abo atoye mu Balevi, mu baherezankuka, no mu bakuru b'imiryango ya ba sekuru y'Israyeli, ngo bashikirize ingingo y'Umukama, bongere batature amatati, bakaba i Yeruzalemu. Araheza abaha amategeko avuga ati: «Uko ni ko muzogira mwubashe Umukama, mu budahemuka, mufise umutima utunganye. Amatati yose benewanyu baba mu bisagara vyabo bazobazanira, ari ayerekeye ugusesa amaraso, ari ayerekeye ukurenga itegeko, ibwirizwa, umugenzo n'ingingo, murabagabishe kugira ngo ntibagwe mu caha imbere y'Umukama, kandi ngo ishavu ntiryisuke kuri mwebwe no kuri benewanyu. Murabigire gutyo, ntimuzogwa mu caha. Ehe, umuherezankuka Amariya azoba umukuru wanyu mu bintu vyose vyerekeye Umukama. Zebadiya mwene Isimayeli azoba indongozi y'umuryango wa Yuda, mu bintu vyose vyerekeye umwami. Abalevi na bo bazobabera abanditsi. Nimukomere kandi mukore, maze Umukama abe kumwe n'uwo wese azokora neza.»

Ivyo biheze, bene Mowabu na bene Hamoni, bari kumwe n'abo mu Bamehuni, baza kurwanya Yozafati. Haza ababurira Yozafati bavuga bati: «Hari ingabo isinzi zije kukurwanya zivuye i Aramu, hakurya y'ikiyaga, kandi ng'izo ziri i Hatsetsoni Tamari, ari yo Heni Gedi.» Yozafati agira ubwoba, aca ahindukiza amaso ngo ahanuze Umukama, atangaza kwisonzesha mu Buyuda bwose. Abo mu Buyuda barakorana ngo bambaze Umukama. Bari baturutse mu bisagara vyose vy'Ubuyuda ngo bambaze Umukama. Yozafati ahagarara hagati mw'ishengero ry'Abayuda n'ababa i Yeruzalemu, mu Ngoro y'Umukama, imbere y'imbuga ikiri nshasha, araheza avuga ati: «Mukama Mana ya ba sokuru bacu, mbega si wewe uri Imana mw'ijuru kandi si wewe uganza ubwami bwose bw'amakungu? Ubukomezi n'ububasha buri mu minwe yawe, kandi nta n'umwe yoshobora guhangana nawe. None si wewe ga Mana yacu, womoye imbere y'igihugu cawe Israyeli, ababa muri iki gihugu, ukagiha uruvyaro rwa Aburahamu, umukunzi wawe ngo ruciganzire na ntaryo? Barabaye muri co, kandi bakikwubakiramwo ingoro y'izina ryawe, bavuga bati: “Hagize icago kitugwako, inkota, ingingo iduhana, akaranda canke amapfa, tuzohagarara imbere y'iyi ngoro n'imbere yawe, kuko izina ryawe riri muri iyi ngoro, duheze tugutakambire aho turi mu marushwa, nawe uheze utwumvire, kandi udukize. None ubu, ng'abo bene Hamoni, bene Mowabu n'abo ku musozi Sehiri, bamwe wabuza Israyeli kwinjiramwo igihe yava mu gihugu ca Misiri, kubera ko itabahindukiriye kandi ntibatikize, ng'abo bariko baradusubiriza mu nkoko mu kuza kutwomora mw'itongo watwihereye. Ewe Mana yacu, mbega ntuzobafatira ingingo? Erega nta bukomezi dufise imbere y'izo ngabo isinzi zaje kuturwanya; ntituzi ico turi bukore. Ariko amaso yacu ahanze wewe”.» Abantu bose bo mu Buyuda bari bahagaze imbere y'Umukama bari kumwe n'imicuko yabo, abagore babo n'abandi bana babo. Niho rero umutima w'Umukama waza mw'ishengero hagati, uja kuri Yahaziyeli, mwene Zakariya, mwene Benaya, mwene Yehiyeli, mwene Mataniya, umulevi wo muri bene Asafu, araheza avuga ati: «Nimwumvirize neza bantu mwese bo mu Buyuda, na mwebwe muba i Yeruzalemu, nawe mwami Yozafati! Ng'uku uko Umukama ababwiye: ntimuze mutinye, kandi ntimuze mugire ubwoba imbere y'izo ngabo isinzi, kuko iyo ntambara si iyanyu, ariko ni iy'Umukama. Ejo nyene muramanuke, mubarwanye. Ng'abo bariko baraduga ku mudugo wa Tsitsi, muzobasanga ku mpera y'umubande, aharabana n'ubugaragwa bwa Yeruweli. Si mwebwe muzorwana. Muri ico gihe, muragume mu bibanza vyanyu, muhagarare, muheze mwirabire urukiza rw'Umukama ari kumwe namwe. Ewe Yuda nawe Yeruzalemu, ntimutinye kandi ntimugire ubwoba! Ejo muragende muhangane, Umukama azoba ari kumwe namwe.» Yozafati yunamika amaso hasi, Abayuda bose n'ababa i Yeruzalemu na bo bakubita inkoro hasi imbere y'Umukama imbere y'Umukama, baramusenga. Abalevi bo mu Bakehati n'abo mu Bakorahi barahaguruka kugira ngo bahayagize Umukama Imana y'Israyeli n'ijwi rirenga. Baraheza bavyuka kare mu gitondo, bagenda mu bugaragwa bwa Tekowa. Bakigenda, Yozafati arahaguruka, ababwira ati: «Nimunyumvirize bantu bo mu Buyuda na mwebwe muba i Yeruzalemu: nimwemere Umukama Imana yanyu, muzoshigikirwa! Nimwemere abahanuzi biwe, muzotsinda.» Hanyuma agisha inama igihugu, agena abaririmvyi b'Umukama kugira ngo bamuhayagize kubera umwakaka w'ubweranda bwiwe, igihe bazoba bagiye guhangana n'abafise ibirwanisho, bavuga bati: «Nimushimagize Umukama, kuko ubuntu bwiwe bwamaho imyaka yose.» Mu gihe bari batanguye indirimbo n'amashemezo, Umukama ashiraho abibundira bene Hamoni, Abamowabu n'abo ku musozi Sehiri, bari baje kurwanya Ubuyuda, baraheza baratsindwa. Bene Hamoni na bene Mowabu bahagurukira ababa ku musozi Sehiri ngo babarigite kandi babahonye. Bahejeje guhonya ababa kuri Sehiri, baca basubiranamwo, umuntu wese yica mugenziwe. Aho Abayuda bashikiye ku munara w'irerekero mu bugaragwa, baraba za ngabo, babona ni imivyimba gusa irambaraye hasi. Nta wari yarokotse. Yozafati araza kumwe n'ingabo ziwe ngo basahure ibintu vyabo, bakura muri iyo mivyimba ibintu isinzi bigizwe n'amatungo n'ibikoresho vy'agaciro. Baraseha gushika aho bibananira gutwara, kandi bamara imisi itatu basahura ivyo bintu kuko vyari isinzi. Ku musi ugira kane, bakoranira mu kabande k'Umuhezagiro, haba ari ho bahezagirira Umukama, ni co gituma ico kibanza bacise «Akabande k'Umuhezagiro» gushika n'ubu. Baraheza barahindukira, abantu bose bo mu Buyuda n'aba Yeruzalemu, basubira i Yeruzalemu mu kanyamuneza, barongowe na Yozafati, kuko Umukama yari yabanezereje mu gutsinda abansi babo. Binjira i Yeruzalemu, inanga, amakembe n'urumbete bisamirana, gushika mu Ngoro y'Umukama. Ubwoba butewe n'Umukama bushwara ubwami bwose bw'ibihugu aho bumviye ko Umukama yarwanije abansi b'Israyeli. Ubwami bwa Yozafati buratekana, Imana yiwe imuha impore hirya no hino. Uko ni ko Yozafati yatwaye Yuda. Aho yaba umwami, yari afise imyaka mirongo itatu n'itanu, hanyuma amara imyaka mirongo ibiri n'itanu ari umwami i Yeruzalemu. Nyina wiwe yitwa Hazuba, akaba umukobwa wa Shilehi. Akurikiza imigenzo ya se wiwe Asa, ntiyayiheba, akora ibigororotse mu maso y'Umukama. Ariko ibitabo ntivyavuyeho, kandi abantu ntibari bwashire imitima yabo ku Mana ya ba sekuru babo. Ibisigaye vyerekeye Yozafati, kuva ku ntango gushika ku mpera, vyanditse mu vyavuzwe na Yehu mwene Hanani, bigashirwa mu gitabu c'abami b'Israyeli. Mu nyuma, Yozafati umwami w'Ubuyuda, acudika na Akaziya, umwami w'Israyeli, na we akaba yari afise imigenzo mibi. Acudika na we kugira ngo bakore amato azoza araja i Tarashishi, bakorera ayo mato i Hetsiyoni Geberi. Eliyezeri mwene Dodavahu w'i Maresha, yigisha ka muhanuzi yagiriza Yozafati ati: «Ko wacuditse na Akaziya, Umukama arasambuye ivyo wakoze.» Nya mato aramenagurika, ntiyashobora kuja i Tarashishi.

Yozafati ahamvya ba sekuru biwe, afubwa hamwe na ba sekuru biwe, mu Gisagara ca Dawudi. Umuhungu wiwe Yehoramu aba umwami mu kibanza ciwe. Yehoramu yari afise benewabo, bene Yozafati, ari bo Hazariya, Yehiyeli, Zakariya, Hazariya, Mikayeli na Shefatiya. Abo bose bari bene Yozafati, umwami w'Israyeli. Se wabo yari yarabahaye ingabire nyinshi: ifeza, inzahabu, ibintu vy'agaciro, hamwe n'ibisagara bikomeye mu Buyuda. Ariko yari yahaye ubwami Yehoramu, kuko yari imfura. Yehoramu araheza asubirira se wiwe ku ngoma, aratsimbatara, hanyuma benewabo n'abatware bamwebamwe bo muri Israyeli abamarira ku bugi bw'inkota. Yehoramu yari afise imyaka mirongo itatu n'ibiri aho yaba umwami, hanyuma amara imyaka umunani ari umwami i Yeruzalemu. Akurikiza imigenzo y'abami b'Israyeli, nk'uko umuryango wa Akabu wari warabigize, kuko umukobwa wa Akabu ari we yari umugore wiwe. Araheza akora inabi mu maso y'Umukama. Ariko Umukama ntiyashatse gutikiza umuryango wa Dawudi kubera isezerano yari yasezeranye na Dawudi, kuko yari yavuze ko azomuha itara , we n'abahungu biwe imisi yose. Mu gihe ciwe, Abanyedomu bagarariza ubukuru bwa Yuda, baca biyimikira umwami abagaba. Yehoramu aragenda, ari kumwe n'abatware biwe n'imikogote yiwe yose. Ahengera mw'ijoro aravyuka, yica Abanyedomu bari bamukikije hamwe n'abakuru b'imikogote. Ariko Abanyedomu bagumye bagarariza ubukuru bwa Yuda gushika n'ubu. Na Libuna nyene cagararije muri ico gihe ubukuru bwa Yehoramu, kuko yari yahevye Umukama Imana ya ba sekuru biwe. Yehoramu yari yarubatse n'ibitabo ku misozi y'Ubuyuda, atuma ababa i Yeruzalemu basenga ibigirwamana, azimiza Abayuda. Hanyuma aronka urwandiko ruturutse ku muhanuzi Eliya ruvuga ruti: «Ng'uku uko Umukama Imana ya sokuru wawe Dawudi, avuze: “Kubera ko utagendeye mu nzira za so wawe Yozafati, mu nzira za Asa, umwami w'Ubuyuda, ariko ukagendera mu nzira y'abami b'Israyeli, kandi ugatuma Abayuda n'ababa i Yeruzalemu basenga ibigirwamanana nk'uko umuryango wa Akabu wabigize, ukaba kandi warishe benewanyu, bo mu muryango wa so wawe, kandi bari beza kukurusha, ehe Umukama agiye guhanisha icago gikomeye igihugu cawe, abahungu bawe, abagore bawe, n'amatungo yawe yose, na we aguhanishe indwara nyinshi, indwara yo mu mara, gushika aho amara yawe azosohoka ku musi ku musi kubera iyo ndwara”.» Umukama akaburira kuri Yehoramu umutima w'Abafilisti n'Abarabu baba mu micungararo y'Abakushi. Baraheza batera Yuda, bitera imbere muri yo, bayinyaga amatungo yose yari mu ngoro y'umwami, hamwe n'abahungu biwe n'abagore biwe, iwe ntihasigara umuhungu namba atari Yehoyakazi, umuhererezi mu bahungu biwe. Ivyo vyose biheze, Umukama amuhanisha indwara yo mu mara idakira. Ku musi ku musi, amara yiwe yaza arasohoka kubera iyo ndwara yiwe, gushika ikiringo c'imyaka ibiri gihere; apfa ababaye cane. Igihugu ciwe nticamutuririye ibimoga neza nk'uko cari carabigiriye ba sekuru biwe. Yari afise imyaka mirongo itatu n'ibiri aho yaba umwami. Araheza amara imyaka umunani ari umwami i Yeruzalemu. Agenda ata wukimushaka, bamufuba mu Gisagara ca Dawudi, ahandi atari mu ruhafu rw'abami.

Ababa i Yeruzalemu bimika Akaziya, umuhungu w'umuhererezi wa Yehoramu, ngo abe umwami mu kibanza ciwe, kuko abahungu bakuru bose bari batikijwe n'ingabo zari zazananye n'Abarabu mw'icumbi. Akaziya mwene Yehoramu, umwami w'Ubuyuda, aba umwami. Akaziya yari afise imyaka mirongo ine n'ibiri igihe yaba umwami, araheza aganza umwaka umwe aba i Yeruzalemu. Nyina wiwe yitwa Hataliya, umukobwa wa Homuri. Na we kandi agendera mu nzira z'abo mu muryango wa Akabu, kuko nyina wiwe ni we yamwosha kuba umubisha. Araheza akora inabi mu maso y'Umukama nk'umuryango wa Akabu, kuko ni bo baciye baba abahanuzi biwe inyuma y'urupfu rwa se, bimubera inyanduruko y'urupfu. Araheza aja ku mohe yabo, ajana na Yehoramu mwene Akabu, umwami w'Israyeli mu rugamba rw'ukurwanya Hazayeli, umwami wa Aramu, i Ramoti Galahadi. Niho Abaramu bakomeretsa Yehoramu, agaca agaruka kwivuriza i Yizereheli, kuko izo nguma bari bazimukomerekereje i Rama, igihe yariko ararwanya Hazayeli, umwami wa Aramu. Hazariya mwene Yehoramu, umwami w'Ubuyuda, amanuka i Yizereheli kuraba Yehoramu mwene Akabu kuko yari arwaye. Imana ni yo yashatse ko Akaziya agenda kwa Yehoramu ngo ahandurire urupfu. Agishika yaciye ajana na Yehoramu kurwanya Yehu mwene Nimushi, uwo Umukama yari yasize amavuta ngo azohonye umuryango wa Akabu. Igihe Yehu yariko arakurikiza ingingo yafatiwe umuryango wa Akabu, yahitanye abatware bo mu Buyuda, abahungu ba benewabo na Akaziya, n'abasuku ba Akaziya, arabica. Atuma abaja kurondera Akaziya, bamufatira aho yari yinyegeje i Samariya, bamuzana kwa Yehu, baraheza baramwica, baramuhamba, kuko bavuga bati: «Ni umuhungu wa Yozafati, ni we yarondeye Umukama n'umutima wiwe wose.» Mu muryango wa Akaziya, nta n'umwe yasigaye yoshobora gutwara ubwami. Hataliya, nyina wa Akaziya, abonye ko umuhungu wiwe apfuye, akura hasi ahonya uruvyaro rwose rwo mu nda y'ingoma mu muryango wa Yuda. Ariko Yehoshabehati, umukobwa w'umwami, afata Yowashi umuhungu wa Akaziya, amwiba mu bahungu b'umwami bari bagiye kwicwa, amushira, we n'umurezi wiwe mu cumba c'uburiri. Uko ni ko Yehoshabehati, umukobwa w'umwami Yehoramu, umugore w'umuherezankuka Yehoyada, kubera ko yari mushiki wa Akaziya, yamunyegeje, amukura mu maso ya Hataliya, ntiyamwica. Yowashi agumana na bo mu Ngoro y'Imana, yinyegeza imyaka itandatu, Hataliya ari we atwara.

Mu mwaka ugira indwi, Yehoyada afata ingingo yo kwunga isezerano n'aba bakuru b'imigwi y'ijana: Hazariya mwene Yerohamu, Isimayeli mwene Yohanani, Hazariya mwene Hobedi, Mahaseya mwene Hadaya na Elishafati mwene Zikri. Baraheza bahetura Yuda, bakoranya Abalevi bo mu bisagara vyose vy'Ubuyuda n'abakuru b'imiryango ya ba sekuru y'Israyeli, baca baja i Yeruzalemu. Ishengero ryose ryungira isezerano n'umwami mu Ngoro y'Imana. Hanyuma Yehoyada ababwira ati: «Ehe, umwana w'umwami azoba umwami nk'uko Umukama yavyemereye bene Dawudi. Ng'ibi rero ivyo muza gukora: ica gatatu co muri mwebwe baza gukora kw'Isabato, abaherezankuka n'Abalevi, bazorarira ubwinjiriro; ikindi ca gatatu, kizoja mu ngoro y'umwami; ikindi ca gatatu kirarire Irembo ry'Umushinge; abantu bose na bo baje ku mbuga z'Ingoro y'Umukama. Kandi nta wuzokwinjira mu Ngoro y'Umukama, kiretse abaherezankuka n'Abalevi bashinzwe imirimo; bo bazokwinjira, kuko bahezagiye. Abantu bose baze bazigame amategeko y'Umukama. Abalevi bazokikiza umwami, hirya no hino, umuntu wese afise ibirwanisho vyiwe mu minwe. Uwo wese azokwinjira mu ngoro, azokwicwa. Muragumane n'umwami yinjira canke asohoka.» Abalevi n'Abayuda bose bakora ivyo umuherezankuka Yehoyada yari yabategetse vyose. Hanyuma umuntu wese ahitana abantu biwe, abakora ku musi w'Isabato hamwe n'abaruhuka ku musi w'Isabato, kuko umuherezankuka Yehoyada ata n'umwe yari yarakuyemwo muri iyo migwi. Umuherezankuka Yehoyada aha abakuru b'imigwi y'ijana amacumu, inkinzo n'ibitembe vy'umwami Dawudi vyari mu Ngoro y'Imana. Ashira abantu bose mu bibanza, umuntu wese n'ikirwanisho ciwe mu minwe, kuva ku ruhande rw'iburyo rw'ingoro gushika ku ruhande rw'ibubamfu rw'ingoro, iruhande y'uruhimbi n'imbere y'ingoro, ngo bakikize umwami. Hanyuma rero basohokana umuhungu w'umwami, bamwambika urugori, bamushikiriza Isandugu ry'amategeko, bamugira umwami. Yehoyada n'abahungu biwe bamusiga amavuta, hanyuma batera impundu bati: «Umwami nahangame!» Hataliya yumva urwamo rw'igihugu ciruka congera gihayagiza umwami, aca agenda iyo abantu bari mu Ngoro y'Umukama. Araraba, abona umwami ahagaze ku gikwa mu rwinjiriro, abatware n'abavuza inzamba bari iruhande y'umwami, abantu bo mu gihugu bari mu gahimbare, bavuza n'inzamba. Abaririmvyi bafise ibicurarangisho vy'indirimbo ni bo batera indirimbo z'uguhayagiza. Hataliya yitaburirako impuzu, arasemerera ati: «Umugararizo! Umugararizo!» Umuherezankuka Yehoyada asohora abakuru b'imigwi y'ijana, abatwara ingabo, ababwira ati: «Nimumusohore, mumukure mu ngoro, ave mu mirongo, uwumukurikira wese yicishwe inkota.» Nkako, umuherezankuka yari yavuze ati: «Ntimumwicire mu Ngoro y'Umukama.» Bamuta mu minwe, ashitse mu rwinjiriro rw'Irembo ry'Amafarasi ku ngoro y'umwami, baca bamwicira aho nyene. Yehoyada yunga isezerano n'igihugu cose, yunga kandi isezerano n'umwami, kugira ngo babe igihugu c'Umukama. Abantu bose baca binjira mu ngoro y'ikigirwamana citwa Bahali, barayisenyura, bamenagura impimbi zayo n'ibishusho vyayo, Matani na we, umuherezankuka w'ikigirwamana citwa Bahali, bamwicira imbere y'izo mpimbi. Hanyuma Yehoyada ashira igikorwa c'ukurinda Ingoro y'Umukama mu minwe y'abaherezankuka b'Abalevi Dawudi yari yagenye gutunganya Ingoro y'Umukama n'uguhereza inkuka Umukama, nk'uko vyanditse mw'Itegeko rya Musa, mu kanyamuneza no mu ndirimbo, bakurikije ivyo Dawudi yategetse. Hanyuma ashira abarinzi ku marembo y'Ingoro y'Umukama, kugira ngo ntihagire igihumanye cinjira uko cishakiye. Afata abakuru b'imigwi y'ijana, abanyacubahiro, abatwara mu gihugu n'abantu bose bo mu gihugu, bamanukana umwami bamuvana mu Ngoro y'Umukama; bamucana kw'irembo rikuru, bamushikana mu ngoro y'umwami, baraheza bavyagiza umwami ku ntebe y'ubwami. Abantu bose bo mu gihugu barahimbarwa, igisagara kiratekana. Hataliya we, bari bamwicishije inkota.

Yowashi yari amaze imyaka indwi igihe yaba umwami. Aganza imyaka mirongo ine aba i Yeruzalemu. Nyina wiwe yitwa Tsibiya, w'i Berisheba. Yowashi akora ibigororotse mu maso y'Umukama mu gihe cose umuherezankuka Yehoyada yamaze. Yehoyada akwera Yowashi abagore babiri, avyara abahungu n'abakobwa. Mu nyuma, Yowashi agira umutima w'ugusanura Ingoro y'Umukama. Akoranya abaherezankuka n'Abalevi, ababwira ati: «Nimugende mu bisagara vy'Ubuyuda, mutororokanye amafeza muri Israyeli yose yo gusanura Ingoro y'Imana, ku mwaka ku mwaka, kandi munyarutse ico gikorwa!» Ariko Abalevi ntibanyarutsa. Niho umwami yatumako umutware Yehoyada, amubwira ati: «Ni kuki utasavye Abalevi gutororokanya mu Buyuda n'i Yeruzalemu ishikanwa, Musa, umusavyi w'Imana, n'ishengero ry'Israyeli bageneye Ihema ry'Amategeko? Nkako Hataliya, wa mugore w'umubisha n'abahungu biwe batabungabunze Ingoro y'Imana, ibikoresho vyeranda vyose vyari mu Ngoro y'Umukama bakabikoresha mu vy'ikigirwamana citwa Bahali.» Umwami rero atanga itegeko, babaza isandugu, barishira mu rwinjiriro rw'Ingoro y'Umukama, amaja hanze, baca batangaza mu Buyuda n'i Yeruzalemu ngo bazane ishikanwa ry'Umukama, Musa, umusavyi w'Imana yategetse Israyeli, mu bugaragwa. Abatware bose n'igihugu cose barahimbarwa, baraheza baza barashikana baterera muri rya sandugu gushika ryuzure. Hageze ko bashira isandugu umwami ngo arisuzume arishikirijwe n'Abalevi, kuko babonye ko amafeza yabaye menshi, umwanditsi w'umwami n'umunyamabanga w'umuherezankuka mukuru baraza, bagacuranura iryo sandugu, bagaca baritwara, bakarisubiza mu kibanza caryo. Uko ni ko babigira ku musi ku musi; baraheza bakegeranya amafeza menshi. Umwami na Yehoyada bashikiriza ayo mafeza abakoze ico gikorwa c'ugusanura Ingoro y'Umukama. Bararika abasatuzi b'amabuye n'ababaji b'ugusanura Ingoro y'Umukama, hamwe n'abahinga b'ivyuma n'umuringa ngo bakomeze Ingoro y'Umukama. Abo bakozi rero barakora, maze ico gikorwa c'ugusanura ingoro kiratera imbere kubera bo. Baduza Ingoro y'Imana bakurikije uburinganire bwayo, barayikomeza. Bamaze guheza, bazana imbere y'umwami na Yehoyada amafeza asigaye, na bo bacuramwo ibikoresho vyo mu Ngoro y'Umukama, ibikoresho vyeranda, ivy'uguhereza inkuka, ibikombe, ibikoresho vy'inzahabu n'ifeza. Baraheza baguma bahereza inkuka muri iyo Ngoro y'Umukama, mu gihe cose Yehoyada yamaze. Yehoyada arasaza, ashika mu zabukuru, hanyuma arapfa; apfa amaze imyaka ijana na mirongo itatu. Bamufuba mu Gisagara ca Dawudi, hamwe n'abami, kuko yari yarakoze ivyiza muri Israyeli, abikorera Imana n'Ingoro yayo. Yehoyada amaze gupfa, abatware bo mu Buyuda baraza, bakubitira ibipfukamiro imbere y'umwami, umwami na we arabumviriza. Baraheza baheba Ingoro y'Umukama Imana ya ba sekuru, bakorera ibigirwamana vyitwa Ashera n'ibindi bigirwamana, hanyuma ishavu ryisuka kuri Yuda na Yeruzalemu kubera ico caha cabo. Imana irungika muri bo abahanuzi ngo babagarukane ku Mukama, barabakebura ariko ntibabatega amatwi. Hanyuma umutima w'Imana ushwara Zakariya, umuhungu w'umuherezankuka Yehoyada, araheza ahagarara imbere y'igihugu, ababwira ati: «Ng'uku uko Imana ivuze: ni kuki murenga amategeko y'Umukama, kandi mutaroranirwa? Ko mwahevye Umukama, na we nyene azobaheba.» Baramugarariza, hanyuma bamwicishiriza amabuye ku mbuga, imbere y'Ingoro y'Umukama, babitegetswe n'umwami. Umwami Yowashi ntiyibuka ubuntu se wiwe Yehoyada yari yaramugiriye, ahubwo yica umuhungu wiwe. Mu gihe yariko arapfa, Zakariya avuga ati: «Umukama nabibone, kandi agukurikirane.» Umwaka uheze, ingabo za Aramu ziduga kurwanya umwami Yowashi. Bitera mu Buyuda no muri Yeruzalemu, birara mu gihugu hagati, batikiza abatware bose b'igihugu, baraheza barungikira umwami w'i Damasi ivyo basahuye vyose. Nkako ingabo za Aramu zari zaje ari abantu bakeyi, ariko nticabujije ko Umukama ata mu minwe yabo ingabo isinzi n'isinzi, kuko bari bahevye Umukama Imana ya ba sekuru babo. Baraheza bafatira ingingo Yowashi. Aho bamuviriye iruhande, bakamusiga ababaye cane, abasuku biwe baramugarariza kubera amaraso y'abahungu b'umuherezankuka Yehoyada, bamwicira ku buriri bwiwe, arapfa. Bamufuba mu Gisagara ca Dawudi, ariko ntibamuhamba mu ruhafu rw'abami. Ng'aba abamugararije: Zabadi, umuhungu w'umuhamonikazi Shimuhati, na Yehozabadi, umuhungu w'umumowabukazi Shimeriti. Nayo ivyerekeye abahungu biwe, imirimo myinshi yaranguye, umushinge w'Ingoro y'Imana, raba vyanditse mu vyavuzwe mu gitabu c'abami. Umuhungu wiwe Amatsiya, aba umwami mu kibanza ciwe.

Amatsiya yari amaze imyaka mirongo ibiri n'itanu igihe yaba umwami, aganza imyaka mirongo biri n'icenda aba i Yeruzalemu. Nyina wiwe yitwa Yehohadani w'i Yeruzalemu. Akora ibigororotse mu maso y'Umukama, ariko ntiyakorana umutima wiwe wose. Ubwami bwiwe bumaze gutsimbatara, yaciye yica abasuku biwe bari bishe umwami, se wiwe. Ariko abahungu babo ntiyabishe, kuko biranditse mw'Itegeko, mu gitabu ca Musa, aho Umukama yategetse avuga ati: «Ba se b'abana ntibazokwicwa bahorwa abana babo, n'abana nyene ntibazokwicwa bahorwa ba se babo, umwe wese azopfa azira igicumuro ciwe.» Amatsiya aca akoranya Abayuda, hanyuma akurikije imiryango ya ba sekuru babo, agena abakuru b'imigwi y'igihumbi, abakuru b'imigwi y'ijana, abakwiragiza mu Buyuda bwose no mu Bubenyamini. Aca arabaharura kuva ku myaka mirongo ibiri n'iyirenga, asanga ni imisore ibihumbi amajana atatu ishobora kuja ku rugamba, izi kurwanisha icumu n'inkinzo. Atora kandi muri Israyeli abarwanyi b'intwari ibihumbi ijana, ku ngero y'amatarenta ijana y'ifeza. Ariko umuntu w'Imana araza iwe, avuga ati: «Ewe mwami, ingabo z'Israyeli ntizijane na we, kuko Umukama atari kumwe na Israyeli, kandi atari kumwe na bene Efurayimu bose! Ariko niwagenda, naho woba ukomeye ku rugamba, Imana izogutembagaza imbere y'umwansi, kuko Imana ifise ububasha bw'ugushigikira canje gutembagaza umuntu.» Amatsiya abwira uwo muntu w'Imana ati: «Amatarenta ijana nahaye ingabo z'Israyeli yo ndayagire gute?» Wa muntu w'Imana avuga ati: «Umukama arafise ivyo aguha birengeye ivyo.» Amatsiya rero arabatandukanya, ingabo zaje iwe ziva muri Efurayimu zija mu kibanza cazo; ishavu ryazo rica rirurumbira cane kuri Yuda, zisubira mu kibanza cazo ishavu rirurumba. Amatsiya arakomera, araheza arongora igihugu ciwe, agenda mu kiyaya c'Umunyu, ahatsinda bene Sehiri ibihumbi icumi. Bene Yuda bafata muri bo ibihumbi icumi bakiri bazima, babajana kw'isonga ry'igitandara c'ibuye, hanyuma babacuranguza bari kuri iryo songa ry'igitandara c'ibuye, bose baramenagurika. Ingabo Amatsiya yari yasubije inyuma ngo ntizijane na we ku rugamba, zirara mu bisagara vy'Ubuyuda, kuva kuri Samariya gushika i Beti Horoni, zihica abantu ibihumbi bitatu, zihanyaga ibinyagano vyinshi. Amatsiya amaze kuva gutikiza Abanyedomu, azana imana za bene Sehiri, azigira imana ziwe, akubita inkoro hasi imbere yazo, azituririra ibimoga neza. Ishavu ry'Umukama rirurumbira kuri Amatsiya, Umukama amurungikira umuhanuzi, na we amubwira ati: «Ni kuki warondeye imana z'ico gihugu kandi zitashoboye kurokora abantu bazo ngo zibakure mu minwe yawe?» Akiriko aramuyagira, Amatsiya amubwira ati: «Mbega ni twebwe twakugenye ngo ube umujenama w'umwami? Geza aho, ahandiho barakwica!» Nya muhanuzi ageza aho, ariko avuga ati: «Ndazi ko Imana yafashe ingingo y'ukukuzimanganya kuko wakoze ivyo, ntiwumvirize impanuro yanje.» Amatsiya umwami w'Ubuyuda arahanuza, atuma uwuja kubwira Yowashi umwami w'Israyeli, akaba mwene Yehoyakazi mwene Yehu, ati: «Ingo duhigure.» Yowashi, umwami w'Israyeli, na we atuma intumwa kwa Amatsiya, umwami w'Ubuyuda, avuga ati: «Igitovu c'i Libani catumye kubwira isederi ry'i Libani kiti: “Numpe umukobwa wawe, abe umugore w'umuhungu wanje!” Hanyuma igikoko co mu gahinga k'i Libani kihaciye gihonyanga ico gitovu. Wewe wibwiye uti: “Ehe natsinze Abanyedomu!” Hanyuma umutima wawe ugutuma wishira hejuru, urininahaza. Kumbura ugume mu nzu iwawe! Mbega ni kuki wokwisuka mu vyago uzogwamwo, wewe, eka n'Abayuda mukajana?» Ariko Amatsiya yica amatwi, kuko ivyo vyava ku Mana kugira ngo ibate mu minwe y'Israyeli, kuko bari birukiye imana za Edomu. Yowashi, umwami w'Israyeli araduga, batana mu mitwe, we na Amatsiya, umwami w'Ubuyuda, bari i Beti Shemeshi y'Ubuyuda. Ubuyuda buratsindwa n'Israyeli, ingabo z'Ubuyuda zirahunga, umwumwe wese ahungira mw'ihema ryiwe. Amatsiya umwami w'Ubuyuda, mwene Yowashi, mwene Yehoyakazi afatira Yowashi, umwami w'Israyeli i Beti Shemeshi, hanyuma amutwara i Yeruzalemu. Aca asenyura uruhome rwa Yeruzalemu, ahangana n'intambwe amajana ane, kuva kw'irembo rya Efurayimu gushika ku rwinjiriro rwo mu mfuruka. Afata inzahabu yose, ifeza, ibikoresho vyose vyari mu Ngoro y'Imana kwa Hobedi Edomu, amatungo yo mu ngoro y'umwami, atwarana n'abantu bagizwe imbohe, araheza yisubirira i Samariya. Amatsiya mwene Yowashi, umwami w'Ubuyuda, araheza amara imyaka icumi n'itanu, Yowashi mwene Yehoyakazi, umwami w'Israyeli, amaze gupfa. Ibisigaye mu vyakozwe na Amatsiya, kuva mu ntango gushika ku mpera, vyanditse mu gatabu c'abami b'Ubuyuda n'ab'Israyeli. Kuva aho Amatsiya ahebeye Umukama, i Yeruzalemu baciye bamugira inama y'ukumukura ku ngoma, aca ahungira i Lakishi. Ariko barungika abamukurikirana gushika i Lakishi, bamwicirayo. Baterurira ikiziga ciwe ku mafarasi, baja kumufuba hamwe na ba sekuru biwe mu gisagara co mu Buyuda.

Mu gihugu cose c'Ubuyuda, batora Oziyasi ngo bamugire umwami mu kibanza ca se wiwe Amatsiya. Yari afise imyaka icumi n'itandatu. Ni we yasubiye kwubaka igisagara ca Elati, agisubiza Ubuyuda, umwami Amatsiya amaze guhamvya ba sekuru biwe. Oziyasi yari afise imyaka icumi n'itandatu, igihe yaba umwami, araheza aganza imyaka mirongo itanu n'ibiri aba i Yeruzalemu. Nyina wiwe yitwa Yekoliya, w'i Yeruzalemu. Akora ikintu cose kigororotse mu maso y'Umukama nk'uko se wiwe, Amatsiya yari yakoze. Yirukiye Imana mu gihe Zakariya yari afise ubumenyi bw'ivyo yerekwa n'Imana, kandi mu gihe yirukira Umukama Imana yaramuha kuroranirwa. Hanyuma agenda kurwanya Abafilisti, asenyura uruhome rwa Gati, uruhome rwa Yabne n'uruhome rwa Hashidodi, hanyuma yubaka ibisagara muri Hashidodi no mu Bafilisti. Imana iramufasha kurwanya Abafilisti n'Abarabu baba i Guri Bahali, n'Abamehunimu. Abahamoni baza baraha ingorore Oziyasi, izina ryiwe riramenyekana gushika no mu marembo ya Misiri, kuko yari yabaye umuntu ahambaye cane rwose. Oziyasi yubakisha iminara i Yeruzalemu, kw'Irembo ry'Imfuruka, kw'Irembo ry'Akabande, no ku yindi mfuruka nyene y'uruhome; iyo minara arayikomeza cane. Arasubira yubaka iminara mu bugaragwa, yimba amariba menshi y'amazi kuko yari afise ibitungwa vyinshi haba mu ntara y'epfo, haba mu kiyaya, akagira abarimyi n'abakora mu mizabibu mu misozi no mu mitumba imera cane, kuko yarakunda cane ivy'uburimyi. Oziyasi yari afise ingabo zizi kurwana, zaja ku rugamba zigabuye mu migwi, hakurikijwe igitigiri c'abaharuwe, bigizwe n'umwanditsi Yehiyeli hamwe n'umunyamabanga Mahaseya, zigategekwa na Hananiya, umwe mu ntwazangabo z'umwami. Igitigiri cose hamwe c'abakuru b'imiryango ya ba sekuru b'abo barwanyi b'intwari cari ic'ibihumbi bibiri n'amajana atandatu. Bari barongoye ingabo z'intwari zigizwe n'abantu ibihumbi amajana atatu n'indwi n'amajana atanu, zirwana zuzuye ubukomezi n'ubutwari ngo zifashe umwami kurwanya umwansi. Oziyasi aronderera ingabo zose inkinzo, amacumu, inkofero z'ivyuma, ibikingirizo vy'ivyuma, imiheto n'amabuye arasishwa itopito. Akoreshereza i Yeruzalemu ibimashini bihinguwe n'umuhinga ngo babitereke ku minara no mu mfuruka z'impome ngo babikoreshe mu kurasa imyampi no mu gutera amabuye maninimanini. Izina ryiwe riba rurangiranwa hose, kandi arafashwa bimwe vy'agatangaza gushika n'aho aba agahambaye rwose. Amaze gutsimbatara, umutima wiwe wishira hejuru gushika aho ayoba agahemukira Umukama Imana yiwe. Yahavuye yinjira no mu Ngoro y'Imana ngo aturirire ibimoga neza ku ruhimbi rw'ibimoga neza. Umuherezankuka Hazariya, yinjira inyuma yiwe ari kumwe n'abaherezankuka b'Umukama, abantu b'intwari mirongo umunani. Baraheza batesha umwami Oziyasi, bamubwira bati: «Si wewe, Oziyasi, urekuriwe guturirira Umukama ibimoga neza, ariko ni Abaherezankuka, bene Aroni, bo batiriwe guturira ibimoga neza. Sohoka uve muri iyi ngoro, kuko wahemutse, nta teka ugifise ku Mukama Imana.» Oziyasi arashavura kandi agifise mu minwe icotezo c'uguturira ibimoga neza. Hanyuma agishavuriye abo baherezankuka, imibembe iramuza ku ruhanga rwiwe imbere y'abo baherezankuka, akiri mu Ngoro y'Umukama, iruhande y'uruhimbi rw'ibimoga neza. Umuherezankuka mukuru Hazariya aramuraba ari kumwe n'abo baherezankuka bose, babona afise imibembe ku ruhanga. Baramuhindagiza ngo ave aho hantu kandi na we nyene arihuta kuvaho kuko Umukama yari yamuhanye. Umwami Oziyasi aguma arwaye iyo mibembe gushika ku musi w'urupfu rwiwe. Yaba mu nzu iri ukwa yonyene nk'umuntu arwaye imibembe nyene, kuko yari yaraciwe mu Ngoro y'Umukama. Umuhungu wiwe Yotamu aba ari we agaba ingoro y'umwami, yongera atunganiriza abantu mu gihugu. Ibisigaye vyerekeye Oziyasi, kuva ku ntango gushika ku mpera, vyanditse n'umuhanuzi Izaya mwene Amotsi. Oziyasi ahamvya ba sekuru biwe, bamufuba hamwe na ba sekuru biwe mu ruhafu ruri mw'itongo ry'abami, kuko bavuga bati: «Ni umuntu arwaye imibembe!» Umuhungu wiwe, Yotamu, aba umwami mu kibanza ciwe.

Yotamu yari amaze imyaka mirongo ibiri n'itanu igihe yaba umwami. Aganza imyaka icumi n'itandatu ari i Yeruzalemu. Nyina wiwe yitwa Yerusha, umukobwa wa Tsadoki. Akora ibigororotse mu maso y'Umukama muri vyose, akora nk'uko se wiwe Oziyasi yari yarakoze, ariko we ntiyinjira mu Ngoro y'Umukama, yamara igihugu co cagumye kiyoba. Yotamu ni we yubatse irembo rikuru ry'Ingoro y'Umukama, kandi yubaka ibintu vyinshi mu ruhome rwa Oferi, yubaka ibisagara mu misozi y'Ubuyuda, yubaka inzu zikomakomeye n'iminara mu mashamba. Yararwanije umwami wa bene Hamoni, agirako arabatsinda. Uyo mwaka bene Hamoni bamushikanira ingorore y'amatarenta ijana y'ifeza, amakori ibihumbi icumi y'ingano n'ibihumbi icumi y'amasaka. Ivyo ni vyo bene Hamoni bamushikaniye, no mu mwaka ugira kabiri n'uwugira gatatu. Yotamu aratsimbatara kuko yari yagumye agendera imbere y'Umukama Imana yiwe. Ibisigaye vyerekeye Yotamu, indwano ziwe zose n'imigenzo yiwe, raba vyanditse mu gitabu c'abami b'Israyeli n'ab'Ubuyuda. Yari amaze imyaka mirongo ibiri n'itanu igihe yaba umwami, aganza imyaka icumi n'itandatu ari i Yeruzalemu. Yotamu ahamvya ba sekuru biwe, bamufuba mu Gisagara ca Dawudi. Umuhungu wiwe Akazi aca aba umwami mu kibanza ciwe.

Akazi yari amaze imyaka mirongo ibiri igihe yaba umwami, aganza imyaka icumi n'itandatu aba i Yeruzalemu. Ntiyakora ibitunganye mu maso y'Umukama, ntiyakora nka sekuru wiwe Dawudi. Ariko yakurikije inzira z'abami b'Israyeli, ahingura ibishusho vy'ibigirwamana vyitwa Bahali mu cuma gishongesheje. Mbere yaratuririye ibimoga neza mu kabande ka bene Hinomu, aturirira abahungu biwe mu gitongorero c'umuriro, gutyo akurikiza amashano y'abanyamahanga Umukama yari yaromoye imbere ya bene Israyeli. Agirako ahereza imbagwa, aturirira ibimoga neza mu bitabo, ku mitumba no munsi y'igiti c'intunda cose. Umukama Imana yiwe, amuta mu minwe y'umwami wa Aramu, na we aramutsinda, amutwara n'abantu benshi, abagira abaja, abajana i Damasi. Umukama yongera amuta mu minwe y'umwami w'Israyeli, na we aramutsinda aramugeseza. Pekahi mwene Remaliya, ku musi umwe gusa, yica mu Buyuda abantu ibihumbi ijana na mirongo ibiri, kandi bose bari abagabo b'intwari, bicwa kuko bari barahevye Umukama Imana ya ba sekuru babo. Zikri, intwari yo muri Efurayimu, yica Mahaseya umuhungu w'umwami, yica Hazirikamu umubwiriza wo mu ngoro, na Elikana, icegera c'umwami. Bene Israyeli bagira abaja abantu ibihumbi amajana abiri bo muri benewabo bo mu Buyuda, bagizwe n'abagore, abahungu n'abakobwa. Babanyaga n'ibintu vyinshi cane, babitwara i Samariya. Aho hari umuhanuzi w'Umukama yitwa Hodedi, aja gusanganira ingabo zishitse i Samariya, azibwira ati: «Ehe, kubera ishavu Umukama Imana ya ba sokuru banyu yagiriye Yuda, yataye bene Yuda mu minwe yanyu, muraheza bamwe muri bo mubicana uburake bwinshi bwashitse no kw'ijuru. None ubu muriko muja inama y'ugucuvya bene Yuda na Yeruzalemu ngo mubagire abaja n'abajakazi banyu! None ubwo si mwebwe, muri mu caha imbere y'Umukama Imana yanyu? Ubu rero, nimunyumvirize; nimurekure imbohe mwari mwafashe muri benewanyu, ahandiho ubukari bw'ishavu ry'Umukama burabarurumbirako.» Abagabo bamwe mu bakuru bo muri bene Efurayimu, Hazariya mwene Yohanani, Berekiya mwene Meshilemoti, Ezekiyasi mwene Shalumi na Hamasa mwene Hadelayi, bahagurukira abo bari bavuye ku rugamba, bababwira bati: «Ntimuze muzane izo mbohe ngaha, kuko twoba tuguweko n'icaha imbere y'Umukama; mushaka kwongereza ibicumuro vyacu n'icaha cacu, kandi icaha cacu gisanzwe ari kinini, ngo ubukari bw'ishavu ryiwe bururumbire kuri Israyeli!» Abo barwanyi barekura izo mbohe, kandi basiga n'ivyo bari banyaze imbere y'abatware n'ishengero ryose. Hanyuma, abantu bari bahamagawe ku mazina barahaguruka, baja mu vyo kwakira izo mbohe, abari gusa muri bo bose babambika ivyo bakuye mu vyari vyasahuwe, babambika impuzu, babambika inkweto, barabagaburira, babaha ibinyobwa, babasiga n'amavuta; hanyuma batwara ku ndogobwe uwo wese w'intege nke, babajana i Yeriko, igisagara c'ibigazi, hafi ya benewabo; baraheza basubira i Samariya. Muri ico gihe, umwami Akazi atumako abami bo muri Ashuri ngo bamutabare Abanyedomu bongera kuza, batsinda Yuda, bafata n'imbohe. Abafilisti na bo bari bisutse ku bisagara vyo mu ntara y'epfo n'ubumanuko bwa Yuda, bigarurira Beti Shemeshi, Ayaloni, Gederoti, Soko n'ibigwati vyayo, Timuna n'ibigwati vyayo, Gimzo n'ibigwati vyayo, baca bagereraho. Nkako, Umukama yari yacubije Ubuyuda kubera Akazi, umwami w'Israyeli, kuko yari yigenjeje nabi mu Buyuda, agahemukira cane Umukama. Tiligati Pilineseri, umwami wa Ashuri, aramurwanya kandi aramucumukuza, ntiyamutabara. N'aho Akazi yari yatwaye umugabane mu vyo mu Ngoro y'Umukama, mu vyo mu ngoro y'umwami, no mu vyo abatware bari bashikaniye umwami wa Ashuri, nta co vyamufashije. No mu gihe yari mu makuba, umwami Akazi yarushirijeho guhemukira Umukama, ahereza imbagwa imana z'i Damasi zari zamutsinze, hanyuma avuga ati: «Ko imana z'abami ba Aramu zibatabara, ni zo ngiye guhereza imbagwa kugira ngo zintabare nanje.» Ahubwo zamubereye imvo y'ugutikira, we na Israyeli yose. Akazi rero yegeranya ibikoresho vyo mu Ngoro y'Imana, amenagura ivyo bikoresho vyo mu Ngoro y'Umukama, yugara inzugi z'Ingoro y'Umukama, yiyubakira impimbi ahari imfuruka hose i Yeruzalemu. Mu gisagara cose, no mu bisagara vy'Ubuyuda, ashinga ibitabo ry'ugutuririramwo ibimoga neza izindi mana, gutyo ashavuza Umukama Imana ya ba sekuru biwe. Ibisigaye bimwerekeye, imigenzo yiwe yose, kuva ku ntango gushika ku mpera, vyanditse mu gitabu c'abami b'Ubuyuda na Israyeli. Akazi ahamvya ba sekuru biwe, bamufuba mu gisagara, i Yeruzalemu, ariko ntibamushira mu mpafu z'abami b'Israyeli. Umuhungu wiwe Ezekiyasi aca aba umwami mu kibanza ciwe.

Ezekiyasi yari amaze imyaka mirongo ibiri n'itanu igihe yaba umwami, aganza imyaka mirongo ibiri n'icenda aba i Yeruzalemu. Nyina wiwe yitwa Abiya, umukobwa wa Zakariya. Akora ibigororotse mu maso y'Umukama, muri vyose akora nk'uko sekuru wiwe Dawudi yari yakoze. Mu mwaka wa mbere ari ku ngoma, mu kwezi kwa mbere, ni we yuguruye imiryango y'Ingoro y'Umukama aca arayisanura. Atumako abaherezankuka n'Abalevi, abakoraniriza mu kibanza co mu buseruko, ababwira ati: «Nimunyumvirize mwa Balevi! Ubu nimwityorore kandi mutyorore n'Ingoro y'Umukama Imana ya ba sokuru banyu, kandi mukure umwanda wose mu ngoro. Nkako ba sokuru bacu barahemutse, bakora inabi mu maso y'Umukama Imana yacu; baramuhevye, bima amaso urusago rw'Umukama, bamuha umugongo. Mbere barugaye n'inzugi zo mu rwinjiriro, bazimya amatara, ntibaba bagiturira ibimoga neza, ntibaba bagihereza inkuka Imana y'Israyeli mu Ngoro yayo. Niho rero ishavu ry'Umukama ryisuka kuri Yuda na Yeruzalemu, abigira agahabwa, bicika umuvumo, maze uwubibonye akiha akamo nk'uko namwe muvyibonera. None ehe, ba sokuru bacu batikijwe n'inkota; abahungu bacu na bo, abakobwa bacu n'abagore bacu bagizwe imbohe kubera ivyo. Ubu rero, ico mfise ku mutima ni ukwunga isezerano n'Umukama Imana y'Israyeli kugira ngo adukureko ubukari bw'ishavu ryiwe. Bane banje, ubu ntimwanjanjwe kuko ari mwebwe Umukama yatoye ngo mwame imbere yiwe, mumukorere, mumubere abahereza kugira ngo mumuturirire ibimoga neza.» Abalevi baciye barenguka ni aba: Mahati mwene Hamasayi, na Yoweli mwene Hazariya bo muri bene Kehati; muri bene Merari, Kishi mwene Habudi, Hazariya mwene Yehaleleli; mu Bagerishoni, ni Yowahi mwene Zima na Hedeni mwene Yowahi; muri bene Elitsafani, ni Shimuri na Yehiyeli; muri bene Asafu, ni Zakariya na Mataniya; muri bene Hemani, ni Yehiyeli na Shimehi; mu bene Yedutuni, ni Shemahiya na Huziyeli. Bakoranya rero benewabo, barityorora, hanyuma baza gutyorora Ingoro y'Umukama bakurikije itegeko ry'umwami nk'uko Umukama yari yarabivuze. Abaherezankuka binjira imbere mu Ngoro y'Umukama kugira ngo bayityorore. Basohora imyanda yose basanze mu Ngoro y'Umukama, bayiterera ku mbuga y'Ingoro y'Umukama, hanyuma Abalevi barayiyora baja kuyita kure y'umugezi wa Kideroni. Batangura kuyityorora ku musi wa mbere w'ukwezi kwa mbere, hanyuma ku musi ugira umunani w'ukwo kwezi bashika mu rwinjiriro rw'Ingoro y'Umukama; batyorora Ingoro y'Umukama mu misi umunani; barangiza ku musi ugira icumi na gatandatu w'ukwezi kwa mbere. Baraheza bagenda ku mwami Ezekiyasi, binjira iwe bavuga bati: «Twatyoroye Ingoro y'Umukama yose, uruhimbi rw'inkuka n'ibikoresho vyarwo vyose, imeza y'ugutondekako imikate n'ibikoresho vyayo vyose, eka n'ibikoresho vyose umwami Akazi yari yarataye igihe yahemuka akiri ku ngoma, twabiteguye, turabityorora, ng'ivyo biri imbere y'uruhimbi rw'Umukama.» Umwami Ezekiyasi avyuka kare, akoranya abakuru b'igisagara, araheza aduga mu Ngoro y'Umukama. Bajana ibimasa indwi, impfizi z'intama indwi, imyagazi y'intama indwi n'impfizi z'impene indwi, babiherezako imbagwa y'igicumuro babitangira ubwami, Ingoro y'Umukama, n'Abayuda. Ezekiyasi abwira rero abaherezankuka bene Aroni ngo babiherereze ku ruhimbi rw'Umukama. Babaga nya bimasa, abaherezankuka bafata amaraso bayamijagira ku ruhimbi; babaga za mpfizi z'intama, bamijagira amaraso ku ruhimbi; hanyuma babaga ya myagazi y'intama, bamijagira amaraso ku ruhimbi. Baraheza bazana amasuguru y'umugara y'imbagwa y'igicumuro imbere y'umwami n'ishengero, na bo bayubikako ibiganza vyabo. Abaherezankuka barayabaga, amaraso yayo bayatangako imbagwa y'igicumuro ku ruhimbi ngo basabire ikigongwe Israyeli yose, kuko umwami yari yategetse ko inkuka n'imbagwa y'igicumuro bizotangirwa Israyeli yose. Atondeka Abalevi mu Ngoro y'Umukama, bafise urusama, inanga n'amakembe, nk'uko Dawudi, Gadi ari we rumenyi w'umwami, na Natani umuhanuzi bari barabitegetse. Nkako iryo tegeko ryari ryatanzwe n'Umukama aciye ku bahanuzi biwe. Abalevi rero bahagarara mu bibanza bafise ibicurarangisho vyakozwe na Dawudi, abaherezankuka na bo bafise inzamba. Ezekiyasi atanga itegeko ry'uguherereza inkuka ku ruhimbi; hanyuma, inkuka itanguye, ururirimbo rw'Umukama ruratangura hamwe n'inzamba bigumirijwe n'ibicurarangisho vya Dawudi, umwami w'Israyeli. Ishengero ryose rikubita inkoro hasi, indirimbo rirasamirana, inzamba zirasirana, vyose birabandanya gushika barangize guhereza iyo nkuka. Bahejeje guhereza, umwami n'abari kumwe na we bose barapfukama bakubita inkoro hasi. Hanyuma umwami Ezekiyasi n'abatware babwira Abalevi ngo bahayagize Umukama bakoresheje amajambo ya Dawudi na Asafu ari we rumenyi, baraheza bahayagiza Umukama mu kanyamuneza, barunama, bakubita inkoro hasi. Ezekiyasi ashikiriza ijambo, avuga ati: «Ubu rero ko mushaka gukorera Umukama, nimwegere murengukane mu Ngoro y'Umukama imbagwa n'amashikanwa y'ugukenguruka!» Ishengero riraheza rirarengukana imbagwa n'amashikanwa y'ugukenguruka; uwo wese afise umutima utanga utitangiriye itama arahereza inkuka. Igitigiri c'inkuka ishengero ryazanye ni impfizi z'inka mirongo indwi, impfizi z'intama ijana, imyagazi y'intama amajana abiri, ivyo vyose biherezwakwo inkuka Umukama. Ibindi vyeguriwe Umukama ni ibitungwa bininibinini amajana atandatu n'ibitungwa bitobito ibihumbi bitatu. Ariko, abaherezankuka bari bake ntibashobora kubaga izo nkuka zose, Abalevi, benewabo, baca barabafasha gushika ico gikorwa kirangire, n'ugushika abaherezankuka bahejeje kwityororora, kuko Abalevi bari bafise ku mutima umwitwarariko w'ukwityorora kurusha abaherezankuka. Vyongeye hari inkuka nyinshi, hamwe n'ibinure vy'imbagwa z'amahoro, hamwe n'imyengo ijana n'inkuka. Ni uko igikorwa co mu Ngoro y'Umukama casubijweho. Ezekiyasi arahimbarwa hamwe n'igihugu cose kubera ivyo Imana yari yateguriye igihugu, kandi ivyo bintu bigaca bishika ubwo nyene.

Ezekiyasi atumako Israyeli yose n'Ubuyuda bwose, yandikira kandi amakete Efurayimu na Manase ngo baze mu Ngoro y'Umukama i Yeruzalemu, guhimbaza Ipasika y'Umukama Imana y'Israyeli. Umwami, abatware biwe n'ishengero ryose ry'i Yeruzalemu baja inama y'uguhimbaza Ipasika mu kwezi kugira kabiri. Nkako, ntibari barashoboye kuyihimbaza mu gihe cayo, kuko abaherezankuka batari bwityorore ari benshi, kandi n'igihugu kitari bwakoranire i Yeruzalemu. Iyo nama iratungana mu maso y'umwami no mu maso y'ishengero ryose, baraheza bashinga ingingo y'ugukwiragiza muri Israyeli yose, kuva i Berisheba gushika i Dani, ubutumire bw'ukuja i Yeruzalemu guhimbaza Ipasika y'Umukama Imana y'Israyeli, kuko benshi ntibari bayihimbaje nk'uko vyanditse. Intumwa zinyaruka zijana muri Israyeli yose no mu Buyuda bwose amakete zihawe n'umwami n'abatware biwe, ngo zivuge nk'uko umwami yabitegetse, ziti: «Yemwe Banyisrayeli, nimugaruke ku Mukama, Imana ya Aburahamu, Izahaki na Israyeli, Umukama na we azogarukira abasigaye muri mwebwe bakava mu minwe y'abami ba Ashuri. Ntimumere nka ba sokuru banyu na benewanyu bagararije Umukama Imana ya ba sekuru babo, hanyuma ikabatikiza nk'uko muvyibonera. Ubu rero ntimudadaze ibikanu vyanyu nka ba sokuru banyu. Nimuyoboke Umukama Imana yanyu, mwinjire mu Ngoro yiwe yagize nyeranda na ntaryo, mukorere Umukama Imana yanyu, kugira ngo abakureko ubukari bw'ishavu ryiwe.
