Nkako, nimwagaruka ku Mukama, benewanyu n'abana banyu bazogirirwa impuhwe n'ababambukanye, bashobore kugaruka muri iki gihugu; kuko Umukama Imana yanyu ari n'imbabazi n'impuhwe, kandi ntazoba akibakurako ijisho nimwagaruka kuri we.» Za ntumwa ziragenda ziva mu gisagara zija mu kindi mu ntara ya Efurayimu, n'iya Manase, gushika no mu ntara ya Zabuloni, ariko abantu barabatwenga bakabatyekeza. Ariko bamwe mu bantu bo kwa Asheri, kwa Manase no kwa Zabuloni, barisubiyeko, bagenda i Yeruzalemu. Muri Buyuda na ho nyene ikiganza c'Imana cabashizemwo umutima umwe kugira ngo barangure itegeko ry'umwami n'abatware, bakurikiza ibiri mw'ijambo ry'Umukama. Isinzi ry'abantu rikoranira i Yeruzalemu mu kwezi kugira kabiri, bahimbaza umusi mukuru w'imikate itambiye. Ryari ishengero rinini cane. Bakura hasi basenyura impimbi zari i Yeruzalemu, bakuraho n'ivyotezo vyose babita mu mugezi wa Kideroni. Baraheza babaga umwagazi w'Ipasika ku musi ugira icumi na kane w'ukwezi kugira kabiri. Abaherezankuka n'Abalevi, bari buzuye ibimaramare, barityorora, baraheza bazana inkuka mu Ngoro y'Umukama. Hanyuma bahagarara mu bibanza vyabo bakurikije ingingo ibagenga n'itegeko rya Musa, umuntu w'Imana. Abaherezankuka bamijagira amaraso baherejwe n'Abalevi. Kubera ko mw'ishengero hari benshi batari bityoroye, Abalevi baba ari bo babagira imbagwa z'Ipasika uwo wese atari atyoroye ngo amutyororere Umukama. Nkako benshi mu gihugu, benshi mu bo kwa Efurayimu, kwa Manase, kwa Isakari no kwa Zabuloni, ntibari bityoroye, barya umwagazi w'Ipasika badakurikije ivyanditse. Niho Ezekiyasi yabasabira, avuga ati: «Umukama we mwiza, nagirire impuhwe umuntu wese afise umutima witwararitse kurondera Imana Umukama Imana ya ba sokuru biwe, n'aho yoba adatyoroye nk'uko bitegerejwe mu ngoro.» Umukama arumvira Ezekiyasi, araheza arakiza igihugu. Bene Israyeli bari i Yeruzalemu bamara imisi indwi bahimbaza mu kanyamuneza kenshi uyo musi mukuru w'imikate itambiye. Abalevi n'abaherezankuka na bo, uko bukeye uko bwije, baguma bahayagiza Umukama n'ibicurarangisho birangurutse bari imbere y'Umukama. Ezekiyasi ayaga irishika ku mutima Abalevi bategera neza ivyerekeye Umukama; baraheza bafungura ivyagenywe mu misi indwi, bahereza imbagwa z'amahoro, kandi bakengurukira Umukama Imana ya ba sekuru babo. Ishengero rija inama y'ukubandanya bahimbaza mu yindi misi indwi, baraheza babandanya bahimbaza mu kanyamuneza mu misi indwi. Nkako Ezekiyasi, umwami w'Ubuyuda, yari yahaye ishengero ibimasa igihumbi n'ibitungwa bitobito ibihumbi indwi, abatware na bo bari bahaye ishengero ibimasa igihumbi n'ibitungwa bitobito ibihumbi icumi. Abaherezankuka na bo bari bityoroye ari benshi. Ishengero ryose ry'Abayuda, abaherezankuka, Abalevi, ishengero ryose ryari ryaje riva muri Israyeli, inyambukira ziva mu gihugu c'Israyeli ziba mu Buyuda, barahimbarwa. Haba agahimbare kenshi i Yeruzalemu kuko kuva mu gihe c'umwami Salomo mwene Dawudi, umwami w'Israyeli, nta bintu nk'ivyo vyari bwigere biba i Yeruzalemu. Abaherezankuka n'Abalevi baca barahaguruka bahezagira igihugu; ijwi ryabo rirumvirwa, igisabisho cabo kirashika mu kibanza ceranda c'Imana, mw'ijuru.

Ivyo vyose bimaze kurangira, Abanyisrayeli bose bari aho baca baja mu bisagara vy'Ubuyuda, bamenagura inkingi z'amabuye, basenyura ibigirwamana vyitwa Ashera, basambura ibitabo n'impimbi mu Buyuda bwose no mu Bubenyamini, hamwe no muri Efurayimu na Manase, gushika biherengetere. Hanyuma bene Israyeli basubira mu bisagara vyabo, umwumwe wese mw'itongo ryiwe. Ezekiyasi aca agena imigwi y'abaherezankuka n'iy'Abalevi, afatiye ku migwi yabo, umwumwe wese hakurikijwe igikorwa ciwe. Abaherezankuka n'Abalevi bashingwa guhereza inkuka n'amashikanwa y'amahoro, gushimagiza n'uguhayagiza, ku marembo y'amacumbi y'Umukama. Umugabane w'amatungo y'umwami uraheza ugenerwa inkuka, inkuka zo mu gitondo n'izo ku mugoroba, inkuka zo ku masabato, zo mu mboneko z'ukwezi n'izo ku misi mikuru yagenywe nk'uko vyanditse mw'Itegeko ry'Umukama. Ategeka kandi abantu baba i Yeruzalemu ngo batange umuturi wagenewe abaherezankuka n'Abalevi, kugira ngo bitwararike itegeko ry'Umukama. Iryo jambo rimaze gukwira hose, bene Israyeli batanga umukimba w'ivyerano vy'ingano, uw'umuvinyu mushasha, uw'amavuta mashasha, uw'ubuki, n'uw'ibindi vyimburwa vyose vyo mu mirima. Baraheza bahereza ic'icumi kinini kuri ivyo vyose. Abanyisrayeli n'Abayuda baba mu bisagara vy'Ubuyuda, na bo nyene bahereza ic'icumi c'ibitungwa bininibinini na bitobito, ic'icumi c'ibintu vyeranda rwose vyeguriwe Umukama Imana yabo. Barabizana, barunda ibirundo n'ibirundo. Mu kwezi kugira gatatu, batangura kwegeranya ivyo birundo, baheza mu kwezi kugira indwi. Ezekiyasi n'abatware baraza, babona ivyo birundo, maze bahezagira Umukama n'igihugu c'Israyeli. Ezekiyasi abaza abaherezankuka n'Abalevi ivyerekeye ivyo birundo. Hazariya, umuherezankuka mukuru, wo mu muryango wa Tsadoki, aramwishura, avuga ati: «Kuva aho batanguriye kuzana mu Ngoro y'Umukama amashikanwa yageruwe, twarariye turahaga, hasigara vyinshi, kuko Umukama yahezagiye igihugu ciwe; ni co gituma hasigaye vyinshi nk'ibi.» Ezekiyasi ategeka ko bubaka ivyumba mu Ngoro y'Umukama. Baca baravyubaka. Baraheza binjizayo mu buryo butunganye amashikanwa yageruwe, ivy'icumi hamwe n'ibintu vyeranda. Umulevi Konaniya aba ari we abishingwa; mwenewabo Shimehi aba icegera ciwe. Yehiyeli, Hazaziya, Nahati, Hasaheli, Yerimoti, Yozabadi, Eliyeli, Yismakiya, Mahati, na Benaya, baba abarinzi bagabwa na Konaniya na mwenewabo Shimehi, bagenywe n'umwami Ezekiyasi hamwe na Hazariya, umukuru w'Ingoro y'Imana. Umulevi Kore mwene Yimuna, yararira irembo ryo mu buseruko, yari ashinzwe amashikanwa yashikaniwe Imana ku gushaka, kugira ngo agabure amashikanwa yageruriwe Umukama, hamwe n'ibintu vyeranda rwose. Mu bisagara vy'abaherezankuka, Hedeni, Minyamini, Yozuwe, Shemahiya, Amariya na Shekaniya, abo ni bo yategeka kugira ngo bagaburire benewabo mu buryo butunganye bakurikije imigwi, bakabagaburira uwukuze co kimwe n'umuto, tutibagiye ab'igitsinagabo bari banditswe kuva ku bafise imyaka itatu n'iyirenga gusa, ariko bakagaburira abo bose bari bamaze kwinjira mu Ngoro y'Umukama kurangura umurimo wo ku musi ku musi, bari ku gikorwa cabo aho bararirira bakurikije imigwi yabo. Iyandikwa ry'abaherezankuka ryafatira ku miryango ya ba sekuru hamwe n'Abalevi kuva ku bafise imyaka mirongo ibiri n'iyirenga, bafatiye ku bibanza baraririramwo n'imigwi yabo. Bongera bandika abana babo batobato bose, abagore babo, abahungu babo n'abakobwa babo hamwe n'ishengero ryose kuko bari biyeguriye ibintu vyeranda badahemuka. Ku vyerekeye abaherezankuka, bene Aroni, baba mu matongo y'uburagiro yegereranye n'ibisagara vyabo, mu gisagara kimwekimwe cose, hari abantu bagenywe ku mazina, ngo bahe imitagi umuntu w'igitsinagabo wese ari mu baherezankuka n'abanditswe bose bo mu Balevi. Ezekiyasi agira gutyo mu Buyuda bwose, akora iciza, ikigororotse n'ikibereye imbere y'Umukama Imana yiwe. Mu gikorwa cose atanguye gukora cerekeye Ingoro y'Imana, cerekeye Itegeko n'icerekeye amabwirizwa, yagikora ngo arondere Imana n'umutima wiwe wose, kandi akaroranirwa.

Ivyo biheze, igihe c'ukuyoboka Imana cararangiye, ni ho umwami wa Ashuri ari we Senakeribu yaja mu Buyuda, ashinga icumbi ngo atere ibisagara bikomeye, yiyemeza kubisenyura. Ezekiyasi abonye ko Senakeribu yaje kandi agabiye kurwanya Yeruzalemu, agisha inama abatware biwe n'intwari ziwe ngo bagomere amazi y'amasoko ari inyuma y'igisagara; na bo baraheza baramufasha. Hanyuma abantu benshi barakorana bagomera amasoko yose n'umugezi watemba hagati mu gihugu, bavuga bati: «Ni kuki abami ba Ashuri boshika basanga amazi yisuka ari menshi?» Ezekiyasi agira ubutwari, asubira kwubaka uruzitiro rwose rwari rwasenyutse, yubakako iminara, ashira n'urundi ruzitiro inyuma, asanura Miro mu Gisagara ca Dawudi; acurisha imyampi myinshi n'inkinzo. Agena intwazangabo ku rugamba ngo zirongore igihugu; azikoraniriza iruhande yiwe ku nama kw'irembo ry'igisagara, hanyuma aziyagira irizishika ku mutima, avuga ati: «Nimukomere, mube intwari! Ntimutinye kandi ntimugire ubwoba imbere y'umwami wa Ashuri n'imbere y'isinzi ryose riri kumwe na we, kuko abari kumwe natwe ari benshi kuruta abari kumwe na we. We yishimikije ukuboko kw'umubiri wiwe, ariko twebwe twishimikije Umukama Imana yacu, ni we adufasha kandi akarwana indwano zacu.» Igihugu caciye kirema kubera ayo majambo ya Ezekiyasi, umwami w'Ubuyuda. Ivyo biheze, umwami wa Ashuri ari we Senakeribu arungika abasuku biwe i Yeruzalemu, we yari akiri i Lakishi ari kumwe n'ingabo ziwe. Atuma uwuja kubwira Ezekiyasi, umwami w'Ubuyuda n'Abayuda bose bari i Yeruzalemu ati: «Ng'uku uko umwami wa Ashuri ari we Senakeribu avuze: “Mbega ico mwishimikije ni igiki kugira ngo mugume mwugarijwe i Yeruzalemu? Ubwo Ezekiyasi ntariko arabahenda kugira ngo atume mwicwa n'inzara n'inyota, ababwira ati: 'Umukama Imana yacu azodukura mu minwe y'umwami wa Ashuri?' Mbega Ezekiyasi, si we yazimanganije vya bitabo vyiwe n'impimbi ziwe, akongera agategeka Yuda na Yeruzalemu avuga ati: 'Muzokubita inkoro hasi imbere y'uruhimbi rumwe rudende, kandi muturirire ibimoga neza kuri rwo gusa'? Ntimuzi ivyo nakoreye, jewe na ba sokuru banje, ibihugu vyose vyo kw'isi? Ugira ngo imana z'ibihugu vy'amakungu zarashoboye gukura ibihugu vyazo mu minwe yanje? Ni iyihe mu mana zose z'ayo makungu ba sokuru banje bahoneje, yashoboye gukura igihugu cayo mu minwe yanje, kugira ngo Imana yanyu ishobore kubakura mu minwe yanje? Ubu rero Ezekiyasi ntabahuvye canke ngo abahende muri ubwo buryo! Ntimumwemere! Nkako nta mana n'imwe y'igihugu na kimwe canke y'ubwami na bumwe yashoboye gukura igihugu cayo mu minwe yanje no mu minwe ya ba sokuru banje. Eka, na mwebwe! Imana yanyu ntizobakura mu minwe yanje!”» Abo basuku ba Senakeribu bongera gutuka Umukama Imana, na Ezekiyasi, umusavyi wayo. Hanyuma Senakeribu yandika amakete y'ugutuka Umukama Imana y'Israyeli n'ukumutyoza, avuga ati: «Kurya imana z'ibihugu vy'amakungu zitakuye ibihugu vyazo mu minwe yanje, ni ko n'Imana ya Ezekiyasi itazokura igihugu cayo mu minwe yanje.» Abo basuku barasemerera n'ijwi rirenga mu kiyuda, basemerera abantu b'i Yeruzalemu bari ku ruhome ngo babatere ubwoba kugira ngo bashobore kwigarurira igisagara. Bavuga Imana ya Yeruzalemu nk'imana z'ibihugu vyo kw'isi, zahinguwe n'iminwe y'abantu. Ariko umwami Ezekiyasi n'umuhanuzi Izaya mwene Amotsi, barasenga kubera ivyo; bongera batabaza amajuru. Hanyuma Umukama arungika umumarayika, atikiza abarwanyi b'intwari bose, indongozi n'abatware mw'icumbi ry'umwami wa Ashuri. Yaciye asubira mu gihugu ciwe yuzuye ibimaramare mu maso. Araheza yinjira mu ngoro y'imana yiwe; abavuye mu bura bwiwe bamwicisha inkota aho nyene. Umukama arokora Ezekiyasi n'ababa i Yeruzalemu, abakura mu minwe y'umwami wa Ashuri ari we Senakeribu, no mu minwe y'abandi bose; araheza arabakingira mu mpande zose. Benshi baciye bazanira ishikanwa Umukama i Yeruzalemu, bashikanira n'ingemu z'agaciro Ezekiyasi, umwami w'Ubuyuda, kandi kuva ubwo aca aba mukuru mu maso y'amakungu. Muri iyo misi, Ezekiyasi ararwara yenda gupfa, araheza atakambira Umukama, na we amushikiriza ijambo kandi amugirira n'igitangaro. Ariko Ezekiyasi ntiyisubirako afatiye ku ciza yagiriwe kuko umutima wiwe wari wishize hejuru, hanyuma ishavu ry'Umukama ryisuka kuri we no kuri Yuda na Yeruzalemu. Hanyuma, n'aho umutima wiwe wari wishize hejuru, Ezekiyasi aricisha bugufi, we n'ababa i Yeruzalemu, maze ishavu ry'Umukama ntiryisuka kuri bo mu gihe ca Ezekiyasi. Ezekiyasi aronka itunga n'ubuninahazwa burengeye, agira ubushinguro bw'ifeza, ubw'inzahabu, ubw'amabuye y'agaciro, ubw'ibimoga neza, ubw'inkinzo n'ubw'ibikoresho vyose vy'agaciro, agira ibigega vy'ukwimburiramwo umwimbu w'ingano, umuvinyu mushasha n'amavuta mashasha, agira impongore z'ibitungwa vy'ubwoko bwose hamwe rero n'ibitungwa biba muri izo mpongore. Yiyubakira ibisagara, atunga ubusho bwinshi bw'ibitungwa bitobito na bininibinini. Nkako Imana yari yamuhaye amatungo menshi cane. Ezekiyasi ni we ubwiwe yari yagomeye umugende wa ruguru w'amazi ya Gihoni, ayaroresha epfo amaja mu burengero bw'Igisagara ca Dawudi. Ezekiyasi yaguma aroranirwa mu bikorwa vyiwe vyose. Ariko igihe intumwa z'abatware b'i Babiloni zarungikwa iwe ngo zitohoze ivyerekeye igitangaro cari cabereye mu gihugu, Imana yaramuretse we nyene kugira ngo imugeze, imenye ibiri mu mutima wiwe vyose. Ibisigaye vyerekeye Ezekiyasi, ivyerekeye ubuntu bwiwe, vyanditse mu vyo umuhanuzi Izaya mwene Amotsi yabonye mu kubonekerwa, no mu gitabu c'abami b'Ubuyuda n'Israyeli. Ezekiyasi ahamvya ba sekuru biwe, bamufuba ahantu hakirurutse mu mva za bene Dawudi. Ku rupfu rwiwe, Abayuda n'ababa i Yeruzalemu bose baramutera iteka. Umuhungu wiwe Manase aba ari we aba umwami mu kibanza ciwe.

Manase yari amaze imyaka icumi n'ibiri igihe yaba umwami, aganza imyaka mirongo itanu n'itanu aba i Yeruzalemu. Akora inabi mu maso y'Umukama, akurikiza amashano y'amakungu Umukama yari yaromoye imbere ya bene Israyeli. Arongera ataba ibitabo se wiwe Ezekiyasi yari yarazimanganije, yubakira ibigirwamana vyitwa Bahali impimbi, ahingura ibigirwamana vyitwa Ashera, akubita inkoro hasi imbere y'inteko z'ijuru, atako arazikorera. Yubaka impimbi mu Ngoro y'Umukama, kandi Umukama yari yavuze ku vyerekeye iyo ngoro ati: «I Yeruzalemu, ni ho hazoba izina ryanje na ntaryo.» Yubakira impimbi ingabo zose zo mw'ijuru mu ntangaro zibiri z'Ingoro y'Umukama. Aturirira abahungu biwe ubwiwe mu kiyaya ca bene Hinomu, abatangako inkuka, aragendeza, arapfumura, araragura, ahanuza imizimu, yirukira ba rumenyi. Arushirizaho gukora inabi mu maso y'Umukama ngo amushavuze. Ashira mu Ngoro y'Imana igishusho kibaje yari yarahinguye, kandi Imana yari yarabwiye Dawudi n'umuhungu wiwe Salomo ku vyerekeye iyo ngoro iti: «Muri iyo ngoro, i Yeruzalemu ni ho natoye mu bisata vyose vy'Israyeli ngo ndahashire izina ryanje na ntaryo, kandi sinzosubira kuyerereza ibirenge vy'Israyeli mu ntara nageneye ba sokuru banyu; baritwararika gusa gukora ivyo nabategetse vyose nciye kuri Musa ku vyerekeye itegeko, amabwirizwa n'ingingo.» Hanyuma Manase ahubisha Abayuda n'ababa i Yeruzalemu, bakora inabi kurusha amakungu Umukama yari yaratikije mu maso ya bene Israyeli. Umukama ashikiriza ijambo Manase n'igihugu ciwe, ariko ntibaryitwararika. Hanyuma Umukama abagomorerako abakuru b'ingabo z'umwami wa Ashuri, bafatisha ingobe Manase, bamubohesha iminyororo y'umuringa, hanyuma bamujana i Babiloni. Amaze kugwa mu makuba, arondera gucuresha Umukama Imana yiwe; aricisha bugufi rwose imbere y'Imana ya ba sekuru biwe, arayitakambira. Nayo iramwumvira, yumviriza igisabisho ciwe, iraheza imusubiza i Yeruzalemu mu bwami bwiwe. Manase rero aramenya ko Umukama ari we Mana. Ivyo biheze, Igisagara ca Dawudi agikikuza uruhome ruva mu burengero kw'isoko rya Gihoni, mu kiyaya, rugashika mu rwinjiriro rw'urugi rw'Ifi, rugakikuza Oferi; arugira rurerure cane. Araheza akwiragiza intwazangabo mu bisagara vyose bizitijwe amabuye vy'Ubuyuda. Araheza akura mu Ngoro y'Umukama imana z'abanyamahanga, na ca gishusho, impimbi zose yari yarubatse ku musozi w'Ingoro y'Umukama n'i Yeruzalemu; ivyo vyose abita kure y'igisagara. Yubaka uruhimbi rw'Umukama, arubagirako imbagwa z'amahoro n'izo gukenguruka; kandi ategeka Yuda gukorera Umukama Imana y'Israyeli. Ariko igihugu cagumye giherereza imbagwa mu bitabo, yamara bakazihereza Umukama Imana yabo gusa. Ibisigaye vyerekeye Manase, igisabisho yerekeje ku Mana yiwe, n'amajambo ba rumenyi bamushikirije kw'izina ry'Umukama Imana y'Israyeli, ng'ivyo biri mu gitabu c'ivyaranguwe n'abami b'Israyeli. Igisabisho ciwe n'ukuntu yumviwe, ibicumuro vyiwe vyose, ubuhemu bwiwe, ibibanza yari yarubatsemwo ibitabo agashinga n'ibigirwamana vyitwa Ashera n'ibigereranyo imbere y'uko yisubirako, raba vyanditse mu vyaranguwe na Hozayi. Manase ahamvya ba sekuru biwe, bamufuba mu ngoro iwe. Umuhungu wiwe Amoni, aba ari we aba umwami mu kibanza ciwe. Amoni yari amaze imyaka mirongo ibiri n'ibiri igihe yaba umwami, aganza imyaka ibiri aba i Yeruzalemu. Akora inabi mu maso y'Umukama nk'uko se wiwe Manase yabigize. Amoni ashikanira imbagwa ibigirwamana se wiwe Manase yari yarahinguye, yongera arabikorera. Ntiyigeze yicisha bugufi imbere y'Umukama nk'uko se wiwe Manase yicishije bugufi, ahubwo Amoni we yarushirijeho gucumura. Abasuku biwe baramugarariza, bamwicira mu ngoro iwe. Abantu bo mu gihugu bica abo bose bari bagararije umwami Amoni, abo bantu bo mu gihugu baca bimika umuhungu wiwe Yoziyasi ngo abe ari we aba umwami mu kibanza ciwe.

Yoziyasi yari amaze imyaka umunani igihe yaba umwami, aganza imyaka mirongo itatu n'umwe aba i Yeruzalemu. Akora ibitunganye mu maso y'Umukama, akurikira inzira ya sekuru wiwe Dawudi, ntiyakebereza iburyo canke ibubamfu. Mu mwaka ugira umunani ari ku ngoma, n'aho yari akiri muto, atangura kurondera Imana ya sekuru wiwe Dawudi. Mu mwaka ugira icumi na kabiri na ho, atangura gukura mu Buyuda n'i Yeruzalemu ibitabo, ibigirwamana vyitwa Ashera, ibishusho bibaje n'ibishusho vy'icuma gishongesheje. Basitura impimbi z'ikigirwamana citwa Bahali abona, Yoziyasi na we amenagura ivyotezo vyari biteretse hejuru kuri zo, asyokora ibigirwamana vyitwa Ashera, ibishusho bibaje n'ibishusho vyose vy'icuma gishongesheje abigira ubunywenywe, aca abisanzaza ku mva z'ababishikanira imbagwa bose. Yoziyasi kandi aturirira amagufa y'abaherezankuka ku mpimbi zabo, atyorora Yuda na Yeruzalemu. Mu bisagara vya Manase, vya Efurayimu, vya Simeho gushika kwa Nefutali, no mu misaka yavyo mu mpande zose, asitagura impimbi n'ibigirwamana vyitwa Ashera, aca ubunywenywe ibigereranyo, amenagura ivyotezo biri mu gihugu cose c'Israyeli, hanyuma asubira i Yeruzalemu. Mu mwaka ugira icumi n'umunani ari ku ngoma, amaze gutyorora igihugu n'ingoro, Yoziyasi arungika Shafani mwene Atsaliya, Mahaseya, umukuru w'igisagara, n'umunyamabanga Yowahi mwene Yowakazi, gusanura Ingoro y'Umukama Imana yiwe. Bagenda kwa Hilikiya, umuherezankuka mukuru, batanga ifeza yari yashikanywe mu Ngoro y'Imana, iyo Abalevi barinda urugi begeranije bahawe na Manase na Efurayimu n'iyavuye n'ahandi hose hasigaye muri Israyeli, mu Buyuda bwose no mu Bubenyamini no mu baba i Yeruzalemu. Hanyuma bazishikiriza abajejwe igikorwa bashinzwe Ingoro y'Umukama, na bo baziha abajejwe igikorwa bariko barakora mu Ngoro y'Umukama ngo basanure bongere bakomeze iyo ngoro. Baziha abasatura ibiti n'abubatsi ngo bagure amabuye abaje, ibiti vy'iteranirizo kugira ngo bamanike amatanga ku nzu abami b'Ubuyuda bari barasituye. Abo bagabo bakorana ubutungane igikorwa cabo; bari babatoreye Yahati na Hobadiya, Abalevi bo mu bene Merari, Zakariya na Meshulamu bo mu bene Kehati, ngo babarongore; batora kandi Abalevi bose b'abahinga mu gucuraranga. Abari bagenywe bategeka abikorezi b'imizigo bakagenzura n'uwo wese yakora igikorwa mu murimo umwumwe wose. Mu Balevi harimwo abanditsi, abanyamabanga n'abasangarembo. Igihe bariko baracuranura ifeza zari zashikanywe mu Ngoro y'Umukama, umuherezankuka Hilikiya atora ca Gitabu c'Itegeko ry'Umukama ryari ryaciye kuri Musa. Hilikiya araheza ashikiriza ijambo, abwira umwanditsi Shafani, ati: «Natoye Igitabu c'Itegeko mu Ngoro y'Umukama.» Hilikiya aca ahereza ico gitabu Shafani. Shafani araheza ashira ico gitabu umwami, yongera ashikiriza ijambo umwami, avuga ati: «Ivyashinzwe abasuku bawe vyose biriko birakorwa. Baracuranuye ifeza zari mu Ngoro y'Umukama, bazishikiriza ababijejwe n'abariko bararangura ibikorwa.» Hanyuma umwanditsi Shafani abimenyesha umwami, avuga, ati: «Umuherezankuka Hilikiya yaranshikirije igitabu.» Shafani araheza agisomera imbere y'umwami. Umwami amaze kwumva amajambo y'Itegeko, atabura ivyambarwa vyiwe. Aca ategeka Hilikiya, Ahikamu mwene Shafani, Habudoni mwene Mishe, umwanditsi Shafani na Hasaya, umusuku w'umwami, avuga ati: «Gende mubaze Umukama, ibinyerekeye, n'ivyerekeye uwusigaye muri Israyeli no mu Buyuda, hakurikijwe amajambo y'igitabu catowe, kuko ishavu ry'Umukama ryisutse kuri twebwe ni ryinshi, kubera ko ba sokuru bacu batazigamye ijambo ry'Umukama ngo bakore bakurikije ivyanditse vyose muri ico gitabu.» Hilikiya n'abantu b'umwami bagenda ku muhanuzikazi Hulda, umugore wa Shalumi, mwene Tokehati, mwene Hasera, umuraririzi w'impuzu. Uwo muhunuzikazi yaba i Yeruzalemu mu gacimbiri ka kabiri. Baraheza bamuyagira ivyo bintu. Na we ababwira ati: «Ng'uku uko Umukama Imana y'Israyeli avuze: “Murabwire umuntu yabatumye iwanje, muti: 'Ng'uku uko Umukama avuze: Ehe jewe, ngiye gusuka inabi kuri iki kibanza no ku bakibamwo, ndahasuke imivumo yose yanditse muri ico gitabu basomeye imbere y'umwami w'Ubuyuda; kuko bampevye, bagaturirira ibimoga neza izindi mana, gushika aho banshavuza kubera ibikorwa vyose bakoze. Ishavu ryanje rigiye kwisuka kuri iki kibanza, kandi nta kizorizimya'. Ariko, umwami w'Ubuyuda yabarungitse kubaza Umukama, muzomubwira muti: 'Ng'uku uko Umukama Imana y'Israyeli avuze: Ko wumviye ayo majambo, bigatuma umutima wawe woroha, ukicisha bugufi imbere y'Imana, aho wumviye amajambo yayo yagiriza ico kibanza, akagiriza n'abakibamwo; ko wicishije bugufi imbere yanje kandi ugatabura ivyambarwa vyawe ukongera ukaririra imbere yanje, na jewe numvise. Ni iriyazwe n'Umukama. Ehe nanje ngiye kukwegereza ba sokuru bawe, ubegere mu mva yawe mu mahoro; amaso yawe ntazobona inabi yose ngiye gusuka kuri iki kibanza no ku bakibamwo'”.» Baraheza bagarukanira inyishu umwami. Umwami atumako abakurambere bose bo mu Buyuda n'ab'i Yeruzalemu ngo bakoranire hamwe. Hanyuma umwami aduga mu Ngoro y'Umukama, ari kumwe n'abantu bose bo mu Buyuda, ababa i Yeruzalemu, abaherezankuka, Abalevi n'igihugu cose, kuva ku wukuze gushika ku mutoyi. Araheza asoma amajambo yose y'igitabu c'isezerano catowe mu Ngoro y'Umukama, na bo bariko barumviriza. Umwami, ahagarara ku gikwa ciwe, yunga isezerano imbere y'Umukama y'ukwama akurikira Umukama n'ukuzigama amategeko yiwe, amabwirizwa yiwe n'imigenzo yiwe n'umutima wiwe wose n'umushaha wiwe wose mu kurangura amajambo y'isezerano yanditse muri iki gitabu. Atuma abantu bose bari i Yeruzalemu n'i Benyamini bemera, ababa i Yeruzalemu baca bakurikiza isezerano ry'Imana, Imana ya ba sekuru babo. Hanyuma Yoziyasi azimanganya amashano yose mu ntara zose za bene Israyeli, kandi ategeka abari muri Israyeli bose gukorera Umukama Imana yabo. Mu gihe ciwe cose ntibigeze bareka gukurikira Umukama Imana ya ba sekuru babo.

Yoziyasi araheza agirira Ipasika Umukama i Yeruzalemu, babaga imbagwa z'Ipasika ku musi ugira icumi na kane w'ukwezi gutangura. Hanyuma ashikiriza abaherezankuka amabanga yabo, arabaremesha ngo bitange batiziganya mu gukora mu Ngoro y'Umukama. Abwira Abalevi bigisha Israyeli yose biyeguriye Umukama ati: «Nimushire Isandugu ryeranda mu ngoro umwami Salomo mwene Dawudi, umwami w'Israyeli yubatse; ntimugisubira kuza murarirerura ku bitugu. Ubu, nimukorere Umukama Imana yanyu, mukorere n'igihugu cayo Israyeli. Nimwitegure mufatiye ku muryango wa ba sokuru banyu, mukurikije n'imigwi yanyu, mukurikije urwandiko rwa Dawudi, umwami w'Israyeli, n'urwandiko rw'umuhungu wiwe Salomo. Murafata ibibanza mu ngoro mukurikije imigwi y'imiryango ya ba sekuru ba benewanyu, abana b'igihugu n'uruhande rw'umuryango wa sekuru w'Abalevi. None rero nimubage imbagwa z'Ipasika, kandi mwityorore, mutegure benewanyu, kugira ngo bakore bakurikije ijambo ry'Umukama, ryaciye kuri Musa.» Yoziyasi araheza aha abana b'igihugu ibitungwa bitobito bigizwe n'imyagazi y'intama n'iy'impene, ngo vyose bibe ivy'Ipasika y'abari aho bose. Iyo myagazi yose yari ibihumbi mirongo itatu. Yoziyasi yayibahanye n'ibimasa ibihumbi bitatu. Ivyo bitungwa vyose vyari vyavuye mu matungo y'umwami. Abatware biwe babiherezako ishikanwa rivuye ku gushaka, babiha igihugu, abaherezankuka n'Abalevi. Hilikiya, Zakariya na Yehiyeli, indongozi mu Ngoro y'Imana, bahereza abaherezankuka imbagwa z'Ipasika ibihumbi bibiri n'amajana atandatu hamwe n'ibimasa amajana atatu. Konaniya na benewabo Shemahiya na Netaneyeli, Hashabiya, Yehiyeli na Yozabadi, abakuru b'Abalevi, bahereza Abalevi imbagwa z'Ipasika ibihumbi bitanu hamwe n'ibimasa amajana atanu. Igikorwa kiraringanizwa; abaherezankuka bahagarara mu bibanza vyabo, Abalevi na bo baja mu migwi yabo hakurikijwe itegeko ry'umwami. Baraheza babaga imbagwa z'Ipasika. Abaherezankuka baza barakira amaraso bayamijagira, Abalevi na bo bariko barabaga. Bashira ku ruhande inkuka ngo bazihe imigwi y'imiryango ya ba sekuru b'abana b'igihugu kugira ngo bazihereze Umukama nk'uko vyanditse mu gitabu ca Musa. Bagira gutyo nyene no ku mpfizi. Baraheza batara imbagwa z'Ipasika ku muriro nk'uko bitegerejwe, bongera bateka ivyeguriwe Umukama mu naga, mu nkono no mu mibehe, baca babishira abana bose b'igihugu. Mu nyuma bategura ivyabo n'ivy'abaherezankuka, kuko abaherezankuka, bene Aroni, baguma bahereza inkuka n'ibinure gushika mw'ijoro. Abalevi na bo kandi bategura ivyabo n'ivy'abaherezankuka bene Aroni. Abaririmvyi, bene Asafu, baguma mu bibanza vyabo, hakurikijwe itegeko rya Dawudi. Asafu, Hemani na Yedutuni, rumenyi w'umwami, abasangarembo kw'irembo ryose, nta n'umwe muri bo yava ku gikorwa ciwe, kuko benewabo b'Abalevi ari bo babategurira. Igikorwa cose c'Umukama c'uguhimbaza Ipasika n'uguhereza inkuka ku ruhimbi rw'Umukama, kirategurwa kuri uyo musi, hakurikijwe itegeko ry'umwami Yoziyasi. Hanyuma bene Israyeli bari aho barahimbaza Ipasika muri ico gihe, umusi mukuru w'Imikate itambiye na wo bawuhimbaza mu misi indwi. Nta Pasika nk'iyo yari bwigere ihimbazwa muri Israyeli kuva mu gihe c'umuhanuzi Samuweli, kandi nta n'umwe mu bami b'Israyeli yigeze ahimbaza Ipasika nk'iyo Yoziyasi, abaherezankuka, Abalevi, abo mu Buyuda bose, Abanyisrayeli bari aho, n'ababa i Yeruzalemu bahimbaje. Iyo Pasika yahimbajwe mu mwaka ugira icumi n'umunani umwami Yoziyasi ari ku ngoma. Ivyo vyose biheze, Yoziyasi amaze gusanura ingoro, Neko, umwami wa Misiri, aduga kurwana i Karkemishi, ku ruzi Ewufrati; Yoziyasi na we agenda kumutangira. Neko amutumako intumwa ngo zivuge ziti: «Dupfa iki ga mwami w'Ubuyuda? Uyu musi si wewe nje kurwanya, ni uwundi muryango ndiko ndarwanya, kandi Imana yambwiye ngo nyaruke. None rero reka gutangira Imana iri kumwe nanje, ahandiho yokuzimanganya.» Ariko Yoziyasi ntiyamukurako ijisho, ariyoberanya riho ngo amurwanye; ntiyumviriza amajambo ya Neko yari yavuye mu kanwa k'Imana; araheza agenda kurwanira mu kabande k'i Megido. Abarasisha imiheto barasa umwami Yoziyasi, umwami aca abwira abasuku biwe ati: «Nimuntware kuko numva vyanse cane.» Abasuku biwe bamukura mu mukogote wa mbere, bamwuriza mu mukogore wiwe ugira kabiri, bamujana i Yeruzalemu. Hanyuma arapfa, afubwa mu mva za ba sekuru biwe. Abayuda n'ababa i Yeruzalemu bose baragandarira Yoziyasi. Yeremiya araheza acurira intimba Yoziyasi. Abaririmvyi n'abaririmvyikazi bose bagumye bavuga ivyerekeye Yoziyasi mu gucura intimba, gushika n'ubu, baca babigira umugenzo muri Israyeli, kandi raba vyanditse mu ndirimbo z'ugucura intimba. Ibisigaye vyerekeye Yoziyasi, ukudahemuka kwiwe nk'uko vyanditse mw'Itegeko ry'Umukama, ivyo yakoze, kuva mu ntango gushika ku mpera, raba vyanditse mu gitabu c'abami b'Israyeli n'ab'Ubuyuda.

Abantu bo mu gihugu bafata Yehoyakazi mwene Yoziyasi, bamugira umwami mu kibanza ca se wiwe i Yeruzalemu. Yowakazi yari amaze imyaka mirongo ibiri n'itatu igihe yaba umwami, aganza amezi atatu aba i Yeruzalemu. Umwami wa Misiri amukura ku ngoma i Yeruzalemu, kandi acira igihugu gutanga ingorore y'amatarenta ijana y'ifeza n'itarenta imwe y'inzahabu. Umwami wa Misiri yimika mwenewabo Eliyakimu ngo abe umwami w'Ubuyuda na Yeruzalemu, aca ahindura izina ryiwe amwita Yehoyakimu. Neko afata mwenewabo Yowakazi amujana mu Misiri. Yehoyakimu yari amaze imyaka mirongo ibiri n'itanu igihe yaba umwami, aganza imyaka icumi n'umwe aba i Yeruzalemu. Akora inabi mu maso y'Umukama Imana yiwe. Nabukodonozori, umwami wa Babiloni, aca aza kumutera. Amubohesha iminyororo ikozwe mu vyuma vy'umuringa, amujana i Babiloni. Nabukodonozori afata ibikoresho vyo mu Ngoro y'Umukama, abijana i Babiloni, abishira mu ngoro yiwe i Babiloni. Ibisigaye vyerekeye Yehoyakini, amashano yakoze n'ivyamushikiye, raba vyanditse mu gitabu c'abami b'Israyeli n'ab'Ubuyuda. Umuhungu wiwe Yehoyakimu aba umwami mu kibanza ciwe. Yehoyakini yari amaze imyaka umunani igihe yaba umwami, aganza amezi atatu n'imisi icumi aba i Yeruzalemu, araheza akora inabi mu maso y'Umukama. Umwaka uheze, umwami Nabukodonozori arungika abamujana i Babiloni hamwe n'ibikoresho vy'agaciro vyo mu Ngoro y'Umukama. Aca yimika mwenewabo Sedesiyasi ngo abe umwami w'Ubuyuda na Yeruzalemu. Sedesiyasi yari amaze imyaka mirongo ibiri n'umwe igihe yaba umwami, aganza imyaka icumi n'umwe aba i Yeruzalemu. Akora inabi mu maso y'Umukama Imana yiwe, ntiyicisha bugufi imbere y'umuhanuzi Yeremiya yavuga irivuye mu kanwa k'Umukama. Yarongeye agarariza umwami Nabukodonozori yari yaramurahije Imana. Ariko yadadaje igikanu, akomantaza umutima wiwe, aho yohindukiye ku Mukama Imana y'Israyeli. Vyongeye abakuru bose b'abaherezankuka hamwe n'igihugu, bagumye bagwiza ubuhemu mu gukora amashano y'amakungu, bahumanya Ingoro y'Umukama, we nyene yari yaratagatifuje i Yeruzalemu. Umukama Imana ya ba sekuru babo yarabarungikiye impanuro, akama avyuka igitondo azirungika aciye ku ntumwa ziwe, kuko yari afitiye imbabazi ico gihugu n'ikirimba ciwe. Ariko barashinyagurije izo ntumwa z'Imana, bakengera amajambo yayo, batyekeza abahanuzi bayo, gushika n'aho ishavu ry'Umukama ryisuka ku gihugu cayo kandi ntiryaba rigiturura. Niho yabashuhurirako umwami w'Abakasidimu, yicisha inkota imisore yabo yari mu cumba c'ingoro nyeranda yabo, ntiyagirira imbabazi umusore canke inkumi, umutama canke umuhumure, bose abata mu minwe y'uwo mwami. Ibikoresho vyose vyari mu Ngoro y'Imana, vyaba bininibinini canke bitobito, amatungo yo mu Ngoro y'Umukama, amatungo y'umwami n'ay'abatware biwe, vyose abitwara i Babiloni. Baturira Ingoro y'Imana, basenyura uruhome rwa Yeruzalemu, ingoro zayo zose baziha umuriro, ibintu vyayo vyose vy'agaciro barayogeza. Nabukodonozori ajana abarokotse inkota kubagira imbohe i Babiloni, baba abaja biwe n'ab'abahungu biwe, gushika ku ngoma y'ubwami bw'Ubuperesi, kugira ngo ijambo ry'Umukama ryaciye mu kanwa k'umuhanuzi Yeremiya rivuga riti: «Igihugu kizoruhuka igihe cose kizomara mu makuba, gushika imyaka mirongo indwi ihere, cishure amasabato yaco» riranguke. Mu mwaka wa mbere, Sirusi, umwami w'Ubuperesi ari ku ngoma, kugira ngo ijambo ry'Umukama ryaciye mu kanwa ka Yeremiya riranguke, Umukama yakabuye umutima wa Sirusi, umwami w'Ubuperesi, atangaza mu bwami bwiwe bwose iri jambo, mbere aranaryandika, avuga ati: «Ng'uku uko Sirusi, umwami w'Ubuperesi avuze: “Umukama Imana y'ijuru yarampaye ubwami bwose bwo kw'isi, yongera anshinga kumwubakira ingoro i Yeruzalemu, mu Buyuda. None ni nde muri mwebwe ava mu gihugu ciwe? Umukama Imana yiwe nabe kumwe na we, aheze aduge”.»

Mu mwaka wa mbere Sirusi, umwami w'Ubuperesi ari ku ngoma, kugira ngo ijambo ry'Umukama ryaciye mu kanwa ka Yeremiya riranguke, Umukama yakabuye umutima wa Sirusi, umwami w'Ubuperesi, atangaza iri jambo mu bwami bwiwe bwose, mbere aranaryandika avuga ati: «Ng'uku uko Sirusi, umwami w'Ubuperesi avuze: “Umukama Imana y'ijuru yarampaye ubwami bwose bwo kw'isi, yongera anshinga kumwubakira ingoro i Yeruzalemu mu Buyuda. None ni nde muri mwebwe ava mu gihugu ciwe? Imana yiwe nibe kumwe na we, aheze aduge i Yeruzalemu mu Buyuda, yubake Ingoro y'Umukama Imana y'Israyeli, kuko ari yo Mana ihangamye i Yeruzalemu. Umuntu wese asigaye, aho aba hose, abantu b'aho hantu bategerezwa kuzana ifeza, inzahabu, amatungo n'ibitungwa, hamwe n'amashikanwa avuye ku gushaka, bizokoreshwe mu kwubaka Ingoro y'Imana iri i Yeruzalemu”.» Maze abakuru b'imiryango ya Yuda n'iya Benyamini, abaherezankuka, Abalevi, n'uwo wese Imana yari yakaburiye umutima, barahaguruka, baduga kwubaka Ingoro y'Umukama iri i Yeruzalemu. Uwo wese yabana na bo arabafasha mu kubaha ibikoresho vy'ifeza, inzahabu, amatungo, ibitungwa n'ibintu vy'agaciro, hamwe n'amashikanwa yose avuye ku gushaka. Umwami Sirusi aca asohora ibikoresho vyo mu Ngoro y'Umukama Nabukodonozori yari yaranyaze i Yeruzalemu akabishira mu nzu y'imana ziwe. Umwami w'Ubuperesi, Sirusi, abwiriza umushinguzi yitwa Miteredati kubisohora, araheza abiharurira umutware wa Yuda, Sheshebatsari. Ng'iki igitigiri cavyo: amabesani y'inzahabu mirongo itatu, amabesani y'ifeza igihumbi, imbugita mirongo ibiri n'icenda, ibikombe vy'inzahabu mirongo itatu, ibikombe vy'ifeza bisanzwe amajana ane na cumi, hamwe n'ibindi bikoresho igihumbi. Ibikoresho vyose vy'inzahabu n'ivy'ifeza vyari ibihumbi bitanu n'amajana ane. Ivyo vyose Sheshebatsari abidugana hamwe n'abari baragizwe imbohe baduganywe bava i Babiloni bataha i Yeruzalemu.

Ng'aba ababa muri iyo ntara baje bava mu buja, iyo bari barajanywe kugirwa imbohe, abo umwami wa Babiloni Nabukodonozori yari yaragize imbohe i Babiloni, hanyuma bakagaruka i Yeruzalemu no mu Buyuda, umwe wese mu gisagara ciwe, bazananye na Zorobabeli, Yozuwe, Nehemiya, Seraya, Rehelaya, Marudokayi, Bilishani, Misepari, Biguvayi, Rehumu na Bahana: igitigiri c'abagabo bo mu gihugu c'Israyeli: bene Paroshi bari ibihumbi bibiri n'ijana na mirongo indwi na babiri, bene Shefatiya, amajana atatu na mirongo indwi na babiri, bene Arahi, amajana indwi na mirongo indwi na batanu. Bene Pahati Mowabu, muri bene Yozuwe na Yowabu bari ibihumbi bibiri n'amajana umunani na cumi na babiri, bene Helamu, igihumbi n'amajana abiri na mirongo itanu na bane, bene Zatu, amajana icenda na mirongo ine na batanu, bene Zakayi, amajana indwi na mirongo itandatu, bene Bani, amajana atandatu na mirongo ine na babiri, bene Bebayi, amajana atandatu na mirongo ibiri na batatu, bene Hazigadi, igihumbi n'amajana abiri na mirongo ibiri na babiri, bene Adonikamu, amajana atandatu na mirongo itandatu na batandatu, bene Biguvayi, ibihumbi bibiri na mirongo itanu na batandatu, bene Hadini, amajana ane na mirongo itanu na bane. Bene Ateri, kwa Ezekiyasi, bari mirongo icenda n'umunani, bene Betsayi, amajana atatu na mirongo ibiri na batatu, bene Yora, ijana na cumi na babiri, bene Hashumi, amajana abiri na mirongo ibiri na batatu, bene Gibari, mirongo icenda na batanu. Ab'i Betelehemu, bari ijana na mirongo ibiri na batatu. Abagabo b'i Netofa, bari mirongo itanu na batandatu, abagabo b'i Hanatoti, ijana na mirongo ibiri n'umunani. Bene Hazimaveti, bari mirongo ine na babiri. Ab'i Kiriyati Yeharimu, i Kefira n'i Beyeroti, bari amajana indwi na mirongo ine na batatu, ab'i Rama n'i Geba, amajana atandatu na mirongo ibiri n'umwe. Abagabo b'i Mikimasi, bari ijana na mirongo ibiri na babiri, abagabo b'i Beteli n'i Hayi, amajana abiri na mirongo ibiri na batatu. Ab'i Nebo, bari mirongo itanu na babiri. Bene Magibishi, bari ijana na mirongo itanu na batandatu, bene Helamu wundi, igihumbi n'amajana abiri na mirongo itanu na bane, bene Harimu, amajana atatu na mirongo ibiri. Ab'i Lodi, i Hadidi n'i Ono, bari amajana indwi na mirongo ibiri na batanu, ab'i Yeriko, amajana atatu na mirongo ine na batanu. Bene Senaya, bari ibihumbi bitatu n'amajana atandatu na mirongo itatu. Abaherezankuka bari aba: bene Yedaya, bo mu muryango wa Yozuwe, bari amajana icenda na mirongo indwi na batatu, bene Imeri, igihumbi na mirongo itanu na babiri, bene Pashihuri, igihumbi n'amajana abiri na mirongo ine n'indwi, bene Harimu, igihumbi na cumi n'indwi. Abalevi bari bene Yozuwe na bene Kadimiyeli bo muri bene Hodaviya, bakaba mirongo indwi na bane. Abaririmvyi bari bene Asafu, bakaba ijana na mirongo ibiri n'umunani. Abasangarembo bari bene Shalumi, bene Ateri, bene Talmoni, bene Hakubu, bene Hatita, na bene Shobayi, bose hamwe bakaba ijana na mirongo itatu n'icenda. Abasuku bunganira Abalevi bari bene Tsiha, bene Hasufa, bene Tabahoti, bene Kerosi, bene Siyaha, bene Padoni, bene Lebana, bene Hagaba, bene Hakubu, bene Hagabu, bene Shalumayi, bene Hanani, bene Gideli, bene Gahari, bene Rehaya, bene Retsini, bene Nekoda, bene Gazamu, bene Huza, bene Paseya, bene Besayi, bene Asena, bene Mehunimu, bene Nefusimu, bene Bakibuki, bene Hakufa, bene Harehuri, bene Batsiluti, bene Mehida, bene Haresha, bene Barikosi, bene Sisera, bene Temahi, Bene Netsiya na bene Hatifa. Abahungu b'abasuku ba Salomo bari bene Sotayi, bene Sofereti, bene Peruda, bene Yahela, bene Darikoni, bene Gideli, bene Shefatiya, bene Hatili, bene Pokereti Hatsebayimu na bene Ami. Abasuku bunganira Abalevi bose hamwe n'abahungu b'abasuku ba Salomo, bari amajana atatu na mirongo icenda na babiri. Ng'aba abaje bava i Teli Mela, Teli Harusha, Kerubi Adani na Imeri, batashoboye kudondora umuryango wa ba sekuru babo n'ubwoko bwabo ngo berekane ko ari Abanyisrayeli: bene Delaya, bene Tobiya na bene Nekoda, bari amajana atandatu na mirongo itanu na babiri; mu bahungu b'abaherezankuka, bari bene Hobaya, bene Hakotsi na bene Barizilayi, yari yabiriye umwe mu bakobwa ba Barizilayi w'i Galahadi agaca yitirirwa izina ryabo Abo ni bo barondeye aho banditse mu rutonde rwa ba sekuru babo ntibabatore, baca bakurwa mu buherezankuka. Umutware ababuza kurya ku bintu vyeranda cane gushika habonetse umuherezankuka akoresha ihurimu n'itumimu. Iryo shengero ryose hamwe ryarimwo abantu ibihumbi mirongo ine na bibiri n'amajana atatu na mirongo itandatu, udashizemwo abasuku babo n'incoreke zabo, na bo bakaba bari ibihumbi indwi n'amajana atatu na mirongo itatu n'indwi; muri bo amajana abiri bari abaririmvyi n'abaririmvyikazi. Amafarasi yabo yari amajana indwi na mirongo itatu n'atandatu; impunda zabo zari amajana abiri na mirongo ine na zitanu; ingamiya zabo zari amajana ane na mirongo itatu na zitanu, indogobwe na zo zikaba ibihumbi bitandatu n'amajana indwi na mirongo ibiri. Bamwe mu batware b'imiryango ya ba sekuru, igihe bashika mu Ngoro y'Umukama i Yeruzalemu, baciye bahereza amashikanwa avuye ku gushaka, kugira ngo Ingoro y'Imana isubire ishingwe mu kibanza yahoramwo. Batanze amadarakuma y'inzahabu ibihumbi mirongo itandatu n'imwe, imina z'ifeza ibihumbi bitanu, n'amakanzu ijana y'abaherezankuka, babitanga bafatiye ku co umwe wese ashobora kuronka, babishira mu bubiko bwagenewe ico gikorwa. Abaherezankuka, Abalevi n'abandi bantu basanzwe, abaririmvyi, abasangarembo n'abasuku bunganira Abalevi, bose bagerera mu bisagara vyabo. Gutyo Abanyisrayeli yose bagerera mu bisagara vyabo.

Ukwezi kugira indwi gushika bene Israyeli bari mu bisagara vyabo, hanyuma abantu bakoranira i Yeruzalemu bose uko bakabaye. Yozuwe mwene Yotsadaki arahaguruka ari kumwe n'abaherezankuka benewabo, na Zorobabeli mwene Salatiyeli na benewabo, bubaka uruhimbi rw'Imana y'Israyeli kugira ngo baruhererezeko inkuka nk'uko vyanditse mw'Itegeko rya Musa, umuntu w'Imana. Bongera gushinga uruhimbi ku mushinge warwo kuko batinya abantu basigaye muri izo ntara. Baruhererezako Umukama inkuka, inkuka zo mu gitondo n'izo ku mugoroba. Baraheza bahimbaza umusi mukuru w'Insago, nk'uko vyanditse, bahereza inkuka ku musi ku musi bakurikije igitigiri nk'uko cashinzwe ku musi ku musi. Ivyo biheze, bahereza inkuka yama itangwa mu mboneko z'amezi n'izo zose zo ku misi mikuru yagenewe Umukama, hamwe n'izo z'uwo wese ahereza Umukama ishikanwa rivuye ku gushaka. Kuva ku musi wa mbere w'ukwezi kugira indwi, batangura guhereza Umukama inkuka. Ariko Ingoro y'Umukama ntiyari bwashingwe. Baraheza bashikiriza amahera abasatuzi b'amabuye n'ababaji, baha Abanyasidoni n'Abanyatiri ivyokurya, ibinyobwa n'amavuta, kugira ngo bavane ibiti vy'amasederi muri Libani, babishikane i Yafo babicishije mu kiyaga. Bari bahawe urushusha na Sirusi, umwami w'Ubuperesi. Mu mwaka ugira kabiri bamaze gushika ahahora Ingoro y'Imana i Yeruzalemu, mu kwezi kugira kabiri, Zorobabeli mwene Salatiyeli na Yozuwe mwene Yotsadaki hamwe na benewabo basigaye, abaherezankuka, Abalevi n'abandi bose bavuye iyo bari barangarijwe bakaza i Yeruzalemu, batangura kugena Abalevi bamaze imyaka mirongo ibiri n'iyirenga, ngo bahagarikire ibikorwa vy'Ingoro y'Umukama. Yozuwe, abahungu biwe na benewabo, Kadimiyeli n'abahungu biwe, bene Yuda, bavira hasi rimwe ngo bahagarikire abakora ibikorwa vy'ukwubaka Ingoro y'Imana, bari kumwe na bene Henadadi, abahungu babo na benewabo b'Abalevi. Abubatsi bahejeje gushinga umushinge w'Ingoro y'Umukama, baciye bagena abaherezankuka bambaye umwambaro wabo kandi bafise n'inzamba be n'Abalevi bene Asafu bafise urusama, barahaguruka ngo bahayagize Umukama nk'uko vyategetswe na Dawudi, umwami wa Israyeli. Bararirimba bahayagiza bongera bashimagiza Umukama bahanirana bati: «Umukama ni mwiza, nkako ubuntu agirira Israyeli bwamaho imyaka yose.» Igihugu cose na co caza kiratera impundu n'ijwi rirenga mu gihe bariko barahayagiza Umukama kubera ko umushinge w'Ingoro y'Umukama wari ushinzwe. Hanyuma benshi mu baherezankuka, Abalevi n'abakuru b'imiryango ya ba sekuru, abakurambere bari barabonye Ingoro y'Umukama ya kera, baza bararira baboroga cane igihe bariko barashinga umushinge w'iyo ngoro babona, ariko abandi benshi bagatera impundu z'akanyamuneza n'ijwi rirenga, gushika n'aho abantu batashobora gutandukanya ijwi ry'impundu z'akanyamuneza n'induru y'amarira y'igihugu, kuko abantu barahogora cane, urwamo rwabo rukumvikanira kure.

Abansi b'Ubuyuda n'ab'Ububenyamini bumvise ko abari barajanywe kugirwa imbohe bariko barubakira ingoro Umukama Imana y'Israyeli, bagenda kwa Zorobabeli no ku bakuru b'imiryango ya ba sekuru, bababwira, bati: «Reka tubafashe kwubaka, kanatsinda dusenga Imana yanyu nka mwebwe, kandi tuyishikanira imbagwa, kuva igihe Esari Hadoni, umwami wa Ashuri atuduganiye ngaha.» Ariko Zorobabeli, Yozuwe, n'abandi bakuru b'imiryango ya ba sekuru y'Israyeli, bababwira bati: «Eka mwebwe ntimudufasha kwubakira ingoro Imana yacu, ahubwo ni twebwe twenyene tuzokwubakira Umukama Imana y'Israyeli, nk'uko Sirusi, umwami w'Ubuperesi yabidutegetse.» Niho rero abantu bo muri ico gihugu baca inkokora abantu bo mu Buyuda bakaza barabatera ubwoba ngo bababuze kwubaka. Baranahereye ababosha ngo bahebe umugambi wabo, mu gihe cose Sirusi, umwami w'Ubuperesi yamaze, gushika no ku ngoma ya Dariyusi, umwami w'Ubuperesi nyene. Ku ngoma ya Ahashuwerusi, hakiri mu ntango, ba bansi banditse ibirego barega ababa mu Buyuda n'i Yeruzalemu. Mu gihe ca Arutaheshasete, Bishelamu, Miteredati, Tabeyeli na bagenzi babo basigaye, bandikira Arutaheshasete, umwami w'Ubuperesi. Iryo kete ryari ryanditse mu ndome z'icaramu no mu rurimi rw'icaramu nyene. Rehumu, umukuru w'intara, n'umwanditsi Shimeshayi, bandikira umwami Arutaheshasete ikete ryerekeye Yeruzalemu ryatangura rivuga riti: «Rehumu, umukuru w'intara, umwanditsi Shimeshayi, n'abagenzi babo basigaye, abacamanza, abatware, abaserukira intara, abanyacubahiro, Abarekewa, Abababiloni, Abashushani, Abadeha, Abahelamu, n'amakungu asigaye, Asinapari, umukuru kandi ahambaye, yari yarangaje akayagerera mu gisagara ca Samariya n'ahandi hakurya y'uruzi , n'ahandi hose.» Iryo kete bamurungikiye ryabandanya rivuga riti: «Mwami Arutaheshasete, twese abasuku bawe, twebwe tuba hakurya y'uruzi, n'abandi bose, turamenyesheje umwami ko Abayuda baje bava iwawe, bashitse iwacu i Yeruzalemu, bakaba bariko barasubira kwubaka ico gisagara c'ikigarariji kandi kibi, kandi bariko baruzuza impome basubiramwo n'imishinge. Umwami rero namenye yuko batazoba bagitanga ingorore, ikori n'imisoro, ico gisagara nicasubira kwubakwa, impome zaco zikuzura. Nta nkeka, ivyo bizotukisha abami. Ko ubu tubeshejweho n'ingoro, ntibikwiye ko tubona umwami ariko arakengerwa. Ni co gituma twanditse tukabimenyesha umwami, kugira ngo ugomvye uvyironderere mu gitabu c'ibivugwa kuri ba sokuru bawe. Muri ico gitabu c'ibivugwa uzoheza wibonere kandi uhamenyere ko ico gisagara ari igisagara kigarariza, gitukisha abami n'intara kigategurirwamwo imigumuko kuva kera na rindi. Ico ni co catumye ico gisagara gitikizwa. Turamenyesheje umwami ko ico gisagara nicasubira kwubakwa, impome zaco zikwuzura, nta co uzoba ukironka kivuye hakurya y'uruzi.» Umwami aca abarungikira inyishu ati: «Mukuru w'intara Rehumu, mwanditsi Shimeshayi, mwebwe bagenzi babo muba i Samariya na mwebwe muba ahandi hakurya y'uruzi, gire amahoro. . . ! Ikete mwaturungikiye ryasomewe imbere yanje mu buryo butomoye, ndaheza ntanga itegeko, baratohoza basanga ko kuva kera na rindi ico gisagara camye kigarariza abami, kandi ko imigumuko n'imigararizo vyateguriwe muri co. Harigeze kuba abami bahambaye batwaye Yeruzalemu bakaganza no hakurya y'uruzi hose; ico gihe barahabwa ingorore, ikori n'imisoro. Ubu rero nimutange itegeko ry'ugutesha abo bantu, ico gisagara ntigisubire kwubakwa, gushika aho nzobahera uruhusha. Kandi nimugabe, ivyo ntimubifate minenerwe, kugira ngo ikibi nticongerekane ngo gihave gitukisha abami.» Urwandiko rw'iryo kete ry'umwami Arutaheshasete rumaze gusomerwa imbere ya Rehumu, umwanditsi Shimeshayi na bagenzi babo, baciye bagenda barihuta i Yeruzalemu aho Abayuda bari, babatesha ibikorwa bitwaje inguvu n'igikenye. Niho rero ibikorwa vy'ukwubaka Ingoro y'Imana i Yeruzalemu vyahagarara; bihagarara gutyo gushika mu mwaka ugira kabiri, Dariyusi, umwami w'Ubuperesi ari ku ngoma.

Niho abahanuzi, umuhanuzi Hagayi n'umuhanuzi Zakariya mwene Hido, bigisha ka bahanuzi Abayuda bari mu Buyuda n'i Yeruzalemu kw'izina ry'Imana y'Israyeli yari kumwe na bo, Zorobabeli mwene Salatiyeli na Yozuwe mwene Yotsadaki bahaguruka, batangura kwubaka Ingoro y'Imana i Yeruzalemu. Hari n'abahanuzi b'Imana bari kumwe na bo ngo babafashe. Muri ico gihe nyene, Tatenayi, icariho co hakurya y'uruzi, Shetari Bozinayi na bagenzi babo, baza aho bari, baraheza bababwira bati: «Ni nde yabahaye uruhusha rwo kwubaka iyo ngoro n'ukuvyura urwo ruhome?» None rero ng'uku uko tubabwiye: «Tubwire amazina y'abantu bariko barubaka iyo nyubakwa.» Ariko ijisho ry'Imana yabo ryari ku bakurambere bo mu Buyuda; baraheza ntibabatesha kwubaka, gushika iyo nkuru ishikiriye Dariyusi, na bo bakaronka ikete ryerekeye ivyo bintu. Ng'uru urwandiko rw'ikete Tatenayi, icariho co hakurya y'uruzi, Shetari Bozinayi na bagenzi babo, abanyacubahiro bari hakurya y'uruzi bandikiye umwami Dariyusi. Bamurungikiye ikete ryanditswemwo ngo: «Mwami Dariyusi, gira amahoro yuzuye! Umwami namenye ko twagiye mu ntara ya Yuda ahari Ingoro y'Imana nkuru. Iriko irubakishwa amabuye abaje, kandi n'ibiti biramaze gushingwa mu mpome. Ico gikorwa baracitondeye neza kandi amaboko arabakundira. Niho twabaza abo bakurambere, tukababwira tuti: “Ni nde yabahaye uruhusha rwo kwubaka iyo ngoro n'ukuvyura urwo ruhome?” Twarababajije kandi n'amazina yabo kugira ngo tuyakumenyeshe, turaheza twandika amazina y'abantu babarongoye. Ng'iri ijambo batwishuye: bavuga bati: “Turi abasuku b'Imana y'ijuru n'isi, kandi turiko turasubira kwubaka ingoro yari yarubatswe kera, haciye imyaka myinshi, iyo umwami mukuru w'Israyeli yari yarubatse kandi akaba yari yarayujuje. Ariko kubera ko ba sokuru bacu bashavuje Imana y'ijuru, yabataye mu minwe ya Nabukodonozori, umwami wa Babiloni w'Umukasidimu, asambura iyo Ngoro, agirako yangaza abantu bayo i Babiloni. Ariko mu mwaka wa mbere Sirusi, umwami wa Babiloni, ari ku ngoma, umwami Sirusi atanga itegeko ry'ukwabaka iyo Ngoro y'Imana. Vyongeye, ibikoresho bikozwe mu nzahabu no mw'ifeza vyari mu Ngoro y'Imana, ivyo Nabukodonozori yari yaranyaze mu Ngoro yayo y'i Yeruzalemul , akabitwara mu ngoro y'i Babiloni, umwami Sirusi yabikuye muri iyo ngoro y'i Babiloni, bishikirizwa uwitwa Sheshebatsari, yari yagize icariho. Amubwira ati: 'Akira ibi bikoresho, ugende, ubishire mu Ngoro y'i Yeruzalemu, kandi iyo Ngoro y'Imana isubire yubakwe mu kibanza yahoramwo'. Hanyuma Sheshebatsari araza, ashinga umushinge w'Ingoro y'Imana i Yeruzalemu. Kuva ico gihe gushika ubu, iracubakwa, kandi ntiruzura. Ubu rero, umwami niyaba abona ko ari vyiza, nibarondere mu nzu y'ububiko bw'umwami iri ngaho i Babiloni, barabe ko hari itegeko ryatanzwe n'umwami Sirusi ry'ukwubaka iyo Ngoro y'Imana i Yeruzalemu, baheze batumenyeshe ico umwami yipfuza cerekeye ivyo bintu”.»

Niho umwami Dariyusi yatanga uruhusha ngo baronderere mu nzu y'ibitabu vyandikwamwo amatungo yatanzwe aho i Babiloni. Hanyuma batora ikizingo mu ngoro y'i Ahimeta mu ntara ya Mediya, canditswemwo icibutso kivuga kiti: «Mu mwaka wa mbere umwami Sirusi ari ku ngoma, uwo mwami Sirusi yatanze itegeko ryerekeye Ingoro y'Imana i Yeruzalemu, avuga ati: “Ingoro nisubire kwubakwa, ibe ikibanza co guhererezamwo imbagwa. Umushinge wayo nusubire gushingwa, ubuhagurutsi bwayo buzobe ubw'intambwe mirongo itandatu, ubwaguke bwayo na bwo nyene bube ubw'intambwe mirongo itandatu. Haraba imirongo itatu y'amabuye abaje, n'umurongo w'ibiti bishasha. Ico bizogurwa kizova mu ngoro y'umwami. Vyongeye, ibikoresho bikozwe mu nzahabu no mw'ifeza vyari mu Ngoro y'Imana, ivyo Nabukodonozori yari yaranyaze mu ngoro y'i Yeruzalemu akabitwara i Babiloni, nibisubizwe kandi bijanwe mu kibanza cavyo mu ngoro y'i Yeruzalemu, bishirwe mu Ngoro y'Imana. None rero, wewe Tatenayi, icariho co hakurya y'uruzi, na Shetari Bozinayi, na mwebwe bagenzi babo, abatware bo hakurya y'uruzi, nimuvyihoze ntimubijemwo. Nimureke ibikorwa vy'iyo Ngoro y'Imana bibandanye. Umukuru w'Abayuda n'abakurambere b'Abayuda nibubake iyo ngoro mu kibanza yahoramwo. Ehe kandi itegeko ntanze ry'ivyo uzogirira abakurambere b'Abayuda ryerekeye ukwubaka iyo Ngoro y'Imana: ico bizogurwa kizova mu matungo y'umwami azoba yavuye mu misoro yo hakurya y'uruzi, gishikirizwe abo bantu kugira ngo ntibahagarike ibikorwa. Ivyo bazokenera vyose vyaba ibimasa, impfizi z'intama n'imyagazi y'intama vy'uguhereza inkuka Imana y'ijuru, vyaba ingano, umunyu, umuvinyu canke amavuta, baze bagihabwe ku musi ku musi, nticigere kibura nk'uko abaherezankuka b'i Yeruzalemu bazoba bibitegetse, kugira ngo bashobore gushikanira Imana y'ijuru amashikanwa y'akamotera gashimisha, bongere basabire ukuramba umwami n'abahungu biwe. Vyongeye ndatanze itegeko ry'uko umuntu wese azorenga kuri iyi ngingo, bazoshingura inkingi y'inzu yiwe, kugira ngo bayimumanikeko, bayimwicireko. Inzu yiwe na yo bazoyigira ikirundo c'umwavu kubera ubugaba bwiwe. Imana yatumye izina ryayo rihangama muri iki kibanza, iratembagaza umwami wese canke igihugu cose kizokoresha ububasha gifise ngo gihumanye canke gisenyure iyo Ngoro y'Imana y'i Yeruzalemu. Ni jewe, Dariyusi, nshinze iryo tegeko, kandi nirikurikizwe guhera ubu nyene”.» Niho rero Tatenayi, icariho co hakurya y'uruzi, Shetari Bozinayi na bagenzi babo, bakora bakurikije uko itegeko umwami Dariyusi yabarungikiye riri. Abakurambere b'Abayuda barubaka ingoro bakurikije impanuro z'umuhanuzi Hagayi na Zakariya mwene Hido, igikorwa gitera imbere. Barayubaka mbere barayuzuza bakurikije itegeko ry'Imana y'Israyeli, bakurikije n'itegeko rya Sirusi, Dariyusi na Arutaheshasete, abami b'Ubuperesi. Iyo ngoro yuzuye ku musi ugira gatatu w'ukwezi kwa Adari kw'umwaka ugira gatandatu umwami Dariyusi ari ku ngoma. Bene Israyeli, abaherezankuka, Abalevi, n'abari barangajwe basigaye, bagira umusi mukuru wo kwinjira iyo Ngoro y'Imana mu kanyamuneza. Kandi kuri uyo musi mukuru wo kwinjira iyo Ngoro y'Imana, bahereje ibimasa ijana, impfizi z'intama amajana abiri, imyagazi y'intama amajana ane, n'impfizi z'impene icumi na zibiri z'imbagwa y'igicumuro itangiwe Israyeli yose, bakurikije igitigiri c'ibisata vy'Israyeli. Baraheza bagena abaherezankuka mu migwi yabo, n'Abalevi mu migwi yabo, ngo bazoze barakorera Imana i Yeruzalemu nk'uko vyanditse mu gitabu ca Musa. Abari barajanywe kugirwa imbohe bahimbaza Ipasika ku musi ugira icumi na kane w'ukwezi gutangura. Nkako abaherezankuka n'Abalevi bari bityororeye hamwe, bose bari batyoroye, baraheza babaga imbagwa y'Ipasika, bayiherereza abari barajanywe kugirwa imbohe bose, bayiherereza benewabo b'abaherezankuka, na bo nyene batikuyemwo. Ni uko, bene Israyeli bose batashe bava iyo bari baragiriwe imbohe, basangira imbagwa y'Ipasika n'abavavanuye n'ubuhumane bw'amakungu yo kw'isi, bifatanya na bo ngo baronderere hamwe Umukama Imana y'Israyeli. Bahimbaza mu kanyamuneza umusi mukuru w'imikate itambiye, mu gihe c'imisi indwi, kuko Umukama yari yabanezereje mu guhindukiriza umutima w'umwami wa Ashuri kuri bo, kugira ngo abunganire mu gikorwa co gusanura Ingoro y'Imana, Imana y'Israyeli.

Ivyo biheze, ku ngoma ya Arutaheshasete, umwami w'Ubuperesi, haza Esidarasi, mwene Seraya, mwene Hazariya, mwene Hilikiya, mwene Shalumi, mwene Tsadoki, mwene Ahitubu, mwene Amariya, mwene Hazariya, mwene Merayoti, mwene Zerahiya, mwene Huzi, mwene Buki, mwene Abishuwa, mwene Pinihasi, mwene Eleyazaro, mwene Aroni umuherezankuka mukuru. Uwo Esidarasi yaje avuye i Babiloni. Yari umwanditsi azi neza itegeko rya Musa Umukama Imana y'Israyeli yari yaratanze. Umwami amuha ivyo yari yasavye vyose, kuko ikiganza c'Umukama Imana yiwe cari kuri we. Bamwe muri bene Israyeli, bo mu baherezankuka, bo mu Balevi, bo mu baririmvyi, bo mu basangarembo na bamwe mu basuku bunganira Abalevi, baduga i Yeruzalemu ku mwaka ugira indwi umwami Arutaheshasete ari ku ngoma. Ashika i Yeruzalemu mu kwezi kugira gatanu kw'umwaka ugira indwi uwo mwami ari ku ngoma. Nkako, kw'igenekerezo rya mbere ry'ukwezi gutangura ni ho yaduga ava i Babiloni, hanyuma kw'igenekerezo rya mbere ry'ukwezi kugira gatanu, ashika i Yeruzalemu, kuko ikiganza c'Imana yiwe cari kuri we kimukingira. Nkako Esidarasi yari yiyemeje kurondera itegeko ry'Umukama n'ukurirangura, hamwe n'ukwigisha imigenzo nyayo n'ingingo muri Israyeli. Ng'iki icimuro c'ikete umwami Arutaheshasete yahaye Esidarasi, umuherezankuka akaba n'umwanditsi, umwanditsi w'amajambo y'amategeko y'Umukama hamwe n'imigenzo yerekeye Israyeli: «Muherezankuka Esidarasi, ukaba n'umwanditsi abushitse w'amategeko y'Imana y'ijuru, jewe Arutaheshasete, umwami w'abami. . . Ng'iri itegeko nshinze: mu bwami bwanje, abo bose mu bantu b'Israyeli, abaherezankuka babo n'Abalevi, bashaka kugenda i Yeruzalemu, barashobora kujana nawe. Nkako urungitswe n'umwami n'abajenama biwe indwi ngo utohoze ivyerekeye Yuda na Yeruzalemu, ukurikije itegeko ry'Imana yawe riri mu minwe yawe. Urungitswe kandi ngo ujane ifeza n'inzahabu umwami n'abajenama biwe bashikaniye ku gushaka Imana y'Israyeli ihangamye mu Ngoro yayo i Yeruzalemu. Uzojana n'ifeza yose n'inzahabu yose uzokura mu ntara y'i Babiloni, hamwe n'amashikanwa azotangwa n'igihugu n'abaherezankuka bivuye ku gushaka. Bizoba ishikanwa rivuye ku gushaka ritangiwe Ingoro y'Imana iri i Yeruzalemu. None rero, izo feza uzoziguremwo udatevye impfizi z'inka, impfizi z'intama, imyagazi y'intama, hamwe n'amashikanwa n'imyengo bijanye na zo, uzobiherereze ku ruhimbi rw'Ingoro y'Imana yanyu iri i Yeruzalemu. Ifeza n'inzahabu bizosigara, wewe na benewanyu muzozikoreshe ico muzobona kibereye, mukurikije ugushaka kw'Imana yanyu. Ibikoresho uhawe vy'ugukoresha mu Ngoro y'Imana yawe, uze ubishire imbere y'Imana ya Yeruzalemu. Ibisigaye bikenewe mu Ngoro y'Imana yawe, utegerejwe gutanga, uzobitange ubikuye mu nzu y'ubushinguro bw'umwami. Ni jewe, Umwami Arutaheshasete mpaye itegeko abanyabigega bose bo hakurya y'uruzi ngo barangure neza ico umuherezankuka Esidarasi akaba n'umwanditsi w'amategeko y'Imana y'ijuru azobasaba cose. Bazomuha gushika ku matarenta ijana y'ifeza, gushika ku makori ijana y'ingano, gushika ku mabata ijana y'umuvinyu, gushika ku mabata ijana y'amavuta, n'umuvinyu utagira ingero. Ico cose kivuye kw'itegeko ry'Imana y'ijuru kize kirangurirwe neza Ingoro y'Imana y'ijuru, kugira ngo ishavu ryayo ntiryisuke ku bwami bw'umwami no ku bahungu biwe. Vyongeye, turabamenyesheje ko ata n'umwe mu baherezankuka, mu Balevi, mu baririmvyi, mu bacunganzugi, mu banetinimu canke mu basuku bakora muri iyi Ngoro y'Imana, afatwa n'itegeko ry'ugutanga ingorore, ikori canke imisoro. Nawe Esidarasi, ukurikije ubwitonzi Imana yaguhaye, nugene abacamanza n'abashingantahe bazocira imanza abantu bose bo hakurya y'uruzi, abo bose bazi amategeko y'Imana yawe, wongere uyigishe abatayazi. Uwo wese atazorangura itegeko ry'Imana yawe n'itegeko ry'umwami, aze acirirwe urubanza rukwiriye, ari urwo gupfa, canke urw'ugucibwa, canke urw'ukunyagwa ibitungwa, canke urw'ugupfungwa.» Nahezagirwe Umukama Imana ya ba sokuru bacu, we yashize ivyo mu mutima w'umwami kugira ngo atere iteka Ingoro y'Umukama iri i Yeruzalemu! Yarangiriye ubuntu mu maso y'umwami, abajenama biwe n'abatware b'intwari b'umwami bose. Nanje nararemye, kuko ukuboko kw'Umukama Imana yanje kwari kuri jewe, ndaheza nkoranya abakuru bavuye muri Israyeli, kugira ngo badugane nanje.

Ng'aba abakuru b'imiryango ya ba sekuru babo, n'abanditswe bafatiye ku mamuko yabo baduganye nanje bava mu bwami bwa Arutaheshasete, umwami wa Babiloni: muri bene Pinihasi yari Gerishomu, muri bene Itamari, Daniyeli, muri bene Dawudi, Hatushi, muri bene Shekaniya, muri bene Paroshi yari Zakariya ari kumwe n'abagabo banditswe ijana na mirongo itanu, muri bene Pahati Mowabu yari Eliyehohenayi mwene Zerahiya ari kumwe n'abagabo amajana abiri; muri bene Shekaniya yari mwene Yahaziyeli ari kumwe n'abagabo amajana atatu, muri bene Hadini yari Hebedi mwene Yonatani ari kumwe n'abagabo mirongo itanu, muri bene Helamu yari Yeshaya mwene Hataliya ari kumwe n'abagabo mirongo indwi, muri bene Shefatiya yari Zebadiya mwene Mikayeli ari kumwe n'abagabo mirongo umunani, muri bene Yowabu yari Hobadiya mwene Yehiyeli ari kumwe n'abagabo amajana abiri na cumi n'umunani, muri bene Shelomiti yari mwene Yosifiya ari kumwe n'abagabo ijana na mirongo itandatu, muri bene Bebayi yari Zakariya mwene Bebayi ari kumwe n'abagabo mirongo ibiri n'umunani, muri bene Hazigadi yari Yohanani mwene Hakatani ari kumwe n'abagabo ijana na cumi, muri bene Adonikamu, ng'aya amazina y'abaherukiye: Elifeleti, Yehiyeli na Shemahiya bari kumwe n'abagabo mirongo itandatu, muri bene Biguvayi yari Hutayi na Zakuri bari kumwe n'abagabo mirongo indwi. Ndaheza ndabakoraniriza ku ruzi rutemba ruja i Ahawa; tuhacumbika imisi itatu. Ndagendura igihugu n'abaherezankuka; muri bene Levi sinasangaho n'umwe. Niho natumako abantu bakurubakuru, Eliyezeri, Ariyeli, Shemahiya, Elinatani, Yaribu, Elnatani, Natani, Zakariya, Meshulamu, ntumako n'abantu baciye ubwenge, ari bo Yoyaribu na Erenatani. Ndaheza ndabatuma kwa Ido, umukuru w'ikigwati ca Kasifiya; ndabatamika amajambo baja gushikiriza Ido na benewabo ari bo basuku bunganira Abalevi bari mu kigwati c'i Kasifiya kugira ngo batuzanire abasuku b'ugukora mu Ngoro y'Imana yacu. Kubera ko ukuboko kwiza kw'Imana yacu kwari kuri twebwe, batuzanira umugabo azi ubwenge wo muri bene Maheli, mwene Levi, mwene Israyeli, yitwa Sherebiya ari kumwe n'abahungu biwe na benewabo, bose hamwe bakaba icumi n'umunani, bazana na Hashabiya, ari kumwe na Yeshaya wo muri bene Merari, benewabo, n'abahungu babo, bose hamwe bakaba mirongo ibiri; mu basuku bunganira Abalevi na bo, abo Dawudi n'abatware bari bashinze gukorera Abalevi, bari abasuku amajana abiri na mirongo ibiri, bose bahamagarwa ku mazina yabo. Aho ku ruzi Ahawa ni ho natangarije ukwisonzesha ngo twicishe bugufi imbere y'Imana yacu, kugira ngo tuyisabe kugira urugendo rwiza, twebwe n'abana bacu, n'amatungo yacu yose. Nkako nari nagize isoni z'ugusaba umwami ingabo n'abagendera ku mafarasi ngo baturinde umwansi ku rugendo, kuko twari twabwiye umwami tuti: «Ukuboko kw'Imana yacu kuri kuri abo bose bayirondera ngo ibagirire ivyiza; ariko kandi ubukomezi bwayo n'ishavu ryayo birahanamiye abo bose bayikurako.» Niho rero twisonzesha, tugasaba Imana yacu kubera ico, nayo iratwumvira. Hanyuma mu baherezankuka bakuru ntoramwo icumi na babiri ari bo Sherebiya, Hashabiya hamwe na benewabo icumi. Ndabapimira ifeza, inzahabu, n'ibikoresho vyashikaniwe Ingoro y'Imana yacu, biherejwe n'umwami, abajenama biwe, abatware biwe n'Abanyisrayeli bose bari aho. Ndabapimira, ndaheza ndabahereza amatarenta amajana atandatu na mirongo itanu y'ifeza n'ibikoresho vy'ifeza vy'amatarenta ijana, amatarenta ijana y'inzahabu, amabesani mirongo ibiri y'inzahabu y'amadarakuma igihumbi, ibikoresho bibiri vyiza bikozwe mu muringa ukayangana, vy'agaciro nk'inzahabu. Ndababwira nti: «Mweguriwe Umukama, n'ibi bikoresho nyene vyeguriwe Umukama. Iyi feza n'inzahabu na vyo ni ishikanwa rivuye ku gushaka, riherejwe Umukama Imana ya ba sokuru banyu. Murabirabe neza kandi mubizigame gushika aho muzobipimira imbere y'abaherezankuka bakuru, y'Abalevi, y'abakuru b'imiryango ya ba sekuru b'Israyeli, i Yeruzalemu mu vyumba vy'Ingoro y'Umukama.» Hanyuma abaherezankuka n'Abalevi bakira ifeza n'inzahabu, ibikoresho vyari vyapimwe ngo babijane i Yeruzalemu mu Ngoro y'Imana yacu. Niho kw'igenekerezo ry'icumi na kabiri ry'ukwezi gutangura twava ku ruzi Ahawa tukagenda i Yeruzalemu. Ukuboko kw'Imana yacu kwari kuri twebwe, idukura mu minwe y'umwansi n'iy'uwadutegeye ku nzira. Dushitse i Yeruzalemu, tumaraho imisi itatu. Ku musi ugira kane, za feza, za nzahabu na vya bikoresho bipimirwa mu Ngoro y'Imana yacu, bipimwa n'umuherezankuka Meremoti mwene Uriya ari kumwe na Eleyazaro mwene Pinihasi, bari kumwe n'Abalevi Yozabadi mwene Yozuwe na Nohadiya mwene Binuyi. Vyose bimaze guharurwa n'ugupimwa, ivyapimwe vyose vyaciye vyandikwa muri uyo mwanya nyene. Abari barajanywe kugirwa imbohe, bamaze kuva mu buja, bahereza inkuka Imana y'Israyeli, igizwe n'ibimasa icumi na bibiri, bayiherereza Israyeli yose, bahereza n'impfizi z'intama mirongo icenda na zitandatu, imyagazi y'intama mirongo indwi n'indwi n'impfizi z'impene icumi na zibiri z'imbagwa y'igicumuro. Ivyo vyose biba inkuka iherejwe Umukama. Hanyuma bashikiriza amateka y'umwami ivyegera vy'umwami n'ivyariho vyo hakurya y'uruzi, bica biza gufasha igihugu kwubaka Ingoro y'Imana.

Ivyo biheze, abatware begera aho ndi bambwira bati: «Igihugu c'Israyeli, abaherezankuka n'Abalevi ntibitandukanije n'abantu b'izi ntara n'amashano yabo, amashano y'Abakanahani, Abaheti, Abaperizi, Abayebusi, Abahamoni, Abamowabu, Abanyamisiri, n'Abemori. Nkako, babiriye mu bakobwa babo, babashingira n'abahungu babo, bavanga uruvyaro rweranda n'abantu bo muri izo ntara, kandi abatware n'abakuru ni bo batanguriye abandi guhemuka muri ivyo.» Aho numviye ivyo bintu, naciye nitaburirako impuzu yanje n'umutamana wanje, ndandagura umushatsi wo ku mutwe wanje n'ubwanwa, nca ndicara numiwe. Abahinze agashitsi bumvise amajambo y'Imana y'Israyeli, kubera ubwo buhemu bw'abari barajanywe kugirwa imbohe, bakoranira iwanje, nanje nguma nicaye numiwe gushika ku gihe c'ugutanga ishikanwa, ku mugoroba. Hageze igihe c'ishikanwa ryo ku mugoroba, nca ndareka kwibabaza naho nari namaze kwitabagurirako impuzu yanje n'umutamana wanje, ndapfukama, ngaranzura ibiganza vyanje ndavyerekeza ku Mukama Imana yanje. Ndaheza mvuga nti: «Ewe Mana yanje, mfise isoni n'ibimaramare vy'ukwunamura amaso yanje ndayerekeza kuri wewe, Mana yanje, kuko ivyaha biri ku gatwe kacu vyabaye vyinshi, ibibi bitwagira vyaduze gushika mw'ijuru. Kuva mu gihe ca ba sokuru bacu twamye twagirwa n'ibibi bikomeye gushika n'ubu. Kubera ivyaha vyacu, twebwe, abami bacu n'abaherezankuka bacu, twatawe mu minwe y'abami b'ibihugu, tumarwa n'inkota, turangazwa, turasahurwa, turamaramazwa nk'uko biri uyu musi. Ubu rero, igihe c'akanya gatoyi, Umukama Imana yacu, yatugiriye ikigongwe, mu kuturekera agasigarira, kandi akaduha gushinga urumambo rw'ihema mu kibanza ciwe ceranda. Gutyo, Imana yacu yaraboneshereje amaso yacu, iraduha kubaho gatoyi n'aho twari mu buja. Nkako twari abaja, ariko Imana yacu ntiyaduhebeye mu buja bwacu, yaratugiriye ubuntu mu maso y'abami b'Ubuperesi, yongera kuduha kubaho, kugira ngo dusubire kwubaka Ingoro y'Imana yacu, dusanure aho yasenyutse. Imana yaduhaye kandi aho twubaka inzu tubamwo i Yeruzalemu no mu Buyuda. None ubu ga Mana yacu, turi buvuge iki ko ivyo vyose vyabaye? Twahevye amategeko yawe wategetse uciye ku basavyi bawe ari bo bahanuzi, ukavuga uti: “Igihugu mwinjiyemwo ngo muciganzire ni igihugu gihumanye, kubera ubuhumane bw'abantu b'ibindi bihugu bacujujemwo amashano yabo, bakagihumanya kuva ku ntango gushika ku mpera. None rero ntimuze mushingire abakobwa banyu ku bahungu babo, ntimuze mukwere abahungu banyu abakobwa babo, kandi ntimuze mwigere mwirukira amahoro yabo canke ineza yabo, ni ho muzoheza mugakomera, mugafungura ibintu vyizavyiza vy'ico gihugu, mukakiraga abana banyu imyaka yose”. Inyuma y'ivyadushikiye vyose kubera ibikorwa bibi vyacu n'ibitwagira bikomeye, ukaba na we Mana yacu wararetse guhana ivyaha vyacu, ukaturekera n'agasigarira nk'aka, ubwo none twokongera kurenga amategeko yawe, mu gushingiranira n'ibihugu bikora ayo mashano? Ntiwohava udushavurira gushika aho uturandura ntihagire abasigara canke abarokoka? Ewe Mukama Mana y'Israyeli, uri intungane. Nkako aho tugeze uyu musi turi agasigarira karokotse. Ehe turi mu maso yawe kandi turi abanyavyaha, ata n'umwe yari akwiye kuguturukira kubera ivyo.»

Mu gihe Esidarasi yasenga kandi yigaya ari mu marira kandi yubaraye hasi imbere y'Ingoro y'Imana, ishengero rinini ry'Abanyisrayeli, abagabo, abagore n'abana, bari bakoraniye iruhande yiwe, kuko igihugu cariko kirabogoza kirira cane. Hanyuma Shekaniya mwene Yehiyeli, wo muri bene Helamu, ashikiriza ijambo Esidarasi ati: «Twarahemukiye Imana yacu, twabira abagore b'abanyamahangakazi bo mu bantu b'iki gihugu. Ariko ubu, Israyeli irafise umwizero n'aho vyagenze uko. Ubu rero hinge dusezeranire Imana yacu ko tugiye kwirukana abo bagore bose n'abavutse kuri bo, dukurikize impanuro ya wewe databuja n'iy'abahinda agashitsi bumvise itegeko ry'Imana yacu. Ivyo nibiranguke hisunzwe itegeko. Va hasi rero kuko ivyo bintu vyega wewe. Twebwe turi kumwe nawe. Kenyera zigume ubikore!» Niho Esidarasi yahaguruka, arahiza abaherezankuka bakuru n'Abalevi hamwe na Israyeli yose, ko bazokora bisunze iryo jambo. Baca bararahira. Esidarasi araheza arahaguruka, ava aho yari ari imbere y'Ingoro y'Imana, agenda mu cumba ca Yohanani mwene Eliyashibu, yinjirayo ariko ntiyafungura umukate, ntiyanywa n'amazi, kuko yari agandaye kubera ubuhemu bw'abari barajanywe kugirwa imbohe. Baraheza bakwiragiza itangazo mu Buyuda n'i Yeruzalemu ry'uko abari barajanywe kugirwa imbohe bose bakoranira i Yeruzalemu, kandi ko umuntu wese atazoba yaje mu misi itatu, nk'uko vyari bitegetswe n'abatware n'abakurambere, itunga ryiwe ryose rizogirwa umuziro, kandi na we nyene agacibwa mw'ikoraniro ry'abari barajanywe kugirwa imbohe. Hanyuma abantu bose bo mu Buyuda n'abo mu Bubenyamini bakoranira i Yeruzalemu muri iyo misi itatu. Hari mu kwezi kugira icenda, kw'igenekerezo rya mirongo ibiri ry'ukwo kwezi. Igihugu cose kigandagaza ku nama y'Ingoro y'Imana, gihinda agashitsi kubera ivyo bintu no kubera hari imvura nyinshi. Umuherezankuka Esidarasi arahaguruka, ababwira ati: «Mwarahemutse mwabira abagore b'abanyamahangakazi, vyongereza icaha c'Israyeli. Ubu rero nimwemere icaha canyu mu maso y'Umukama Imana ya ba sokuru banyu, mukore ico ishaka. Nimuvavanure n'abantu bo muri iki gihugu, mutandukane n'abo bagore b'abanyamahangakazi.» Ishengero ryose ryishurana ijwi rirenga, rivuga riti: «Ni vyo! Dutegerezwa kubishira mu ngiro twisunze ijambo udushikirije. Ariko abantu ni benshi kandi ni mu gihe c'imvura nyinshi, nta woshobora kuguma ahagaze hanze; aho nyene si igikorwa c'umusi umwe canke c'imisi ibiri, kuko twacumuye muri ivyo bintu turi benshi. Turasavye abatware bacu baserukire ishengero ryose, maze abantu bose bo mu bisagara vyacu babiriye abagore b'abanyamahanga, barenguke mu gihe gitegekanijwe, bari kumwe n'abakurambere b'igisagara kimwekimwe, n'abacamanza baco gushika aho ubukari bw'ishavu ry'Imana yacu ku vyerekeye ivyo bintu butuvako.» Yonatani mwene Hasaheli na Yahizeya mwene Tikiva ni bo bonyene babirwanije, Meshulamu hamwe n'Umulevi yitwa Shabetayi na bo barabashigikira. Ariko abari barajanywe kugirwa imbohe bo bakora nk'uko vyari vyashinzwe. Batora umuherezankuka Esidarasi, abagabo, abakuru ba ba sekuru, hakurikijwe imiryango ya ba sekuru babo, bose batorwa bahamagawe ku mazina yabo. Kw'igenekerezo rya mbere ry'ukwezi kw'icumi, ni ho bicara kugira ngo bihweze ivyo bintu Kw'igenekerezo rya mbere ry'ukwezi gutangura, ni ho barangiza kwihweza ivy'abagabo bose bari babiriye abagore b'abanyamahangakazi. Mu bahungu b'abaherezankuka, abo basanze bari barabiriye abagore b'abanyamahangakazi bari aba: muri bene Yozuwe mwene Yotsadaki na benewabo yari Mahaseya, Eliyezeri, Yaribu na Gedaliya. Baraheza bemera kwirukana abagore babo n'ugutanga impfizi y'intama kubera ko bagiriwe n'ivyaha vyabo. Muri bene Imeri yari Hanani na Zebadiya; muri bene Harimu yari Mahaseya, Eliya, Shemahiya, Yehiyeli na Oziyasi; muri bene Pashihuri yari Eliyohenayi, Mahaseya, Isimayeli, Netaneyeli, Yozabadi na Elihasa; mu Balevi yari Yozabadi, Shimehi, Kelaya ari we Kelita, Petahiya, Yuda na Eliyezeri; mu baririmvyi yari Eliyashibu; mu basangarembo yari Shalumi, Telemu na Uri. Muri Israyeli: muri bene Paroshi yari Ramiya, Yiziya, Malikiya, Miyamini, Eleyazaro, Malikiya na Benaya; muri bene Helamu yari Mataniya, Zakariya, Yehiyeli, Habudi, Yeremoti na Eliya; muri bene Zatu yari Eliyohenayi, Eliyashibu, Mataniya, Yeremoti, Zabadi na Haziza; muri bene Bebayi yari Yohanani, Hananiya, Zabayi na Hataliya; muri bene Bani yari Meshulamu, Maluki, Hadaya, Yashubi, Sheyali na Ramoti; muri bene Pahati Mowabu yari Hadena, Kelali, Benaya, Mahaseya, Mataniya, Betsaleli, Binuyi na Manase; muri bene Harimu yari Eliyezeri, Yishiya, Malikiya, Shemahiya, Simeho, Benyamini, Maluki na Shemariya; muri bene Hashumi yari Matenayi, Matata, Zabadi, Elifeleti, Yeremayi, Manase na Shimehi; muri bene Bani yari Mahadayi, Hamuramu, Uweli, Benaya, Bediya, Keluhu, Vaniya, Meremoti, Eliyashibu, Mataniya, Matenayi, Yahasayi, Bani, Binuyi, Shimehi, Shelemiya, Natani, Hadaya, Makinadebayi, Shashayi, Sharayi, Hazareli, Shelemiya, Shemariya, Shalumi, Amariya na Yozefu. Muri bene Nebo yari Yehiyeli, Matitiya, Zabadi, Zebina, Yadayi, Yoweli na Benaya. Abo ni bo bari barabiriye abagore b'abanyamahangakazi, mbere bamwe muri bo bari bamaze kubavyarako abana.

Amajambo ya Nehemiya mwene Hakaliya. Mu kwezi kwa Kiselevu, mu mwaka ugira mirongo ibiri, jewe nari mu ngoro i Shushani. Niho Hanani, umwe muri benewacu yaza, we n'Abayuda. Ndaheza ndababaza ivyerekeye abantu bo mu Buyuda barokotse batari barambukanywe, nca ndababaza n'ivyerekeye Yeruzalemu. Bambwira bati: «Abasigaye batambukanywe bari hariya mu ntara, bari mu marushwa menshi no mu gakengerwe. Uruhome rwa Yeruzalemu rwarasenyaguritse, amarembo yayo yarigiswe n'umuriro.» Aho mariye kwumva ayo majambo, naciye nicara ndarira, mara imisi ngandaye, nisonzesha kandi nsengera imbere y'Imana y'ijuru. Navuga nti: «Ndagusavye, Mukama Mana y'ijuru, Mana nkuru kandi uteye akoba, wewe uzigama isezerano, ukagirira ubuntu abagukunda kandi bakazigama amategeko yawe, unkundire unyumvirize neza, wugurure amaso yawe, kugira ngo wumvirize igisabisho jewe umusavyi wawe nguma mvugira imbere yawe ijoro n'umutaga, nsabira abasavyi bawe, bene Israyeli. Ndemeje ibicumuro twebwe bene Israyeli twagucumuyeko. Jewe n'umuryango wa data, twaracumuye, ari ukugushayako twaragushayeko. Nkako ntitwazigamye amategeko, imigenzo n'ingingo wahaye umusavyi wawe Musa. Ndagusavye wibuke ijambo wategetse Musa, umusavyi wawe, ukavuga uti: “Nimwahemuka jewe nzobashwiragiza mu bihugu, ariko nimwangarukako mukazigama amategeko yanje, kandi mukayarangura, n'aho bamwe muri mwebwe bokwangazwa gushika ku rubibe rw'ijuru, nzobatororokanya ndabakureyo, ndabazane mu kibanza natoye ngo habe ari ho nshira izina ryanje”. Abo ni abasuku bawe, ni igihugu cawe warokoje ububasha bwawe buhambaye n'ikiganza cawe gikomeye. Ewe Mukama, ndagusavye ugutwi kwawe kwumvirize igisabisho c'umusuku wawe n'igisabisho c'abasuku bawe bahimbarwa n'ukwubaha izina ryawe. Ndagusavye uhe umusavyi wawe kuroranirwa uyu musi, umwami aze kumuraba ryiza!» Ico gihe jewe nari nshinzwe guhereza inyobwa umwami.

Hari mu kwezi kwa Nisani, mu mwaka ugira mirongo ibiri, umwami Arutaheshasete ari ku ngoma, umuvinyu ukaba wari imbere yiwe; nakira uwo muvinyu ndawuha umwami, kandi sinari bwigere nijirwa ndi imbere yiwe. Umwami ambwira ati: «Ni kuki wijiriwe mu maso kandi utarwaye? Nta kindi kikubabaje atari intuntu ufise mu mutima!» Ndaheza ngira ubwoba bwinshi cane, nca nishura umwami nti: «Umwami nahangame imyaka yose! Ni kuki ntokwijirwa mu maso kandi igisagara kirimwo imva za ba sokuru banje catikiye, amarembo yaco na yo yarigiswe n'umuriro?» Umwami aca ambwira ati: «None usaba iki?» Ndaheza nsenga Imana y'ijuru, nca mbwira umwami nti: «Umwami niyaba abona ko bibereye, umusuku wawe akaba yogira iteka mu maso yawe, nundungike mu Buyuda, mu gisagara kirimwo imva za ba sokuru banje, kugira ngo nsubire kucubaka.» Umwami, ari kumwe n'umwamikazi yicaye iruhande yiwe, ambwira ati: «Urugendo rwawe ruzomara igihe kingana iki kandi uzohindukira ryari?» Umwami abona ko ari vyiza, arandungika, nanje ndamumenyesha igihe nzogarukira. Nongera mbwira umwami nti: «Umwami niyaba abona ko ari vyiza, nibampe amakete nzoshira ivyariho vyo hakurya y'uruzi, kugira ngo bandeke ndengane gushika nshitse mu Buyuda, bampe n'ikete nzoshira Asafu acungera ikibira c'umwami ngo ampe ibiti vyo kumanika ubwinjiriro bw'irerekero riri hafi y'ingoro, ampe n'ivy'uruhome rw'uruzitiro rw'igisagara n'ivy'inzu nzobamwo.» Ndaheza ndashikira vya vyariho vyo hakurya y'uruzi, ndabishikiriza ya makete y'umwami. Umwami yari yampaye abakuru b'ingabo hamwe n'abagendera ku mafarasi ngo tujane. Umuhoroni yitwa Sanebalati n'umuhamoni yitwa Tobiya, umusuku, bavyumvise barababara, eka barababazwa cane n'uko hari umuntu aje kuronderera ineza bene Israyeli. Hanyuma ndashika i Yeruzalemu ndahaguma imisi itatu. Niho navyuka mw'ijoro, jewe n'abagabo bakeyi, kandi nta muntu namenyesheje ico Imana yanje yari yanshize mu mutima nokorera Yeruzalemu. Nta kindi gitwazi twari kumwe kiretse indogobwe nagenderako. Mw'ijoro ndasohoka, nca kw'Irembo ry'Akabande, amaja aharabana n'Isoko ry'Igisato, n'amaja kw'Irembo ry'Umwavu, hanyuma nihweza impome za Yeruzalemu zasenyaguritse n'amarembo yayo yarigiswe n'umuriro. Mu nyuma nca kw'Irembo ry'Iriba no ku Rugomero rw'Umwami, ariko ya ndogobwe nariko ndagenderako irabura ahantu ica. Ndaheza ndugana umugezi, mw'ijoro nihweza urwo ruhome, hanyuma nca ndahindukira ninjirira kw'Irembo ry'Akabande, nsubira inyuma. Abakuru ntibaciye n'ikanda iyo nari nagiye n'ico nariko ndakora, kandi nta co nari bwabwire Abayuda, abaherezankuka, abanyacubahiro, abakuru, eka mbere n'abasigaye bashinzwe ibindi bikorwa. Hanyuma ndababwira nti: «Murabona amarushwa turimwo! Yeruzalemu yaratikiye, amarembo yayo yarigiswe n'umuriro! Ingo, dusubire kwubaka uruhome rwa Yeruzalemu, ntitugume turi ak'amenyo.» Ndabamenyesha ko ukuboko kwiza kw'Imana kuri kuri jewe, ndababwira n'amajambo umwami yari yambwiye. Baca bavuga bati: «None nituve hasi dusubire twubake!» Baca baragira ingoga z'ukurangura ico gikorwa ciza. Wa muhoroni Sanebalati na wa muhamoni Tobiya umusuku, na Geshemu umwarabu, ngo bavyumve baca baradutwenga kandi baratugaya bavuga bati: «Mbega ivyo bintu muriko muragira ni ibiki? Mushaka kugarariza umwami?» Ndabasubiza iri jambo, ndababwira nti: «Imana y'ijuru ni yo izotuma twebwe abasuku bayo twererwa. Tugiye kuva hasi dusubire twubake. Ariko mwebwe nta mugabane, nta burenganzira, nta n'icibutso mufise i Yeruzalemu.»

Eliyashibu, umuherezankuka mukuru, arahaguruka ari kumwe na benewabo b'abaherezankuka nyene, bubaka Irembo iry'Intama; bararihezagira baca batera inzugi zaryo; barabandanya gushika ku munara w'Ijana, barawuhezagira, barabandanya gushika no ku munara wa Hananeyeli. Abantu b'i Yeriko, babandanirizako barubaka, hakurikira Zakuri mwene Imuri. Bene Hasenaya na bo bubatse Irembo ry'Ifi; bararimanika, batera inzugi zaryo, bashirako ibigombo n'ibihindizo. Ababandanije basanura ni Meremoti mwene Uriya, mwene Hakotsi, hakurikira Meshulamu mwene Berekiya mwene Meshezabeli, hakurikira Tsadoki mwene Bahana. Ababandanije basanura ni ab'i Tekowa, ariko abanyacubahiro babo baranka kwitaba igikorwa ca ba shebuja. Irembo rya kera ryasanuwe na Yoyada mwene Paseya na Meshulamu mwene Besodiya, bararimanika batera inzugi zaryo, bashirako ibigombo n'ibihindizo. Ababandanije basanura ni Melatiya w'i Gibehoni, Yadoni Umumeroni, abagabo b'i Gibehoni n'i Mitsipa, gushika ahari icicaro c'icariho co hakurya y'uruzi. Uwabandanije asanura ni Huziyeli mwene Harehaya, wo mu bahingura inzahabu, hakurikira Hananiya ava mu bahingura imibavu, hanyuma basiga basanuye Yeruzalemu gushika ku ruhome rwagutse. Uwabandanije asanura ni Refaya mwene Huri, umutware w'igice c'intara ya Yeruzalemu; uwabandanije asanura ni Yedaya mwene Harumafu, ashikana imbere y'inzu yiwe, hakurikira Hatushi mwene Hashabuneya. Igice ca kabiri casanuwe na Malikiya mwene Harimu, na Hashubi mwene Pahati Mowabu, basanura n'Umunara witwa w'Amatanure. Uwabandanije asanura ni Shalumi mwene Haloheshi, umutware w'ikindi gice c'intara ya Yeruzalemu, ahasanura ari kumwe n'abakobwa biwe. Irembo ry'Akabande ryasanuwe na Hanuni hamwe n'ababa i Zanowa; bararyubaka, batera inzugi zaryo, ibigombo n'ibihindizo vyaryo, basanura n'intambwe igihumbi z'uruhome gushika kw'Irembo ry'Umwavu. Iryo Rembo ry'Umwavyu ryasanuwe na Malikiya mwene Rekabu, umukuru w'intara ya Beti Keremu; ni we yaryubatse, atera inzugi zaryo, ibigombo n'ibihindizo vyaryo. Irembo ry'Iriba ryasanuwe na Shaluni mwene Koluhoze, umutware w'intara ya Mitsipa; araryubaka, ararisakara, atera inzugi zaryo, ibigombo n'ibihindizo vyaryo; asanura kandi uruhome rw'Urugomero rw'Intumwa, iruhande y'umurima w'umwami gushika ku ngazi zimanuka ziva mu Gisagara ca Dawudi. Uwabandanije asanura ni Nehemiya mwene Hazibuki, umutware w'igice c'intara ya Beti Tsuri gushika imbere y'imva za Dawudi, gushika ku rugomero rw'urwubakano, no gushika ku Nzu y'Intwari. Ababandanije basanura ni Abalevi ari bo Rehumu mwene Bani, hakurikira Hashabiya, umutware w'igice c'intara ya Kehila, aserukira intara yiwe, hakurikira benewabo ari bo Bavayi mwene Henadadi, umutware w'ikindi gice c'intara ya Kehila, hakurikira Hezeri mwene Yozuwe, umutware wa Mitsipa, asanura igice kigira kabiri kiri imbere y'umudugo, ahari ibirwanisho, mu mfuruka. Uwabandanije asanura ni Baruki mwene Zakayi, asanurana ishaka igice kigira kabiri, kuva mu mfuruka gushika ku rugi rw'inzu ya Eliyashibu, umuherezankuka mukuru. Uwabandanije asanura ni Meremoti mwene Uriya, mwene Hakotsi, asanura igice kigira kabiri, kuva ku rugi rw'inzu ya Eliyashibu gushika ku mpera y'inzu ya Eliyashibu. Ababandanije basanura ni abaherezankuka, abagabo bo mu kiyaya. Ababandanije basanura ni Benyamini na Hashubi, gushika imbere y'inzu yabo, hakurikira Hazariya mwene Mahaseya, mwene Hananiya, gushika iruhande y'inzu yiwe. Uwabandanije asanura ni Binuyi mwene Henadadi, asanura igice kigira kabiri kuva ku nzu kwa Hazariya gushika mu mfuruka, no gushika mu bwibeto. Palali mwene Uzayi asanura imbere y'imfuruka n'umunara uduga uva ku ngoro nkuru y'umwami yari iruhande y'ikibuye c'ibohero, hakurikira Pedaya mwene Paroshi. Abasuku bunganira Abalevi baba i Hofeli, basanuye kuva kw'Irembo ry'Amazi amaja mu buseruko, hamwe n'umunara warengako. Ababandanije basanura ni ab'i Tekowa, basanura igice kigira kabiri aharabana n'umunara munini warengako, gushika ku ruhome rwa Hofeli. Kuva hejuru y'Irembo ry'Indogobwe hasanuwe n'abaherezankuka, umwe wese asanura imbere y'inzu yiwe. Ababandanije basanura ni Tsadoki mwene Imeri, kuva imbere y'inzu yiwe, hakurikira Shemahiya mwene Shekaniya, umurinzi w'irembo ryo mu buseruko. Ababandanije basanura ni Hananiya mwene Shelemiya na Hanuni, umuhungu agira gatandatu wa Tsalafu, yasanuye igice kigira kabiri, hakurikira Meshulamu mwene Berekiya yasanuye imbere y'icumba ciwe. Uwabandanije asanura ni Malikiya, umwe mu bahingura inzahabu, ashitsa ku nzu y'abasuku bunganira Abalevi n'iy'abadandaza imbere y'Irembo rya Mifekadi, ashitsa no ku cumba co hejuru kiri mu mfuruka. Hagati y'ico cumba co hejuru kiri mu mfuruka n'Irembo ry'Intama, hasanuwe n'abahingura inzahabu hamwe n'abadandaza. Hanyuma Sanebalati yumvise ko turiko turubaka urwo ruhome, arashavura kandi arashangashirwa, aja mu vyo gutyekeza Abayuda. Araheza avugira imbere ya benewabo n'imbere y'ingabo za Samariya, ati: «Mbega barya Bayuda ata co bamaze bariko barakora iki? Boba bagira basanure ivyasambutse ngo basubire guhereza imbagwa? Ubwo hazoshika umusi baheza? Ugira ngo bazozura amabuye yaturiwe bayakure mu birundo vy'ibihomoke?» Tobiya, umuhamoni, yari iruhande yiwe, avuga ati: «Nibapfe kwubaka!
