Ku mpembo nomurengerezako ibingana gute?» Tobito na we amubwira: «Arafise, mwana, uburenganzira bw'ugutwara ica kabiri c'ivyo yaje azanye vyose.» Tobiya ahamagara Rafaheli, amubwira ati: «Akira ica kabiri c'ivyo waje uzanye vyose, ni yo mpembo yawe, uheze wigire amahoro!» Niho Rafaheli yahamagara abo babiri akabihereranya, akababwira ati: «Nimuhezagire Imana kandi muyishingire intahe imbere y'abazima bose kubera ivyiza yabagiriye, muhezagire kandi muririmbire izina ryayo! Nimumenyeshe abantu bose ibikorwa vy'Imana nk'uko bibereye, kandi ntimugatinye kuyishingira intahe. Ni vyiza kuzigama ibanga ry'umwami, ariko birabereye gushira ahabona no gushingira intahe ivyo Imana yakoze. Murakore iciza, inabi ntizobaturukira. Igisabisho kirimwo ukuri n'ugufasha abandi kurimwo ubutungane ni vyiza kuruta itunga ririmwo akarenganyo. Ugushasha abandi ni vyiza kuruta ukurunda inzahabu. Ugufasha abandi kurakiza urupfu, kugahanagura igicumuro cose. Abafasha abandi bazoramba. Abacumura n'abarenganya abandi ni bo ubwabo bigirira nabi. Ngira ndabamenyeshe ukuri kwose, kandi nta kintu na kimwe ndabahisha. Namaze kukubamenyesha ndababwira nti: “Ni vyiza kuzigama ibanga ry'umwami, ariko birabereye gushira ahabona ivyo Imana yakoze.” Burya rero aho wasenga, ga Tobito, na Sara nyene, ni jewe nashikana icipfuzo cari mu gisabisho canyu imbere y'Imana ininahaye, co kimwe na ca gihe wafuba abapfuye. Harya utagonanwa mu kuva hasi no mu kurekera indya ngaho uja gufuba uwapfuye, ni jewe naba natumwe iwawe ngo ndakugeze, kandi Imana yaranantumye kugukiza, mwe n'umukazana wawe Sara. Jewe ndi Rafaheli, umwe mu bamarayika indwi bama ngaho kandi bishikira imbere y'Imana ininahaye.» Baraheza bagwa mu gahundwe uko ari babiri, bagwa hasi bubamye, batekewe n'ubwoba. Ababwira ati: «Ntimugire ubwoba, nimugire amahoro! Murame murahezagira Imana imyaka yose! Aho jewe nari kumwe namwe, si ubuntu bwanje bwatuma mba kumwe namwe, ariko vyatumwa n'ugushaka kw'Imana. Ni yo rero mwokwama muhezagira imisi yose, mukayiririmbira. Mwarabonye ko jewe ata kintu na kimwe nigeze ndya, ariko mukabibona nk'indoto. Ubu rero nimuhezagire Umukama ngaha kw'isi, kandi mushingire intahe Imana. Ehe jewe ndaduze iw'uwantumye. Nimwandike ivyabashikiye vyose.» Aca araduga. Barahaguruka ariko ntibaba bagisubira kumubona. Baraheza barahezagira bongera baririmbira Imana, bayishingira intahe, kubera ivyo bintu bihambaye yari yakoze aho umumarayika w'Imana yababonekera.

Tobito araheza avuga ati: «Imana nzima nihezagirwe mu myaka yose, co kimwe n'ubwami bwayo! Ni yo ubwayo ihana ikongera ikagira imbabazi. Ni yo ishora ikuzima gushika mu nda y'isi, kandi ni yo ubwayo ikirurutsa umuntu ikamukiza urupfu rw'akagirire. Nta na kimwe kiyica mu myanya y'intoke. Nimuyishingire intahe, bene Israyeli, mu maso y'amakungu! Ni yo ubwayo yabashwiragije muri yo, ibamenyesherezayo ubukuru bwayo. Nimuyihayagize mu maso y'abazima bose, kuko ni yo Mukama wacu, ni yo Mana yacu, ni yo Dawe wacu, ni yo Mana mu myaka yose. Niyabahana, ni ukubera ububisha bwanyu, ariko mwese izobagirira imbabazi, ibakure mu makungu yose mwashwiragiyemwo. Nimwayigarukako n'umutima wanyu wose, n'umushasha wanyu wose, mugakurikiza ukuri mu maso yayo, niho izobagarukira, kandi ntizoba igisubira kubahisha amaso yayo. Ubu rero, nimwitegereze ivyo yabakoreye, muheze muyishingire intahe n'ijwi rirenga. Nimuhezagire Umukama nyene ubutungane, muhayagize Umwami yamaho. Jewe, mu gihugu najanywemwo kugirwa imbohe, ndamushingira intahe, nkereka amakungu y'abacumuzi ububasha n'ubukuru vyiwe. Nimwigarure, mwa bacumuzi mwe, mukurikize ubutungane mu maso yiwe! Nta wubizi, hari n'aho yobaraba ryiza, akabagirira imbabazi. Ndahayagiza Imana yanje, n'umushaha wanje ugahayagiza Umwami w'ijuru, ugahimbarwa n'ubukuru bwiwe. Abantu bose nibayirate, kandi bayishingire intahe mu Banyayeruzalemu! Yeruzalemu gisagara ceranda, Imana iguhana kubera ivyo abana bawe bakora, ariko izokwongera igirire imbabazi abana b'intungane. Shingira intahe Umukama n'umutima mwiza, uhezagire Umwami yamaho, kugira ngo ihema ryiwe risubire kwubakwa iwawe mu kanyamuneza. Muri wewe nanezereze abajanywe kugirwa imbohe bose, muri wewe nakunde abagowe bose, uko imvyaro zose zizogenda zirakurikirana mu myaka yose. Umuco wakaka uzotamanzura gushika ku mbibe zose z'isi. Amakungu isinzi azoza avuye kure akugana, ababa ku mpera zose z'isi baze bagana izina ryawe ryeranda, bafise mu minwe amashikanwa yabo bashikaniye Umwami w'ijuru. Imvyaro zose zizokwuzuzamwo agahimbare, witwe Uwatowe uko imvyaro zizogenda zirakurikirana mu myaka yose. Barakavumwa bose abazokubwira amajambo agumye! Barakavumwa bose abazogusambura, bagasenyura impome zawe, hamwe n'abo bose bazositura iminara yawe, bagaturira n'inzu zawe, ariko baragahezagirwa mu myaka yose abazokwubaha bose! Genda rero uhimbarwe mu bana b'intungane, kuko bazokoranira hamwe bose, bagahezagira Umukama yamaho. Barahiriwe abagukunda, kandi barahiriwe abazohimbarwa n'amahoro yawe! Barahiriwe abantu bose bazokuririra kubera uguhanwa kwawe! Nkako bazonezererwa muri wewe, babone akanyamuneza kawe kose mu myaka yose. Mushaha wanje, hezagira Umukama, Umwami mukuru kuko Yeruzalemu izosubira kwubakwa, muri ico gisagara, habe Ingoro yiwe mu myaka yose. Nzoba mpiriwe, nihaba agasigarira k'uruvyaro rwanje gasubira kubona umwaka wawe, bikazotuma gashingira intahe Umwami w'ijuru. Inzugi ya Yeruzalemu zizoba zikozwe mu mabuye y'agaciro y'isafiro n'isimaragido, n'impome zawe zose nyene zizoba zubakishijwe amabuye y'agaciro. Iminara ya Yeruzalemu izoba yubakishijwe inzahabu, inzitiro zayo zubakishijwe inzahabu ityoroye. Amabarabara ya Yeruzalemu azoba ashashemwo amabuye atukura n'amabuye ava muri Ofiri. Mu marembo ya Yeruzalemu hazosamirana indirimbo z'akanyamuneza, mu nzu zaho zose bavuge bati: “Aleluya! Imana y'Israyeli iragahezagirwa!” Abahezagiwe bazoguma bahezagira izina ryeranda mu myaka n'imyaka.»

Amajambo Tobito yakoresheje mu gushinga intahe araheze. Tobito araheza arapfa mu mahoro, amaze imyaka ijana na cumi n'ibiri, bamufubana iteka i Niniva. Yari yahumye amaso afise imyaka mirongo itandatu n'ibiri. Amaze gusubira kubona, yaratunze aratunganirwa, arafasha abandi, aguma arushizaho guhezagira Imana no gushingira intahe ubukuru bwayo. Ari ku mpfiro, ahamagara umuhungu wiwe Tobiya amubwiriza avuga ati: «Mwana, jana abana bawe, muhungire mu Bumedi, kuko jewe ndemera ko ivyo Imana yabwiye Nahumu vyerekeye Niniva vyose bizoba, kandi bikazoshikira Ashuri na Niniva. Ivyavuzwe n'abahanuzi b'Israyeli batumwe n'Imana uko vyakabaye, bizoshika vyose. Nta na kimwe kizohara mu vyo bavuze vyose, vyose bizoshika mu gihe cavyo. Mu Bumedi hazoba urukiza kuruta muri Ashuri n'i Babiloni. Erega jewe ndazi kandi ndemera ko ivyo Imana yavuze vyose bizoranguka kandi bikaba. Mu vyo yavuze, nta jambo rizovamwo. Benewacu baba mu gihugu c'Israyeli bazokurwa muri ico gihugu giteye igomwe, bashwiragizwe bose, bajanwe kugirwa imbohe. Igihugu c'Israyeli cose kizocika umusaka, muri Samariya n'i Yeruzalemu na ho nyene hacike umusaka. Ingoro y'Imana izoba mu gahinda, haciye akanya iturirwe. Hanyuma Imana izosubira ibagirire imbabazi, ibagarukane mu gihugu c'Israyeli. Bazokwongera bubake Ingoro, ariko itameze nk'iya mbere, gushika ku gihe c'aho ivyategekanijwe biranguka. Inyuma y'ivyo, bose bazova iyo bazoba barajanywe kugirwa imbohe, bagaruke, basubire bubake neza Yeruzalemu, n'ingoro y'Imana yubakweho nk'uko abahanuzi b'Israyeli babivuze. Abantu bo mu makungu yose y'isi iyo iva ikagera, bose bazogaruka bubahe Imana vy'ukuri. Bose bazoheba ibigirwamana vyabo vyahendesha ububeshi bwavyo bikabazimiza, baheze bahezagire mu butungane Imana yamaho. Bene Israyeli bose bazoba barokotse muri iyo misi, bazokwibuka Imana mu kuri. Bazotororokana bagaruke i Yeruzalemu. Bazokwibera mu gihugu ca Aburahamu imyaka yose ata nkomanzi, kibegukire. Abakunda Imana vy'ukuri bazohimbarwa, nayo abacumura n'abarenganya bazozimanganya kw'isi yose. Ubu rero, bane, jewe ndababwirije ibi: Nimukorere Imana mu kuri, kandi mukore ibiyishimisha. Murabwirize abana banyu gukurikiza ubutungane no gufasha abandi, baze bame bibuka Imana, kandi bahezagire izina ryayo na ntaryo mu kuri, n'ububasha bwabo bwose. None rero wewe, mwana, urava i Niniva, ntuzohagume. Umusi wafuvye nyoko wawe hambavu yanje, kuri uyo musi ntuzorare na hamwe muri iki gisagara. Nkako ndabona ko muri co hari akarenganyo kenshi kandi huzuye uburyarya bwinshi, ntihagire n'uwo bitera isoni. Itegereze, mwana, ayo Nadabu yakoreye Akiyakaro yamureze. Ntiyamushungururiye ikuzimu abona! Ariko kuri iryo bara yakoze Imana yaramwishuye Akiyakaro abona. Akiyakaro yarasokorotse aja ahabona, Nadabu na we aja mu mwijima w'imyaka yose, kuko yari yarondeye kwica Akiyakaro. Kubera ko Akiyakaro yafasha abandi, yarasimvye umutego w'urupfu Nadabu yari yamuteze, Nadabu na we agwa mu mutego w'urupfu uramwica. None rero, bane, nimwitegereze ico ugufashaabandi kumara, n'ico ububisha bukora, kuko bwo burica! Raba, ubuzima buramvuyeko!» Baca bamuryamika ku buriri, aracikana, hanyuma bamufubana iteka. Maze nyina wa Tobiya na we arapfa, hanyuma Tobiya amufuba hambavu ya se wiwe, aca ajana n'umugore wiwe mu Bumedi, bagerera i Hekibatana hafi yo kwa sebukwe Raguweli. Yarabungabunganye iteka sebukwe na inabukwe bageze mu zabukuru, aho bapfiriye naho, abafuba i Hekibatana mu Bumedi, araheza atorana ivy'umuryango wa Raguweli, co kimwe n'ivya se wiwe Tobito. Tobiya apfa amaze imyaka ijana na cumi n'indwi, apfana iteka. Yapfuye amaze kubona no kwumva ugutikira kwa Niniva, amaze kubona Abanyaniniva bazanwa mu Bumedi kugirwa imbohe na Akiyakaro umwami w'Ubumedi. Araheza ahezagira Imana kubera ivyo yari yagiriye Abanyaniniva na Ashuri vyose. Imbere y'ugupfa, yarahimbawe n'ivyashikiye Niniva, araheza arahezagira Umukama Imana mu myaka n'imyaka.

Mu mwaka ugira icumi na kabiri Nabukodonozori ari ku ngoma, aganza Ashuri ari i Niniva, igisagara kinini, ico gihe Arupakishadi na we yaganza Abamedi ari muri Hekibatana. Arupakishadi yari yarazitije Hekibatana impome z'amabuye abaje y'intambwe zitatu z'ubwaguke n'intambwe zitandatu z'uburebure. Izo mpome yari yazishikanye ku ntambwe mirongo indwi z'ubuhagurutsi no ku ntambwe mirongo itanu z'ubwaguke. Yari yarubatse iminara y'intambwe ijana ku marembo, yubaka n'umushinge w'intambwe mirongo itandatu z'ubwaguke. Kandi yari yarubatse amarembo, amarembo afise intambwe mirongo indwi z'ubuhagurutsi n'intambwe mirongo ine z'ubwaguke, kugira ngo ingabo ziwe zishobore gusohoka ari nyinshi, abarwanira hasi na bo bashobore kuhagirira imyimenyerezo. Muri iyo misi, umwami Nabukodonozori atera umwami Arupakishadi mu kiyaya kinini, ari co kiyaya co mu ntara ya Ragawu. Abantu bose baba mu misozi, n'abantu bose baba ku nzuzi Ewufrati na Tigiri, ababa muri Hidasupe no mu biyaya vya Ariyoki, umwami w'Abelumayi, bakoranira iwe. Amakungu menshi akurira hasi rimwe ngo baje mu rugamba rwa bene Kelewudi. Nabukodonozori, umwami wa Ashuri, atuma intumwa ku bantu bose baba mu Buperesi, no ku baba mu burengero bose, ababa mu Busilisiya, i Damasi, muri Libani, muri Antilibani, ababa ku nkengera y'ikiyaga bose; ababa mu ntara z'i Karumeli, iza Galahadi, izo mu Bugalile bwa ruguru, abo mu kiyaya kinini c'i Esidereloni, abo bose bo muri Samariya, abo mu bisagara vyaho, n'abo hakurya y'uruzi Yorodani gushika i Yeruzalemu, i Batane, i Kelusi, i Kadeshi ku ruzi rwa Misiri, i Tahafanesi, i Ramusesi no mu ntara yose ya Gosheni, gushika amaja ruguru ya Tanisi na Nofi, n'abo bose baba mu Misiri gushika amaja ku mbibe za Etiyopiya. Abantu bose baba kw'isi yose barasuzugura ijambo rya Nabukodonozori, umwami wa Ashuri, ntibaja hamwe na we ngo bafatanye urugamba; ntibamukangwa, ahubwo bagira urunani imbere y'izo ntumwa ziwe, bazirungika zirayoye zuzuye ibimaramare mu maso. Nabukodonozori arashavurira cane ivyo bihugu, aca ararahira kw'izina ry'ingoma yiwe n'ubwami bwiwe ko azokwihora Ubusilisiya, Damasi n'Ubusiriya kuva ku rubibe gushika ku rundi, akicisha inkota yiwe abantu bose baba mu ntara ya Mowabu na bene Hamoni, Ubuyuda bwose n'ababa mu Misiri bose gushika ku nkengera z'ibiyaga bibiri. Akoranya ingabo ziwe, aja gutera umwami Arupakishadi mu mwaka ugira icumi n'indwi; aratsinda urwo rugamba. Hanyuma ashwiragiza ingabo za Arupakishadi zose, abarwanira ku mafarasi biwe bose n'imikogote yiwe yose. Yigarurira ibisagara vyiwe, aragenda gushika i Hekibatana, yigarurira iminara, asibanganya ibibanza vyaho, ubwiza bwaho abuhindura akajoreza. Afatira Arupakishadi mu misozi y'i Ragawu, amusogota amacumu yiwe, arazimangana gushika n'ubu. Araheza arataha we n'ingabo ziwe n'abarwanyi isinzi, aguma aho ata co yinona, aja mu vyo kugira imisi mikuru hamwe n'ingabo ziwe igihe c'imisi ijana na mirongo ibiri.

Mu mwaka ugira icumi n'umunani, ku musi ugira mirongo ibiri na kabiri w'ukwezi gutangura, mu ngoro kwa Nabukodonozori, umwami wa Ashuri, hafatirwa ingingo y'ukwihora isi yose, nk'uko umwami yari yarabivuze. Atumirako icarimwe intwazangabo ziwe zose n'abatware biwe bose, abahishurira umugambi wiwe, hanyuma yivugira we nyene ko agiye gukorera iyo si ikibi kibishe. Niho rero bashinga ingingo y'ukuzimanganya zina muntu wese, bagatikiza abatari bitavye akamo k'umwami. Ahejeje kubabwira umugambi wiwe, Nabukodonozori, umwami wa Ashuri, ahamagara Holoferne, umukuru w'ingabo ziwe, akaba n'icegera ciwe, amubwira ati: «Umwami mukuru, aganza isi yose avuze ati: “Ehe, uzova ngaha ugende, ujane n'abantu biyizi ko bakomeye, abarwanira hasi bashika nk'ibihumbi ijana na mirongo ibiri, n'amafarasi isinzi hamwe n'abayagenderako ibihumbi icumi na bibiri. Uraheza ugende gutera vya bihugu vyose vyo mu burengero, kuko vyagararije ijambo rivuye mu kanwa kanje. Uzobabwira bategure ivu n'amazi, kuko nzoja kubatera nuzuye uburake, isi yose nzoyipfukisha ibirenge vy'ingabo zanje, kandi ndazibirekurireko zibinyage. Ababo bakomeretse bazokwuzura imifurege, imigezi n'inzuzi vyose vyuzure kubera imivyimba y'ababo. Nzobajana aho isi igera hose kugirwa imbohe. Ariko wewe, umaze kugenda uramfatira intara zabo zose, uce ubangumiriza gushika ku musi w'igihano cabo. Nayo abagarariji, ntihaze hagire uwo ijisho ryawe ryihanganira. Ni ukubicisha n'ukubanyaga mu ntara zawe zose. Mbere ndarahiye ubuzima bwanje n'ububasha bw'ingoma yanje! Narabivuze kandi nzobikora n'ukuboko kwanje. Ariko wewe, ntuzorenge kw'ijambo na rimwe mu majambo ya shobuja; uzoyarangure ata gahaze nk'uko nabigutegetse, ntuzotebe kuyarangura”.» Holoferne ava aho shebuja ari, ahamagara ivyariho, intwazangabo n'abakuru b'ingabo za Ashuri. Aharura abagabo bari batorewe kuja ku rugamba nk'uko shebuja yari yabimutegetse. Bashika ibihumbi ijana na mirongo ibiri, n'ibihumbi icumi na bibiri vy'abarasisha imiheto bagendera ku mafarasi. Abatondeka nk'uko batondeka isinzi ry'ingabo ku rugamba. Afata isinzi n'isinzi ry'ingamiya, indogobwe n'impunda vy'ukwikorera imizigo yabo, hamwe n'intama, impfizi z'inka n'impene bidaharurwa vy'ukuzofungura. Umugabo wese atekererwa impamba nini, hamwe n'inzahabu n'ifeza vyinshi cane bivuye mu ngoro y'umwami. Holoferne n'ingabo ziwe bitangira imbere y'umwami Nabukodonozori, baja gutera intara zose zo mu burengero, barazishwara n'imikogote yabo, abagendera ku mafarasi n'abarwanira hasi babo. Isinzi ry'uruvange rw'abantu rijana na bo, rimeze nk'inzige n'umusenyi wo kw'isi, nkako nta washobora kubaharura kubera ubwinshi bwabo. Bava i Niniva, bagenda imisi itatu bagana ikiyaya c'i Bekitireti. Bava i Bekitileti baja gucumbika iruhande y'umusozi uherereye ibubamfu bw'Ubusilisiya bwa ruguru. Ahitana ingabo ziwe zose, abarwanira hasi, abagendera ku mafarasi hamwe n'imikogote yiwe, ava ngaho, yerekeza mu ntara y'imisozi. Ahimbagura Puti na Ludi, yongera anyaga bene Rasisi na bene Isimayeli, bose bari aharabana n'ubugaragwa, mu bumanuko bw'i Kelewoni. Ajabuka uruzi Ewufrati, aca muri Mezopotamiya , atikiza ibisagara vyose vyari ahakirurutse ku ruzi Aburona, gushika ku kiyaga. Yigarurira intara z'Ubusilisiya, ahimbagura abari bamugararije bose, aragenda gushika mu ntara za Yafeti, ziri mu bumanuko aharabana na Arabiya. Akikuza bene Madiyani bose, aturira insago zabo, yongera anyaga impongore zabo. Amanuka mu kiyaya c'i Damasi mu gihe c'ishwabura ry'ingano, aturira imirima yabo yose, atikiza ibitungwa bitobito na bininibinini vyabo, asahura ibisagara vyabo, ayogeza ibiyaya vyabo, kandi acisha ku bugi bw'inkota imisore yabo yose. Ubwoba n'agashitsi bitewe na we bihwikira ababa ku nkengera y'ikiyaga, abari i Sidoni n'i Tiri, ababa i Shuri n'i Okina n'ababa muri Yamuniya bose. Ababa muri Hazoti no muri Ashikeloni baramutinya cane.

Bamurungikira intumwa zimushiriye ijambo ry'ugusaba ihumure, bavuga bati: «Ehe twebwe abasavyi ba Nabukodonozori, umwami mukuru, turi imbere yawe dukoreshe ico ubona kibereye. Ehe amaraso yacu, itongo ryacu ryose n'imirima yacu yose y'ingano, ibitungwa vyacu bitobito na bininibinini, impongore ziri aho ducumbitse biri imbere yawe, bikoreshe ico ubona kibereye. Ehe, ibisagara vyacu n'ababibamwo, ni abasavyi bawe; niwinjire, ubikoreshe ico ubona kibereye.» Abo bagabo bashika kwa Holoferne, bamushikiriza iryo jambo. Amanuka ku nkengera y'ikiyaga, we n'ingabo ziwe, ashira abarinzi mu bisagara biri ahakirurutse, atoramwo abagabo b'intwari bo kubafasha. Abantu baho n'abo mu micungararo bose bamwakira bafise ingori, batamba kandi bavuza n'ingoma. Atikiza intara zabo zose, ahimbagura ibiti vyo mu bitabo vyabo, kuko yari yiyemeje kuzimanganya imana zose zo kw'isi kugira ngo amakungu yose akorere Nabukodonozori we musa, indimi zose n'imiryango yose y'ayo makungu bimwambaze nk'imana. Ashika aharabana n'i Esidereloni, iruhande ya Dotaya, amaja imbere y'urufatangane rw'imisozi mininiminini y'Ubuyuda. Aca acumbika hagati na hagati ya Gayibayi na Sikutayi, araheza ahamara ukwezi kwose kugira yegeranye imizigo yose y'ingabo ziwe.

Bene Israyeli baba mu Buyuda barumva ivyo vyose Holoferne, umukuru w'ingabo za Nabukodonozori, umwami wa Ashuri, yakoreye amakungu n'ukuntu yasahuye mu bitabo vyayo vyose kandi akabizimanganya. Bagira ubwoba bwinshi cane imbere yiwe, bongera bagirira agahinda Yeruzalemu, isengero y'Umukama Imana yabo. Nkako, ni ho bari bakiva iyo bari barajanywe kugirwa imbohe, kandi ni ho igihugu cose c'Ubuyuda cari kigitororokana, kandi ibikoresho, uruhimbi n'ingoro ni ho vyari bigityororwa ubuhumane Barungika intumwa mu ntara ya Samariya, i Kona, i Beti Horoni, i Belimayini, i Yeriko, muri Koba, muri Esora no mu kabande ka Salemu. Bifatira amataba yose y'imisozi miremire, ibigwati vyari bihasanzwe babizitiza impome, hanyuma baraziganya ivyokurya bazokwikorako mu kwitegurira intambara, kuko imirima yabo yaheruka gushwaburwa. Yoyakimu, yari asanzwe ari umuherezankuka mukuru i Yeruzalemu muri iyo misi, yandikira abantu baba i Betuliya n'i Bayitomesitayimu, harabana na Esidereloni, imbere y'ikiyaya cegereye Dotayimu. Yababwira gucungera imidugo yo mu ntara y'imisozi, kuko ari ho hari inzira ija mu Buyuda, kandi vyari vyoroshe kuhatangirira abahaca, kuko haraga ku buryo abantu babiri batahacira rimwe. Bene Israyeli bagira nk'uko umuherezankuka mukuru Yoyakimu yari yabategetse ari kumwe n'inama y'abakurambere b'igihugu c'Israyeli, bari bashashe i Yeruzalemu. Abantu bose b'Israyeli batakambira Imana bashimitse, barisonzesha n'umwete mwinshi, bo, abagore babo, abana n'ibitungwa vyabo, eka n'abanyamahanga bari bahatse indaro, abacangero babo n'abashumba babo, bose bakenyera amagunira. Abantu bose b'Israyeli, abagore n'abana baba i Yeruzalemu, bakubita inkoro hasi imbere y'isengero, bisiga umunyota ku mitwe yabo, baca basasa amagunira yabo imbere y'Umukama. Uruhimbi barukikuza n'igunira, bahurikira hamwe mu gutakambira Imana y'Israyeli n'umwete mwinshi, kugira ngo ntareke ngo abana babo banyagwe, ngo abagore banyuruzwe, ngo ibisagara barazwe bisenyurwe, ngo ibintu vyeranda bihumanywe canke ngo amakungu ahimbarwe n'ukwitwengera. Umukama arumva ijwi ryabo kandi arabona amakuba barimwo. Igihugu gishishikara kwisonzesha imisi myinshi mu Buyuda yose n'i Yeruzalemu, bari imbere y'ikibanza ceranda c'Umukama Mushoboravyose. Umuherezankuka mukuru Yoyakimu, n'abari aho imbere y'Umukama bose, ari bo baherezankuka n'abandi bajejwe ibikorwa vy'Umukama, bahereza inkuka y'ubudahengeshanya, amashikanwa y'indagano n'amashikanwa y'igihugu avuye ku gushaka, bambaye amagunira. Batakambira Umukama bashimitse, inkofero zabo zuzuyeko umunyota, ngo agarukire umuryango wose w'Israyeli.

Bamenyesha Holoferne, umukuru w'ingabo za Ashuri, ko bene Israyeli bariko baritegurira intambara, ko bamaze kwugara amayira yo mu ntara y'imisozi, miremire kandi ko bateze imitego mu biyaya. Aca agira ishavu ryinshi cane, ahamagaza abatware bose b'i Mowabu, intwazangabo za Hamoni, ivyariho vyose vyo ku nkengera y'ikiyaga. Araheza ababwira ati: «Bene Kanahani mwe, nimumenyeshe rero ibi bintu: abo bantu bagandagaje mu misozi ni ba nde? Ibisagara babamwo ni ibihe? Igitigiri c'ingabo zabo kingana iki? Ububasha bwabo n'ubukomezi bwabo bishingiye kuki? Umwami abagaba, agategeka ingabo zabo ni nde? Ni kuki banse kuza kunsanganira nk'abandi bose baba mu burengero?» Akiyori, umutware wa bene Hamoni bose, abwira Holoferne ati: «Databuja niyumvirize ijambo riva mu kanwa k'umusavyi wawe, ndaheza ndakumenyeshe ukuri ku vyerekeye abo bantu baba muri iyo ntara y'imisozi, kandi mubana hafi. Nta kinyoma kiza kuva mu kanwa k'umusavyi wawe. Abo bantu ni abamuka ku Bakasidimu. Ubwa mbere baba muri Mezopotamiya kuko banse gukurikira imana za ba sekuru babo baba mu ntara y'Abakasidimu; baheba inzira za ba sekuru, baca bakorera Imana yo mw'ijuru, Imana bari baramenye, birukanwa kure y'imana z'abo ba sekuru, baca bahungira muri Mezopotamiya, bamarayo igihe kirekire. Imana yabo ibabwira ko bava aho hantu baba ngo bagende mu gihugu ca Kanahani. Barabayo, baharonkera inzahabu, ifeza n'ibitungwa vyinshi cane. Hanyuma baramanuka mu Misiri kuko inzara yari yakwiye mu gihugu ca Kanahani cose, baharonkera ivyokurya baca bagumayo. Baraharondokera cane, abagize umuryango wabo ntibaba bagiharurika. Umwami wa Misiri arabahagurukira, akoresha urwenge, abazigira ku kubumba amatafari; arabacumukuza abagira abaja. Batakambira Imana yabo, na yo ica isuka amahano atagira kivura ku gihugu cose ca Misiri, hanyuma Abanyamisiri barabomora ngo babave mu maso. Imana ikamya Ikiyaga Gitukura imbere yabo, ica ibacisha mu nzira ija Sinayi n'i Kadeshi Barineya. Na bo birukana abantu bose baba mu bugaragwa. Bagerera mu gihugu c'Abemori, bahonya ab'i Heshiboni bivuye inyuma. Hanyuma bajabuka uruzi Yorodani, bigarurira intara yose y'imisozi. Bomora Umukanahani, Umuperizi, Umuyebusi, Umusikemu n'Abagirigashi bose ngo bababise, baca biberaho imisi n'iyindi. Mu gihe badacumuye ku Mana yabo bararoranirwa, kuko Imana bari kumwe yazirana n'akarenganyo. Ariko baramutse bataye inzira yabahaye, baratikirira rwose mu ntambara nyinshi, bakaja kugirwa imbohe mu gihugu kitari icabo, isengero y'Imana yabo igasamburwa, ibisagara vyabo bikigarurirwa n'abansi babo. Ubu, bamaze kugaruka ku Mana yabo, baraduze, bava iyo bari bangarijwe, iyo bari barashwiragiriye, bagerera i Yeruzalemu ahari ingoro nyeranda yabo, bagerera mu ntara y'imisozi, kuko hagaragara. None rero, muhanyi databuja, ico gihugu, nicaba vy'ukuri carayobewe, kigacumura ku Mana yaco, tuzohagabira kubera ubwo bugaba buri muri bo, duheze tuduge tubarwanye. Ariko nihaba ata karenganyo kari mu gihugu cabo, databuja navyihoze, ahandiho Umukama wabo akaba n'Imana yabo yobakingira, natwe tukaba twimaramaje kw'isi yose.» Akiyori ahejeje kuvuga ayo majambo, igihugu cose cari gikikije ihema ku muzingi, kivugira mu vyongoshwi, ivyegera vya Holoferne, abantu bose baba ku nkengera y'ikiyaga n'ababa i Mowabu, basaba ko bomuhimbagura, bavuga bati: «Ntitwotinya bene Israyeli, kuko ehe ni abantu batagira imbaga n'ububasha bw'ukurwana bikomeye. Kubera ico rero, databuja Holoferne, tuzobahagurukira, ingabo zawe zibagire ubunywenywe.»

Uruyogoyogo rw'abantu bari bakikije abari mu nama rumaze guhwama, Holoferne, umukuru w'ingabo za Ashuri abwirira Akiyori imbere y'ishengero ryose ry'abanyamahanga hamwe na bene Mowabu bose ati: «Ubaye nde none ga Akiyori, namwe bacangero ba Efurayimu mubaye ba nde kugira ngo wewe Akiyori, uvuge ka muhanuzi muri twebwe nk'uko ubigize uyu musi, ngo utubuze kurwanya umuryango w'Israyeli, uvuga ko Imana yabo izobakingira? None ni nde wundi ari Imana atari Nabukodonozori, we azorungika ingabo ziwe akabazimanganya kuri iyi si, n'Imana yabo ntibarokore? Ariko twebwe abasuku biwe, tuzobasyokora turi urunani, kandi ntibazokwihanga ubukomezi bw'amafarasi yacu. Nkako tuzobaturirira aho bari. Imisozi yabo izoborerwa amaraso yabo, ibiyaya vyabo vyuzure imivyimba yabo. Ubworo bw'ibirenge vyabo ntibuzokwihagararako imbere yacu, kandi bazopfa urupfu rubi, ni ko umwami Nabukodonozori aganza isi yose avuze. Kandi ko yavuze, amajambo yiwe ntazoba impfagusa. Nawe Akiyori, mucangero wa Hamoni, wewe wavuze ayo majambo umusi wakora icaha, ntuzosubira kumbona kuva uyu musi, gushika nihoye ubwo bwoko bwatorotse buva mu Misiri. None rero, aho nzogarukira, inkota y'intwazangabo zanje n'iy'igihugu c'abasuku banje izotobekeranya imbavu zawe, ugwe hamwe n'ababo bakomeretse. Abasuku banje bazokujana mu ntara y'imisozi, bagushire mu gisagara kiri mu midugo yaho. Ntuzopfa gushika utikiranye na bo. Niwaba mu mutima wawe wizeye ko batazofatwa, ntujonjogore mu maso. Naravuze, kandi nta jambo na rimwe mu majambo yanje rizoba impfagusa.» Holoferne ategeka abasuku biwe bari mw'ihema iwe gufata Akiyori ngo bamujane i Betuliya bamute mu minwe ya bene Israyeli. Abasuku ba Holoferne baramufata, bamujana inyuma y'urusago mu kiyaya, bava aho mu kiyaya baja mu ntara y'imisozi, bashika ku masoko yari hepfo ya Betuliya. Abantu bo mu gisagara kiri kw'isonga ry'umusozi bababonye, bafata ibirwanisho vyabo, bava mu gisagara kiri kw'isonga ry'umusozi, umuntu wese afata itopito, babategerera ku mudugo, babatera amabuye. Baraheza bamanuka munsi y'umusozi, baboha Akiyori, bamurekera aho bamutaye muns i y'umusozi, baca basubira kwa shebuja wabo. Ariko bene Israyeli bamanutse bava mu gisagara cabo, baramushikira; bamaze kumubohora, bamujana i Betuliya bamushikiriza abakuru b'igisagara cabo; Na bo bakaba, muri iyo misi bari Oziyasi mwene Mishe wo mu muryango wa Simeho, Kabirisi mwene Gotoniyeli na Karumi mwene Melikiyeli. Bakoranya abakurambere bose bo mu gisagara, imisore yose n'abagore bose, na bo nyene baraza muri iryo koraniro. Bashira Akiyori hagati muri ico gihugu cose c'abantu, Oziyasi araheza amubaza ivyabaye. Mu kubishura, abamenyesha amajambo yavugiwe mu nama ya Holoferne, amajambo yose yavugiye hagati y'abakuru b'Abashuri n'ubwishime bwose Holoferne yagize ku muryango w'Israyeli. Abantu barunama, bakubita inkoro hasi imbere y'Imana, batakamba bavuga bati: «Mukama Mana y'ijuru, nurabe ubwishime bwabo, ugirire ikigongwe umuryango wacu ucinyizwa, wongere urabe uyu musi abakwihebeye ukuntu bamerewe.» Baraheza bahoza Akiyori, baramukeza cane. Oziyasi amukura mw'ikoraniro, amujana mu ngoro iwe; yongera azimana abakurambere bose. Barara baratabaza Imana y'Israyeli iryo joro ryose.

Bukeye, Holoferne ategeka ingabo ziwe zose n'abantu biwe bose bari bemeye kumufasha ngo bakore umurongo bagende i Betuliya, bigarurire imidugo y'intara y'imisozi, ngo barwanye bene Israyeli. Kuri uyo musi, umugabo wese akibasha afata urugendo. Inteko z'abagabo bagiye ku rugamba zari ibihumbi ijana na mirongo indwi z'abarwanira hasi, n'ibihumbi icumi na bibiri vy'abarwanira ku mafarasi, hatarimwo imizigo n'abagabo bagenda n'amaguru bari muri bo; ryari isinzi rinini cane. Bacumbika mu kiyaya kiri hafi y'i Betuliya, iruhande y'isoko; barahakwiragira hose mu bwaguke kuva i Dotayimu gushika i Belibayimu, mu burebure naho kwari ukuva i Betuliya gushika i Kuyamoni, harabana n'i Esidereloni. Bene Israyeli bababonye ubwinshi bwabo, bibatera ubwoba bwinshi, baca babwirana bati: «Ubu ho bazokungutura isi yose; nta misozi miremire, nta mibande canke imitumba izorinda uburemere bwabo.» Bamaze gufata umwumwe wese ibirwanisho vyiwe, bakadomeka n'ibimuri ku minara yabo, bagumye baraririye iryo joro ryose. Ku musi ugira kabiri, Holoferne agomorera amafarasi yiwe yose kuri bene Israyeli bari i Betuliya. Agenzura imidugo yose ija mu gisagara cabo, agendura n'amasoko y'amazi, aca arayifatira; ahashira ibirindiro vy'abagabo b'abarwanyi, we asubira mu bantu biwe. Hanyuma abatware bose ba bene Ezawu, abakuru bose b'igihugu ca Mowabu n'intwazangabo zo ku nkengera y'ikiyaga baramwegera, bamubwira bati: «Databuja niyumvirize ijambo kugira ntihagire uwo mu ngabo zawe ahagwa; kuko ico gihugu ca bene Israyeli kitishimiye amacumu yaco, ariko cishimiye uburebure bw'imisozi babamwo, kuko ntivyoroshe gushika ku masonga y'imisozi yabo. None rero, databuja, ntubatere nka kurya kw'abarwana bahanganye, niho ata muntu n'umwe wo mu bantu bawe azohagwa. Nugume mw'icumbi ryawe ukingire umuntu wese wo mu ngabo zawe, abasuku bawe na bo bacungere isoko ry'amazi ava munsi y'umusozi, kuko ni ho ababa i Betuliya bavoma. Inyota izobica bace bareka igisagara cabo gifatwe. Twe n'abantu bacu, tuzoduga ku masonga y'imisozi yo hafi, tuhashinge ikirindiro kugira ngo ntihagire umuntu n'umwe asohoka ava mu gisagara. Bazokwicwa n'inzara, bo, abagore babo n'abana babo, kandi inkota itaranabakorako, bazoba barambaraye ku mbuga z'inzu zabo. Uzogerera igihano gihambaye abagararije, ntibaze kugusanganira mu mahoro.» Ayo majambo yabo arahimbara Holoferne n'intwazangabo ziwe zose, aca ategeka ko bakora nk'uko bari bavuze. Icumbi rya bene Hamoni ririmuka rijana n'Abashuri ibihumbi bitanu, bacumbika mu kabande, bifatira imigezi y'amazi n'amasoko ya bene Israyeli. Bene Ezawu na bene Hamoni baraduga, bacumbika mu ntara y'imisozi, aharabana na Dotayimu, barungika bamwe muri bo mu bumanuko no mu buseruko, aharabana na Egrebeli, iri hafi ya Kushi, ku mugezi wa Mokimuri. Ingabo za Ashuri zisigaye zicumbika mu kiyaya, isi yose irazima. Amahema yabo n'imizigo yabo birundwa hamwe, biba ikigunguzi amahanga; vyari vyinshi cane. Bene Israyeli batakambira Umukama Imana yabo, kuko umutima wabo wari watungurutse, kubera ko abansi babo bose bari babakikuje, kandi bikaba bitari bigishoboka ko babava hagati ngo bahunge. Amacumbi y'Abashuri, abarwanira hasi, imikogote, abagendera ku mafarasi babo, bamara imisi mirongo itatu n'ine babakikuje. Amazi arahera mu nkono zose z'abantu baba i Betuliya. Amatangi arakama ntibaba bakironka amazi banywa ngo bashire inyota n'umusi n'umwe, kuko barabagerera mu kubaha ayo banywa. Imicuko yabo ihava iragoyagoya, abagore n'imisore bagwa umwumwa kubera inyota, bakagwa ku bibuga vyo mu gisagara no mu marembo yaco inguvu zabahezemwo. Igihugu cose, imisore, abagore n'abana, gikoranira iruhande ya Oziyasi ari kumwe n'abakuru b'igisagara. Barasemerera n'ijwi rirenga, bavugira imbere y'abakurambere bose bati: «Imana niducire urubanza twe namwe, kuko mwatugiriye nabi cane mu kudasaba ihumure Abashuri. None ubu nta muntu n'umwe dufise adutabara, ahubwo Imana yadutaye mu minwe yabo kugira ngo tugwe imbere yabo kubera ko tunyotewe, turiko turahona buhone. Ubu rero nimubatumeko, muhebere igisagara cose abantu ba Holoferne n'ingabo ziwe zose, bagisahure. Nkako vyotubera vyo tubaye imbohe zabo kuko twopfuma tuba abaja, ariko tukabaho. Gutyo ntituzobona imicuko yacu iriko iradupfira mu maso, abagore n'abana bacu bariko baracikana. Turabasavye kw'izina ry'ijuru n'isi, n'iry'Imana yacu, Umukama wa ba sokuru bacu aduhana kubera ibicumuro vyacu n'ibicumuro vya ba sokuru bacu, ntimushire mu ngiro ayo majambo uyu musi uri hejuru.» Bose baca bakomera induru icarimwe hagati mw'ikoraniro, hanyuma batakambira Umukama Imana n'ijwi rirenga. Oziyasi arababwira ati: «Gumya umutima, benewacu, twihangane iyindi misi itanu; muri yo, Umukama Imana yacu azotugirira impuhwe kuko ntazokwigera aduheba. Ariko iyo misi niyahera ata wudutabaye, nzoca nshira mu ngiro amajambo yanyu.» Araheza ararekura abantu ngo basubire mw'icumbi; baragenda baja ku nzitiro z'amabuye no mu minara y'igisagara cabo; baca barungika abagore n'abana mu nzu zabo; mu gisagara cose bari mu maganya menshi.

Muri iyo misi, Yudita, umukobwa wa Merari mwene Ogisi, mwene Yozefu, mwene Huziyeli, mwene Elikiya, mwene Hananiya, mwene Gedewo, mwene Rafayini, mwene Ahitubu, mwene Eliya, mwene Hilikiya, mwene Eliyabu, mwene Natanayeli, mwene Salamiyeli, mwene Sarasadayi, mwene Israyeli, aravyumva. Umugabo wiwe yari Manase, wo mu muryango wiwe no mu bwoko bwiwe. Yari yapfuye mu gihe c'igesa ry'ingano. Nkako, yariko arahagarikira abatekera imiganda y'ingano mu kiyaya, hanyuma ubushuhe bukaze bwisuka ku mutwe wiwe, ashika ahenukira ku buriri bwiwe, apfira i Betuliya, mu gisagara ciwe. Bamufuba hamwe na ba sekuru biwe mw'itongo riri hagati ya Dotayimu na Balamoni. Hari haciye imyaka itatu n'amezi ane Yudita aba mu nzu iwe ari umupfakazi. Yari yariyubakiye urusago ku gisenge c'inzu yiwe. Yakenyerera igunira mu mafyigo, akambara impuzu ziwe z'ubupfakazi. Yaguma yisonzesha mu misi yose y'ubupfakazi bwiwe, kiretse ku misi irongora amasabato no ku masabato, ku misi irongora imboneko z'ukwezi no ku mboneko z'ukwezi, ku misi mikuru no ku misi y'agahimbare k'umuryango w'Israyeli. Yari mwiza cane ku mutima no ku mubiri. Umugabo wiwe Manase yari yamusigiye inzahabu n'ifeza, abasuku n'incoreke, ibitungwa n'imirima; araheza yigumira mu vyiwe. Nta n'umwe yari kumuvuga nabi, kuko Yudita yubaha Imana cane. Araheza arumva amajambo mabi igihugu cavuga ku mukuru waco, kuko bari bihebuye kuko batagira amazi. Yudita arumva kandi amajambo yose Oziyasi yari yababwiye, ukuntu yari yabarahiye ko azotanga igisagara akagiha abo muri Ashuri mu misi itanu. Yudita amaze kurungika incoreke yiwe yari ijejwe ibintu vyiwe vyose, ahamagara abakurambere bo mu gisagara ciwe, ari bo Kabirisi na Karumi. Yudita abonana n'abakuru b'i Betuliya Baza iwe, aca ababwira ati: «Nyumvirize rero, batware b'ababa i Betuliya: ijambo mwavugiye imbere y'igihugu wa musi ntiritunganye, igihe mwarahira indahiro, muyirahira kw'izina ry'Imana ko muzohebera igisagara abansi bacu, nihahera imisi itanu Umukama atabatabaye. None ubu muri ba nde, kugira mugeze Imana uyu musi uri hejuru, kandi mukishira mu kibanza c'Imana hagati mu bana b'abantu? Ubu muriko murageza Umukama Mushoboravyose, ariko nta co muzokwigera mumenya. Nimwaba mudashobora kumenya akari i bwina bw'umutima w'umuntu, kandi ntimutegere amajambo y'ubwenge bwiwe, none muzoshobora gute gutohoza akari mu Mana yakoze ivyo vyose, kumenya ico yiyumvira n'ugutegera umugambi wayo? Oya benewacu, ntimushavuze Umukama Imana yacu. Nkako niyaba adashaka kudutabara mu misi itanu, arafise ububasha bw'ukudukingira mu misi ashatse, canke bw'ukudutikiriza imbere y'abansi bacu. Ariko namwe, ntimusabire ingwati imigambi y'Umukama Imana yacu, kuko Imana ntikangirwa nk'umuntu, ntiyoberwa nk'umwana w'umuntu. Ni co gituma, mu kurindira urukiza rwiwe, twomusaba ngo adutabare, kandi azokwumvira ijwi ryacu abonye bibereye. Nkako mu ruvyaro rwacu, eka no kuri uyu musi uri hejuru, ntihigeze haba muri twebwe umuryango, igihugu, igisata canke igisagara gisenga imana zahinguwe n'iminwe y'umuntu nk'uko vyigeze kuba mu misi yo hambere, bigatuma ba sokuru bacu baherera ku nkota, bagasahurwa, kandi bagahonera imbere y'abansi bacu. Ariko twebwe nta yindi mana twamenye atari iyo, ari na co gituma twizigiye ko itazotwiyobagiza kandi ko itazovirira umuryango wacu. Nkako, nitwafatwa, n'Ubuyuda bwose buzoba bufashwe, ibintu vyacu vyeranda bizosahurwa, ihumanywa ryavyo rihorwe n'amaraso yacu. Benewacu bagapfa, igihugu kikajanwa kugirwa imbohe, n'intoranwa yacu igatikira, bizogwa ku gatwe kacu iyo tuzoba turi abaja mu mahanga. Abatwigaruriye bazokwitwengera natwe tumaramarire imbere yiwe. Nkako ubuja bwacu ntibuzotuma turabwa ryiza, ahubwo Umukama Imana azobuhindura akagayo. Ubu rero benewacu, nitwereke benewacu ko ubuzima bwabo babukesha twebwe, ko ibintu vyeranda, Ingoro y'Imana n'uruhimbi rweranda bihagaze kubera twebwe. Turetse n'ivyo, nidukengurukire Umukama Imana yacu, atugeza nka ba sokuru bacu. Nimwibuke ivyo yagiriye Aburahamu vyose, n'ukuntu yagejeje Izahaki, n'ivyashikiye Yakobo vyose muri Mezopotamiya y'Ubusiriya, igihe yaragira intama za inarume Labani. Nk'uko Umukama atabaturiye mu gusesa umutima wabo, ni ko natwe atatwihoye, ahubwo ni ukugabisha ko Umukama ahana abamwegereye.» Oziyasi amubwira ati: «Ivyo wavuze vyose wabivuganye umutima mwiza, nta n'umwe azokwanka amajambo yawe. Erega ubwitonzi bwawe ntibwibonekeje uyu musi gusa, kuko kuva ugitangura kubaho, igihugu cose kirazi ubwenge bwawe kuko umutima wawe wiyumvira vyiza. Yamara abantu baranyotewe cane, kandi batugobereye ngo dukore nk'uko twababwiye, twongere dushireko n'indahiro tutazorengako! Ubu rero, nudusabire, kuko uri umugore ayoboka Imana, Umukama azoheza arungike imvura yuzuze amatangi yacu y'amazi, gutyo ntituzosubira gusaragara.» Yudita ababwira ati: «Nyumvirize: ngiye gukora ikintu kizomenyekana mu bana b'igihugu cacu uko imvyaro zizogenda zirakurikirana. Mwebwe murahagarare kw'irembo muri iri joro, nanje ndaza gusohokana n'incoreke yanje, ya misi mwavuga ko iheze muzoca muhebera igisagara abansi bacu itarahera, Umukama azogarukira Israyeli akoresheje ikiganza canje. Ariko mwebwe ntimuze kubaza ico ngomba kugira kuko ntababwira ukuntu ico ngiye gukora kizoranguka.» Oziyasi n'abakuru bamubwira bati: «Genda n'amahoro! Umukama Imana akuje imbere, wihore abansi bacu!» Baca bava mu rusago, basubira mu bibanza vyabo.

Yudita akubita inkoro hasi, yisiga umunyota ku mutwe, akura igunira yari yambaye, mu gihe i Yeruzalemu bariko barahereza ishikanwa ry'ibimoga neza ryo kuri uwo mugoroba mu Ngoro y'Imana. Maze Yudita atakambira Umukama n'ijwi rirenga, avuga ati: «Mukama Mana ya Data Simeho, wewe washize mu minwe yiwe inkota ngo ahane abanyamahanga bapfukuye amabere y'umwigeme w'isugi ngo bamusige iceyi, bagapfukura amatako yiwe ngo amaramare, bakongera bakamusambanya ku gahato ngo bamuteshe iteka. Nkako, wari wavuze uti: “Uko si ko bizogenda”, ariko barabigize. Ni co gituma wataye abakuru babo mu minwe y'ababica, ikinyoma cabo cari cahumanije uburiri ugihanisha amaraso, utikiriza abasuku iruhande y'abategetsi, abategetsi na bo ubatikiriza ku ntebe zabo z'ubukuru. Abagore babo wabahaye ababanyuruza, abakobwa babo ubaha ababajana kubagira imbohe, ibinyagano vyabo vyose urabitanga ngo bigabanganwe n'abana bawe ukunda, baguhurumbira n'umwete, bazira kubona amaraso yabo ahumana, bakagutabaza ngo ubarwaneko. Ewe Mana, Mana yanje, nyumvira jewe umupfakazi! Nkako ni wewe wagize ivya kera, ibiriho ubu n'ibizoza. Wariyumviriye ivy'ubu n'ibizoza, kandi ivyabaye ni ivyo wari wariyumviriye. Ivyo wari warategekanije vyararengutse bivuga biti: “Ehe turi hano!” Nkako inzira zawe zose zirateguye kandi ufata ingingo ubanje kwitondera. Raba ukuntu abo muri Ashuri bagwije ingabo bishira hejuru kubera amafarasi n'abarwanira ku mafarasi, bishima ku kuboko kw'ingabo zirwanira hasi, bishimira inkinzo, icumu, umuheto n'itopito. Ntibamenye ko uri Umukama uhagarika intambara. Umukama ni ryo zina ryawe. Konya inguvu zabo ukoresheje ububasha bwawe, tsinda ubukomezi bwabo ukoresheje ishavu ryawe. Nkako, bigiriye inama y'uguhumanya ibintu vyawe vyeranda, ugutyoza ihema rihangamyemwo izina ryawe rininahaye n'ugusenyuza icuma ihembe ry'uruhimbi rwawe. Itegereze ubwishime bwabo, usuke ishavu ryawe ku mutwe wabo, shira mu kiganza canje, jewe umupfakazi ubukomezi nipfuza. Koresha akarimi kanje gasosa ukubitire umuja iruhande y'umukuru, n'umukuru hambavu y'umusuku wiwe. Cinyiza ijunja ryabo ukoresheje ukuboko kw'umugore. Nkako ubukomezi bwawe ntiburi mu bwinshi, n'ububasha bwawe nyene ntiburi mu bafise inguvu. Ahubwo uri Imana y'abicishije bugufi, umutabazi w'abakene, inkinzo ya ba ntamagara, umuburanyi w'abahebwe, umukiza w'abihebuye. Egome, egome Mana ya data, Mana y'intoranwa yawe Israyeli, wewe ugaba ijuru n'isi, Muremyi w'amazi, Mwami w'ikiremwa cawe cose, niwumvirize wewe igisabisho canje, tuma ijambo ryanje risosa kugira ngo rikomeretse ryongere rimyore abashinze imigambi mibi igeramiye isezerano ryawe, Ingoro yawe nyeranda, umusozi Siyoni n'inzu y'abana bawe. Menyesha intara imwimwe yose n'umuryango uwo ari wo wose ko uri Imana, Imana y'ingabo zose n'iy'ubukomezi, kandi ko ata wundi akingira igihugu c'Israyeli atari wewe.»

Aho ahereje gutakambira Imana y'Israyeli kandi arangije ayo majambo yose, ava hasi, ahamagara incoreke yiwe, aca amanuka mu nzu yahimbarizwamwo imisi y'Isabato n'imisi mikuru; akura igunira yari yambaye, yiyambura impuzu ziwe z'ubupfakazi, ariyoza n'amazi, yisiga amavuta menshi amoga neza, asokoza imishatsi yiwe, ayibohesha urugori rw'igitambara, araheza yambara impuzu ziwe z'umusi mukuru yahora yambara umugabo wiwe Manase akiriho, yambara inkweto ku maguru, ashira ubudede mw'izosi, yambara imiringa, impeta, amahereni, eka ibisharizo vyiwe vyose, arishariza rwose, kugira ahimbare amaso y'abagabo bomuraba. Aha incoreke yiwe inkono y'umuvinyu n'agakarabo k'amavuta, yuzuza isaho ifu y'ingano, igicumbe c'ivyamwa, imikate myizamyiza. Aca atekera neza ibikombe vyiwe vyose, abikorera incoreke yiwe. Barasohoka bagana irembo ry'i Betuliya, basanga Oziyasi n'abakurambere b'igisagara, Kabirisi na Karumi ari ho bahagaze. Hanyuma babonye Yudita bagasanga mu maso hahindutse, yahinduye n'ivyambarwa, batangarira ubwiza bwiwe, bamubwira bati: «Ese Imana ya ba sokuru bacu yokugirira ubuntu, ikarangura imigambi yawe kugira ngo bene Israyeli bahimbarwe, kandi Yeruzalemu igire iteka!» Yudita asenga Imana, araheza ababwira ati: «Bategeke banyugururire irembo ry'igisagara, nce nsohoka kurangura amajambo twavuganye»; hanyuma bategeka imisore kumwugururira nk'uko yabisavye. Babigenza uko nyene, Yudita asohokana n'incoreke yiwe, maze abagabo bo mu gisagara bamukurikiza ijisho gushika aheze kumanuka umusozi n'ukujabuka akabande; hanyuma ntibasubira kumubona. Bagenda baramvuye mu kabande. Ikirindiro c'Abashuri kiramutegera. Baramufata, bamubaza bati: «Uri uwo kwa ba nde? Uva he ukaja he?» Yudita yishura ati: «Ndi umukobwa w'Abahebereyi kandi mpunze iwabo kuko bagire batabwe mu minwe yanyu ngo mubatandagure. None, nje kuraba Holoferne umukuru w'ingabo zanyu, kugira ndamushikirize amajambo y'ukuri, ndamwereke inzira yocamwo kugira ngo yiganzire intara yose y'imisozi, mu ngabo ziwe ata muntu n'umwe ahaguye canke ico cose gifise ubuzima.» Ba bagabo bumvise amajambo yiwe, bakihweza mu maso hiwe babona afise ubutore bw'agatangaza, baca bamubwira bati: «Warokoye ubuzima bwawe mu kumanuka udatevye ukaza kwiyereka databuja. Ubu rero, ingo uje mw'ihema ryiwe, bamwe muri twebwe baraguherekeza gushika bagushikanye iwe. Niwashika imbere yiwe, ntugire ubwoba mu mutima wawe, ahubwo urashikiriza ayo majambo, azoca akugirira neza.» Batora muri bo abagabo ijana, ngo bajane na we n'incoreke yiwe, baraheza barabajana gushika kw'ihema rya Holoferne. Abantu bo mw'icumbi bashikukira rimwe bose, kuko bari bamenyesheje ko yashitse mw'icumbi. Bamaze gushika, baramukikuza akiri inyuma y'ihema rya Holoferne, gushika bamenyesheje Holoferne yuko ari ho ari. Baratamarira ubwiza bwiwe, kandi batamarira na bene Israyeli kubera we, hanyuma umwumwe abwira uwundi ati: «Ni nde yosuzugura ico gihugu kirimwo abagore mwene abo? Mu bagabo si vyiza ko hasigara n'umwe, kuko abosigara boshobora guhuvya isi yose.» Abararira Holoferne barasohoka hamwe n'intwazangabo ziwe, binjiza Yudita mw'ihema. Holoferne yari aruhukiye ku buriri bwiwe munsi y'icugamo kigizwe n'impuzu itukura, gisharijwe n'inzahabu n'ishohamu, kandi giteweko utubuyenge. Ni uko, baramumenyesha ko ari ho ari, aca aja imbere y'umuryango w'ihema ryiwe, imbere yiwe hari amatara akozwe mw'ifeza. Yudita arengutse imbere yiwe n'intwazangabo ziwe, bose batangarira ubwiza bwiwe. Aca akubita inkoro hasi, aramwunamira, abasuku biwe baca baramuhagurutsa.

Holoferne amubwira ati: «Tekana mugore ntugire ubwoba mu mutima, kuko sinigeze ngirira nabi umuntu n'umwe yatoye gukorera Nabukodonozori, umwami w'isi yose. Ubu, iyo abantu bo mu muryango wawe baba mu ntara y'imisozi batankengera, simba narababanguriyeko icumu ryanje. Ariko ivyo ni bo bavyikwegeye. None rero, mbwira igituma wabahunze ukiyizira iwacu. Waje ugana urukiza vy'ukuri. Tekana, muri iri joro nta co uba, eka no mu nyuma. Nta muntu n'umwe azokugirira nabi, ahubwo bazokugirira neza, nk'uko bigirirwa abasuku ba databuja, umwami Nabukodonozori.» Yudita amubwira ati: «Emera amajambo y'umusavyikazi wawe, incoreke yawe ikuyagire, kandi nta kinyoma nza kubwira databuja muri iri joro. Kandi, niwakurikiza amajambo y'incoreke yawe, hariho igikorwa Imana izorangurana nawe, vyongeye, databuja ntazota hasi mu migambi yiwe. Nihahangame Nabukodonozori, umwami w'isi yose, yakurungitse gusubiza umuntu wese mu nzira nziza, nihahangame n'ububasha bwawe. Nkako, kubera wewe, uretse ko abantu bamuyoboka, n'ibikoko vyo mw'ishamba, ibitungwa n'inyoni zo mu kirere vyose bizobaho kubera ububasha bwawe, bitere iteka Nabukodonozori n'umuryango wiwe wose. Nkako twarumvise ubwitonzi bwawe n'ubuhinga bw'umutima wawe, kandi vyaravuzwe kw'isi yose ko ari wewe musa uri mwiza mu bwami bwose, ukaba agahebuza mu bumenyi, ukaba n'igitangaza mu kurongora urugamba. Ku vyerekeye ijambo Akiyori yavugiye mu nama yawe, twarumvise amajambo yaryo, kuko abantu b'i Betuliya bamurokoye hanyuma akabiganira ivyo yari yavugiye imbere yawe vyose. None rero, muhanyi databuja, ntufate minenerwe ijambo ryiwe, ahubwo nurishire ku mutima wawe kuko ari iry'ukuri. Nkako umuryango wacu ntuhanwa, inkota ntibatsinda, kiretse iyo bacumuye ku Mana yabo. Ubu rero, kugira ngo databuja ntazorinde gutsindwa ata n'ico akoze, urupfu rugiye kubashwaramwo, igicumuro cabiganziye ari na co gituma bashavuza Imana yabo igihe cose bayikuyeko. Aho baburiye ivyokurya, amazi yose nayo akabura, baciye bafata umugambi w'ukwikora ku bitungwa vyabo, bigira inama y'ukwifashisha uko bashaka ivyo Imana yababujije kurya mw'itegeko ryayo. Ivyerano vya mbere vy'ingabo, ic'icumi c'umuvinyu n'ic'amavuta bari babitse ngo bavyegurire abaherezankuka bama bakorera Imana i Yeruzalemu, bigiriye inama y'ukubirya kandi ata muntu n'umwe mu gihugu yari arekuriwe n'ukubikozako iminwe. Barungitse intumwa i Yeruzalemu ngo zibazanire uruhusha rutanzwe n'inama y'abakurambere ubona ko n'ababa i Yeruzalemu bari bakoze gutyo. Nibamara kurushikirizwa, bakabikora, uyo musi nyene bazoca batabwa mu minwe yawe ubatikize. Ni co gituma, jewe incoreke yawe, aho menyeye ivyo vyose, naciye mva iwabo ndahunga. Imana yandungitse ngo nkorane nawe ibintu isi yose izokwumva ikumirwa, eka n'abazoba bavyumvise bose. Nkako incoreke yawe irakunda gusenga, igakorera Imana y'ijuru ijoro n'umutaga. Ubu rero, nzoguma iruhande yawe, databuja, incoreke yawe izohora isohoka mw'ijoro igiye ku kabande, mpeze nsenge Imana, izoheze imbwire igihe bazoba bakoze ibicumuro vyabo. Ngarutse nzobikumenyesha, uce usohokana n'ingabo zawe zose, kandi nta n'umwe muri bo azokunanira. Hanyuma nzokujana, ndagucishe mu Buyuda, gushika ushike imbere ya Yeruzalemu. Nzogushirira intebe y'ubutegetsi muri yo, uce ubayobora nk'intama zitari zifise umwungere. Nta n'imbwa izosokorora ururimi ngo igukuge. Nkako ivyo nabibwiwe ndabiburiwe, ndabimenyeshwa ndaheza ntumwa kubigushikiriza.» Amajambo yiwe arahimbara Holoferne n'intwazangabo ziwe zose. Batangarira ubwitonzi bwiwe, baca bavuga bati: «Kuva ku mpera y'isi gushika ku yindi, nta wundi mugore mwiza kandi afise amajambo arimwo ubwenge nka we.» Holoferne amubwira ati: «Imana yaragize neza mu kukurungikira igihugu canje kugira ngo ube ubukomezi mu maboko yacu, ariko utume abakengereye databuja batikira. Ahawe, usa neza, uri umuhinga mu kuvuga. Niwagira nk'uko wabivuze, Imana yawe izoba Imana yanje, uzotsimbatara mu ngoro y'umwami Nabukodonozori, ube rurangiranwa kw'isi yose.»

Holoferne ategeka ko binjiza Yudita ahashinguwe ibikoresho vyiwe bikozwe mw'ifeza, ategeka kandi ko bamugaburira ku vyokurya vyiwe no ku muvinyu wiwe w'ukunywa. Yudita araheza avuga ati: «Sindabiryako kugira ngo ntibibe igitsitaza, ahubwo bazompa ku vyo naje nzanye.» Holoferne amubwira ati: «None ivyo ufise nivyahera, tuzokura hehe ibindi bimeze nka vyo tuguha, ko ata wundi n'umwe wo mu muryango wawe turi kumwe?» Yudita amubwira ati: «Ndarahiye ubuzima bwawe nyene, databuja, incoreke yawe ntizomara ivyo ifise Umukama atararangura ivyo yashinze akoresheje ukuboko kwanje.» Intwazangabo za Holoferne ziraheza zimujana mw'ihema, arasinzira gushika mu gicugu, avyuka umutwenzi ukitse. Atuma abagenda kubwira Holoferne bati: «Databuja, nategeke barekure incoreke yiwe ije hanze gusenga.» Holoferne ategeka abacunzi biwe bamugendanira ngo ntibabimubuze. Yudita amara mw'icumbi imisi itatu. Yaza arasohoka mw'ijoro aja ku kabande k'i Betuliya, kandi akaza ariyuhagirira mw'icumbi kw'isoko ry'amazi. Mu kuduga yaza arasaba Umukama Imana y'Israyeli ngo ayobore umugambi wiwe w'ukuzamura abana b'igihugu ciwe. Amaze kwikura agatosi kose yarinjira mw'ihema akagumayo gushika bamuzanire ibifungurwa vyiwe ku mugoroba. Hanyuma, ku musi ugira kane, Holoferne ategurira inzimano abasuku biwe gusa, ntiyatumira n'umwe mu bakoresha. Abwira Bagowasi, umukevyi ashinzwe ivyiwe vyose, ati: «Genda winginge urya mugore w'umuhebereyi ari iwawe, aze hano dusangire imfungurwa n'inyobwa. Nkako twoba twambaye ibara twirengagije umugore nk'urya ntitumuyagishe; nkako tutamwiyegereje azodutwenga.» Bagowasi arasohoka ava kwa Holoferne, yinjira kwa Yudita amubwira ati: «Iyi ncoreke nziza ntitinye guseruka imbere ya databuja kugira iterwe iteka imbere yiwe, dusangire umuvinyu mu kanyamuneza, kandi uno musi nyene abe nk'umukobwa wo mu Bashuri bama mu ngoro ya Nabukodonozori.» Yudita amubwira ati: «Mbaye nde aho novuguruza databuja? Ico cose azobona ko ari ciza mu maso yiwe, nzogikora ningoga, kandi kizonezereza gushika ku musi w'ugupfa kwanje.» Arahaguruka, yambara impuzu yiwe n'ibisharizo vyose vy'umugore; incoreke yiwe irinjira, isasa hasi imbere ya Holoferne insato z'intama yari yakuye kwa Bagowasi z'ugukoresha igihe cose, kugira ngo azohore afungura azicayeko. Yudita arinjira, aca aricara, umutima wa Holoferne uramuvamwo, umushaha wiwe uradidagizwa, aca yipfuza cane kuryamana na we. Yaguma arondera umwanya nyawo w'ukumuryosharyosha kuva ku musi amubona. Holoferne amubwira ati: «Nunywe rero kandi unezerwane natwe.» Yudita amubwira ati: «Ndanywa databuja, kuko kuva navuka, ubuzima bwanje buratewe iteka muri jewe uyu musi gusumba.» Amaze kwakira ivyo incoreke yiwe yateguye, ararya kandi anywera imbere ya Holoferne. Holoferne yaranezerewe kubera Yudita, aca anywa umuvinyu mwinshi cane atari bwigere anywa n'umusi n'umwe kuva yakavuka.

Bugorovye, abasavyi biwe bataha bihuta. Bagowasi yugara urusago ari hanze, aca ataramura abari aho, abakura imbere ya shebuja, baja kuryama. Nkako, bose bari barushe kubera bari banyoye cane. Yudita ni we wenyene yasigaye mw'ihema, Holoferne na we arambaraye ku buriri bwiwe kuko yabogaboga umuvinyu. Yudita abwira incoreke yiwe kuguma inyuma y'icumba ciwe c'uburyamo n'ukurindira aho asohokera nk'uko yari asanzwe abigira imisi yose. Nkako yavuga yuko aja gusohoka agiye gusenga, yongera abwira Bagowasi gutyo nyene. Bose bava aho baragenda, nta n'umwe yasigaye mu cumba c'uburyamo, kuva ku muto gushika ku mukuru. Hanyuma Yudita ahagarara iruhande y'uburiri bwa Holoferne, asengera mu mutima wiwe, ati: «Mukama Mana nyene ububasha bwose, kubitiza ijisho ku bikorwa vy'amaboko yanje muri uyu mwanya, kugira ngo Yeruzalemu ishimagizwe. Nkako, ubu ni igihe kibereye c'ukugarukira intoranwa yawe n'ukurangura umugambi wanje w'ugusyokora abansi baduhagurukiye.» Ico gihe yegera umutambikwa w'uburiri wari iruhande y'umutwe wa Holoferne, awusokororamwo inkota; araheza yegera uburiri, asumira imishatsi y'umutwe wiwe, avuga ati: «Mukama Mana y'Israyeli, nunkomeze kuri uyu musi.» Hanyuma akubita kabiri ku gikanu ca Holoferne n'inguvu ziwe zose, amuca umutwe. Araheza ahenurira ikiziga ciwe hirya y'umusego, yongera akura icugamo ku nkingi. Haheze akanya aca arasohoka, ahereza incoreke yiwe umutwe wa Holoferne; na we awurokeza mw'isaho yiwe y'impamba, baca barasohokana uko ari babiri nk'uko bari basanzwe babigira bagiye gusenga. Barengana icumbi, bazunguruka ka kabande, baduga ku musozi w'i Betuliya, bashika ku marembo yaho. Akiri kure, Yudita abwira abari barinze amarembo ati: «Nimwugurure, nimwugurure rero irembo, Imana, Imana yacu iri kumwe natwe kugira ngo yerekane kandi ubukomezi bwayo muri Israyeli, yereke n'abansi ububasha bwayo nk'uko yabigize uyu musi.» Hanyuma abagabo bo mu gisagara ciwe bumvise ijwi ryiwe, barihuta bamanuka kw'irembo ry'igisagara cabo, baca batumako abakurambere b'igisagara. Bose barashwabaduka kuva ku muto gushika ku mukuru muri bo, kuko cari igitangaza kuri bo kubona agarutse. Bugurura irembo, baramusanganira, bacana umuriro kugira ngo habone, baca barabashengerera. Yudita ababwira n'ijwi rirenga ati: «Nimuninahaze Imana, nimuyininahaze! Nimuninahaze Imana yo itakuye ikigongwe cayo ku muryango w'Israyeli, ahubwo igasyokora abansi bacu ikoresheje ukuboko kwanje muri iri joro.» Hanyuma akura wa mutwe mw'isaho, arawubereka ababwira ati: «Ng'uwu umutwe wa Holoferne umukuru w'intwazangabo za Ashuri, ng'iki icugamo yari aryamyemwo aborewe. Umukama yamukubitishije ukuboko kw'umugore. Umukama ni muzima, we yankingiye mu nzira naciyemwo; kuko ubwiza bwanje bwahenze Holoferne kugira ngo apfe ata gicumuro akoranye nanje ngo nandure iceyi kandi ngo maramare.» Igihugu cose kiratamarirwa cane, baraheza barunama, basenga Imana bongera bavugira icarimwe bati: «Ewe Mana yacu, urahezagiwe, wewe wahoneje abansi b'igihugu cawe uyu musi!» Oziyasi abwira Yudita ati: «Uragahezagirwa n'Imana Rudasumbwa, mukobwa, kuruta abagore bose bo kw'isi, kandi nihahezagirwe Umukama Imana, we yaremye ijuru n'isi, we yakuyoboye ngo uce umutwe w'umukuru w'abansi bacu Nkako, ukwizigira kwawe ntikuzokwibagirwa mu mitima y'abantu, bazokwama bibuka ubukomezi bw'Imana mu myaka yose. Ese Imana yoguha kwama uninahazwa na ntaryo, ikaguhunda ivyiza, wewe utatinyiririye ubuzima bwawe kubera ko umuryango wacu wari ucubijwe, ahubwo ukanka ko duhona, ukemera kuyoborwa n'Imana yacu.» Abantu bose bavuga bati: «Ni ivy'ukuri! Ni ivy'ukuri!»

Yudita ababwira ati: «Nimunyumvirize benewacu: akire uyu mutwe muwumanike hejuru ku ruhome rw'uruzitiro rwanyu. Hanyuma umutwenzi niwakika, izuba rikarasira kw'isi, umwe wese araca afata ibirwanisho vyiwe; umugabo wese akomeye ave mu gisagara, mwitorere indongozi nk'abagira bamanuke mu kiyaya amaja ku birindiro vy'Abashuri, ariko ntimumanuke. Abashuri na bo bazofata ibirwanisho vyabo bagende mw'icumbi ryabo, bakangure intwazangabo za Ashuri, na bo biruke bagana ihema rya Holoferne, bamubure. Ubwoba buzobatekera, babahunge. Mwebwe n'abo bose baba mu ntara y'Israyeli muzobakinagiza mubatsinde mu mayira. Ariko imbere y'ukugira ivyo, banze mumpamagarire Akiyori, umuhamoni, kugira arabe kandi amenye uwakengereye umuryango w'Israyeli akongera akamuturungikira nk'uwumurungitse gupfa.» Bahamagara Akiyori aho yari mu nzu kwa Oziyasi. Yabaye agishika, abonye umutwe wa Holoferne mu minwe y'umugabo umwe yari mw'ishengero ry'abantu, agwa hasi yubamye, umutima uramwankira. Bamaze kumuvyura, yitura ku birenge vya Yudita, akubita inkoro hasi imbere yiwe, avuga ati: «Urahezagiwe mu nsago zose z'Ubuyuda, no mu ntara yose aho bazokwumva izina ryawe bakagira ubwoba; ubu rero, mbwira ivyo wakoze vyose muri iyi misi.» Yudita amwiganira ari hagati mw'ishengero ivyo yakoze vyose, kuva ku musi yagenda gushika kuri uyo musi yariko arabibiganira. Ahejeje kuvuga, abantu batera impundu n'ijwi rirenga, mu gisagara cabo hasamirana urwamo rw'akanyamuneza. Akiyori abonye ivyo Imana y'Israyeli yakoze vyose, aca yemera Imana rwose, arigenyereza, yinjira mu muryango w'Israyeli gushika n'ubu. Umutwenzi ukitse, bamanika umutwe wa Holoferne ku ruhome. Umugabo wese afata ibirwanisho vyiwe, bose basohoka biciyemwo imigwi, bamanuka umusozi. Abashuri bababonye batuma abaja kubimenyesha intwazangabo zabo, na zo zibimenyesha abakuru bazo, abakuru b'ibihumbi n'abategetsi babo bose. Bashitse kw'ihema rya Holoferne, babwira uwari ashinzwe ivyiwe vyose, bati: «Vyura databuja, kuko ba baja bubahutse kumanuka kuturwanya; duca tubatikiza baherengetere.» Bagowasi arinjira, adodora ku rugi rw'ihema, kuko yiyumvira ko Holoferne aryamanye na Yudita. Yumvise ata wukakaje, akingura urugi, yinjira mu cumba c'uburyamo asanga yapfuye, yatembagarijwe ku curirizo, bamuciye umutwe. Bagoya akoma induru n'ijwi rirenga, arira, aboroga yongera ahogora cane, hanyuma yitaburirako impuzu ziwe. Yinjira mw'ihema aho Yudita yarara, ntiyamubona. Aravumbuka aja iyo abantu bari akoma induru ati: «Abaja bagumutse! Umugore umwe rudende w'Abahebereyi yambitse ibara ingoro y'umwami Nabukodonozori. Ng'uwu Holoferne arambaraye hasi, kandi nta mutwe ukiri kuri we.» Abakuru b'ingabo za Ashuri bumvise ayo majambo, bitaburirako imitamana yabo, imitima yabo iratuntura cane, amaborogo n'induru vyabo biratwaza hagati mw'icumbi.

Abari mu mahema bavyumvise barumirwa n'ivyabaye. Agashitsi n'ubwoba birabuzura ku buryo ata muntu n'umwe yagumye hambavu y'uwundi, ariko basanzarira rimwe, barahunga, bashwiragirira mu mayira yose yo mu kiyaya n'ayo mu ntara y'imisozi. Abari bacumbitse mu ntara y'imisozi mu micungararo ya Betuliya na bo nyene barahunga. Ico gihe, bene Israyeli, abagabo bose bashobora kurwana bari muri bo baboma amaguru mu nyuma. Oziyasi arungika i Bayitomasitayimu, i Bebayi, i Kobayi, i Kola no mu ntara yose y'Israyeli kumenyesha ivyabaye kugira ngo abantu baho bose basimbire ku bansi, babatikize. Bene Israyeli bavyumvise babasimbirako bose icarimwe, barabica gushika n'i Koba. Abava i Yeruzalemu no mu ntara yose y'imisozi na bo baraza, kuko bari bamenyeshejwe ivyari vyabaye mw'icumbi ry'abansi babo. Ababa i Galahadi no mu Bugalile babatera babaturutse mu mbavu barabatikiza rwose gushika bashike i Damasi n'iyo imbibe zayo zigarukira. Ababa i Betuliya basigaye basimbira kw'icumbi ry'Abashuri, barabanyaga, bahakura itunga ryinshi cane. Bene Israyeli bagarutse bavuye gutikiza abansi; baca biganzira abacitse kw'icumu, ababa mu bigwati n'abari mu buragiro bwo mu ntara y'imisozi no mu kiyaya, basahura ibintu vyinshi; nkako hari ibintu vyinshi cane. Yoyakimu, umuherezankuka mukuru hamwe n'inama y'abakurambere ba bene Israyeli baba i Yeruzalemu baza kuraba ivyiza Umukama yakoreye Israyeli, n'ukuraba Yudita ngo baramukanye amahoro. Binjiye iwe, baramuhezagira bose hamwe, bamubwira bati: «Uri mukuru muri Yeruzalemu, iteka rinini ry'Israyeli, icubahiro kizima c'umuryango wacu! Ivyo vyose wabikoresheje ukuboko kwawe, wagiriye ivyiza Israyeli, n'Imana yarabishimye. Uragahezagirwa n'Umukama Mushoboravyose imyaka n'imyaka.» Ishengero ryose rivuga riti: «Ni ivy'ukuri!» Igihugu cose gisahura iryo cumbi mu misi mirongo itatu. Bashikiriza Yudita ihema rya Holoferne, ibikoresho vyose bikozwe mw'ifeza, uburiri, amabesani n'ibindi bikoresho vyiwe vyose. Aravyakira, abiremeka ku ndogobwe yiwe, aboherako imikogote yiwe aca abirundamwo. Abagore bose b'Israyeli barashikuka ngo bamurabe, hanyuma baramuhezagira. Bamwe muri bo baca baramutambira. Yakira udukoni mu minwe yiwe, aduha abagore bari kumwe na we. Hanyuma bambara ingori z'amashami y'imizeti, we n'abo bari kumwe. Hanyuma arenguka imbere y'ishengero ryose arongoye umugwi w'abagore bose baririmba. Abagabo bose b'Israyeli baramukurikira bafise ibirwanisho, bambaye ingori, kandi batera indirimbo. Yudita rero atera ururirimbo rw'amashemezo muri Israyeli yose, igihugu kiritabira urwo ruririmbo n'ijwi rirenga.

Yudita avuga, ati: «Nimuterere Imana yanje umurisho w'ingoma! Ririmbire Umukama muvuza urusama, mumucurarangire izaburi mumushimagiza. Nimuhaye kandi mwambaze izina ryiwe. Nkako Imana ihagarika indwano, ni Umukama. Kuko mu rusago rwiwe, hagati mu gihugu, ni ho yankuriye mu minwe y'abampama. Abashuri bavuye mu misozi yo mu buraruko, baza bazanye ingabo zigizwe n'abantu ibihumbi n'ibihumbi, iryo sinzi rizibira inzuzi, ababo barwanira ku mafarasi barakubita imisozi irazima. Yahiga guturira intara yanje, kumarira ku nkota imisore yanje, gucuranguriza hasi abakiri kw'ibere, kunsahura abana banje n'ukunyuruza abigeme banje! Umukama Mushoboravyose yabataye mu minwe y'umugore. Intwari yabo ntiyishwe n'imisore, bene Titani ntibayishe, ibihangange vy'ijunja ntivyayishe, ariko Yudita, umukobwa wa Merari, yayitsindishije ubwiza bwo mu maso hiwe. Yambuye ivyambarwa vyiwe vy'ubupfakazi kugira aremurure abaruhijwe bo muri Israyeli, yisiga mu maso ibimoga neza, apfungisha imishatsi yiwe agatambara, yambara ikanzu yera iremvye kugira ngo Holoferne amugomwe; inkweto ziwe zihimbara amaso yiwe, ubwiza bwiwe na bwo bumutwara umutima, inkota imuca izosi. Abaperesi bahindishwa agashitsi n'ubutwari bwiwe, Abamedi na bo bahagarikwa umutima n'ubuhizi bwiwe. Abanje baruhijwe bavugije induru, abansi bagira ubwoba; ba ntamagara banje bavugije urwamo, abansi bahinda agashitsi, bashize ijwi hejuru naho baca bagwa igihumura. Abahungu bavuka ku bakobwa ni bo babasogose, babakomeretsa nk'abana b'abahemutse ku rugamba, bahonera mu ntambara y'Umukama wanje. Nzoririmbira Imana yanje ururirimbo rushasha; Mukama, uri mukuru kandi uraninahaye, uratangarirwa kubera ubukomezi bwawe, uri mutananirwa! Ibiremwa vyose nibigukorere, kuko waravuze bica birabaho; wararungitse umutima wawe uca urabiremarema; nta muntu n'umwe ananira ijwi ryawe. Nkako imisozi izonyiganyizwa n'amazi, inyiginyuke ku mishinge yayo, ibitandara vy'amabuye bizoshonga nk'ishashara imbere yawe. Ariko abakwubaha wama ubaraba ryiza. Nkako imbagwa iyo ari yo yose ni ntoyi kugira ngo igire akamotera keza; ibinure vyayo vyose na vyo ni bikeyi cane kugira ngo babiguhereze nk'inkuka. Ariko uwubaha Umukama we, ni mukuru muri vyose Aragowe amakungu arwanya umuryango wanje. Umukama Mushoboravyose azoyihora ku musi w'urubanza mu gusuka umuriro n'inyo mu mibiri yabo, baheze baririre muri ubwo bubabare imyaka yose.» Aho bashikiye i Yeruzalemu barasenze Imana, hanyuma igihugu kimaze gutyororwa, baciye bahereza inkuka zabo, amashikanwa avuye ku gushaka kwabo, batanga n'amaturo. Yudita yegurira Imana ibintu vyose vya Holoferne igihugu cari camuhaye, ca cugamo c'impuzu na co yari yikuriye we nyene mu cumba c'uburyamo, acegurira Imana. Igihugu kija mu gahimbare i Yeruzalemu imbere y'ikibanza ceranda ikiringo c'amezi atatu, kandi Yudita agumana na bo. Iyo misi iheze, umwe wese asubira mw'itongo iwe. Yudita agenda i Betuliya yigumira mw'itongo ryiwe. Aguma yubahwa mu gihugu cose igihe yari akiriho. Benshi baramwipfuza, ariko nta mugabo n'umwe yamumenye mu misi yose y'ubuzima bwiwe kuva umusi umugabo wiwe Manase yapfa agahambwa hamwe n'abantu b'iwabo. Asazana iteka rinini cane mu nzu y'umugabo wiwe gushika ku myaka ijana n'itanu. Aha incoreke yiwe umwidegemvyo, araheza apfira i Betuliya, bamuhamba mu ruhafu rw'umugabo wiwe Manase. Umuryango w'Israyeli ugandarira Yudita imisi indwi. Imbere y'uko apfa yari yaragaburiye amatungo yiwe incuti zose z'umugabo wiwe Manase n'incuti z'umuryango wiwe. Nta muntu yabaye agisubira gutera ubwoba bene Israyeli Yudita akiriho, no mu misi itari mike yakurikiye urupfu rwiwe.

Mu mwaka ugira kabiri umwami mukuru Ahashuwerusi ari ku ngoma, kw'igenekerezo rya mbere rya Nisani, Marudokayi ashikirwa n'indoto. Yari mwene Yayiri, mwene Shimehi, mwene Kishi wo mu muryango wa Benyamini, umuntu w'Umuyuda aba mu gisagara c'i Shushani, yari umuntu ahambaye, asukura ku kirimba c'umwami. Ariko yari umwe mu bambukanywe, abo Nabukodonozori umwami wa Babiloni yambukanye abavana i Yeruzalemu hamwe na Yekoniya, umwami w'Ubuyuda. Izo ndoto zari izi: Induru y'uruyogoyogo, imituragaro na nyamugigima n'intureka kw'isi. Ng'ivyo ibiyoka amahanga bibiri, biragabirije, bigira birwane uko ari bibiri. Hari urwamo rwinshi; kubera urwo rwamo igihugu cose caciye citegurira urugamba kugira ngo kirwanye igihugu c'intungane. Ng'uwo umusi w'umuzimagiza n'umwijima, w'amarushwa n'agahinda, w'agacinyizo n'intureka nyinshi kw'isi. Igihugu ci'intungane cose hamwe kiriko kirahinda agashitsi gitinya amabi agihanamiye, citeguriye gutikira none kiriko kiratabaza Imana. Uko gitabaza hisuka amazi menshi nka kurya isoko ritoyi rivamwo uruzi runini. Uko izuba riseruka ni ko umuco utamanzura. Abicisha bugufi bashirwa hejuru, bagatandagura abaninahaye. Marudokayi yikanguye, amaze kubona izo ndoto n'ico Imana ishaka kurangura, agumiza ku mutima ivyo bintu, hashika mw'ijoro akirondera kubitegera. Hanyuma Marudokayi aguma ku kirimba ari kumwe na Bigetana na Tereshin, abakevyi babiri b'umwami bacungera ikirimba. Arumva imigambi yabo n'imyitwarariko yabo; aramenya ko biteguriye kwica umwami Ahashuwerusi, aca abimenyesha umwami. Umwami arasambisha ba bakevyi babiri. Bamaze kuvyiyemerera, baca barirukanwa. Umwami arandika ivyo bintu kugira ngo bazokwame bavyibuka, Marudokayi na we nyene aravyandika. Hanyuma umwami aha itegeko Marudokayi ry'ugusukura ikirimba, amuha n'udushimwe kubera ivyo. Aho hari kandi Hamani mwene Hamedata Umwagagi, yari atonye ku mwami, araheza arondera gukorera ikibi Marudokayi n'igihugu ciwe kubera ba bakevyi babiri b'umwami.

Hari mu gihe ca Ahashuwerusi. Uwo Ahashuwerusi yaganza intara ijana na mirongo ibiri n'indwi kuva ku Buhindi gushika kuri Kushi. Muri ico gihe, umwami Ahashuwerusi yicaye ku ntebe yiwe y'ubwami yari i Shushani ku murwa mukuru. Mu mwaka ugira gatatu ari ku ngoma, ategurira inzimano abatware biwe bose n'abasavyi biwe. Ingabo z'Ubuperesi n'Ubumedi, abanyacubahiro n'abatware b'intara bari barengutse iwe. Amara igihe kirekire, imisi ijana na mirongo umunani yose, abereka itunga rigize ininahazwa ry'ubwami bwiwe n'iteka ry'ubukuru bwiwe bw'icubahiro. Iyo misi irangiye, umwami azimana abantu bari aho i Shushani ku murwa mukuru, kuva ku mukuru gushika ku muto; iyo nzimano imara imisi indwi, abazimanira ku mbuga mu kigo c'ingoro y'umwami. Hari hasharijwe n'impuzu zera n'iz'urwatsi rutoto zipfunditse ku migozi y'inyuzi zera n'izitukura, zimanitswe ku mpeta z'ifeza, ku nkingi z'amabuye yera abaje neza. Hariho n'ibitanda bikozwe mu nzahabu no mw'ifeza, biri ku masaso y'amabuye abaje neza, ayatukura, ayera, ay'umuhondo n'ayirabura. Bazimaniye ibinyobwa mu bikombe vy'inzahabu no mu bikombe vy'ubundi bwoko, maze umuvinyu w'ibwami urisuka nk'uwutanzwe n'umwami nyene. Banywa nk'uko bitegekanijwe, ata gahato, kuko uko ariko umwami yari yabitegetse umubwiriza wese wo mu ngoro iwe kugirira umwumwe wese ico ashaka. Umwamikazi Vashiti na we nyene, azimana abagore mu ngoro y'ubwami y'umwami Ahashuwerusi. Ku musi ugira indwi, igihe umutima w'umwami wari unezerejwe n'umuvinyu, umwami abwira Mehumani, Bizita, Harubona, Bigita na Abagita, Zetari na Karikasi, abo uko ari indwi bari abakevyi bakorera umwami Ahashuwerusi ngo barengutse umwamikazi Vashiti imbere y'umwami, kandi aze yambaye urugori rw'ubwami. Umwami yashaka kwereka abantu n'abatware bari ngaho, ubwiza bw'uwo mwamikazi, kuko yari aryoheye ijisho. Ariko umwamikazi Vashiti aranka kwitaba ubwo butumire umwami yari yarungikanye abo bakevyi. Maze umwami araraka cane, ishavu rimururumbiramwo. Umwami ahanuza abahinga bazi kuraba ivy'ibihe, kuko uko ni ko umwami yabigenza imbere y'abazi amategeko n'ingingo bose. Muri bo, abishikira bari Karishena, Shetari, Adumata, Tarashishi, Meresi, Marisena na Memukani, abatware indwi b'Ubuperesi n'Ubumedi, bama imbere y'umwami, bakicara mu bibanza vy'imbere mu bwami. Arababaza ati: «Dukurikije itegeko, twogira gute umwamikazi Vashiti ko ataranguye ijambo ry'umwami Ahashuwerusi, yatumye abakevyi?» Memukani avuga ari imbere y'umwami n'abatware ati: «Umwamikazi Vashiti ntiyacumuye ku mwami gusa, yacumuye kandi no ku batware bose n'abantu bose bari mu ntara zose z'umwami Ahashuwerusi. Nkako iyo nyifato y'umwamikazi Vashiti izomenyekana mu bagore bose, bitume barabana akagayo abagabo babo, bavuga bati: “N'umwami Ahashuwerusi yaravuze ngo barengutse umwamikazi Vashiti, imbere yiwe, ariko ntiyarenguka”. None kuri uyu musi abatwarekazi bo mu Buperesi no mu Bumedi bumvise iyo nyifato y'umwamikazi ni ko bazoza barabwira abatware bose b'umwami, bihave bivamwo akagayo n'imitongano. None rero, niyaba umwami abona ko ari vyiza, nihasohoke itegeko ntabanduka ry'umwami, ryandikwe mu mategeko y'Ubuperesi n'Ubumedi, rivuga ko Vashiti atazokwongera guseruka imbere y'umwami Ahashuwerusi, kandi ko n'iteka ryiwe ry'ubwamikazi umwami agiye kuriha umwe mu bagenzi biwe yomwubaha kumurusha. Igihe iryo tegeko umwami azoba yatanze rizoba ryamaze kwumvikana mu bwami bwiwe bwose, ubona ko ari bunini, abagore bose bazoheza bahe icubahiro abagabo babo, kuva ku mukuru gushika ku muto.» Iryo jambo rirahimbara umwami n'abatware, umwami araheza akora nk'uko Memukani yavuze. Hanyuma arungika amakete mu ntara zose z'umwami, intara yose akurikije inyandiko yayo, igihugu cose akurikije ururimi rwaco, kugira ngo umugabo wese agire ijambo mu rugo rwiwe kandi avuge ururimi ruvugwa mu gihugu ciwe.

Ivyo biheze, ishavu ry'umwami Ahashuwerusi rimaze guturura, yibuka Vashiti n'ivyo yakoze hamwe n'ingingo yafatiwe. Maze abagendanyi bakorera umwami bavuga bati: «Nibaronderere umwami abigeme bakiri isugi baryoheye ijisho. Vyongeye umwami nagene abagenduzi mu ntara zose z'ubwami bwiwe, baheze bajane umwigeme wese akiri isugi kandi aryoheye ijisho i Shushani ku murwa mukuru, mu nzu y'abagore, bamushinge Hegayi, umukevyi w'umwami akaba n'umurinzi w'abagore, kugira ngo aze arabaha ivyo bisiga. Maze umwigeme azohimbara umwami abe ari we aba umwamikazi mu kibanza ca Vashiti.» Iryo jambo riranezereza umwami; aca akora gutyo. I Shushani ku murwa mukuru, hari Umuyuda yitwa Marudokayi, mwene Yayiri, mwene Shimehi, mwene Kishi, umuntu w'Umubenyamini, yari yavanywe i Yeruzalemu hamwe n'abajanywe kugirwa imbohe hamwe na Yekoniya umwami w'Ubuyuda, bakajanwa kugirwa imbohe na Nabukodonozori umwami wa Babiloni. Marudokayi yari areze Hadasa, ari we Esitera, umukobwa wa sewabo kuko atari afise se, ntagire nyina, akaba uwo mukobwa yari afise imero nziza kandi aryoheye ijisho. Se wiwe na nyina wiwe bamaze gupfa, Marudokayi yaciye amutunga nk'umukobwa wiwe. Iryo jambo ry'umwami n'itegeko ryiwe bimaze kumenyekana, kandi abakobwa benshi bamaze gukoranirizwa i Shushani, ku murwa mukuru, bagashikirizwa Hegayi, Esitera yaciye ajanwa mu ngoro y'umwami, ashikirizwa Hegayi, umurinzi w'abagore. Uwo mukobwa aramuhimbara, aca aramutonesha. Aca yihuta kumuha ivyo aza arisiga n'ivy'ukurya, amuha n'incoreke indwi zatowe mu ngoro y'umwami, aca amwimurira n'incoreke ziwe mu ruhande rwiza rw'inzu y'abagore. Esitera ntiyari yarahishuye igihugu ciwe canke amamuko yiwe, kuko Marudokayi yari yaramubujije kubihishura. Imisi yose Marudokayi yama atembera imbere y'imbuga y'iyo nzu y'abagore kugira ngo amenye ko Esitera ari mu mahoro n'uburyo bamubungabunga. Igihe kigeze, umukobwa umwumwe wese yagenda kubonana n'umwami Ahashuwerusi, ahejeje ikiringo c'amezi icumi n'abiri nk'uko itegeko rigenga abagore ryabitegekanya. Nkako ng'uku uko vyagenda mu misi y'ukwitegura: bamara amezi atandatu bisiga amavuta yitwa mira, ayandi mezi atandatu bakayamara bisiga ibimoga neza n'ibindi bigira neza abagore. Uwo mukobwa rero agiye kubonana n'umwami, ico cose asavye yaragihabwa, kugira ngo agende akijanye, ava mu nzu y'abagore aja mu ngoro y'umwami. Yinjira ku mugoroba, mu gitondo akagaruka ashikira mu yindi nzu y'abagore iganzwa na Shahashigazi, umukevyi w'umwami yararira abahabara, kandi ntiyigera asubira kuja kubonana n'umwami, kiretse umwami wenyene amushimye akamuhamagara mw'izina. Hashitse igihe c'uko Esitera, umukobwa wa Abihayili, sewabo wa Marudokayi, umwe yari yamutunze nk'umukobwa wiwe agenda kubonana n'umwami, nta kintu yasavye kiretse ivyo Hegayi, umukevyi w'umwami akaba n'umurinzi w'abagore yari yaravuze. Esitera yaguma aryohera ijisho ry'abamubona bose. Esitera ajanwa kubonana n'umwami Ahashuwerusi mu ngoro yiwe y'ubwami, mu kwezi kugira icumi, ari kwo kwezi kwa Tebeti, mu mwaka ugira indwi, uwo mwami ari ku ngoma. Umwami arakunda Esitera kurusha abandi bagore bose, na we aronka iteka kandi aratona mu maso yiwe kurusha abandi bigeme bose; umwami amwambika urugori rw'ubwami ku mutwe kandi amugira umwamikazi mu kibanza ca Vashiti. Hanyuma umwami azimana inzimano y'agakura abatware biwe n'abagendanyi biwe bose, inzimano yitiriwe Esitera. Aha umusi w'akaruhuko intara ziwe, kandi aragabira abantu nk'umwami nyene. Igihe abo bigeme bakoranira hamwe ubugira kabiri, Marudokayi yaciye yicara kw'irembo ry'umwami. Esitera na we ntiyari yigeze ahishura amamuko yiwe canke igihugu ciwe kuko Marudokayi yari yarabimwihanije. Esitera yarangura ico Marudokayi amubwiye nko mu gihe yari akimureze. Muri iyo misi nyene, igihe Marudokayi yari yicaye kw'irembo ry'umwami, Bigitani na Tereshi, abakevyi babiri b'umwami bo mu barinzi b'irembo, barashangashirwa barondera kwica umwami Ahashuwerusi. Marudokayi aramenya ivyo bintu, aca abimenyesha umwamikazi Esitera, Esitera na we abibwira umwami kw'izina rya Marudokayi. Hanyuma baratohoza ivyo bintu, barabitora; abo bagabo babiri baca bamanikwa ku giti. Ivyo bica vyandikwa umwami abona, mu gitabu c'urukurikirane rw'ivyo ku ngoma z'abami.

Ivyo biheze, umwami Ahashuwerusi agira mukuru Hamani mwene Hamedata, Umwagagi, amutera iteka, amugira mukuru mu batware bose bari kumwe na we. Abasuku b'umwami bose bari kw'irembo ry'umwami, bategerezwa kwunamira n'ugukubita inkoro hasi imbere ya Hamani nk'uko umwami yari yategetse kubimugirira. Ariko Marudokayi we ntiyigera yunama kandi ntiyakubita inkoro hasi. Abasuku b'umwami bari kw'irembo ry'umwami babwira Marudokayi bati: «Ni kuki utakurikiza itegeko ry'umwami?» Bama babimubwira ku musi ku musi, ariko ntabumvirize. Niho babimenyesha Hamani kugira ngo barabe ko iyo nyifato ya Marudokayi ibandanya. Nkako, yari yarabamenyesheje ko ari Umuyuda. Hamani abonye ko Marudokayi atamwunamira canke ntakubite inkoro hasi imbere yiwe, Hamani arashavura cane. Abona bitoba bikwiye kwica Marudokayi gusa kuko bari bamumenyesheje igihugu Marudokayi avukamwo. Niho rero Hamani yarondera guhonya Abayuda bose, igihugu ca Marudokayi, bari mu bwami bwose bwa Ahashuwerusi. Mu kwezi gutangura, ari kwo kwezi kwa Nisani, mu mwaka ugira icumi na kabiri umwami Ahashuwerusi ari ku ngoma, baterera Ipuri, ni ukuvuga ubufindo, imbere ya Hamani, babigira ku musi ku musi, ku kwezi ku kwezi. Ubufindo bufindukira ku kwezi kw'icumi na kabiri ari kwo Adari. Maze Hamani abwira umwami Ahashuwerusi ati: «Hariho igihugu cashwiragiye gisabagira mu bantu, mu ntara zose z'ubwami bwawe. Imigenzo yabo iratandukanye n'iy'ibindi bihugu vyose, n'amategeko y'umwami ntibayubahiriza; ntibikwiye ko umwami yobareka ngo bagume bitekaniye. Niyaba umwami abona ko ari vyiza, niyandike urwandiko rw'ukubahonya, mpeze ngerere abazokora ico gikorwa amatarenta ibihumbi icumi y'ifeza, baze bayajane mu bubiko bw'umwami.» Umwami yiyambura impeta yiwe ku rutoke, ayiha Hamani mwene Hamedata, Umwagagi, umwansi w'Abayuda. Umwami abwira Hamani ati: «Ifeza urazigumya, abo bantu na bo urabakoza ico ubona kibereye.» Niho rero abanditsi b'umwami bahamagarwa mu kwezi gutangura, kw'igenekerezo ry'icumi na gatatu, baraheza bandika ivyo vyose Hamani yari yategetse ivyegera vy'umwami n'ivyariho vyagaba intara yose n'abatware, abantu mu ntara iyo ari yo yose bakurikije inyandiko yayo, intara yose bakurikije ururimi rwayo, vyandikwa kw'izina ry'umwami Ahashuwerusi, kandi bidomwako ikidodo c'impeta y'umwami. Ayo makete arungikanwa abirutsi mu ntara zose z'umwami kugira ngo bahonye, bice kandi bazimanganye Abayuda bose, kuva ku musore gushika ku mutama, abana n'abagore, bicirwe umusi umwe, kw'igenekerezo ry'icumi na gatatu ry'ukwezi kw'icumi na kabiri, ari kwo kwezi kwa Adari, bongere babanyage ivyo batunze. Ng'iki icimuro c'iryo kete: «Jewe Ahashuwerusi, umwami mukuru, nandikiye ivyariho n'ivyegera vyabo vy'intara ijana na mirongo ibiri n'indwi kuva ku Buhindi gushika kuri Kushi ibi bikurikira: Jewe ngaba ibihugu vyinshi nkaganza isi yose, nipfuza ko ntokwishira hejuru kubera ubwishime bw'ugutegeka, ahubwo ko notwara neza imisi yose mu bwitonzi, kugira ngo mu gutwara nsasagaze hose ubuzima butagira inkomanzi, nongere ntume ubwami butekana, buba nyabagendwa kuva ku rubibe gushika ku rundi, kandi ngarukane amahoro abantu bose bipfuza. Ariko mbajije abajenama banje ukuntu ivyo bintu vyoranguka, Hamani, uwahebuje mu bwitonzi muri twebwe, yerekanye ugushaka ntangere mu buryo butayegayega n'ukwemera gukomeye, akaba yaronse iteka ry'ukuba uwa kabiri mu bwami, yatumenyesheje ko mu miryango ikwiragiye kwisi hari ubwoko bw'ababisha, ata n'igihugu na kimwe bahuza kubera amategeko yabo, abantu bama bahakana ingingo zifatwa n'umwami, bigatuma intwaro rusangi turongoye ata mahinyu idashinga imizi. None rero, tumaze kumenya ko ico gihugu ari co conyene kidahuza n'umuntu n'umwe muri vyose, kandi ko cishira ukwa conyene mu gukurikiza amategeko cisangije, kikanakora ibibi birenze urugero biteye kubiri n'imigambi yacu, ivyo kikabigira kugira ubwami bwacu ntibutsimbatare; dutegetse ko abo bose mwamenyeshejwe mu rwandiko na Hamani, ashinzwe amabanga akaba n'umuvyeyi wacu agira kabiri, batikizwa rwose hamwe n'abagore n'abana bahonere ku nkota z'abansi ata kigongwe, ntihasigare n'umwe kw'igenekerezo ry'icumi na kane ry'ukwezi kugira icumi na kabiri, ari kwo Adari, muri uyu mwaka, ku buryo abo babisha bo kuva kera n'ubu bakiriko, bamaze guhondoganira ikuzimu mu musi umwe, batuma tugira mu bihe vyo mu nyuma, imigambi irama kandi itekanye mu gihugu.» Urwandiko rw'iryo kete rutangwa nk'itegeko mu ntara imwimwe yose, kugira ngo abantu bazobe bagavye kuri uyo musi. Hanyuma ba birutsi bagenda baranyaruka nk'uko babitegetswe n'umwami, iryo tegeko rishikirizwa i Shushani ku murwa mukuru, umwami na Hamani babona kwicara ngo banywe, ariko igisagara ca Shushani co cari kijumarariwe.

Marudokayi amaze kumenya ivyari vyagizwe vyose, yitaburirako ivyambarwa vyiwe aca yambara igunira, yisiga n'umunyota, agenda hagati mu gisagara, aboroga amaborogo menshi kandi ababaye. Araheza aragenda, ashika imbere y'irembo ry'umwami, kuko nta washobora kwinjira mw'irembo ry'umwami yambaye igunira. Mu ntara yose aho ijambo ry'umwami n'itegeko ryiwe vyari vyashitse, Abayuda baciye bagira ikigandaro gihambaye, barisonzesha, buzura amarira n'intimba; benshi baryama ku magunira, bisiga n'umunyota. Incoreke za Esitera n'abakevyi biwe, baraza barabimumenyesha, umwamikazi aca arababara cane, araheza arungikira impuzu Marudokayi ngo yambare, yiyambure iryo gunira ryiwe, ariko ariyankira. Esitera arengutsa Hataki, umwe mu bakevyi umwami yari yagenye ngo amukorere, amushinga ivya Marudokayi kugira ngo amenye ivyo ari vyo n'igituma cavyo. Hataki arasohoka, agenda aho Marudokayi yari ari ku kibuga c'igisagara carabana n'irembo ry'umwami. Marudokayi amumenyesha ivyari vyamushikiye vyose n'igitigiri c'amafeza Hamani yari yemeye gutanga ngo aze ashirwe mu bushinguro bw'umwami, kugira ngo bahonye Abayuda. Amuha kandi urwandiko rw'ikete ryari ryatanzweko itegeko i Shushani kugira ngo babahonye, arumuha ngo barwereke Esitera kandi babimumenyeshe, bongere bategeke Esitera kuja kubonana n'umwami ngo amutakambire yongere amusabe kugirira ikigongwe igihugu ciwe. Agirako amubwira ati: «Niwibuke igihe wari uciye bugufi, wibuke ukuntu warira mu biganza vyanje. Nkako Hamani, icegera c'umwami, yaratudendereje ku mwami ngo aduhonye. Ambaza Umukama, utuvugire ku mwami, udukize urupfu.» Hataki aragenda, amenyesha Esitera ayo majambo ya Marudokayi. Esitera abwira Hataki kandi anamutegeka kubibwira Marudokayi, ati: «Abasuku b'umwami bose n'abantu bo mu ntara z'umwami barazi ko umugabo wese canke umugore yinjiye iyo umwami ari, imbere mu kigo, adahamagawe, ata rundi rubanza atari ukwicwa, kiretse uwo umwami yerekejeko inkoni yiwe y'ubwami y'inzahabu, akabona kurokoka. Jewe, hashize imisi mirongo itatu ntarengukijwe ngo nje kubonana n'umwami.» Baraheza babwira Marudokayi amajambo ya Esitera. Hanyuma Marudokayi avuga ko bokwishura Esitera bati: «Ntiwiyumvire mu mutima wawe ko uzorokoka wenyene mu Bayuda bose ngo ni uko uri mu ngoro y'umwami. Erega niwaguma winumiye mu gihe nk'iki, agahengwe n'urukiza vy'Abayuda bizoza biva ahandi hantu nayo wewe n'umuryango wa so wawe muhone.
