Ng'iki icimuro c'ikete banditse ku bisate vy'umuringa, bakarirungika i Yeruzalemu kugira ngo kize kihababere icibutso c'amahoro n'isezerano ry'ubucuti. «Ese hoba amahoro mu Banyaroma no mu gihugu c'Abayuda, mu nyanza no kw'isi mu myaka yose, maze inkota n'umwansi bigume kure yabo. Indwano niyatera i Roma ubwa mbere canke incuti yayo aho hose iganza, igihugu c'Abayuda kizoterera agacumu k'ubumwe mu gihe bizoba bikenewe, babigirane umutima wabo wose. Nk'uko Roma yabishinze, nta ngano, nta birwanisho, nta mafeza, nta n'ubwato bizohabwa canke ngo bitizwe abarwanyi, kandi bazokwubahiriza ivyo bemeye ata co basavye. Ni ko kw'uko, igihugu c'Abayuda kiramutse gitewe ubwa mbere, Abanyaroma bazobaterera agacumu k'ubumwe mu gihe bizoba bikenewe, babigirane umutima wabo wose. Nk'uko Roma yabishinze, nta ngano, nta birwanisho, nta mafeza, nta n'ubwato bizohabwa abanywanyi, kandi bazorangura ivyo bemeye ata buryarya. Ayo ni yo majambo Abanyaroma bakoresheje mu kwunga isezerano n'igihugu c'Abayuda. Ariko mu nyuma, nihagira muri bo abashaka kugira ico bongerako canke bakurako, bazobigira nk'uko bavyipfuza, kandi ico bazoba bongeyeko canke bakuyeko, kizokurikizwa. Ku vyerekeye amabi umwami Demetriyusi yabakoreye, twamwandikiye tuvuga tuti: “Ni kuki waremetse umutwaro wawe Abayuda, abagenzi bacu bakaba n'abanywanyi bacu? Nibasubira kukwidogera, tuzobatunganiriza, duheze tukurwanirize mu kiyaga no kw'isi”.»

Demetriyusi amaze kwumva ko Nikanori yaguye ku rugamba hamwe n'ingabo ziwe, asubira kurungika ubugira kabiri mu gihugu c'Ubuyuda, Bakidesi na Arikimosi, bari kumwe n'ishami ry'ingabo ry'iburyo. Bafata inzira y'i Galgala, bacumbika i Mayisaloti muri Arbelosi, barahigarurira kandi bica abantu benshi. Mu kwezi gutangura kw'umwaka w'ijana na mirongo itanu na kabiri, bacumbika imbere ya Yeruzalemu. Hanyuma baragenda, baja i Bereya bari kumwe n'ingabo zigizwe n'abantu ibihumbi mirongo ibiri hamwe n'amafarasi ibihumbi bibiri. Yuda na we yari yacumbitse i Elasa, ari kumwe n'ingabo zigizwe n'abantu ibihumbi bitatu zarobanuwe. Babonye ukuntu ingabo z'abansi zari zigizwe n'abantu benshi cane, baratinya rwose, benshi muri bo baratoroka bava mw'icumbi, hasigara ingabo zigizwe n'abantu amajana umunani gusa. Yuda abona ko icumbi ryiwe risa n'irigaragara, urugamba na rwo rushushe; umutima uranka kuko atari agifise akanya ko kubegeranya. Abuze uko agira, abwira abari basigaye ati: «Haguruke! Tuduge gutera abansi bacu, kumbure twoshobora kubatsinda.» Ariko bo baramutesha ico ciyumviro, bavuga bati: «Ubu nta na kimwe twoshobora gukora uretse kunyaga amagara. Tuzogaruka kurwana tuzananye na benewacu, nayo twebwe turi bake cane.» Yuda avuga ati: «Ntirikabe ko nokora iryo bara ngo ndabahunge. Umusi wacu niwaba washitse, nidupfire benewacu rugabo. Ntidutyoze iteka ryacu.» Ingabo z'abansi ziva mw'icumbi, ingabo za Yuda zimera magabo ngo zihure na zo. Abarwanira ku mafarasi bigaburamwo kubiri, abarasisha amatopito n'abarasisha imiheto bagendera imbere y'ingabo; ku murongo w'imbere hari abarwanyi bose b'intwari, Bakidesi na we akaba mw'ishami ry'ingabo ry'iburyo. Igitero kiregereza giciye ku mpande zibiri, bagenda baravuza inzamba. Abo kwa Yuda na bo nyene baravuza inzamba. Isi iratetemera kubera umurindi w'ingabo; indwano irasutama kuva mu gitondo gushika ku mugoroba. Yuda abona ko Bakidesi n'abarwanyi bakomeye bari ku ruhande rw'iburyo, abafise umutima urinda bose baca baja gukoranira kwa Yuda. Ishami ry'ingabo ry'iburyo barigira ubunywenywe, hanyuma Yuda arabakurikirana gushika ku musozi Hazoti. Ingabo zo mw'ishami ry'ibubamfu zibonye yuko ishami ry'iburyo ryacitse ubunywenywe, zica zikurikira Yuda n'abo bari kumwe, ngo zibatere zibaturutse inyuma. Urugamba rurakomera, hapfa abantu benshi ku mpande zose, Yuda na we nyene arapfa, abasigaye na bo barahunga. Yonatani na Simoni baterura mwenewabo Yuda, bamufuba mu ruhafu rwa ba sekuru biwe i Modeyine. Abanyisrayeli bose baramuririra kandi baramugandarira cane, bacura intimba imisi myinshi, bavuga bati: «Iyo ntwari yahora ikiza Israyeli vyagenze gute ngo ipfe!» Ibindi bikorwa vya Yuda, izindi ndwano yarwanye, ubugabo yerekanye n'ibindi bitangaza yakoze, ntivyanditswe vyose kuko vyari vyinshi cane. Yuda amaze gupfa, abagome basubira kugaruka mu ntara zose z'Israyeli kandi n'abakora ububisha bose basubira kwaduka. Muri iyo misi hatera ikigoyi gihambaye, igihugu gica cifatanya na bo. Bakidesi atora abantu b'abagome baba ari bo ashinga gutwara igihugu. Baza barahiga kandi bakihweza abagenzi ba Yuda, hanyuma bakabajana kwa Bakidesi, akabacira urubanza abashinyaguriza. Muri Israyeli haba amakuba menshi atari bwigere abaho kuva igihe ata muhanuzi yari akivugwa muri bo. Niho rero abagenzi bose ba Yuda bakorana bakabwira Yonatani bati: «Kuva aho mwenewanyu Yuda apfiriye, nta muntu ameze nka we araboneka ngo aje kurwanya abansi, ngo arwanye Bakidesi n'abanka igihugu cacu. Ubu rero turagutoye uyu musi ngo umusubirire, ube umukuru n'indongozi yacu, urwane urugamba rwacu.» Yonatani ashikira ubukuru muri uyo mwanya nyene, aca asubirira mwenewabo Yuda. Bakidesi arabimenya, aca arondera kumwica. Yonatani, mwenewabo Simoni n'abo bari kumwe bose barabimenye, baca bahungira mu bugaragwa bwa Tekowa, bacumbika hafi y'amazi y'iriba rya Asufari. Bakidesi abimenya ari ku musi w'Isabato, aca aja hakurya y'uruzi Yorodani ari kumwe n'ingabo ziwe zose. Yonatani arungika mwenewabo yari arongoye ishengero ngo asabe abagenzi biwe b'Abanabati ngo babike imizigo yabo iwabo, na yo ikaba yari myinshi. Bene Yamburi, ab'i Medaba, bava iwabo bafata umuntu yitwa Yohani n'ivyo afise vyose, bagenda babijanye. Ivyo biheze, bamenyesha Yonatani na mwenewabo Simoni, ko bene Yamburi bariko bagira umusi mukuru w'ubugeni bw'agakura kandi ko batwaye umugeni bamukuye i Nadabati, aherekejwe n'isinzi ry'abantu, umwigeme w'umwe wo mu bantu bahambaye b'i Kanahani Hanyuma bibuka igandagurwa rya mwenewabo Yohani, baca baduga kwibunda mu ngobwe z'umusozi. Bararamura amaso, ngo bagire batya bumva urwamo, hanyuma babona imizigo myinshi, uwarongoye ari kumwe na bagenzibe na benewabo baje ngo bahure bari kumwe n'abavuza ingoma, bafise ibicurarangisho n'ibirwanisho vyinshi. Bava aho bari bibunze, babasimbirako, barabica, hagwa inganda nyinshi, abasigaye na bo bahungira ku musozi. Baca babatwara ibintu vyabo vyose. Ubugeni bwaciye buhinduka ikigandaro, umudiho w'ibicurarangisho vyabo uhinduka intimba. Babonye ko bahoye amaraso ya mwenewabo, baca basubira ku nkengera y'uruzi Yorodani. Bakidesi aravyumva aca aragenda ku musi w'Isabato, gushika ku nkombe z'uruzi Yorodani, ari kumwe n'ingabo nyinshi. Yonatani abwira abari kumwe na we ati: «Haguruke! Turwanire ubuzima bwacu, kuko uyu musi si nk'ejo canke hirya y'ejo hahise. Nkako raba urugamba ruri imbere n'inyuma yacu; ku ruhande rumwe, hari amazi y'uruzi Yorodani, ku rundi hari umwonga n'urufunzo, nta ho dushobora kuzibukirira. Ubu rero, nimwambaze nyene ijuru, kugira ngo muve mu minwe y'abansi bacu.» Intambara irasutama, Yonatani aramvura ukuboko ngo akubite Bakidesi, ariko Bakidesi aramuzibukira mu gusubiza inyuma. Yonatani n'abari kumwe na we biroha mu ruzi Yorodani, baroga bajabuka ku yindi nkombe, ariko ntabajabutse Yorodani ngo babakurikirane. Kuri uyo musi, ku ruhande rwa Bakidesi hapfuye nk'abagabo igihumbi. Bakidesi asubira i Yeruzalemu, yubaka ibisagara bikomeye mu Buyuda, uruzitiro rw'amabuye i Yeriko, i Emawusi, i Beti Horoni, i Beteli, i Timuna, i Piratoni, i Tefoni, yubaka n'impome ndende, akora inzugi n'ibihindizo. Hanyuma ashira abarinzi muri vyo ngo baze barasatira Israyeli. Arakomeza igisagara ca Beti Tsuri, ica Gazara n'ikirimba c'intamenwa. Ahashira ingabo n'ibigega vy'ibifungurwa. Afata abana b'abakuru b'intara, abagira imbohe, abapfungira mu kirimba c'intamenwa i Yeruzalemu mw'ibohero. Mu mwaka w'ijana na mirongo itanu na gatatu, ukwezi kugira kabiri, Arikimosi ategeka ko basenyura uruhome rw'ikigo c'imbere c'ingoro nyeranda, asambura gutyo ibikorwa vy'abahanuzi. Yabaye agitangura kurusambura, muri uyo mwanya, Arikimosi afatwa n'indwara, ibikorwa bica birahagarara. Ururimi rwiwe ruragoba, acika ikirema, kuva ubwo ntiyaba akivuga ijambo na rimwe, ntiyaba agitanga n'amategeko yerekeye urugo rwiwe. Arikimosi apfa ababaye cane muri ico gihe nyene. Bakidesi abonye ko Arikimosi yapfuye, asubira iyo umwami ari, igihugu c'Ubuyuda na co kiratekana imyaka ibiri. Abagome bose bagira inama, bavuga bati: «Ehe Yonatani n'abari kumwe na we bibereye mu mutekano ata co binona. Ubu rero, dutumeko Bakidesi, azoca abafata bose mw'ijoro rimwe.» Baragenda, baja inama na we. Bakidesi agenda ajanye n'ingabo nyinshi, arungikira mu mpisho amakete abanywanyi biwe bose bari mu Buyuda, kugira ngo bafate Yonatani n'abari kumwe na we. Ariko ntibabishobora kuko umugambi wabo waciye umenyekana. Ariko bafata mu bagabo bo muri iyo ntara, abagabo mirongo itanu biyumviriye iyo nabi, barabica. Hanyuma Yonatani aragenda, hamwe na Simoni n'abari kumwe na we, baja i Betibasi mu bugaragwa, basanura imisaka yaho kandi barahakomeza. Bakidesi arabimenya, aca akoranya ingabo ziwe zose, agabisha n'abari mu Buyuda. Aragenda, yugariza Betibasi, arwanya ico gisagara imisi myinshi kandi akora n'ibirwanisho bininibinini. Yonatani arekera mwenewabo Simoni mu gisagara, agenda mu ntara ajanye n'abantu bakeyi. Atera Hodomera, benewabo n'abahungu ba Fasironi aho bari mw'ihema ryabo, na bo batangura kurwana baca badugana n'ingabo. Simoni na we n'abari kumwe na we, bava mu gisagara, baturira vya birwanisho bininibinini. Baca batera Bakidesi, baramusyokora kandi baramucumukuza rwose, kuko umugambi wiwe n'igitero ciwe vyari vyatise. Arashavurira cane abo bantu b'abagome bari bamwoheje kuja muri iyo ntara, abicamwo benshi, aca yigira inama y'ugusubira iwabo. Yonatani amaze kubimenya, aca amurungikira abakurambere ngo bagiranire amasezerano y'amahoro, bongere babasubize abari barajanywe kugirwa imbohe. Bakidesi aravyemera kandi akora nk'uko babimusavye, aca arabarahira ko ata nabi azosubira kumugirira igihe cose azoba akiriho. Amusubiza abari barajanywe kugirwa imbohe, abo yari yakuye mu gihugu c'Ubuyuda, hanyuma arahindukira, asubira mu gihugu ciwe, ntiyaba akigaruka mu ntara yabo. Inkota iraturura muri Israyeli, Yonatani na we agerera i Makimasi, aca atangura gucira imanza abantu, azimanganya abagome muri Israyeli.

Mu mwaka ugira ijana na mirongo itandatu, Alesandro Epifani mwene Antiyokusi araduga, yigarurira Butolemayisi. Abantu baho baramwemera, aca aba umwami waho. Umwami Demetriyusi avyumvise, akoranya ingabo nyinshi cane, aca aja kumurwanya. Demetriyusi arungikira Yonatani amakete arimwo amajambo y'ukumusaba umwumvikano, mu kumwemerera ubukuru. Nkako yavuga ati: «Twihutire kugiranira amasezerano y'amahoro na bo, imbere yuko Yonatani aja hamwe na Alesandro ngo baturwanye, kuko Yonatani yohava yibuka amabi twamukoreye, tukanayakorera benewabo n'igihugu ciwe.» Demetriyusi aha Yonatani ububasha bwo gukoranya ingabo, ubw'ugucura ibirwanisho n'uburenganzira bw'ukuba umunywanyi wiwe, kandi ategeka ko bamusubiza imbohe zari mu kirimba c'intamenwa. Yonatani aja i Yeruzalemu, asoma ya makete igihugu cose n'abari mu kirimba c'intamenwa bumva. Baraheza bagira ubwoba bwinshi bumvise yuko umwami amuhaye ububasha bwo gukoranya ingabo. Abantu bo mu kirimba c'intamenwa basubiza imbohe Yonatani, na we aca azisubiza abavyeyi bazo. Yonatani agerera i Yeruzalemu, atangura kwubaka n'ugusanura igisagara. Araheza abwira abakora ibikorwa kwubaka impome n'ugukikuza umusozi Siyoni uruzitiro rw'amabuye aringaniye, kandi babikora uko. Abanyamahanga baba mu bibanza bizitijwe amabuye vyubatswe na Bakidesi barahunga. Umwe wese ava mu kibanza ciwe, agenda mu gihugu ciwe. Beti Tsuri honyene, ni ho hasigaye bamwebamwe mu bari bahevye itegeko n'amabwirizwa, kuko cari ikibanza c'ubuhungiro. Umwami Alesandro aramenya ivyo Demetriyusi yemereye Yonatani, bamwiganira indwano barwanye n'ubutwari we na benewabo berekanye hamwe n'amakuba babonye. Araheza avuga ati: «Ntituzoronka umugabo nk'uwo! Kuva ubu nitumugire umugenzi n'umunywanyi wacu!» Araheza yandika amakete, arayamurungikira. Yanditse avuga ati: «Mwenewacu Yonatani, jewe umwami Alesandro, ndakuramukije. Twarakwumvise ko uri umugabo ahambaye, akomeye kandi w'akamaro, none ukwiye kuba umugenzi wacu. Ubu rero kuva uyu musi, tukugize umuherezankuka mukuru w'igihugu cawe kandi tukugize umugenzi w'umwami, kugira ngo tuze turaja inama kandi uzigame ubugenzi dufitaniye.» Umwami araheza amurungikira impuzu itukura n'urugori rw'inzahabu. Hanyuma Yonatani yambara ikanzu nyeranda mu kwezi kugira indwi mu mwaka w'ijana na mirongo itandatu, ku musi mukuru w'Insago, aca akoranya ingabo, ategura n'ibirwanisho vyinshi. Demetriyusi yumvise ivyo, arababara, aca avuga ati: «Twakoze iki kugira ngo Alesandro adutange kwunga ubumwe n'Abayuda ngo bamushigikire? Na jewe nzokwandikira Abayuda amajambo aremesha, ndabemerere ubukuru n'ingabire, kugira ngo bemere banshigikire.» Araheza rero abandikira aya majambo: «Gihugu c'Abayuda, jewe umwami Demetriyusi ndabaramukije! Aho twumviye ko mwazigamye isezerano twagiraniye mukaguma muri abagenzi bacu, kandi ntimuje ku ruhande rw'abansi bacu, vyaratunezereye. Nimugume mutubera intahemuka, natwe tuzobagirira ivyiza bihuye n'ivyo mutugirira. Tuzobahebera vyinshi, kandi tubahe n'ingabire. Kuva ubu mbere, ndabaruhuriye kandi ndakuye ku Bayuda bose ingorore, umusoro wo ku munyu n'uwo ku ngori. Kuva uyu musi n'imisi izokurikira, ndahevye ica gatatu c'umwimbu w'intete, n'ica kabiri c'ivyamwa vy'ibiti nategerezwa kuronka mu gihugu c'Ubuyuda, no muri za ntara zitatu zacongeweko zonkowe kuri Samariya no ku Bugalile, kuva ubu n'imyaka yose. Yeruzalemu nibe nyeranda kandi ikurweko ivy'icumi be n'ingorore, yo n'imbibe zayo. Ndahevye ubukuru nari mfise ku kirimba c'intamenwa c'i Yeruzalemu; ndagihaye umuherezankuka mukuru ngo azogishiremwo abagabo yitoreye we nyene ngo bakirinde. Umuntu wese w'Umuyuda yajanywe ari imbohe ava mu gihugu c'Ubuyuda aho ari hose mu bwami bwanje, ndamurekuye yishire yizane ata ncungu atanze. Bose barakuweko ikori ryabo hamwe n'iry'ibitungwa vyabo. Imisi mikuru yose, amasabato, mu mboneko z'ukwezi, imisi yagenywe, ya misi itatu y'imbere y'umusi mukuru na ya misi itatu inyuma y'umusi mukuru, iyo yose izoba ku Bayuda bose bari mu bwami bwanje imisi y'ukurekurirwa n'uguheberwa imisoro. Nta n'umwe azogira ububasha bw'ugutoza umusoro canke ngo aturubike n'umwe muri bo mu kintu ico ari co cose. Mu ngabo z'umwami hazokwinjizwa abagabo ibihumbi mirongo itatu b'Abayuda, kandi baronke impembo ihabwa abari mu ngabo z'umwami bose. Bamwe bazoshirwa mu birimba vy'intamenwa bihambaye vy'umwami, abandi bashirwe mu bibanza vyizigirwa vy'ubwami. Abatware babo n'abakuru babo bazova muri bo nyene, bagengwe n'amategeko yabo, nk'uko umwami yabitegetse mu gihugu c'Ubuyuda. Nayo za ntara zitatu zongewe ku Buyuda zonkowe ku ntara ya Samariya, zizohomekwa ku Buyuda, kugira ngo zifatwe nk'uko zoba zigize igihugu kimwe n'Ubuyuda, kandi ntihagire ubundi bukuru bagamburukira atari ubw'umuherezankuka mukuru. Intara Butolemayisi n'imicungararo yaho, ndabigabiye ingoro nyeranda y'i Yeruzalemu, ngo abe ari vyo bivamwo amahera agenewe ingoro nyeranda. Nanje nzotanga ku mwaka ku mwaka amashekeli ibihumbi icumi na bitanu y'ifeza avuye ku matungo y'umwami, atozwe mu bibanza vyabigenewe. Amashekeli arengako ababijejwe batahora batanga mu myaka iheze, kuva ubu bazoyakoresha mu bikorwa vyo mu nzu. Vyongeye, ya mashekeli ibihumbi bitanu y'ifeza bahora bakura ku yagenewe ingoro nyeranda avuye ku yatozwa ku mwaka ku mwaka, azokwegukira abaherezankuka bazoba baramukiwe. Abazoba bahungiye mu Ngoro y'Imana y'i Yeruzalemu no mu micungararo yaho kuko baheranye ikintu c'umwami canke ikintu ico ari co cose, bazobareka babarekere n'ivyo bafise mu bwami bwanje. Ibikorwa vy'ukwubaka n'ugusanura bizorihwa n'amahera avuye mu kigega c'umwami. Amahera y'ukwubaka impome za Yeruzalemu n'ugukomeza uruzitiro azova mu kigega c'umwami; ni ko kw'uko no ku vyerekeye ukwubaka impome z'ibindi bisagara vyo mu Buyuda.» Ariko aho Yonatani n'igihugu bumviye ivyo bintu, ntibavyemeye, mbere ntibanavyakira, kuko bari bacibuka ikibi kibishe Demetriyusi yakoreye muri Israyeli, n'ukuntu yabacinyije cane. Bigira inama y'ukuja ku ruhande rwa Alesandro kuko ari we yabaye uwa mbere yunze na bo amasezerano y'amahoro; kuva ubwo baca baguma ari abanywanyi biwe. Hanyuma umwami Alesandro akoranya ingabo zikomeye, aca ashinga icumbi ahahanganye na Demetriyusi. Abo bami babiri bamaze gutangura indwano, ingabo za Demetriyusi zirahunga. Alesandro arabakurikirana kandi arabatsinda. Alesandro aremesha urugamba yivuye inyuma gushika izuba rirenge. Demetriyusi apfa kuri uyo musi nyene. Alesandro arungikira Butolemayusi, umwami wa Misiri, abakurambere bajanye ubutumwa buvuga buti: «Aho ngarukiye mu bwami bwanje, kandi nkicara ku ntebe y'ubwami ya ba sokuru banje, naciye nshikira ubukuru, nsyokora Demetriyusi, ndaheza niganzira igihugu cacu. Naramurwanije, tumusyokorana n'ingabo ziwe, turaheza twicara ku ntebe yiwe y'ubwami. Ubu rero, nitwunge ubugenzi, kandi ubu nyene umpe umukobwa wawe ambere umugore, Nzokubera umukwe kandi ndabahe mwe na we agashimwe kakubereye.» Umwami Butolemayusi arishura avuga ati: «Ni mwiza umusi watahiyeko ukagaruka mu gihugu ca ba sokuru bawe, ukongera ukicara ku ntebe y'ubwami yabo. Ubu ngiye kugukorera ivyo wanditse, ariko urabanza uze duhurire i Butolemayisi kugira ngo tubonane amaso mu yandi, kandi nzogushingira umukobwa wanje nk'uko wabinsavye.» Butolemayusi ava mu Misiri ari kumwe n'umukobwa wiwe Klewopatra, aja i Butolemayisi mu mwaka w'ijana na mirongo itandatu na kabiri. Umwami Alesandro agenda kubasanganira; Butolemayusi amuha umukobwa wiwe Klewopatra. Alesandro arongorera Klewopatra i Butolemayisi, haba ibirori bihimbaye, nk'uko bibereye abami nyene. Umwami Alesandro yandikira Yonatani ngo azogende babonane. Yonatani agenda i Butolemayisi yuzuye icubahiro, abonana na ba bami babiri, abashikanira ifeza n'inzahabu, bo na bagenzi babo, abaha n'ayandi mashikanwa menshi, baraheza bamwakira neza. Hanyuma abantu b'ababisha baterekwa itegeko, bava muri Israyeli, baramukoranira ngo bamurege, ariko umwami ntiyabumviriza. Umwami ategeka ko bambura Yonatani impuzu ziwe, bakamwambika impuzu itukura, kandi bica bigenda uko. Umwami amuvyagiza iruhande yiwe, araheza abwira abatware biwe ati: «Nimujane na we hagati mu gisagara, mutangaze yuko ata muntu n'umwe akwiye kumwidogera kubera imvo iyo ari yo yose, kandi ko ata n'umwe akwiye kumutera ubwoba kubera imvo iyo ari yo yose.» Abamurega babonye icubahiro afise nk'uko vyariko biratangazwa, bakabona kandi ko yikwije impuzu itukura, baca barahunga bose. Umwami amutera iteka, amwandika mu bagenzi biwe pfampfe, amugira umukuru w'ingabo n'umukuru w'intara. Yonatani asubira i Yeruzalemu mu mahoro no mu kanyamuneza. Mu mwaka w'ijana na mirongo itandatu na gatanu, Demetriyusi mwene Demetriyusi, ava i Kereti aja mu gihugu ca ba sekuru. Umwami Alesandro avyumvise, biramushavuza cane, aca asubira muri Antiyokiya. Demetriyusi agena Apoloniyusi ngo abandanye atwara intara ya Koyilesiriya. Na we aca akoranya ingabo nyinshi, aja gucumbika hafi ya Yamuniya, arungikira intumwa umuherezankuka mukuru Yonatani ngo imubwire iti: «Ni wewe musa wahagurutse ngo uturwanye, none nsigaye ndi agatwengo n'igitutsi kubera wewe. Ni kuki urondera kutuganza uri hiyo mu misozi? Ubu rero, ukaba wishimiye ingabo zawe, manuka udusange ino mu kiyaya, duheze turabe umugabo uwo ari we. Erega ndi kumwe n'ingabo z'ibisagara. Urabaza neza uheze umenye uwo ndi, ubaze n'abadufasha abo ari bo. Ni bo nyene bivugira ko mudashobora kuduhangara, kuko na ba sokuru bawe batsindiwe kabiri kose mu gihugu cabo. Ubu ntushobora kurinda abarwanira ku mafarasi n'ingabo zingana ukuraho, kandi ari mu kiyaya kitagira amabuye, ntikigire urucekeri canke ikibanza c'uguhungiramwo.» Aho Yonatani yumviye amajambo ya Apoloniyusi, arashangashirwa. Acagura abagabo ibihumbi icumi, aca ava i Yeruzalemu; mwenewabo Simoni aja hamwe na we ngo amwunganire. Ashinga icumbi imbere ya Yope. Ababa mu gisagara baca bugara amarembo yaco kuko bari baremeshejwe n'ingabo za Apoloniyusi zari muri Yafo. Baca batera ico gisagara. Ariko ababa mu gisagara bagira ubwoba, bugurura amarembo, Yonatani yigarurira Yope. Apoloniyusi avyumvise, atondesha abarwanira ku mafarasi ibihumbi bitatu n'ingabo zikomeye, agenda muri Hazoti nk'uwirenganira. Niho muri ico gihe nyene yashika mu kiyaya ari kumwe n'abarwanira ku mafarasi benshi yishimiye. Yonatani aramukurikira gushika i Hazoti, hanyuma ingabo zabo zitangura kurwana. Apoloniyusi yari yasize inyuma yabo abarwanira ku mafarasi igihumbi ahantu hihishije. Yonatani aramenya ko hari abamwibundiye inyuma yiwe. Abo bari binyegeje bakikuza ingabo ziwe, bazirasa imyampi kuva mu gitondo gushika ku mugoroba. Ingabo za Yonatani zirarinda umwansi nk'uko yari yabizitegetse, gushika n'aho amafarasi yazo aruha. Niho rero Simoni yagomora ingabo ziwe agatera abarwanya Yonatani; nkako abarwanira ku mafarasi bari barushe. Simoni arasyokora abansi barata barahunga. Abarwanira ku mafarasi bashwiragirira mu kiyaya, bahungira muri Hazoti, baca binjira mu ngoro y'ikigirwamana cabo Dagoni, kugira ngo barabe ko borokoka. Yonatani aturira Hazoti n'ibisagara bihakikije, asahura ibintu, aca aha umuriro ingoro y'imana Dagoni n'abari bayihungiyemwo. Abahitanywe n'inkota hamwe n'abaturiwe bari nk'abagabo ibihumbi umunani. Yonatani ava aho, aja gucumbika muri Ashikeloni. Abantu bo muri ico gisagara bamusanganiza iteka rinini. Yonatani asubirana i Yeruzalemu n'abo bari kumwe bafise ibintu vyinshi basahuye. Umwami Alesandro avyumvise, aca arushirizaho gutera iteka Yonatani. Amurungikira igipfungo c'inzahabu nk'uko bari basanzwe babigirira incuti z'abami. Amugabira igisagara Akaroni n'intara zose zigikukira.

Umwami wa Misiri akoranya ingabo nyinshi zingana n'umusenyi wo ku nkombe y'inyanza, yegeranya amato menshi, araheza arondera ukuntu yokwigarurira ku rwenge ubwami bwa Alesandro, ngo abufatanye n'ubwami bwiwe. Agenda mu Busiriya yitwaje amajambo y'amahoro. Abantu bo mu bisagara bamwugururira amarembo baja kumusanganira, kuko umwami Alesandro yari yategetse ko baja kumusanganira kubera yuko ari sebukwe. Ariko Butolemayusi acinjira mu bisagara, yaciye ashira mu gisagara kimwekimwe ingabo zikirinda. Yegereje Hazoti bamwereka ingoro y'imana Dagoni yaturiwe, Hazoti n'imicungararo yaho vyasambutse, ibiziga vyandagaye, n'ibisigarira vy'abari batuririwe mu ndwano, kuko bari babarunze aho umwami aza guca. Biganira umwami ivyo Yonatani yakoze kugira ngo amukureko agatima, ariko aguma yinumiye. Yonatani aja i Yope gusanganira umwami n'iteka rinini; bararamukanya kandi barara aho. Yonatani ajana n'umwami gushika ku ruzi rwitwa Elewuterosi, hanyuma asubira i Yeruzalemu. Umwami Butolemayusi yiganzira ibisagara vyo ku nkengera gushika i Selewukiya yo ku kiyaga, kandi yategurira imigambi mibi Alesandro. Atuma abakurambere ku mwami Demetriyusi ngo bamubwire bati: «Ingo twunge isezerano, nzoheza ndaguhe umukobwa wanje afiswe na Alesandro, kandi uce uganza ubwami bwa so wawe. Ndababazwa n'ukubona naramuhaye umukobwa wanje, kuko yarondeye kunyica.» Yamunebagura gutyo kuko yacambirwa ubwami bwiwe. Amaze kumwaka umukobwa wiwe, amuha Demetriyusi, aca atandukana na Alesandro, urwanko rwabo ruraheza rurigaragaza. Butolemayusi yinjira i Antiyokiya, yambara igitako c'ubwami ca Aziya; gutyo yambara ku mutwe wiwe ibitako bibiri vy'ubwami, ica Misiri n'ica Aziya. Ico gihe umwami Alesandro yari mu Busilisiya kuko abantu baho bari bamuhevye. Alesandro avyumvise aca aragenda kumurwanya. Butolemayusi aja guhura na we ari kumwe n'ingabo zikomeye, araheza aramwirukana. Alesandro arahunga aja kwihisha muri Arabiya, umwami Butolemayusi na we arishimagiza. Zabudiyeli, Umwarabu, acacura umutwe Alesandro, awurungikira Butolemayusi. Umwami Butolemayusi na we apfa ku musi ugira gatatu. Abari mu birimba vyiwe vy'intamenwa bica n'abo muri ivyo birimba vy'intamenwa nyene. Demetriyusi aba umwami mu mwaka w'ijana na mirongo itandatu n'indwi. Muri iyo misi Yonatani akoranya abava mu Buyuda kugira ngo batere ikirimba c'intamenwa kiri i Yeruzalemu, acura ibirwanisho bininibinini vyinshi vy'ukuharwanya. Abanka igihugu cabo, abantu ata co bibanga, bagenda aho umwami ari, bamumenyesha ko Yonatani yugarije ikirimba c'intamenwa. Demetriyusi yumvise ivyo, arashavura. Ubwo nyene akibimenya, ava hasi aja i Butolemayisi, yandikira Yonatani ngo areke kwugariza ico kirimba kandi ngo amusange i Butolemayisi ningoga kugira ngo bavugane. Yonatani avyumvise, ategeka ko baguma bugarije ikirimba. Atora bamwe mu bakurambere b'Israyeli no mu baherezankuka, araheza aruha inda. Yakira noneho ifeza, inzahabu, impuzu n'ayandi mashikanwa menshi, agenda kwa wa mwami i Butolemayisi, kandi yakirwa neza. Abatagira ico bibanga bamwe bo mu gihugu baramwidogera, ariko umwami amugirira nk'uko abo yasubiriye bamugiriye, aramuninahaza imbere y'abagenzi biwe bose. Amugumiza mw'ibanga ry'ukuba umuherezankuka mukuru no mu yandi mabanga yahorana, amugira mukuru mu bagenzi biwe pfampfe. Yonatani asaba umwami gukura ikori ku Buyuda, kuri za ntara zitatu no kuri Samariya, araheza amwemerera ko azomuha na we amatarenta amajana atatu. Umwami aravyemera, araheza yandikira Yonatani amakete yerekeye ivyo muri aya majambo: «Mwenewacu Yonatani, na we gihugu c'Abayuda, jewe umwami Demetriyusi ndabaramukije.» Icimuro c'ikete twandikiye incuti yacu Lasitene ku biberekeye, turakibarungikiye namwe ngo mumenye ibirimwo. Dawe Lasitene, jewe umwami Demetriyusi, ndakuramukije. Kubera umutima mwiza badufitiye, twashimye kugirira neza igihugu c'abagenzi bacu b'Abayuda kuko badukorera ibitunganye. Turemeje rero ko baganza Ubuyuda na za ntara zitatu ari zo Afayirema, Lida na Ratamini zonkowe kuri Samariya zikongerwa ku Buyuda, hamwe n'imicungararo yaho yose, ngo bigirire akamaro abaherereza imbagwa i Yeruzalemu, mu kibanza c'amakori agenewe umwami, umwami yahora yanduza ku mwaka ku mwaka ivyimburwa vy'indimo no ku vyamwa. Kuva ubu, ibindi twategerezwa kuronka bivuye ku vy'icumi no ku makori bitwegukira, ku myaba y'umunyu no ku ngori bitwegukira, turabibahebeye vyose. Nta na kimwe muri ivyo kizokurwamwo, kuva ubu no mu myaka yose. Ubu rero, nimwitwararike kugira icimuro c'iryo kete gihabwe Yonatani, kandi gishirwe mu kibanza ciza ku musozi mweranda. Umwami Demetriyusi abonye ko igihugu kiri mu mahoro ku ngoma yiwe, kandi ko ata n'umwe akimuhangara, arungika ingabo ziwe zose, umwe wese i muhira iwe, kiretse ingabo z'abanyamahanga yari yakuye mu mazinga y'ibihugu. Ingabo zose zakomoka kuri ba sekuru zica ziramwanka. Ariko Tirifoni yahora ari mu bakunzi ba Alesandro, yumvise ko ingabo zidogera Demetriyusi, agenda agana Umwarabu yitwa Imalikuwe yari areze Antiyokusi, umwana wa Alesandro; Tirifoni aguma iruhande ya Imarikuwe ngo amuhe nya mwana, kugira ngo abe umwami mu kibanza ca se, araheza amenyesha ivyo Demetriyusi yari yategetse vyose, n'urwanko ingabo ziwe zamwanka. Aguma aho imisi myinshi. Yonatani atuma uwuja kubwira umwami Demetriyusi ngo yomore ingabo zari mu kirimba c'intamenwa zive muri Yeruzalemu, ngo yomore kandi n'izari mu bibanza bizitijwe amabuye, kuko zarwanya Israyeli. Demetriyusi atuma uwuja kubwira Yonatani ati: «Si ivyo gusa nzogirira wewe n'igihugu cawe, ariko nzogutera iteka, wewe n'igihugu cawe, ninaronka umwanya ubereye. Ubu rero, woba ugize neza undungikiye abagabo bamfasha urugamba, kuko ingabo zanje zose ziyonjoroye.» Yonatani amurungikira i Antiyokiya abagabo ibihumbi bitatu b'intwari kandi bakomeye; bashitse aho umwami ari, umwami aranezerwa n'uko baje. Abantu bo mu gisagara bakoranira hagati mu gisagara bashika nk'ibihumbi ijana na mirongo ibiri, bafise umugambi w'ukwica umwami. Umwami ahungira mu ngoro, abaje bava mu gisagara buzura amabarabara, baca bashoza urugamba. Umwami atabaza Abayuda ngo bamurwaneko; bakoranira bose iruhande yiwe, hanyuma bakwiragira mu gisagara, uyo musi bica nk'abantu ibihumbi ijana. Uyo musi baraturira igisagara, basahura ibintu vyinshi, bakiza n'umwami. Abo mu gisagara babonye ukuntu Abayuda biganzira igisagara nk'uko bashaka, inkokora ziracika, baraheza baborogera umwami, batakamba bavuga bati: «Duhe agahengwe, Abayuda bareke kuturwanya no kurwanya igisagara.» Baterera hasi ibirwanisho, bunga amasezerano y'amahoro. Abayuda bahabwa iteka imbere y'umwami n'imbere y'ababa mu bwami bwiwe bose. Baraheza basubira i Yeruzalemu batwaye ibinyagano vyinshi. Umwami Demetriyusi aricara ku ntebe y'ubwami bwiwe, igihugu na co kiratekana ku ngoma yiwe. Niho rero yatangura kurenga ku vyo yari yavuze vyose, arahinduka Yonatani, ntiyamwishura ivyiza yamugiriye, aramucinyiza rwose. Ivyo biheze, Tirifoni arahindukira ari kumwe na Antiyokusi akiri umwana mutoyi, uwo mwana aba umwami kandi aca yambara igitako c'ubwami. Ingabo zose zari zirukanywe na Demetriyusi zikoranira iruhande ya Antiyokusi zirwanya Demetriyusi, aca arahunga aromoka. Tirifoni afata inzovu, yigarurira intara ya Antiyokiya. Wa musore Antiyokusi yandikira Yonatani, avuga ati: «Ndakwemereye ko uzobandanya kuba umuherezankuka mukuru, ndakugize umukuru wa za ntara zine, kandi ndagushize mu bagenzi b'umwami.» Amurungikira kandi imibehe y'inzahabu, ibikoresho vyo ku meza; amuha n'uruhusha rw'ukunywera mu bikombe vy'inzahabu, urw'ukwambara impuzu y'inyambarabami n'ugupfungisha igipfungo c'inzahabu. Agena mwenewabo Simoni ngo abe umukuru w'ingabo kuva i Kirimakosi ya Tiri gushika ku rubibe rwa Misiri. Yonatani arasohoka, ajabuka hakurya y'uruzi, aca no mu bisagara. Ingabo zose z'Ubusiriya zikoranira iwe zigira umugwi umwe. Agenda i Ashikeloni, abantu baho bamwakirana iteka rinini. Ava aho, aja i Gaza, ariko ababa i Gaza baca barugara amarembo. Yonatani arugariza ico gisagara, aha umuriro imicungararo yaco, arahasahura. Abantu b'i Gaza batakambira Yonatani, na we abaha agahengwe ariko agira imbohe abahungu b'abakuru babo, abarungika i Yeruzalemu. Hanyuma ajabuka iyo ntara gushika i Damasi. Yonatani yumva ko abatware ba Demetriyusi bashitse i Kadeshi mu Bugalile bari kumwe n'ingabo nyinshi, bashaka kumukura mu mabanga yiwe. Hanyuma aja kubategera, ariko asize mwenewabo Simoni mu gihugu. Simoni na we acumbika imbere ya Beti Tsuri, arwanya ico gisagara mu misi myinshi, arakizibira. Abo muri ico gisagara bamusaba ngo abahe agahengwe, kandi arakabaha. Hanyuma arabasohora ngo baveyo, aca arigarurira igisagara, agishiramwo n'ingabo zikirinda. Nayo Yonatani n'ingabo ziwe bacumbika hafi y'amazi ya Genesari. Hanyuma barazinduka mu gitondo ca kare baja mu kiyaya ca Hatsori. Abona ng'izo ingabo z'abanyamahanga zije guhurira na we mu kiyaya. Zimutega umutego mu misozi, zica zija kumutegera. Ariko abari binyegeje baca baranyeguruka mu bibanza barimwo, baca baramurwanya. Ingabo za Yonatani zose zirahunga. Ntihasigara n'umwe, kiretse abakuru babiri b'ingabo ziwe, Matatiyasi mwene Abusalomu na Yuda mwene Kalifi. Yonatani atabagura ivyambarwa vyiwe, yirenza inkungugu ku mutwe, arasenga. Mu nyuma asubira iyo bari, arabarwanya, arabatsinda, barahunga. Abari bamutaye babibonye, baca baragaruka iwe, baca barafashanya na we, barakurikirana abansi gushika i Kadeshi mw'icumbi ryabo, baca bacumbika aho nyene. Kuri uyo musi, hapfuye nk'abagabo ibihumbi bitatu mu banyamahanga; Yonatani na we asubira i Yeruzalemu.

Yonatani abonye ko igihe kimwereye, atora abagabo arungika i Roma ngo baje gushimangira n'ukunagura ubugenzi bafitaniye. Hanyuma arungikira amakete nk'ayo Abanyasupariti n'ahandi. Bagenda rero i Roma, binjira mu nama nkuru, bavuga bati: «Umuherezankuka mukuru Yonatani n'abantu b'Abayuda, baturungitse kunagura ubucuti n'ubunywanyi bisubire kumera nko hambere.» Ab'i Roma baha amakete izo ntumwa bisunze iyo zaje ziva kugira ngo ziyajane ata nkomanzi mu gihugu c'Ubuyuda. Ng'iki icimuro c'ikete Yonatani yandikiye Abanyasupariti: «Bavukanyi Banyasupariti, jewe umuherezankuka mukuru Yonatani, abagize inama y'abakurambere b'igihugu, abaherezankuka n'abandi Bayuda, turabaramukije. N'aho hambere Areyosi yatwara iwanyu, yararungikiye ikete umuherezankuka mukuru Oniyasi, rivuga ko muri benewacu, nk'uko icimuro c'iryo kete kiza kuvyemeza. Oniyasi yasanganije iteka umugabo yari yatumwe, yakira n'ikete ryatomora neza ivyerekeye ubunywanyi n'ubugenzi. None rero twebwe, n'aho tutabikeneye kuko ibitabu vyeranda twamana mu minwe ari vyo ruhoza rwacu, twarabirenzeko turungika umuntu yonagura umuvukano n'ubugenzi dusanzwe dufitaniye, kugira ngo ntitube abanyamahanga kuri mwebwe, kuko haciye igihe kirekire kuva aho mutwandikiriye. Igihe cose tuguma tubibuka tudahengeshanya haba ku misi mikuru canke ku yindi misi yashinzwe, igihe duhereza inkuka n'igihe c'ibisabisho, nk'uko bikwiye kandi bibereye kwibuka abavukanyi. Turanezerewe n'uko muninahaye. Ariko tweho, amakuba menshi n'indwano nyinshi vyaratuzingiye, abami badukikije baraturwanya. Ntitwashatse kubagora, mwebwe, abandi banywanyi n'abagenzi bacu mu gihe c'izo ndwano. Nkako intabaro dufise idufasha iva mw'ijuru. Twararokotse abansi, abansi bacu na bo baramaramara. Twatoye rero Numeniyusi mwene Antiyokusi, na Antipatrosi mwene Yasoni, tubatuma mu Banyaroma kunagura ubugenzi n'ubunywanyi dufitaniye, ngo bisubire kumera nko hambere. Niho rero twabategeka ngo baze iwanyu, babaramutse bongere babahe ikete ryacu ry'ukunagura umuvukano wacu. Muzoba mugize neza mutwishuye vuba kuri ivyo.» Ng'iki icimuro c'ikete barungikiye Oniyasi: «Kuri Oniyasi, umuherezankuka mukuru, jewe Areyosi umwami w'Abanyasupariti ndakuramukije. Haratowe mu vyanditse, ko Abanyasupariti n'Abayuda bavukana, kandi ko bakomoka kuri Aburahamu. Ubu rero, ko tuzi ivyo, muzoba mugize neza mutwandikiye ivyerekeye amahoro yanyu. Ahacu ng'iyi inyishu tubandikiye: “Ibitungwa vyanyu n'ivyo mutunze vyose ni ivyacu, ivyacu na vyo ni ivyanyu”. Ni co gituma dutegetse ko ivyo babibamenyesha.» Hanyuma Yonatani yumva ko abatware ba Demetriyusi basubiye kugaruka bari kumwe n'ingabo nyinshi kurusha ubwa mbere ngo bamurwanye. Ava i Yeruzalemu, aja guhurira na bo mu ntara ya Hamati. Nkako ntiyabahaye akanya ngo binjire mu ntara yiwe. Arungika abatasi mw'icumbi ryabo, hanyuma bagarutse bamumenyesha ko basanze bariko baritegurira kubatera mw'ijoro. Izuba rirenze, Yonatani ategeka abiwe ngo babe maso bagumye ibirwanisho mu minwe, bitegurire kurwana ijoro ryose. Ashira abararirizi ku mpande zose z'icumbi. Abansi bumvise ko Yonatani n'abiwe biteguriye urugamba, bagira ubwoba, bavunika umutima, baca baturira icumbi ryabo. Ariko gushika mu gatondo, Yonatani n'abiwe ntibari bwabimenye, babona imiriro yaka gusa. Yonatani arabakurikirana ariko ntiyabafata, kuko bari bajabutse uruzi rwitwa Elewuterosi. Yonatani ahindukirira ku Barabu bitwa Abazabadi; arabica, anyaga n'ibintu vyabo. Ava aho yari acumbitse, aja i Damasi, agenzura intara yose. Simoni na we nyene ava aho, aragenda gushika i Ashikeloni no mu birimba vy'intamenwa bihegereye. Hanyuma ahindukirira kuri Yope, aca arahigarurira. Nkako yari yumvise ko bashaka guhebera abo kwa Demetriyusi ico kibanza kizitijwe amabuye. Aca ashiraho abarinzi ngo bahararire. Ahindukiye, Yonatani akoranya abakurambere b'igihugu, ashinga hamwe na bo ingingo y'ukwubaka ibirimba vy'intamenwa mu Buyuda, kwongereza uburebure bw'impome za Yeruzalemu, kuduza uruhome rurerure hagati y'ikirimba c'intamenwa n'igisagara, kugira ngo kibe ukwaco kandi kugira ngo ntihagire ico bashobora kuhagurira no kuhagurishiriza. Barakorana ngo bubake igisagara, kuko igice c'uruhome rwo ku mugezi mu buseruko cari carasenyutse, na we araheza asanura agacimbiri kitwa Kafenata. Simoni asanura Adida muri Sefela, arahazitira, atera inzugi n'ibihindizo. Tirifoni yarondera kuba umwami wa Aziya, kwambara igitako c'ubwami n'ugufata umwami Antiyokusi. Kubera ko yatinya ko Yonatani atobimwemerera canke yohava amurwanya, arondera ukuntu yomufata ngo amwice. Aca ava ngaho, aja i Beti Shani. Yonatani agenda ngo bahure ari kumwe n'abagabo ibihumbi mirongo ine batorewe kurwana, aca aja i Beti Shani. Tirifoni abonye ko Yonatani yazananye n'ingabo nyinshi, ntiyubahuka kumufata. Amwakirana icubahiro, amwereka abagenzi biwe bose, aramugabira kandi ategeka abagenzi biwe n'ingabo ziwe kugamburukira Yonatani nk'uko bamugamburukira we nyene. Abwira Yonatani ati: «Ni kuki waruhishije ico gihugu cose kandi ata ndwano iri hagati yacu? Ubu rero nubarungike i muhira iwabo, ariko witorere abantu bakeyi bazogumana na we, hanyuma uze tujane i Butolemayisi, nzohaguha, ndaguhane n'ibindi bigo bizitijwe amabuye, n'izindi ngabo hamwe n'abakozi bose, mpeze nce nsubira inyuma nigire. Mu vy'ukuri, ico ni co cari canzanye ngaha.» Yonatani aramwizera, araheza akora nk'uko Tirifoni avuze. Arungika za ngabo, zija mu gihugu c'Ubuyuda. Agumana n'abagabo ibihumbi bitatu, muri bo ibihumbi bibiri bisigara mu Bugalile, igihumbi na co kijana na we. Ariko Yonatani yabaye acinjira i Butolemayisi, abantu baho baciye bugara amarembo baramufata, hanyuma bicisha inkota abinjiranye na we bose. Tirifoni arungika ingabo zirimwo abarwanira ku mafarasi mu Bugalile no mu Kiyaya Gikuru, kugira ngo bahonye abo kwa Yonatani bose. Abo kwa Yonatani bamenye ko Yonatani yafashwe kandi agapfana n'abari kumwe na we bararemeshanya, bagenda bagize urunani, biteguriye urugamba. Abariko barabakurikirana babonye yuko barwanira ukurokora ubuzima bwabo, baciye basubira inyuma. Abo kwa Yonatani bashika bose amahoro mu Buyuda, bagandarira Yonatani n'abari kumwe nawe bafise ubwoba bwinshi. Israyeli yose iragandara cane rwose. Abanyamahanga bose bari babakikije barondera kubahonya bavuga bati: «Ntibakigira umutware, canke uwubashigikira; ubu rero ingo tubarwanye maze tuzimanganye icibutso cabo mu bantu.»

Simoni yumva ko Tirifoni yari yakoranije ingabo nyinshi kugira ngo aje mu gihugu c'Ubuyuda ngo agitikize. Abonye igihugu kiriko kiratetemera gifise n'ubwoba, aduga i Yeruzalemu, aragikoranya. Araheza arakiremesha akibwira ati: «Itegereze ivyo jewe, benewacu n'umuryango wa data twakoze vyerekeye amategeko n'ingoro nyeranda, mwitegereze indwano n'amakuba twabonye. Ivyo ni vyo vyatumye benewacu bose bapfira Israyeli nanje ngasigara ndi jenyene. Ubu rero, ntirikabe ko norondera kurokora ubuzima bwanje mu gihe c'amakuba ico ari co cose, nakare nta co nsumbije benewacu. Ahubwo nzohora igihugu canje, ingoro nyeranda, abagore n'abana banyu, kuko abanyamahanga bose bagiye hamwe ngo batuzimanganye kubera urwanko badufitiye.» Igihugu cumvise ayo majambo, umutima usubira kurema; abantu bishurana ijwi rirenga bati: «Ni wewe uri umukuru wacu mu kibanza ca Yuda na Yonatani mwenewanyu. Nudufashe urugamba, natwe ivyo uzotubwira vyose, tuzobikora.» Akoranya abagabo bose bashobora kurwana, araheza yihutira guheraheza kwubaka impome z'igisagara ca Yeruzalemu, arakizitira ku mpande zose. Hanyuma arungika Yonatani mwene Abusalomu i Yope, ari kumwe n'ingabo zikomeye. Yonatani yomora abahaba, aca acumbikaho. Tirifoni ava i Butolemayisi ari kumwe n'ingabo nyinshi, ngo yinjire mu gihugu c'Ubuyuda. Yonatani yari kumwe na we agenda acunzwe. Simoni aja gushinga icumbi yiwe i Adida aharabana n'ikiyaya. Tirifoni amenye ko Simoni yasubiriye Yonatani mwenewabo kandi ko yiteguye ngo amurwanye, amurungikira abakurambere bamubwira bati: «Amafeza mwenewanyu Yonatani afitiye ikigega c'umwami kubera ibikorwa ashinzwe, ni yo atumye tumugumya. Ubu rero rungika amatarenta ijana y'ifeza, na babiri mu bahungu biwe duca tugira imbohe, kugira ngo ntashobore guhunga, tuzoheza tumurekure.» Simoni yaramenye ko ayo majambo yarimwo urwenge, ariko ararungika uwuja kurondera ayo mafeza n'abo bana, kuko yibwira yuko hohava haduka umugumuko mwinshi mu gihugu, bakavuga bati: «Yonatani yapfuye kuko ntarungitse ayo mafeza n'abo bana.» Arungika rero abo bana na ya matarenta ijana, ariko Tirifoni yari yabeshe, ntiyarekura Yonatani. Ivyo biheze, Tirifoni agenda gutera iyo ntara n'ukuyitikiza. Barinze kuzigura mu kuja muri Adora, ariko Simoni n'ingabo ziwe baramurwanya aho yaja hose. Abari mu kirimba c'intamenwa batuma intumwa kubwira Tirifoni ngo yihute kuja iyo bari aciye mu bugaragwa kandi ngo abe arabarungikira ibifungurwa. Niho rero Tirifoni yategura amafarasi yiwe yose, kugira ngo ajeyo. Ariko muri iryo joro nyene, haca hagwa isegenya irimwo urubura rwinshi cane, biraheza bituma atajayo. Araheza afata inzira, aja mu gihugu ca Galahadi. Ariko aregereza Basikama, Tirifoni yica Yonatani, aca ahambwa aho nyene. Hanyuma Tirifoni asubira inyuma, aja mu gihugu ciwe. Simoni arungika abaja kuzana amagufa ya mwenewabo Yonatani, ayashingura i Modeyine, igisagara ca ba sekuru. Israyeli iramuririra cane, iramugandarira rwose imisi myinshi. Simoni yubaka icibutso ku mva za se wiwe na benewabo, akoresheje amabuye abaje neza, arakiduza ku buryo kiboneka ku wuturutse inyuma canke imbere. Araheza yubakira se, nyina na benewabo bane amatanure indwi y'icibutso yegeranye, ayakikuza n'umurongo w'inkingi ndende, aba icibutso c'imyaka yose. Ashushanya hejuru kuri izo nkingi ibirwanisho n'amato ku buryo abazoca mu nyanza n'ubwato bose bazobibona. Ico ni co cibutso Simoni yubatse ku mva z'abiwe i Modeyine kikiriho gushika n'ubu. Tirifoni ahenda umwami mushasha Antiyokusi, aca aramwica. Araheza aba umwami mu kibanza ciwe, yambara igitako c'ubwami ca Aziya, akorera amabi menshi igihugu. Simoni yubaka inzitiro z'amabuye z'Ubuyuda, azubakako hirya no hino iminara miremire, aziha impome nini, ziriko inzugi n'ibihindizo. Muri izo nzitiro z'amabuye, ahashingura ibifungurwa. Hanyuma Simoni atora abagabo, abatuma gusaba umwami Demetriyusi ngo ahebere ikori intara, kuko ibikorwa vyose vya Tirifoni vyabaye ivy'ugusahura gusa. Umwami Demetriyusi arungikira Simoni inyishu ijanye n'ivyo yamusavye, amwandikira ikete ririmwo aya majambo akurikira: «Muherezankuka mukuru Simoni, ukaba n'umugenzi w'abami, bakurambere, namwe gihugu c'Abayuda, jewe umwami Demetriyusi ndabaramukije. Igitako c'ubwami c'inzahabu n'ipete rihinguwe nk'ishami ry'ikigazi mwaturungikiye, twarabironse. Turiteguriye kugirana namwe amasezerano y'amahoro arama, n'ukwandikira abajejwe amabanga ngo babahebere amakori. Ingingo zose twashinze zibafitiye akamaro zigumaho; kandi inzitiro z'amabuye mwubatse ziguma ari rwanyu. Turabarekuriye aho hose mwihenze n'aho hose mwacumuye gushika kuri uyu musi; turabahebeye n'urugori mwari muheranye. Nihaba hari n'irindi kori ryotojwe i Yeruzalemu, ntirigitojwe. Muri mwebwe nihaba hari abakeneye kwandikwa mu ngabo zacu, barandikwa maze habe amahoro hagati yacu.» Umwaka ugira ijana na mirongo indwi, Israyeli irakira agacinyizo k'abanyamahanga. Hanyuma igihugu c'Israyeli gitangura kuza kirandika ku mpapuro z'ibikorwa n'amasezerano kiti: «Umwaka wa mbere wa nyenicubahiro Simoni, umuherezankuka mukuru, intwazangabo n'umukuru w'Abayuda.» Muri iyo misi, Simoni ashinga icumbi imbere y'igisagara ca Gazara, ashira ingabo hirya no hino yaco, yubaka umunara batembereza, awegereza igisagara, asenyura umwe mu minara ihasanzwe, aca aracigarurira. Abari muri wa munara batembereza basimbira mu gisagara, haca haba uruhagarara runini mu gisagara. Ababa mu gisagara hamwe n'abagore n'abana burira ku ruhome bamaze gutabura impuzu zabo, bashira ijwi hejuru cane, basaba Simoni ngo abahe agahengwe. Bavuga bati: «Ntuduhore ububisha bwacu, kurikiza ahubwo imbabazi zawe.» Simoni asubiza hamwe na bo, ntiyabarwanya. Ariko arabirukana, abakura mu gisagara, ahumanura inzu zarimwo ibigirwamana, abona kwinjira muri ico gisagara aririmba kandi aninahaza Imana. Akura mu gisagara ivyagihumanya vyose, agishiramwo abantu bubaha amategeko. Arakizitira, acubakamwo inzu yiwe. Ababa mu kirimba c'intamenwa c'i Yeruzalemu, ntibashobora gusohoka ngo baje mu gihugu hagati kugira ngo hagire ico basuma canke bashora. Hanyuma barasonza cane. Benshi muri bo baratikira kubera inzara. Abasigaye batakambira Simoni ngo abahe agahengwe, na we arakabaha. Abakura muri ico kirimba, aragityorora ivyagihumanya. Bahinjira kw'igenekerezo rya mirongo ibiri na gatatu ry'ukwezi kwa kabiri, mu mwaka ugira ijana na mirongo indwi na rimwe. Muri ico gihe baraninahaje Imana, bafise amashami y'ibisanda, bavuza amakembe, urusama n'inanga, batera imvyino n'indirimbo, kuko umwansi nyamukuru yari yazimanganijwe muri Israyeli. Simoni ashinga yuko bazoza barahimbaza uyo musi mu kanyamuneza uko umwaka utashe. Azitira umusozi wubatseko Ingoro y'Imana, iruhande y'ikirimba c'intamenwa, aca aba ngaho, we n'abari kumwe na we. Simoni abonye ko umuhungu wiwe Yohani yakuze, amugira umukuru w'ingabo zose, aca aba i Gazara.

Mu mwaka ugira ijana na mirongo indwi na kabiri, umwami Demetriyusi akoranya ingabo ziwe, agenda mu Bumedi gusaba abamufasha kurwanya Tirifoni. Arisake, umwami w'Ubuperesi n'Ubumedi, amenye yuko Demetriyusi yinjiye mu gihugu ciwe, arungika umwe mu ntwazangabo ziwe ngo aje kumufata ari muzima. Iyo ntwazangabo iragenda, yica ingabo za Demetriyusi, iramufata imuzanira Arisake na we amuta mw'ibohero. Igihugu c'Ubuyuda kiratekana mu misi yose Simoni yariko aratwara. Yararondereye ineza igihugu ciwe, ubukuru bwiwe n'icubahiro ciwe, birahimbara Abayuda igihe cose. Igihe yari ahangamanye ubuninahazwa ku ngoma, yarigaruriye ikivuko ca Yope ahaca inzira ija mu mazinga y'inyanza. Yaraguye imbibe z'igihugu ciwe, yiganzira ako karere. Yaregeranije abantu benshi bari barajanywe kugirwa imbohe, yigarurira Gazara, Beti Tsuri n'ikirimba c'intamenwa, agikuramwo ivyagihumanya; nta muntu n'umwe yamuhangara. Bararima itongo ryabo ata nkomanzi, isi ikimbuka, nayo ibiti vyo mu biyaya bikama ivyamwa. Abakurambere baguma biyicariye ku nama, bayaga ivyerekeye amatungo yabo, imisore na yo ikambara impuzu zishajije z'indwano. Ibisagara arabigaburira kandi arabikomeza, gushika aho izina ryiwe rininahazwa gushika no ku mpera z'isi. Asasagaza amahoro mu gihugu, Abanyisrayeli baba mu kanyamuneza kenshi. Umwe wese yiyicarira munsi y'umuzabibu wiwe canke munsi y'umutenahi wiwe. Nta n'umwe yabatera ubwoba. Ababarwanya baraherengetera mu gihugu, abami barahasyokorerwa muri iyo misi. Yararemesheje abicisha bugufi bose bo mu gihugu ciwe, asasagaza amategeko, atuza abagome bose n'ababisha. Ashariza ingoro nyeranda, yongereza n'ibikoresho vyayo. Kuva i Roma gushika i Supariti bumva ko Yonatani yapfuye, birabababaza cane. Ariko aho bumviye ko mwenewabo Simoni yabaye umuherezankuka mukuru mu kibanza ciwe, kandi ko ari we aganza igihugu n'ibisagara biri muri co, baciye bamwandikira ku bisate vy'umujumbu kugira ngo banagure ubugenzi n'ubunywanyi bari barunze na Yuda na Yonatani, benewabo na Simoni. Ivyo bisate babisomera imbere y'ishengero ryari i Yeruzalemu. Ng'iki icimuro c'ikete Abanyasupariti barungitse: «Simoni, umuherezankuka mukuru, bakurambere, baherezankuka namwe mwese benewacu mugize igihugu c'Abayuda, twebwe abatware n'abo mu gisagara c'Abanyasupariti, turabaramukije! Intumwa mwarungitse mu gihugu cacu, zaratumenyesheje ubuninahazwa n'iteka mufise kandi twaranezerejwe n'uko zaje. Twaranditse ivyo zashikirije mu nama y'igihugu. Na vyo vyari ibi bikurikira: “Numeniyusi mwene Antiyokusi, na Antipatrosi mwene Yasoni, batumwe n'Abayuda, baraje iwacu ngo banagure ubucuti dufitaniye. Igihugu caranezerejwe n'ukwakirana abo bagabo icubahiro n'ukubika urwandiko rw'ivyo bavuze mu bitabu vy'amateka y'igihugu, kugira ngo igihugu c'Abanyasupariti kigume kivyibuka”. Icimuro c'urwo rwandiko bakirungikiye na Simoni, umuherezankuka mukuru.» Ivyo biheze, Simoni arungika Numeniyusi i Roma, afise inkinzo nini y'inzahabu ifise uburemere bw'imina igihumbi. Yari amurungitse ngo aje gushimangira ubunywanyi bari bafitaniye n'ab'i Roma. Igihugu cumvise ayo majambo, kivuga kiti: «Ineza tuzosubiza Simoni n'abahungu biwe, ni iyihe? Simoni yaratsimbataye, we na benewabo n'umuryango wa se wiwe, ararwanya abansi b'Israyeli, arabirukana, asubiza Israyeli umwidegemvyo.» Baraheza bavyandika ku bisate vy'umujumbu babihomeka ku nkingi y'ibuye, ku musozi Siyoni. Ng'iki icimuro c'ivyo banditse: «Igenekerezo ry'icumi n'umunani ry'ukwezi kwa Eluli mu mwaka ugira ijana na mirongo indwi na kabiri, ari wo mwaka ugira gatatu Simoni umuherezankuka mukuru ari umunyacubahiro muri Hasarameri, mu nama nkuru y'abaherezankuka y'igihugu, y'abakuru b'igihugu n'abakurambere b'igihugu, batumenyesheje ibi bikurikira: “Mu gihe haza haraba indwano nyinshi mu gihugu, Simoni mwene Matatiyasi, umuherezankuka wo muri bene Yowaribu na benewabo, ntibatinye urukamvye, bararwanya abansi b'igihugu cabo kugira ngo ingoro nyeranda yabo n'Itegeko bigume bihangamye. Yonatani yari yaregeranije igihugu cabo, ababera umuherezankuka mukuru, hanyuma ahamvya abiwe. Abansi b'Abayuda bashaka kwinjira mu gihugu cabo ngo bigarurire ingoro nyeranda yabo, Simoni yaciye ahaguruka ararwanira igihugu ciwe, atanga vyinshi mu vyo atunze, aronsa ibirwanisho abari mu ngabo z'igihugu ciwe, yongera arabahemba. Arazitira ibisagara vy'Ubuyuda, azitira n'igisagara ca Beti Tsuri cahana urubibe n'Ubuyuda carimwo ibirwanisho vy'abansi ubwa mbere, aca agishiramwo ingabo z'Abayuda zikirinda. Azitira igisagara ca Yope kiri ku nyanza, azitira n'igisagara ca Gazara cahana urubibe na Hazoti, cabamwo abansi ubwa mbere, agishiramwo Abayuda. Muri ivyo bisagara ahashira ibikenewe vy'ukubabeshaho. Abayuda babona ukwemera kwa Simoni n'ukuntu yiyemeje gutera iteka igihugu ciwe; bamugira indongozi n'umuherezankuka mukuru kubera ivyo yari yakoze vyose, ubutungane n'ibanga yagumirije igihugu ciwe, n'ukubera ko ata ko atagize ngo ateze imbere igihugu ciwe. Mu gihe ciwe, Simoni yarashoboye gutuza abanyamahanga mu karere kabo, n'abari mu Gisagara ca Dawudi i Yeruzalemu, aho bari bariyubakiye ikirimba c'intamenwa, bakaza barahava baja guhumanya mu micungararo y'ingoro nyeranda n'ugutosekaza rwose ubweranda bwayo. Muri ico kibanza ahagerera abagabo b'Abayuda, arahazitira kugira ngo akingire ako karere n'igisagara, yongereza uburebure bw'impome za Yeruzalemu. Kubera ivyo, umwami Demetriyusi aramwemeza ngo agume ari umuherezankuka mukuru, amushira mu gitigiri c'abagenzi biwe, amutera iteka rinini. Nkako, yari yarumvise ko Abanyaroma bagize Abayuda abagenzi, abanywanyi n'abavukanyi, n'uko bari bakiranye icubahiro intumwa za Simoni. Yari yumvise kandi ko Abayuda n'abaherezankuka bari bashimye ko Simoni aba indongozi n'umuherezankuka mukuru imyaka yose gushika habonetse umuhanuzi w'umwizigirwa; bari bashimye kandi ko aba intwazangabo, kugira ngo yitwararike ingoro nyeranda mu kugena we nyene abakozi bayibungabunga, abajejwe akarere, abashinzwe ibirwanisho n'inzitiro z'amabuye zikingira igisagara; barahimbarwa n'uko yitwararika ingoro nyeranda, ko bose bamugamburukira, ko inzandiko zose zo mu gihugu zitirirwa izina ryiwe, n'uko yambikwa umutamana utukura n'ibisharizo vy'inzahabu. Nta n'umwe mu gihugu canke mu baherezankuka arekuriwe kugira ico yanka muri ivyo, kuvuguruza ivyo Simoni yavuze, gukoranya inama mu gihugu adafise uruhusha rwiwe, kwambara umutamana utukura canke ngo yambaze igipfungo c'inzahabu. Uwuzorenga kuri ivyo canke akagira ico yanka muri ivyo, icaha kizomwagira”. Igihugu cose kirashima ko Simoni akora yisunze ayo majambo.» Simoni aremera kandi arashima kuba umuherezankuka mukuru, intwazangabo, umukuru w'Abayuda n'abaherezankuka, n'ukuba indongozi ya bose. Bategeka ko urwo rwandiko rwandikwa ku bisate vy'umujumbu, bakabishira hagati mu ngoro nyeranda aho bose babona, kandi ko ivyimuro vy'izo nzandiko vyoshingurwa mu bubiko kugira ngo Simoni n'abahungu biwe baze bazitunge.

Antiyokusi, umuhungu w'umwami Demetriyusi arungikira ikete Simoni, umuherezankuka akaba n'umukuru w'Abayuda, arirungikira n'igihugu cose ari mu mazinga y'inyanza. Iryo kete ryari ryanditswemwo ibi bikurikira: «Simoni, umuherezankuka ukaba n'umukuru w'Abayuda, gihugu c'Abayuda, jewe umwami Antiyokusi, ndabaramukije! Aho abantu bamwebamwe b'ababisha bigaruriye ubwami bwa ba sokuru bacu, nkaba nshaka guhabuza ubwami ngo ndabusubize nk'uko bwari ubwa mbere, nkaba naregeranije ingabo nyinshi, ngategura n'amato y'indwano, nkaba kandi nshaka kugenda ngo ninjire hagati mu gihugu kugira ngo nkurikirane abayogeje igihugu cacu n'abasambuye ibisagara vyinshi vyo mu bwami bwanje, ubu rero ndakwemereye ivyo vyose abami b'imbere yanje bari baguhebeye hamwe n'ingabire zose bari baraguhaye. Ndakurekuriye kwihingurira ihera ryawe rizokoreshwa mu gihugu cawe. Yeruzalemu n'ikibanza ceranda bizokwishira vyizane, ibirwanisho vyose wakoze n'inzitiro z'amabuye wubatse kandi ugaba, bizoguma ari ivyawe. Umwenda wose ufitiye umwami n'ingorore womuhaye urabirekuriwe kuva ubu no mu myaka yose. Igihe tuzoba twamaze gushikira ubwami bwacu, tuzogutera iteka rinini, wewe, igihugu cawe n'Ingoro y'Imana, kugira ngo ubuninahazwa bwawe bwibonekeze kw'isi yose.» Mu mwaka ugira ijana na mirongo indwi na kane, Antiyokusi agenda mu gihugu ca ba sekuru biwe, ingabo zose zijana na we, ku buryo Tirifoni asigarana n'abantu bakeyi. Antiyokusi akurikirana Tirifoni ariko arahunga agana igisagara ca Dora kiri ku nyanza, kuko yari azi ko amagorwa yamukoraniyeko kandi ko ingabo ziwe zari zamutaye. Antiyokusi asugereza igisagara ca Dora ari kumwe n'ingabo zigizwe n'abantu ijana na mirongo ibiri hamwe n'abarwanira ku mafarasi ibihumbi umunani. Azinguriza igisagara, amato na yo agitera azananye inyanza, azibiranya igisagara imusozi no mu nyanza, ntiyareka ngo hagire n'umwe asohoka canke ngo yinjire. Numeniyusi n'abo bari kumwe baraza bavuye i Roma, bazananye amakete yandikiwe abami n'ibihugu, yanditswemwo ibi bikurikira: «Mwami Butolemayusi, jewe Lusiyusi, umukuru w'Abanyaroma, ndakuramukije! Abakurambere b'Abayuda baraje iwacu barungitswe n'umuherezankuka mukuru Simoni n'igihugu c'Abayuda, baza iwacu nk'abagenzi n'abanywanyi ngo banagure ubugenzi n'ubunywanyi ngo bisubire kuba nka mbere. Baje bazanye inkinzo y'inzahabu y'imina igihumbi. Ni co gituma vyaduhimbaye kwandikira abami n'ibihugu ngo ntihagire uwubagirira nabi, ntihagire uwubarwanya, bo, ibisagara vyabo n'ibihugu vyabo, ntihagire uwuja hamwe n'ababarwanya. Twabonye ko vyoba vyiza twakiriye n'iyo nkinzo yabo. Hagize abantu b'ababisha bahunga igihugu cabo bakaza iwanyu, murabashikirize umuherezankuka mukuru Simoni, kugira ngo abahane akurikije itegeko ryabo.» Yandikira nk'ivyo umwami Demetriyusi, Atalo, Ariyarate, Arisake, n'ibihugu vyose ari vyo: Samusamesi, Abanyasupariti, Delosi, Mundosi, Sikuwoni, Kariya, Samosi, Pamfiliya, Lisiya, Halikarinasosi, Rodesi, Faselisi, Kosi, Side, Aradusi, Gorutuna, Kinido, Ubushipure na Sireni. Icimuro c'urwo rwandiko bakirungikira Simoni umuherezankuka mukuru. Hanyuma umwami Antiyokusi acumbika ubugira kabiri imbere y'igisagara ca Dora, aguma aza arakirungikamwo ingabo zigitera yongera akora n'ibirwanisho bininibinini. Araheza yugarana Tirifoni, aramubuza gusohoka canke kwinjira. Simoni amurungikira abagabo ibihumbi bibiri b'intwari kugira ngo bamufashe kurwana; arungika kandi ifeza, inzahabu n'ibindi bikoresho vyinshi. Antiyokusi aranka kwakira ivyo bintu, yihakana n'ivyo yari yasezeranye na Simoni ubwa mbere, aramuhinduka. Araheza arungika kwa Simoni, umwe mu bagenzi biwe yitwa Atenobiyusi ngo amushikirize ibi bikurikira: «Ni mwebwe muganza ibisagara vy'ubwami bwanje: Yope, Gazara n'ikirimba c'intamenwa c'i Yeruzalemu. Mwaraciye ubugaragwa intara zaho, mukorera amabi menshi igihugu kandi mwigarurira ibibanza vyinshi biri mu bwami bwanje. Ubu rero subize ibisagara mwafashe, mwongere murihe amakori y'ibibanza mwigaruriye mu ntara zitari iz'Ubuyuda; atari ivyo na ho, tange amatarenta amajana atanu y'ifeza mu kibanza cavyo, mwongere mutange n'ayandi matarenta amajana atanu asubirira ivyo mwasambuye, n'amakori y'ivyo bisagara; atari ivyo naho, tuzoza tubarwanye.» Atenobiyusi, wa mugenzi w'umwami, ashitse i Yeruzalemu, abona ukuntu Simoni aninahaye, abona akagege gaterekanzeko ibikoresho vy'inzahabu n'ivy'ifeza vy'umwakaka. Aratamarirwa, hanyuma ashikiriza Simoni ijambo ry'umwami. Hanyuma Simoni aramwishura avuga ati: «Ntitwigaruriye igihugu c'abanyamahanga canke ngo twihagire ibintu vy'abandi, twigaruriye iragi rya ba sokuru bacu ryari ryatwawe n'abansi bacu bakarimarana igihe ku karenganyo. Ariko twaronse akaryo duca tugarura iragi rya ba sokuru bacu. Nayo Yope na Gazara urondera, ni ibisagara vyagiriye amabi menshi abantu n'igihugu cacu. Ivyo tuzobitangira amatarenta ijana.» Atenobiyusi ntiyamwishura n'ijambo na rimwe, aca asubira aho umwami yari ari ashavuye, amumenyesha ayo majambo, ukuntu Simoni aninahaye, amwiganira n'ivyo yari yabonye vyose, hanyuma umwami arashavura cane rwose. Tirifoni yurira ubwato, ahungira muri Orutoziya. Umwami agena Kendebayosi kuba intwazangabo ijejwe inkengera y'ikiyaga, amuha n'ingabo zirwanira hasi n'izirwanira ku mafarasi; amutegeka gucumbika aharabana n'Ubuyuda, amutegeka kandi gusubira kwubaka Kideroni n'ugukomeza inzugi zaho, kugira ngo arwanye igihugu. Umwami araheza akurikirana Tirifoni. Kendebayosi ashika i Yamuniya, atangura gusomborotsa igihugu, kwinjira mu Buyuda, kugira abantu imbohe, n'ugusasika inganda. Araheza yubaka Kideroni, aca ashiraho abarwanira ku mafarasi n'ingabo zirwanira hasi kugira ngo baze baragenda kugendura amayira yo mu Buyuda, nk'uko umwami yari yabimutegetse.

Yohani aduga ava i Gazara, amenyesha se wiwe Simoni ivyo Kendebayosi yakoze. Simoni atumako abahungu biwe babiri bakuru, Yuda na Yohani, ababwira ati: «Jewe, benewacu n'umuryango wa data, twararwanye mu ndwano z'Israyeli kuva mu buto bwacu gushika n'ubu, kandi kubera ububasha bwacu, twararokoye Israyeli kenshi. Ubu ndashaje, ariko ku bw'ubuntu bw'Imana, mugeze mu bigero. Subire mu kibanza canje rero n'ica mwenewacu, mugende murwanire igihugu cacu, kandi Imana izobafasha.» Araheza atora mu gihugu ingabo zigizwe n'abantu ibihumbi mirongo ibiri hamwe n'abarwanira ku mafarasi. Baraheza bagenda gutera Kendebayosi, barara i Modeyine. Hanyuma, bavyuka kare, bagenda amaja mu kiyaya, baza babona ingabo nyinshi z'abarwanira hasi n'iz'abarwanira ku mafarasi zije zibagana. Hariho umugezi hagati yabo. Yohani n'abiwe bacumbika imbere y'izo ngabo. Abonye ko abantu batinye kujabuka uyo mugezi, Yohani aca ajabuka ubwa mbere. Abantu biwe babibonye bajabuka na bo mu nyuna ziwe. Abo bantu abacamwo imigwi, abarwanira ku mafarasi abashira hagati y'abarwanira hasi. Abansi bari bafise abarwanira ku mafarasi benshi cane. Hanyuma bavuza inzamba, Kendebayosi aratsindwa hamwe n'ingabo ziwe. Benshi muri bo barapfa, abarokotse na bo bahungira mu kibanza kizitijwe amabuye. Yuda, mwenewabo na Yohani arakomereka, ariko Yohani arabakurikirana gushika ashike i Kideroni yubatswe na Kendebayusi. Baguma bahunga bagana iminara iri mu mirima y'i Hazoti. Yohani arayiturira, hapfa muri bo abagabo ibihumbi bibiri. Yohani asubira mu Buyuda mu mahoro. Butolemayusi mwene Abubosi yari yashinzwe kuba intwazangabo mu kiyaya ca Yeriko. Yari afise ifeza n'inzahabu vyinshi, kandi yari umukwe w'umuherezankuka mukuru. Niho yagira ubwishime mu mutima wiwe, ashaka kwigarurira igihugu, kandi yigira inama y'ugukuraho Simoni n'abahungu biwe ku rwenge. Simoni yarakunda kugendera ibisagara biri mu gihugu akitwararika kubibungabunga. Amanuka i Yeriko we n'abahungu biwe, Matatiyasi na Yuda, mu mwaka ugira ijana na mirongo indwi n'indwi, mu kwezi kw'icumi na rimwe, ari kwo kwezi kwa Shebati. Umuhungu wa Abubosi abakirana urwenge mu kibanza kizitijwe amabuye citwa Doki yari yarubatse; abategurira ibinyobwa vyinshi, ariko ahisha abantu muri ico kibanza. Simoni n'abahungu biwe bamaze kuborerwa, Butolemayusi n'abari kumwe na we barahaguruka, bafata ibirwanisho vyabo bagenda bagana Simoni aho bariko baranywera, baramwica, we n'abahungu biwe babiri, na bamwe mu basuku biwe. Butolemayusi agira ubuhemu butavugwa, yishura inabi ineza. Butolemayusi yandika ivyo bintu, hanyuma atuma umuntu ku mwami ngo amurungikire ingabo z'ukumufasha, kugira ngo amugarurire igihugu cabo n'ibisagara. Arungika izindi ntumwa i Gazara kuzimanganya Yohani, arungikira ikete abakuru b'imigwi y'igihumbi, abatumira ngo baze iwe kugira ngo abahe ifeza, inzahabu n'izindi ngabire. Arungika abandi kwigarurira Yeruzalemu n'umusozi wubatseko Ingoro y'Imana. Ariko umuntu umwe abatanga imbere agenda i Gazara kumenyesha Yohani ko se wiwe yatikiranye na benewabo, yongera ati: «Na wewe nyene, yarungitse uwuza kukwica.» Yohani avyumvise agira ubwoba bwinshi, aca afata abo bantu bari baje kumwica arabatikiza, kuko yari yamenye ko barondera kumwica. Ibisigaye vyerekeye Yohani, indwano yarwanye, ibikorwa vyiwe vy'ubutwari, inyubako y'impome yubatse n'ivyo yaranguye vyose, vyo vyanditse mu gitabu c'ivyakorwa ku musi ku musi mu gihe yari umuherezankuka mukuru, kuva aho asubiririye se mu buherezankuka bukuru.

Bayuda benewacu bo mu Misiri, mwaramutse! Twebwe Abayuda benewanyu b'i Yeruzalemu n'abo mu ntara y'Ubuyuda, tubipfurije amahoro meza! Imana nibahunde ivyiza kandi yibuke isezerano yagiriraniye na Aburahamu, Izahaki na Yakobo, abasuku bayo b'intahemuka. Imana nibahe mwese umutima w'ukuyisenga n'ukurangurana umutima mwiza n'ubwira ugushaka kwayo. Niyugururire umutima wanyu itegeko ryayo n'amabwirizwa yayo kandi ibasasagarize amahoro. Niyumvire ibisabisho vyanyu, isubize hamwe namwe, kandi ntibahebe mu gihe kibi. Ubu ngaha turiko turabasabira. Ku ngoma ya Demetriyusi, mu mwaka ugira ijana na mirongo itandatu n'icenda, twebwe Abayuda twarabandikiye mu gihe twari twugarijwe n'amakuba yadushikiye muri iyo myaka, kuva aho Yasoni n'abo bari kumwe bahemukiriye ikibanza ceranda n'igihugu, bagaturira urugi rw'isengero nkuru kandi bagasesa amaraso y'uwutagira icaha. Twarahejeje turasaba Umukama, turumvirwa, duca duhereza imbagwa n'ifu inoze, ducana amatara duhereza n'imikate. Ubu rero, tubandikiye ngo muhimbaze imisi mikuru y'Insago yo mu kwezi kwa Kiselevu kw'umwaka ugira ijana na mirongo umunani n'umunani. Aristobulosi umuhanuzi w'umwami Butolemayusi, akomoka mu muryango w'abaherezankuka basizwe amavuta, namwe Bayuda muri mu Misiri, twebwe ab'i Yeruzalemu n'abo mu Buyuda, inama y'abakurambere na Yuda, turabaramukije kandi tubipfurije amagara meza. Imana yadukijije amahano menshi, turayishimira cane kuko idufasha kurwanya umwami, kandi yirukanye abari baje gutera igisagara ceranda bitwaje ibirwanisho. Nkako, umukuru wabo yari yagiye mu Buperesi kumwe n'ingabo ziwe zibaza ko zitotsindwa. Bose bagandaguriwe mu ngoro y'imanangore Nanaya, kubera urwenge abaherezankuka ba Nanaya bakoresheje. Nkako, yitwaje gucudika na Nanayiya, Antiyokusi aherekejwe na bagenzibe, yagiye aho hantu yiyumvira kuharonkera amatungo menshi y'inkwano. Abaherezankuka bo mu ngoro ya Nanaya bashira ayo matungo ahabona. Antiyokusi aregereza ari kumwe n'abantu bakeyi, yinjira mu ruzitiro rw'ikirimba. Amaze kwinjira mu ngoro, baca barugara. Bugurura umuryango wihishije mu gisenge, bakoragurira amabuye kuri uwo mukuru, baramwica. Bose barabahimbagura, babaca imitwe, baca bayiterera abari hanze. Imana yacu iragahezagirwa muri vyose, kuko yaroshe ababisha. Kubera ko turi mu guhimbaza ityororwa ry'Ingoro y'Imana kw'igenekerezo rya mirongo ibiri na gatanu ry'ukwezi kwa Kiselevu, twiyumviriye yuko bibereye ko tubibamenyesha, kugira ngo na mwebwe nyene muhimbaze umusi mukuru w'Insago n'uwa wa muriro waduka igihe Nehemiya yahereza inkuka, amaze kwubaka Ingoro y'Imana n'uruhimbi. Nkako, aho ba sokuru bacu bajanwa mu Buperesi, abaherezankuka bayoboka Imana cane b'ico gihe, bamaze kurahura umuriro ku ruhimbi, bawunyegeje mu mpisho mu kinogo c'iriba ryakamye, baca baragifurira ku buryo ata wumenya aho hantu. Haciye imyaka myinshi, Imana ibonye ko ari vyiza Nehemiya arungitswe n'umwami w'Ubuperesi, atuma abamuka ku baherezankuka kurondera uwo muriro bari baranyegeje. Ariko kubera ko batumenyesheje yuko batatoye uwo muriro, bagahumuka ahubwo ku runyigimbe, Nehemiya yaciye abategeka yuko baruyora, bakaruzana. Bamaze kuzana imbagwa, Nehemiya ategeka abaherezankuka kumijagira urwo runyigimbe ku nkwi no ku mashikanwa ari kuri zo. Ivyo bimaze gukorwa, haraciye igihe, izuba ryari ripfutswe n'ibicu ubwa mbere, riraka, umuriro mwinshi urarurumba, ku buryo bose batangara. Igihe imbagwa yariko iratokombera, abaherezankuka baguma basenga, bagasengana n'abari aho bose; Yonatani yaratera, Nehemiya n'abandi bakitabiriza. Ico gisabisho cari kimeze gutya: «Mukama, Mukama Mana, muremyi wa vyose, uratinyitse, uri agahambaye, uri intungane, uri ikigongwe, ni wewe musa uri umwami, ni wewe musa uri mwiza, ni wewe musa utanga vyose, ni wewe musa uri intungane, ushobora vyose kandi wamaho, ukiza Israyeli akabi kose; ni wewe witoreye ba sokuru urabatagatifuza. Niwakire iyo mbagwa y'igihugu cawe cose c'Israyeli; nuzigame icibare cawe kandi ugitagatifuze. Nutororokanye abacu basanzaye, nuhe umwidegemvyo abajakariye mu mahanga, raba ryiza abakengerwa n'abankwa, kugira ngo amakungu amenye ko uri Imana yacu. Buragiza abacinyiza abandi bagatwaza ingimba mu bwishime. Shinga igihugu cawe mu kibanza cawe ceranda, nk'uko Musa yabivuze.» Abaherezankuka baca batera indirimbo. Ivyatanzweko imbagwa bimaze gutokombera, Nehemiya atanga itegeko ryo gusuka amazi asigaye ku mabuye manini. Ivyo bibaye, urubeya ruca ruraka. Haza umuco uvuye ku ruhimbi, uca urarumira. Aho ivyabaye bimenyekaniye, baciye biganira umwami w'Abaperesi ko aho abaherezankuka bajanywe ari imbohe bari banyegeje umuriro, hadutse urunyigimbe, rukaba ari rwo abari kumwe na Nehemiya bakoresheje mu gutyorora amashikanwa y'imbagwa. Umwami amaze gutohoza ivyahabereye yaciye azitiza aho hantu, ahagira Ingoro y'Imana. Aho hantu umwami yahakura ibintu vyinshi, akaza arabihako abo yishakiye. Abari kumwe na Nehemiya bita urwo runyigimbe inefutari, ni ukuvuga ityororwa, ariko benshi barwita inefutayi.

Mu vyari vyagiye birandikwa, basanze umuhanuzi Yeremiya yari yategetse abajanywe ari imbohe gutwara umuriro, nk'uko vyari vyaravuzwe; basanga kandi ko uwo muhanuzi mu kubashikiriza itegeko, yari yategetse abo bajanywe ari imbohe, ko batokwibagira amabwirizwa y'Umukama, kandi n'imitima yabo ntitirimuke babonye ibishusho vy'inzahabu n'ivy'ifeza hamwe n'ibisharizo bibitatse. Mu bindi yari yaravuze, yari yabasavye yuko batoshira itegeko kure y'umutima wabo. Muri urwo rwandiko, baravuga kandi ukuntu umuhanuzi abibwiwe n'Imana, yategetse ko yoherekezwa n'ihema n'Isandugu ry'Isezerano aduze ku musozi, umwe Musa yadugako akihweza intoranwa y'Imana. Yeremiya ashitse kuri uyo musozi, yahasanze uburaro bumeze nk'isenga ry'ibuye, yinjizayo ihema, Isandugu ry'Isezerano n'uruhimbi rw'ibimoga neza, hanyuma aca arazibira umuryango. Bamwe mu bo bari kumwe barasubiyeyo ngo bashire ibimenyetso ku nzira, ariko ntibashoboye kuhamenya. Yeremiya abimenye arabatukagura, avuga ati: «Aho hantu hazoguma hatazwi gushika Imana ikoranije igihugu cayo, ikakigirira ikigongwe. Niho rero Umukama azoherekana, akerekana n'ibiriyo; ubuninahazwa bw'Imana buzoseruka, igicu cibonekeze nk'uko cibonekeje mu gihe ca Musa na hamwe Salomo yasaba ashimitse ngo ikibanza gihezagirwe.» Barigana kandi ukuntu Salomo yahereje imbagwa ijanye n'uguheza kwubaka Ingoro y'Imana n'ukuyihezagira, akabigirana ubwitonzi yari afise. Nk'uko Musa yasavye Umukama, hanyuma umuriro uvuye mw'ijuru ugaturira ivyaherejweko imbagwa, ni ko na Salomo yasavye, hanyuma umuriro uva mw'ijuru utokombeza inkuka. Musa yari yavuze ati: «Imbagwa y'igicumuro yatokombeye kuko batari bayifunguye.» Salomo ahimbaza umusi mukuru mu misi umunani nk'uko vyari bisanzwe bigenda. Ivyo biri mu vyagiye birandikwa no mu vyagiye biravugwa na Nehemiya, vyongeye haravugwa ukuntu Nehemiya yubatse inzu y'ibitabu, ayikoranirizamwo ibitabu vy'abami n'ivy'abahanuzi, ivya Dawudi n'amakete y'abami yerekeye amashikanwa. Yuda yagize gutyo nyene, yegeranya ibitabu vyose vyasanzaye kubera indwano baduteye, none biri iwacu. Nimwaba rero mubikeneye, rungike abazobibazanira. Turabandikiye muri iki gihe twegereje guhimbaza ityororwa ry'isengero nkuru. Muzoba mugize neza rero muhimbaje iyo misi. Imana yarokoye igihugu cayo cose, ikagiha intoranwa, ubwami, ubuherezankuka n'ubweranda, nk'uko yari yabiraganye mw'itegeko ryayo, iyo Mana turayizigiye, izotugirira ikigongwe vuba, idukoranirize mu kibanza ceranda idukuye mu ntara zose zo munsi y'ijuru, kuko yadukijije ibibi vyinshi, igatyorora n'ico kibanza. Ivyabaye kuri Yuda Makabe na benewabo, ivyerekeye ityororwa ry'ingoro nkuru y'Imana, ihezagirwa ry'uruhimbi, ibiraba abarwanije Antiyokusi Epifani n'umuhungu wiwe Ewupatori, n'ukuntu abagize ishaka n'ubutwari mu kurwanira idini ry'Abayuda baremeshejwe n'ibitangaro bivuye mw'ijuru ku buryo bashoboye gusahura igihugu cose n'aho bari bakeyi, bakomora isinzi ry'abanyamahanga, ukuntu basubiriye kwigarurira Ingoro y'Imana, ingoro y'agakura kw'isi yose, bakabohora igisagara, bagasubizaho amategeko yagira akurwe, Umukama nyene ikigongwe akaba yari yaraberetse impuhwe ziwe zose, ivyo bikaba vyanditswe na Yasoni w'i Sireni mu bitabu bitanu, twebwe tuzogerageza kubikoraniriza mu gitabu kimwe. Nkako, turavye ubwinshi bw'ibitigiri n'intambamyi abashaka gutohoza ivyagiye biraba vyavuzwe bagira kubera ubwinshi bwavyo, twitwararitse kworohereza abashaka gusoma, twunganira abashima gufata ku mutwe ivyabaye, twandika kandi ibizogirira akamaro abazobisoma bose. Twebwe rero twemeye ico gikorwa kigoye c'ukugira ico cegeranyo, nticatworoheye, caratubijije akuya kandi kituraza maso kenshi. Nk'uko uwuringaniza umusi mukuru kandi arondera gushimisha abandi atoroherwa, ni ko natwe twemeye ata gahato ico gikorwa kitugora, kugira ngo benshi babidushimire. Twararetse ngo umwanditsi w'ivyabaye abe ari we azotohoza ido n'ido, duca ku mayange ivyiyumviro bikurubikuru dusanga muri ico cegeranyo. Kurya umwubatsi w'umuhinga yubaka inzu nshasha ategerezwa kwitwararika umushinge wose, nayo umusizi w'irangi akarondera ibikenewe vyose vy'ugutaka inzu, niyumvira yuko ariko bimeze no kuri twebwe. Ivy'ukwinjira mu vyabaye, ukubica irya n'ino, ukuvyitwararika ido n'ido, ni ivy'umwanditsi w'ivyabaye. Ariko ukurondera kubivuga mu mpfunyapfunyo, utiriwe urabitomora, ivyo ni ukubihebera uwuvyandika aza arabisigura. Kuva ubu rero reka dutangure kwigana ivyo vyabaye ata co twongeye ku vyavuzwe, kuko ntivyokwumvikana tuvuze menshi mu ntangamarara y'ivyo vyabaye, tugahava tubipfunyapfunya mu nyuma.

Igihe abantu baba mu gisagara ceranda mu mahoro yuzuye, bakarangura neza cane amategeko kubera umuherezankuka mukuru Oniyasi yayoboka Imana kandi akanka inabi, vyarashika yuko n'abami ubwabo batera iteka ico ikibanza, bakaninahaza Ingoro y'Imana mu gutanga amashikanwa ateye igomwe cane ku buryo na Selewukosi, umwami wa Aziya, ari we yariha ivyakoreshwa vyose mu migirwa y'uguhereza imbagwa, akoresheje amatungo yiwe. Ariko uwitwa Simoni wo mu muryango wa Benyamini, yari yagizwe umukuru w'Ingoro y'Imana, atata n'umuherezankuka mukuru ku vyerekeye itunganywa ry'isoko ryo mu gisagara. Kubera yuko atari gushobora gutsinda Oniyasi, aja kwa Apoloniyusi, w'i Taraseya; ico gihe yari umukuru w'ingabo z'i Koyilesiriya na Fenisiya, amwiganira ukuntu ububiko bw'amatungo bw'i Yeruzalemu bwuzuye amatungo menshi, ku buryo ivyarimwo ata wari gushobora kubiharura, kandi yuko ayo matungo yari arengeye ibitegekanirijwe imbagwa, n'uko yoshobora kwegukira umwami. Ariko arabonana n'umwami, Apoloniyusi amwiganira ivyo yari yabariwe kuri ayo matungo. Umwami agena umunyamabanga wiwe mukuru Heliyodori, amurungikana itegeko ry'ukunyaga ayo matungo bari bavuze. Ubwo nyene, Heliyodori afata urugendo, nk'uko yoba agiye kugendera ibisagara vya Koyilesiriya na Fenisiya, ariko mu vy'ukuri ajanywe n'ukurangura umugambi w'umwami. Ashitse i Yeruzalemu kandi akakirwa neza n'umuherezankuka mukuru w'igisagara, amenyesha ivyerekeye amakuru yari yavuzwe n'imvo yamuzanye ngaho, araheza arabaza yuko ivyavuzwe ari ivy'ukuri. Umuherezankuka mukuru yerekana yuko hari ibigega bigenewe abapfakazi n'impfuvyi, ariko kandi yuko bimwe muri vyo vyari ivya Hirikano mwene Tobiya, umuntu mukuru cane, kandi yuko ivyo bigega ata ho bisa bisana n'ivyo umubisha Simoni yavuze. Nkako, vyose hamwe vyangana n'amatarenta amajana ane y'ifeza, n'amatarenta amajana abiri y'inzahabu. Umuherezankuka avuga kandi yuko bidashoboka na gatoyi kugirira nabi abemera yuko ico kibanza ari ceranda, bakubaha Ingoro y'Imana, ingoro isonerwa kw'isi yose, bakayirinda kuvogerwa. Ariko Heliyodori yisunze amategeko yahawe n'Umwami avuga yuko uko bigenda kwose ivyo bintu binyagwa bikaja mu kigega c'umwami. Umusi Heliyodori yashinze ugeze, arinjira ngo aharure ayo matungo, agahinda katari gake gakwira igisagara cose. Abaherezankuka bambaye ivyambarwa vyabo vy'ubuherezankuka bakubita inkoro hasi imbere y'uruhimbi, bambaza Imana yashinze amategeko yerekeye amatungo yaziganijwe, bayisaba kuyazigamira neza abayabitse. Uwitegereza ukuntu umuherezankuka mukuru yari asigaye asa, yaca yuzura agahinda. Nkako mu maso no ku rukoba haserura amaganya afise ku mutima. Uwo mugabo yari yatekewe n'ubwoba, atetemera umubiri wose. Abamwitegereza barabona yuko afise ububabare mu mutima. Abantu baza barasohoka bava mu nzu bari mu migwi, kugira ngo basengere hamwe, kuko ikibanza ceranda cari kigeramiwe n'agasuzuguro. Abagore bakenyereye amagunira munsi y'amabere buzura amabarabara. Bamwe mu bakobwa b'isugi bakiri haziko birukira icarimwe baja ku marembo, abandi ku mpome, abandi barungarunga bari ku madirisha. Bose berekeza ibiganza mw'ijuru basenga. Vyari biteye ikigongwe ukubona ukuntu ishengero rikubita inkoro hasi mu kivunga, umuherezankuka mukuru na we ari ngaho, yuzuye amaganya menshi. Mu gihe bariko barasaba Umukama Mushoboravyose ngo azigamire neza ayo matungo abari bayabikishije, ntihagire ikiyakomakoma, Heliyodori we, yariko ararangura ivyapfunditswe. Ariko aho Heliyodori amariye gushika iruhande y'ububiko bw'amatungo, ari kumwe n'abamucungerera ubuzima, uwuganza imitima akaba na nyene ububasha bwose yaribonekeje icese, ku buryo abari bubahutse kuzanana na we bose bahundagajwe n'ububasha bw'Imana, bacika inkokora, barahinda agashitsi. Nkako, babonye ifarasi yambaye ivyambarwa vyiza cane, igendeshwa n'umuntu ateye ubwoba. Iyo farasi isimbira kuri Heliyodori n'inguvu nyinshi, imukubitisha ibinono vy'imbere. Uwari ayicayeko yasa n'umuntu yambaye ibirwanisho vy'inzahabu. Heliyodori abona kandi haserutse imisore ibiri y'inguvu nyinshi, myiza cane kandi yambaye impuzu z'akaroruhore. Iraheza ihagarara umwe ku ruhande uwundi ku rundi, iramuhuragura idatezura, imuca inguma nyinshi. Ubwo nyene, Heliyodori aca agwa hasi abona ari mu mwijima, baca baramuterura, bamuryamika mu nderuzo. Uwo muntu yari yinjiye mu bubiko bwa ya matungo, aherekejwe n'ishengero rinini hamwe n'abamucungera bose, bamurerura atakibasha kwigendera wenyene, baca baremera icese ububasha bw'Imana. Igihe Heliyodori yari arambaraye hasi ata co akivuga kubera ububasha bw'Imana, ata n'urukiza acizeye, abandi na bo bariko barashemeza Umukama yari yateye iteka ikibanza ciwe. Ingoro y'Imana hari haciye akanya yuzuye ubwoba n'umudurumbanyo, iraheza sagwa n'akanyamuneza n'agahimbare kubera Umukama Mushoboravyose yibonekeje. Bamwe mu bagenzi ba Heliyodori baciye bihutira gusaba Oniyasi ngo atakambire Imana Rudasumbwa kugira isubize ubuzima uwo muntu yari ku mpfiro. Umuherezankuka mukuru atinya yuko umwami yohava yikeka yuko Abayuda bateze umutego Heliyodori, aca arahereza inkuka ngo Imana ikize uwo muntu. Igihe uwo muherezankuka mukuru yariko arahereza inkuka y'ugusaba ikigongwe, ya misore nyene isubira kubonekera Heliyodori, yambaye za mpuzu nyene. Iyo misore irahaguruka, ibwira Heliyodori iti: «Kengurukira cane umuherezankuka mukuru Oniyasi, kuko Umukama yakugiriye ubuntu arakuzigamira ubuzima kubera we. Nayo wewe, wahanywe n'Imana, menyesha bose ububasha ntangere bwayo.» Imaze kuvuga ivyo, ica irazimangana. Heliyodori, amaze guhereza imbagwa Umukama, agasenga akengurukira cane uwamuzigamiye ubuzima, atumira Oniyasi kugira amusezere, hanyuma asubira ibwami hamwe n'ingabo ziwe. Yaguma ashinga intahe imbere ya bose yemeza ibikorwa vy'Imana Rudasumbwa yari yiboneye n'amaso yiwe. Umwami amubajije uwundi muntu yoba akwiye gusubira kurungikwa i Yeruzalemu, Heliyodori yishura ati: «Niwaba ufise uwukurwanya canke uwoba ashaka guhungabanya intwaro, murungikeyo. Niyaramuka aharokotse, uzosubira kumubona yarakubiswe, kuko ni ivy'ukuri aho hantu hakikujwe n'ububasha bw'Imana. Nkako uwuba mw'ijuru ni we acungishije ijisho aho hantu akongera akahakingira, maze abahazanywe n'ugukora inabi, akabakubita akabica.» Uko ni ko ivyerekeye Heliyodori n'ibiraba icungerwa ry'amatungo vyagenze.

Umwe Simoni amaze kwibaraguza akavuga ivyerekeye amatungo y'igihugu, abandanya yambika ibara Oniyasi ngo yoba ari we yakubitishije Heliyodori, akaba n'intandaro y'ayo mabi. Uwo Simoni yarubahutse avuga yuko uwagirira neza igisagara, agakingira abavukanyi, agaharanira amategeko, ari we ashaka guhungabanya intwaro. Urwanko Simoni yanka Oniyasi ruguma rwongerekana gushika aho haduka ubwicanyi bugizwe n'abashigikiwe na Simoni. Oniyasi abonye ukuntu yankana urunuka na Simoni, akabona kandi ukuntu Apoloniyusi mwene Menesitewusi umukuru w'ingabo za Koyilesiriya na Fenisiya yatuma ububisha bwa Simoni bwongerekana, agenda ibwami, atajanywe n'ukurega abavukanyi, ariko yitwararitse ineza y'igihugu cose n'iy'umuntu umwumwe. Nkako yarabona yuko hatabaye ingingo y'umwami bitari bigishoboka ko amahoro asasagara mu ntwaro kandi ko Simoni atari agishobora guhagarika ubusazi bwiwe. Selewukosi amaze gupfa, Antiyokusi batazira Epifani akamusubirira ku ngoma, Yasoni mwenewabo wa Oniyasi yaciye yiha ubuherezankuka bukuru amaze kubonana n'umwami akamwemerera amatarenta amajana atatu na mirongo itandatu y'ifeza n'amatarenta mirongo umunani azokura ku yandi matungo. Yandika yuko yemeye kuzotanga kandi amatarenta ijana na mirongo itanu hamwe yomuha ububasha bw'ukwubaka ikigo c'ukunonoreramwo imitsi n'ikindi c'urwaruka, akamwemerera n'ukwandika urutonde rw'Abanyantiyokiya baba i Yeruzalemu. Umwami amaze kuvyemera, Yasoni afata ubutegetsi aca yosha ubwo nyene abavukanyi biwe gukurikiza imigenzo y'Abagereki. Hanyuma akuraho ingingo umwami yari yarafashe ngo yorohereze Abayuda, biciye kuri Yohani, se wa Ewupolemo, ari na we yahavuye arungikwa kwunga ubucuti n'amasezerano hamwe n'Abanyaroma. Azimanganya amateka y'ukuri y'igihugu, ayasubiriza imigenzo iteye kubiri n'amabwirizwa. Ahimbarwa n'ukwubaka ikigo c'ukwinonora imitsi hepfo y'agasozi kariko isengero nkuru, akaza arajana mu myimenyerezo urwaruka rubangutse, yarwambitse inkofero Abagereki bambara mu kwinonora imitsi. Gutyo imigenzo y'Abagereki n'ingendo y'abanyamahanga birenga urugero kubera ububisha burengeje bwa Yasoni yabaye umugome aho kuba umuherezankuka mukuru, ku buryo abaherezankuka batari bacitaho imigirwa yo ku ruhimbi, ahubwo bakaza baranebagura isengero nkuru, bafata minenerwe uguhereza imbagwa. Uko inkengeri ivuze, baca bihutira kwinjira mu kigo c'ukwinonoreramwo imitsi kandi amabwirizwa abibuza. Bariyambuye iteka rya ba sekuru bashira imbere ubuninahazwa bw'Abagereki. Ivyo ni vyo vyatumye Abayuda bugarizwa n'amarushwa. Nkako, baracambiwe imigenzo y'Abagereki, baripfuza gusa na bo muri vyose, ariko muri bo bahavuye bahasanga ababarwanya n'ababamiza mu bihano. Mu vy'ukuri ukurenga amategeko y'Imana ntikwijana, ibihe bikurikira bizovyerekana. Igihe bariko barakinira i Tiri inkino zaringanizwa uko imyaka itanu itashe, n'umwami akaza kurorera, ca gihumane Yasoni kirungikayo abarorerezi bavuye i Yeruzalemu, bari bararonse akabira k'Abanyantiyokiya. Bagiye batwaye amashekeli amajana atatu y'ifeza agenewe imbagwa ya Heraklesi, ariko abo bayatwaye babona yuko bitabereye kuyakoresha ku mbagwa, ahubwo yopfuma akoreshwa mu bindi bikenewe. N'aho uwarungitse ayo mashekeli yari yayageneye imbarwa ya Heraklesi, yahavuye akoreshwa mu gukora ubwato bw'indwano bivuye ku bayajanye. Apoloniyusi mwene Menesitewusi amaze kurungikwa mu Misiri mu birori vy'ukwimika umwami Filometori, Antiyokusi amenya ko uwo mwami Filometori arwanya intwaro yiwe. Antiyokusi aca aritwararika cane umutekano wiwe, agenda i Yope, mu nyuma ashika i Yeruzalemu. Yakirwa neza na Yasoni n'ababa mu gisagara, bamusanganiza amatara yaka n'impundu nyinshi. Ivyo biheze, Antiyokusi ajana ingabo ziwe gucumbika i Fenisiya. Imyaka itatu iheze, Yasoni atuma Menelasi, mwenewabo n'umwe Simoni, ngo ashire amahera umwami, yongere aheraheze ibiganiro vyerekeye ibikorwa vyihutirwa. Menelasi amaze gushika ibwami, arininahaza nk'umuntu ahambaye, aca agabana ubuherezankuka bukuru, atanze amatarenta amajana atatu y'ifeza arenga ku yo Yasoni yari yaratanze.
