Ntivyabaye uko twari tuvyizigiye gusa, ariko babanje kwitanga biha Umukama, natwe nyene baratwiha nk'uko Imana ibishaka. Ni co catumye twihanikiriza Tito ngo asozere iwanyu ca gikorwa kindi c'imbabazi, nk'uko yagitanguye kera. Ariko, nk'uko mutera imbere muri vyose, mu kwemera, mu mvugo, mu bumenyi, mu kwitwararika rwose no mu gukunda nk'uko nabibigishije, ni ko mworushirizaho kandi gukora ico gikorwa c'ubuntu. Si ibwirizwa nshinze; ariko, ico nshaka mu kubibutsa umwete w'abandi, n'ukugeza urukundo rwanyu ngo rube urw'ukuri. Nkako nanone, muramenya ubuntu bw'Umukama wacu Yezu Kristu: n'aho yari umutunzi, yarigize umworo ku bwanyu, kugira ngo muhinduke abatunzi ku kubera ubworo bwiwe. Ni iciyumviro ntanze kuri ivyo, kuko ari co kibabereye, kuko kuva mwakuyu mwabaye aba mbere, si mu kubitangura gusa, ariko ni no mu kubishaka nyene. Ubu rero nimuheraheze ico gikorwa, kugira ngo ingoga z'ukubishaka zirangukire mu bwira bw'ukubiheraheza ku vyo mufise. Umuntu niyagira ingoga, baramushimira ku vyo afise; ico atagira ntakibazwe. Erega abandi ntibotora mitende namwe ngo mugwe mu bukene; ariko ikibwirizwa ni ukungana. Muri iki gihe, umusesekara wanyu womara ubukene bwabo, kugira ngo kandi umusesekara wabo umare ubukene bwanyu, maze hazobe urunganwe; nk'uko vyanditse ngo: «Uwari yegeranije vyinshi yasanga ata musesekara, uwari yegeranije bike na we agasanga adakehaniwe.» Imana nishimagizwe yo yashize mu mutima wa Tito ico gishika abafitiye, kuko yemeye inama yacu kandi kuko kubera ico gishika ca rwose yishakiye na we kuza iwanyu. Tumurungikanye uwo mwenewacu bashimira mu makleziya yose kubera Inkuru nziza, kandi si ico gusa, ariko nakare yatorewe n'amakleziya kutubera umugendanyi muri ca gikorwa c'imbabazi turiko turarangura ngo Umukama aninahazwe we nyene, kandi ngo twerekane ingoga tubafitiye. Aho rero tugomba kwirinda ibineguro vyose ku vyerekeye ya maturo turiko turakorera, kuko tutitwararika ivyiza imbere y'Umukama gusa, turavyitwararika no mu maso y'abantu. Kandi tubarungikiye n'umwe wo muri benewacu, uwo twasuzumye kenshi akatwereka ko ari n'umwete muri vyinshi, ariko ubu arushirizaho kugira umwete kubera umwizero mwinshi abafitiye. Ku vyerekeye Tito, ni we mugenzi wanje dufatanije igikorwa kandi dukorana iwanyu; ku vyerekeye benewacu, n'intumwa z'amakleziya kandi n'icubahiro ca Kristu. Ni uko rero, nimwerekane mu maso y'amakleziya ko urukundo mubafitiye ari urw'ukuri kandi ko dufise imvo z'ukwishimagiza kubera mwebwe.

Ku vyerekeye ca gikorwa c'ugukorera aberanda, nta co ndinze kubandikira, kuko nzi neza wa mwete wanyu nashimagije mu maso y'Abanyamasedoniya ngo bibabere iteka, nkababwira rero ku Abanyakaya bari basanzwe biteguye kuva mwakuyu na wo umwete wanyu wabereye akarorero abatari bake. Mugabo rero, ndabarungikiye benewacu, kugira ngo ishimagizwa dukura kuri mwebwe ntiripfe ubusa muri ivyo, mube mwiteguye riho nk'uko nabibabwiye; ahandiho, nihagira Abanyamasedoniya tuzana bagasanga mutiteguye, twebwe twomaramara, tukamaramazwa n'ikizigizigi twari dufise, ntiriwe ndavuga mwebwe. Ni co gituma niyumviriye kurungika benewacu ngo badutange iwanyu kandi baringanize wa mugisha mwatwemereye, kugira ngo uwo mugisha mwateguye ntuboneke nk'umugisha nyene ariko uboneke nk'ubunibuni. Bitegere namwe, uwubiba bike azokwimbura bike, uwubiba vyinshi azokwimbura vyinshi. Umwe wese natange ico yiyumviriye mu mutima, ntabitangane amarira canke agahato, kuko Imana ikunda utangana akamwemwe . Erega Imana ishobora kubahunda ivyiza vyinshi, mukamana imisi yose muri vyose ivyo mukeneye vyose, maze mugasagarara mu bikorwa vyiza vyose, nk'uko vyanditse ngo: «Yatanze atitangiriye itama, aha aboro, ubutungane bwiwe bwamaho imyaka yose.» Uwutabaza umubivyi imbuto n'umukate wo gufungura azobatabaza namwe imbuto agireko ayisesekaze, kandi azogwiza ivyavuye ku butungane bwanyu. Mumaze kuba abatunzi muri vyose, muzoshobora gutanga mutitangiriye itama, bino biciye kuri twebwe bigatuma bashimira Imana, kuko ico gikorwa ceranda c'ugutabara kitamara ubworo bw'aberanda gusa, ariko gituma abandi benshi barushirizaho gushimira Imana. Babonye uko mumeze kubera izo ntabaro, bazoninahaza Imana kubera ubugamburutsi bwanyu mu kwemera Inkuru nziza ya Kristu, kubera ubuntu mwaberetse bose no kubera igisabisho, bazobahunda n'igishika cinshi, babitumwe n'inema ntangere Imana yabasesekarije. Nidukengurukire Imana ku ngabirano yayo itagira uko ivugwa.

Jewe Pawulo ubwanje ni jewe ndabatakambiye ku bw'ubutekereji n'ubwiza bwa Kristu, jewe nicisha bugufi muri mwebwe iyo turi kumwe, ariko nkabubahuka iyo tutari kumwe. Ndabasavye rero, aho nzozira iwanyu, sinze ndinde kubakarira nk'uko niyumvira kubigirira bamwebamwe biyumvira ko twama dukurikira kamere yacu y'abantu. N'aho turi abantu, ntiturwana nk'abantu; ibirwanisho vy'intambara yacu si ivy'abantu, ariko ku bw'Imana vya birwanisho bifise ububasha bw'ugutembagaza inzu zubakitse, tugasambura ivyiyumviro vy'ababeshi n'ubwishime bwose bwishira hejuru y'ubumenyi bw'Imana tukongera tugafata mpiri ivyiyumvirwa mu mutima vyose ngo biyobokere Kristu; bisubiye kandi twama tugavye ngo duhane ubugambarazi bwose, igihe muzoba mugize ubugamburutsi bushitse. Nimwitegereze ivyo mubona. Uwibwira ko ari uwa Kristu navyibwire rimwe rizima; niyaba ari uwa Kristu, natwe turi abiwe. N'aho noramuka nininahaje birenze ingero kubera bwa bukuru bwacu Umukama yaduhaye ngo tubaronkere akunguko aho kubaronkera uruhombo, ntibintera isoni, kugira ngo noye kumera nk'uwubatera ubwoba na ya makete nabandikiye. Ya makete, nk'uko bavuga, arahambaye kandi arakaze, ariko iyo tumubona dusanga ari uruzingo kandi amajambo yiwe nta co amaze. Uwuvuga atyo navyibwire neza, uko tumeze turi kure mu majambo ari mu makete, ni ko tuzoba kandi mu bikorwa vyacu aho tuzoba turi kumwe. Ni ko ntitwokwubahuka kwiharura muri bamwebamwe bishimagiza bonyene canke ntitwokwubahuka no kwigereranya na bo. Mu kwishima bonyene no mu kwigereranya, nta bwenge baba bafise. Tweho ntituzokwininahaza ibirenze ingero, mugabo tuzokoresha rwa rugero Imana yatugereye mu kudushikana iwanyu. Nkako, ntiturenga urugero nk'uko tutoba twarashitse iwanyu; mu vy'ukuri, twarashitse iwanyu, dushikana Inkuru nziza ya Kristu. Ntitwininahaza ibirenze urugero mu kwishimiriza ivyo abandi bakoze; ariko twizigiye yuko igikuriro c'ukwemera kwanyu kizotuma tuguma dukurira mu mitima yanyu nk'uko bikwiranye na rwa rugero twagenewe, twizigiye kandi kwigisha Inkuru nziza ya Kristu mu bihugu biri hirya y'iwanyu, tukareka riho kwininaharisha ibikorwa bimaze kugirwa ahagenewe uwundi. Uwininahaza niyininahaze mu Mukama, kuko uwishimagiza atari we yemerwa, ariko hemerwa uwo Umukama ashimagiza.

Icompa mukarinda gatoyi ubusazi bwanje! Koko ni ivy'ukuri, murabirinda. Erega ndabafitiye igishika nk'ico Imana ibafitiye, kuko nabashingiye umugabo umwe rudende, kugira ngo ndabahereze Kristu mumeze nk'umwigeme atagira akanenge. Ariko ndatinya ko mwohava muba nka Heva inzoka yataye mu rudubi mu kumuhenda, ivyiyumviro vyanyu bikononekara mu kubajana kure y'ukuri n'ubweranda bwa Kristu. Uwuza iwanyu niyabamenyesha uwundi Yezu atari uwo twabamenyesheje, nimwakira uwundi Mutima atari uwo mwakiriye canke iyindi Nkuru nziza atari iyo mwaronse, urya muramwirinda cane! Nanone ndiyumvira yuko abo batumwa b'agakura ata co bandusha na gatoyi. N'aho ndi ikitazi mu mvugo, ubwenge nta bwo mbuze, kandi ivyo twarabiberetse muri vyose no mu maso ya bose. Mbega hari igicumuro nakoze mu kwicisha bugufi ngo ndabashire hejuru igihe twabigisha Inkuru nziza y'Imana ata mpera tubasaba? Narasahuye ayandi makleziya ndakira impembo ngo mbashe kubakorera. Hanyuma, aho nari iwanyu nkaba mu bukene, sinigeze ngora n'umwe, kuko benewacu bavuye muri Masedoniya ari bo bamaze ubukene. Muri vyose naririnze kubagora kandi nzoguma ndavyirinda. Uko nyene ukuri kwa Kristu kuri muri jewe, nta bwo iyo mvo y'ukwininahaza izomvako mu ntara zo muri Akaya. Ni kuki? Ni uko ntabakunda? Imana ni yo ibizi. Kandi ivyo nkora nzobandanya kubikora, kugira ngo mbuze icitwazo cose abokirondera ngo baboneke nkatwe mu vyo bininaharisha. Nkako abameze batyo ni abigira abatumwa, ni abakozi b'amayeri bigira nk'abatumwa ba Kristu. Kandi ivyo ntibitangaze, kuko n'ishetani irigira nk'umumarayika w'umuco. None rero ntibitangaza ko baba abasuku bayo bakigira na bo nyene abasuku b'ubutungane. Iherezo ryabo rizohura n'ibikorwa vyabo Ndabivuge ndabisubire, ntihagire uwiyumvira ko ndi ikiburabwenge. Nimwemere hoho ko mba ikiburabwenge kugira ngo mbashe nanje kwininahaza gatoyi. Ivyo mvuga sindabivuga ndabitumwe n'Umukama, ariko ndabivuga nk'ikiburabwenge, nzi ko mfise imvo y'ukwininahaza. Ko benshi bininahaza babitumwe n'imvo zo kw'isi, nanje nzokwininahaza. Murihanganire ibiburabwenge munezerewe, mwebwe muri inkerebutsi. Iyo hagize uwubagira abaja, iyo hagize uwubarya, iyo hagize uwubasahura, iyo hagize uwubakengera, iyo hagize uwubabakubita mu maso, ivyo murabirinde. Birantera isoni kuvuga ko twagize intege nke muri ivyo. Ariko nihaba hariho imvo yotuma umuntu yishima, reka mvuge nk'ikiburabwenge, nanje ndayifise. Ni Abahebereyi? Nanje ndi we. Ni Abanyisrayeli? Nanje ndi we. Ni uruvyaro rwa Aburahamu? Nanje ndi rwo. Ni abasuku ba Kristu? Reka mvuge nk'uwataye ubwenge, jeho ndabarusha. Narakoze kubarusha, ndabarusha gutabwa mu mabohero, ndabarushakure n'iyo gukubitwa inkoni, kenshi nagarukiye ku cobo. Gatanu kose Abayuda barankubise inkoni mirongo ine gukuramwo imwe. gatatu barankubise ibitsibo, rimwe baranteye amabuye, gatatu ubwato bwaratwawe, naramaze ijoro n'umutaga mu nyenga. Ingendo nagize ntizigira igiharuro, nama ngeramiwe n'inzuzi, nkageramirwa n'abambuzi, nkageramirwa na benewacu b'amaraso, nkageramirwa n'abanyamahanga, nkageramirwa n'igisagara, nkageramirwa n'agahinga, nkageramirwa n'ibiyaga, nkageramirwa n'abiyita benewacu atari bo. Uri ibikorwa n'uburuhe, uri ukurara maso kenshi, uri inzara n'inyota, uri ukwirirwa ubusa kenshi, uri imbeho n'ukubura agahuzu. N'aho ntorinda kuvuga ibisigaye, hari icama kimpagaritse umutima imisi yose, umwitwarariko w'amakleziya yose. Ni nde yakena ingoga simbe ndazikenye? Ni nde yatemba sinumve ko nsha wese? Ninategerezwa kwininahaza nzokwininahaza ku magara make yanje. Imana ari yo Se w'Umukama Yezu, Nyaguhezagirwa imyaka yose, irazi ko ntabesha. I Damasi umutegetsi w'umwami Haretasi yari yanderekesheje abo mu gisagara ca Damasi ngo bamfate. Ni ko kuncisha mw'idirisha ndi mu gitebo, bansimbisha ikigo, mbona kumuva mu nzara .

Mbega ntegerezwa kwininahaza? Ariko nta co bimaze. Ngira ntandukire ivy'ukubonekerwa n'uguhishurirwa n'Umukama. Ndazi umuntu muri Kristu, haciye imyaka icumi n'ine, yari yagumanye umubiri wiwe sindabizi, atari yawugumanye bizi Imana; ico nzi ni uko uwo muntu yajanywe gushika mw'ijuru rya gatatu. Uwu muntu rero yari yagumanye umubiri wiwe, atawugumanye sindabizi, bizi Imana, ico nzi ni uko yajanywe gushika mw'iparadizo akumva amajambo atovugwa, ata muntu n'umwe yoshobora gusubiramwo Kubera uwo muntu nzokwininahaza, ariko kubera jewe sinzokwininahaza atari ku magara make yanje. Erega noshaka kwininahaza ntivyoba ari vy'ubusazi, kuko noba mvuga ukuri gusa; ariko ndabiretse kugira ngo ntihagire uwunyiyumvira kuruta ivyo ambonako canke ivyo anyumvako. Mbere kugira ngo ivyiza vy'akatabonetse nahishuriwe ntibintere kwishima, narashinzwe umusonga mu mubiri, intumwa y'ishetani iza iranokeza ngo sinishime. Kubera ivyo, gatatu kose naratakambiye Umukama ngo imvemwo. Ariko we yangize ati: «Inema yanje iragukwiye, kuko ubukomezi bwanje bwibonekeza mu magara make.» Ni co gituma nzoshima kwishimagiza canecane mu magara make yanje, kugira ngo ubukomezi bwa Kristu bugerere muri jewe. None rero mpimbarwa mu magara make, mu bitutsi, mu makuba, mu ruhamo no mu maganya mbona ku bwa Kristu, kuko aho hose ndi umunyantege nke, ni ho mba nkomeye. Ubu ho nabaye umusazi! Ni mwebwe mwabimpatiyeko, kuko ari mwebwe mwari kunshimagiza. Nkako nanone, ni co gituma ntigeze ndutwa na ba batumwa b'agakura, n'aho ata co maze. Ibiranga umutumwa mwaravyiboneye iwanyu. Vyabonekeye mu kwiyumanganya muri vyose no mu gukora ibimenyetso, ibitangaro n'ibitangaza. Mbega ico ayandi makleziya yaronse mutaronse n'iki, atari uko ubwanje ntigeze ndabagora? Nimungirire ikigongwe kuri ubwo buryarya. Ubu ni ubwa gatatu nitegurira kuza iwanyu, kandi sinzobagora, kuko si ivyanyu ndondera, ariko ndondera mwebwe. Nakare abana si bo bashinzwe kuziganiriza abavyeyi, ariko abavyeyi ni bo baziganiriza abana. Ku bwanje, nzonezerezwa cane n'ugutanga ivyanje no kwitanga rwose nitangira ubuzima bwanyu; mbega ndushirijeho kubakunda, none urwo nkundwa rwogabanuka? Ivyo vyo birahaye! Ubwanje sinabaremereye. Ariko ko ndi umwanyakenge, nabafashe ku rwenge. Mbega muri ba bandi nabarungikiye, hari n'umwe natumye kubaka inyungu? Narihanikirije Tito ndamurungikanye urya mwenewacu mwiyiziye. Mbega Tito yoba yabatse inyungu? Twoba tutahuje umutima umwe tugaca mu nzira imwe? Kuva kera, mwiyumvira yuko tubiregurako. Imbere y'Imana muri Kristu ni ho tuvugira. N'ivyo vyose, bakunzi banje, tubigira kugira ngo bibakomeze. Erega ndatinya ko aho nzozira iwanyu nosanga mutameze uko nshaka, namwe mugasanga ntameze uko mushaka; ndatinya kumbure ko muri mwebwe hazoba imitongano, ishari, ishavu, akazikira, ukubesheranira, insaku, amanyama, umudurumbanyo. Ndatinya ko aho nzozira Imana yanje yontetereza kubera mwebwe, nkarinda kuririra benshi mu bacumuye kera, ariko ntibihane ku bicumuro bakoze mu gukora ibitaroranye, mu busambanyi no mu buhumbu.

Buzoba ari ubwa gatatu nza iwanyu. Ijambo ryose rizoringanizwa bivuye mu kanwa k'ivyabona bibiri canke bitatu . Hambere narabibwiye abari bacumuye n'abandi bose, n'ubu ntari iyo, mbaye ndabivuga nk'uko nabivuze hamwe naza ubwa kabiri, ninagaruka, nta kigongwe nzogira, kuko ikibemeza ko Kristu ari we avugira muri jewe. We ntafise amagara make kuri mwebwe, ariko yerekana ububasha bwiwe muri mwebwe. Ni ko yarabambwe ku musaraba ku bw'amagara make yiwe, ariko ni muzima noneho kubera ububasha bw'Imana. Natwe nyene turi ba ntamagara muri we, ariko tuzoba bazima hamwe na we kubera ububasha bw'Imana mu vyo tubagirira. Nimwisuzume mwebwe nyene, murabe ko mukomeye mu kwemera, nimwirimbure uko mumeze. Mbega ntimuzi ko Yezu Kristu ari muri mwebwe? Kiretse mwarahinyujwe mugatsindwa. Murazokwibuka yuko twebwe twahinyujwe tugatsinda. Turasaba Imana ngo ntihagire akabi mukora. Ntitubisaba ngo twebwe tuboneke nk'intahinyuka, ariko tubisaba ngo mwebwe mukore iciza, natwe tuboneke nk'abahinyutse. Nanone nta co twoshobora ngo turwanye ukuri, ariko turashobora kurwanira ukuri. Mbere turanezerewe n'uko turi ba ntamagara namwe mugakomera. Kandi ico dusaba mu bisabisho vyacu ni uko mwoba beranda. Ni co catumye ndabandikira ivyo tutari kumwe, kugira ngo maze gushika iwanyu sindinde guhambara mu gukoresha bwa bukuru Umukama yampaye ngo nubake aho gusambura. Ahasigaye ga benewacu, nimunezerwe, murondere ubweranda, muremeshanye, muhuze imitima, mwamane amahoro, ni ho Imana y'urukundo n'amahoro izobana namwe. Nimuramukanye namwe mu guhoberana nk'aberanda. Aberanda bose barabaganutsa. Muragahorane mwese inema y'Umukama Yezu Kristu, urukundo rw'Imana n'ubunywanyi Mutima Mweranda.

Jewe Pawulo, umutumwa atatowe n'abantu kandi atarungitswe n'uwundi muntu, ariko yatowe na Yezu Kristu n'Imana Data yamuzuye mu bapfuye, jewe rero hamwe na benewacu bari aho bose, turandikiye amakleziya yose y'Ubugalati. Tubipfurije, ineza n'amahoro biva ku Mana Dawe wa twese no k'Umukama Kristu Yezu, yitangiye ibicumuro vyacu ngo adukure mu kabi kadukwega kuri iyi si, nk'uko vyashatswe n'Imana Dawe wa twese, yo ikwiye kuninahazwa imyaka n'imyaka. Amen! Birantangaje kubona mwaciye mwikura ningoga ku wabahamagaye ku bw'inema ya Kristu, mukirukira iyindi Nkuru nziza, kandi ata yindi iriho, atari abantu babahagarika umutima, bagashaka guhindura Inkuru nziza ya Kristu. Ariko, n'aho yoba ari twebwe, canke umumarayika avuye mw'ijuru, abigisha Inkuru nziza idahuye n'iyo twabigishije, aragacibwa! Nk'uko twabivuze ubwa mbere, n'ubu ndasubiriye kubibabwira: nihagira umuntu abigisha Inkuru nziza idahuye n'iyo mwaronse, aragacibwa! Mbega, ubu ni ishimwe ry'abantu ngomba canke ni iry'Imana? Canke se ndondera kunezereza abantu? Iyo mba nanezereza abantu, sinobaye nkiri umusuku wa Kristu. Ku vyerekeye Inkuru nziza nabigishije ga benewacu, ndabamenyesha ko iyo Nkuru nziza irengeye abantu kuko nanje ntayihawe canke ntayigishijwe n'umuntu, ariko ni Yezu Kristu yayimpishuriye. Mwarumvise imigenzo nari mfise kera nkiri mu Buyuda, ukuntu nahiga Ekleziya y'Imana nkayitikiza bimwe birenze urugero, mwarumvise kandi ko mu bwoko bwacu narushije benshi mu bo twarukanye gutera imbere mu Buyuda, kuko nabarusha ubwira bw'ukurwanira iragi rya ba sokuru. Yamara uwanyisobanuriye nkiri mu nda ya mama akanyihamagarira ku buntu bwiwe, aho yashima kumpishuriramwo umwana wiwe ngo ndamumenyeshe mu banyamahanga, ubwo nyene ntagishije inama umubiri n'amaraso, kandi sinaduze i Yeruzalemu kuraba abantanze kuba abatumwa, ariko nagiye muri Arabiya, hanyuma nsubira i Damasi. Imyaka itatu ishize, nduga i Yeruzalemu kwibonanira na Kefasi, tumarana imisi icumi n'itanu; mu bandi batumwa nta wundi nabonye atari Yakobo mwenewabo n'Umukama. Ivyo ndabandikiye ndavyemeye ndi mu maso n'Imana, simbesha. Hanyuma, niho naja mu ntara z'Ubusiriya n'Ubusilisiya, ariko abari mu makleziya ya Kristu yo mu Buyuda ntibari bwankubite ijisho; bari bumvise gusa abavuga ngo «Uwahora aduhama kera ariko arigisha ubu kwa kwemera yahora arwanya kera», bikabatuma baninahaza Imana kubera jewe.

Hanyuma, imyaka icumi n'ine ishize, nsubira kudugana na Baranaba i Yeruzalemu, kandi na Tito ndamujana. Vyongeye naduzeyo kubera ivyo nahishuriwe, kandi nabiganiye ivy'Inkuru nziza mpora nigisha mu banyamahanga, nkavyiganira abarabwa nk'abakuru twiherereye, kugira ngo sinkorere ubusa canke simbe nakoreye ubusa nyene. Ariko na Tito nyene twari kumwe; n'aho yari Umugereki, ntibamugobereye ngo yigenyereshe. Nk'uko abiyita benewacu atari bo babishaka, bamwe batwinjiranye mu mpisho ngo bagenzure umwidegemvyo dufise muri Kristu kugira ngo batugumize mu buja. Abo ntitwabakundiye nagatoyi ngo batuganze kugira ngo ukuri kw'Inkuru nziza kugume muri mwebwe. Ku vyerekeye abarabwa nk'abakuru ico barimwo muri kirya gihe sinkibabaye, Imana ntigira nkunzi, abo bakuru rero nta co banyongerereje. Ariko aho baboneye ko nashinzwe kwigisha Inkuru nziza abatagenyerewe, nk'uko Petero yashinzwe kwigisha Inkuru nziza abagenyerewe, kuko uwagize Petero umutumwa w'abagenyerewe ari we yangize nanje umutumwa w'abanyamahanga, kandi aho bamenyeye iteka natewe, Yakobo, Kefasi na Yohani, barabwa nk'inkingi, baciye batwakiriza yompi twe na Baranaba, tugira ubumwe na bo, ngo tuje mu banyamahanga na bo baje mu bagenyerewe. Ariko ico bagomvye gusa ni uko twokwibuka aboro ari co nyene nanje nari nsanzwe mfitiye umwete ngo ndakirangure. Ariko aho Kefasi yaza muri Antiyokiya, naramwifatiye mu gahanga imbonankubone kuko yari yigayishije. Nkako, bamwe mu bantu bavuye kwa Yakobo batarashika, yariko arasangira n'abanyamahanga. Ariko bamaze gushika, aca ariyonjorora yigira ku ruhande, kuko yatinya abagenyerewe. Abandi Bayuda baciye biyorobeka nka we, bitayeko na Baranaba nyene ahava atwarwa n'ubwiyorobetsi bwabo. Ariko mbonye ko batari mu nzira itunganye ngo batumbere ukuri kw'Inkuru nziza, naciye mbwira Kefasi, imbere ya bose, nti: «Mbega, wewe ko uri Umuyuda, ukigenza nk'abanyamahanga, ntiwigenze nk'Abayuda, ni kuki ugobera abanyamahanga ngo bigenze nk'Abayuda?» Twebwe turi Abayuda kavukire, ntituri abacumuzi bavuye mu banyamahanga, ariko, kubera ko tuzi ko umuntu ataronka urukiza kubera ugukurikiza Itegeko, aruronka riho kubera ukwemera Yezu Kristu, na twebwe twaremeye Kristu Yezu, kugira ngo turonke urukiza kubera ukwemera Kristu, atari kubera ugukurikiza Itegeko, kuko ata muntu n'umwe azoronka urukiza kubera ugukurikiza Itegeko. Noneho, mu kurondera kuronka urukiza muri Kristu, nitwasangwa turi abacumuzi nk'abandi, none ga Kristu azoba abaye umusuku w'igicumuro? Haba namba! Nkako nsubiye kwubaka ivyo nasambuye noba nerekanye ko ndi umuntu acumura. Nakare, Itegeko ryatumye mvavanura n'Itegeko kugira ngo mbeho ndi uw'Imana. Narabambanywe na Kristu. Ninaba ndi muzima, si jewe ndi muzima, ariko Kristu ni we ari muzima muri jewe. Ivyo nkora ubu nkiri muri kamere y'umubiri, ndabikora mu kwemera Umwana w'Imana yankunze akanyitangira. Sinanjanjwa ku ngabirano y'Imana. Nkako urukiza nirwaba ruva kw'Itegeko, Kristu azoba yapfiriye ubusa.

Banyagalati mwe, mwa biburabwenge mwe, ni nde yabaroze, kandi ari mwebwe mweretswe imbonankubone Yezu Kristu yabambwe ku musaraba? Iki kintu kimwe gusa ni co nshaka ko mumenyesha: mbega mwaronse Mutima kubera mukurikiza Itegeko canke kubera ko mwumvirije Inkuru nziza y'ukwemera? Mbega mwakabaye muri ibiburabwenge mutyo? Mwatanguriye mu vya Mutima, none ubu musozerereye mu vy'umubiri? Mbega magorwa mwabonye yapfuye ubusa? Ese iyo aba yapfuye ubusa hoho! Uwubagabira Mutima agakorera ibitangaro muri mwebwe, mbega abigira kubera mukurikiza Itegeko canke kubera Inkuru nziza y'ukwemera? Ni nka kumwe Aburahamu «yemera Imana, na yo igaca imuharura mu ntungane.» Mumenye rero yuko abishimiye ukwemera ari bo bana ba Aburahamu. Bisubiye kandi Ivyanditse vyarabimenye bitaraba yuko Imana yari kuzogira intungane abanyamahanga kubera ukwemera, biraheza biburira Aburahamu iyi nkuru nziza ngo: «Amakungu yose azohezagirwa muri wewe». Niho rero abafise ukwemera bahezagirwa hamwe na Aburahamu yaranzwe n'ukwemera. Abishimira ugukurikiza Itegeko bose barahanamiwe n'umuvumo, kuko handitse ngo: «Arakavumwa uwo wese atihambirira ku vyanditse vyose mu gitabu c'Itegeko ngo abirangure.» Nta n'umwe Itegeko rishobora kugira intungane mu maso y'Imana, ni icibonekeza, kuko «intungane ibeshwaho n'ukwemera». Nkako, Itegeko ntiriva ku kwemera, ariko «uwukora ayo mategeko azobeshwaho na yo.» Kristu yadukijije umuvumo w'Itegeko mu kuba umuvumo nyene ku bwacu, kuko handitse ngo: «Arakavumwa umuntu wese amanitswe ku giti» kugira ngo abanyamahanga baronkere muri Kristu Yezu umuhezagiro wa Aburahamu natwe ukwemera kuturonkere Mutima twemerewe. Benewacu, tubigereranye n'ivy'abantu: isezerano n'aho ryoba ari iry'umuntu gusa, rishizwe mu ngiro nta n'umwe arikuraho canke aryongerako. Ni uko rero, Aburahamu ni we yahawe imihango, we n'uruvyaro rwiwe. Ntibavuga ngo: «Imvyaro» nk'uko zoba ari nyinshi, ariko ni rumwe gusa bati: «uruvyaro rwawe», ni ukuvuga Kristu. Ico nshaka kuvuga rero ng'iki: isezerano Imana yashinze imbere y'igihe ntirikurwa n'Itegeko ryashitse hamaze guca imyaka amajana ane na mirongo itatu ngo ripfishe ubusa uwo muhango. Nkako iragi niryaba riva kw'Itegeko ntiriba rikivuye ku muhango, ariko rero Aburahamu yatewe iteka n'Imana kubera uwo muhango. Itegeko none ni iry'iki? Ryageretsweko kugira abarirenga bibonekeze, gushika haze rwa ruvyaro rugenerwa nya muhango, kandi ryatangajwe n'abamarayika riciye ku mukandizi. Noneho ahari umwe rudende ntihabazwa umukandizi, Imana na yo ni imwe rudende. None se Itegeko rirwanya imihango y'Imana? Haba namba! Iyo duhabwa Itegeko rishobora kutuzanira ubuzima, ubutungane bwobaye buva kw'Itegeko. Ariko Ivyanditse vyerekekana ko ibintu vyose biganzwa n'igicumuro, kugira ngo abemeye Yezu Kristu bahangurirwe uwo muhango. Ukwemera kutaraza, twari twafatiriwe n'Itegeko, turindiriye ukwemera kwimirije kwibonekeza. Uko ni ko Itegeko ryatubereye umurezi aturera akadushikiriza Kristu, kugira ngo tube intungane kubera ukwemera. Ukwemera ko kwaje, ntitukirerwa n'uwo murezi. Mwese muri abana b'Imana kubera ukwemera mufise muri Kristu Yezu. Mwese ko mwabatijwe muri Kristu, mwambaye Kristu. Nta Muyuda canke Umugereki , nta mushumba canke uwidegemvya, nta mugabo canke umugore bakiriho , kuko mwese muri umwe muri Kristu Yezu. Nimwaba muri aba Kristu, muri uruvyaro rwa Aburahamu, mukaba rero ba samuragwa nk'uko vyari mu muhango.

Kandi ico mvuga ni iki: Samuragwa akiri umwana, nta co aba arusha umusuku n'aho aba ari nyene ibintu vyose, ariko agabwa n'abarezi be n'ababwiriza gushika ikiringo se yamugeneye gishike. Na twebwe ni uko, tukiri imicuko, twari abaja bagengwa n'amategeko y'isi, ariko igihe c'ukurangura vyose gishitse, Imana yaturungikiye Umwana wayo, yibarutswe n'umugore, avuka agengwa n'Itegeko, kugira ngo acungure abagengwa n'Itegeko, yongere aturonkere iteka ry'ukuba abana b'Imana. Mbere ko turi abana b'Imana, Imana yararungitse mu mishaha yacu Mutima w'Umwana wayo, atakamba ati: «Aba, Dawe!» Ni co gituma utakiri umusuku usigaye uri umwana, kandi ko uri umwana, uri samuragwa ku bw'Imana. Ariko kera mutaramenya Imana, mwari abaja b'ibitari imana muri kamere yavyo. Ubu none, ko mwamenye Imana, nako ko mwamenywe n'Imana, mwasubiriye gute kugaruka kuri ya mategeko azahuka kandi yatitutse, mugashaka gusubira kuba abaja bayo kandi? Muracagendeza imisi, amezi, ibihe n'imyaka! Munteye ubwoba, umengo natamiye ubusa mu kubakorera. Nimumere nkanje kuko nanje meze nkamwe benewacu, ndabibasavye. Nta nabi mwangiriye. Ariko murabizi, indwara ni yo yampaye uburyo bwo gutangura kubamenyesha Inkuru nziza, kandi ivyabageza muri iyo ndwara ntivyatumye munkengera canke ngo ndabatere ishishi, ahubwo mwanyakirije yompi nk'umumarayika w'Imana, nka Kristu Yezu. None ukwishimagiza kwanyu kwagiye hehe? Ndababera icabona yuko, iyo biba ibishoboka, mwari kwinokora amaso yanyu mukayampebera. Bite, ubu nahindutse umwansi wanyu, kuko ndababwira ukuri? Barabereka urukundo rw'igishika rutari rwiza, ariko ico bashaka ni ukubankurako, kugira ngo mubagirire namwe rwa rukundo rw'igishika. Ni vyiza kugiriranira urwo rukundo rwiza rw'igishika, mukabigira imisi yose, ntimubigire iyo ndi kumwe namwe gusa. Bibondo vyanje, mwebwe nsubira kwibaruka mu marira gushika Kristu ashinge imizi muri mwebwe, nagomba kuba hamwe namwe muri iki kiringo ngo mbone kworosha imvugo yanje, kuko ndabura uko ndabafata. Nimumbwire! Mwebwe mushaka kugengwa n'Itegeko, ntimwumva ico Itegeko rivuga? Handitswe ko Aburahamu yari afise abahungu babiri, umwe wo ku mugore w'umushumba , n'uwundi wo ku mugore w'ukuri . Ariko uwo ku mushumba yari yavutse ku bw'inama yo ku mubiri, nayo uwo ku mugore w'ukuri yari yavutse ku bw'umuhango Muri ivyo harimwo ingereranyo: abo bagore berekana ya masezerano abiri. Irya mbere ni iryo ku musozi Sinayi kandi ryavyaye abo kuguma mu bushumba, na ryo ni Hagari, kuko Hagari ni wa musozi Sinayi uri muri Arabiya. Hagari kandi ni we agereranywa na Yeruzalemu y'ubu, kuko iguma mu bushumba kumwe n'abana bayo. Ariko rero Yeruzalemu yo mw'ijuru ni yo mugore w'ukuri, uwo ni umuvyeyi wacu. Nanone handitse ngo: «Himbarwa wa ntavyara we, wewe utavyaye, wishongore utere impundu wewe utigeze urara ku nda, kuko abana b'intabwa ari benshi kuruta ab'inkundwakazi.» Namwe benewacu, muri abana b'umuhango nka Izahaki. Ariko nk'uko uwavutse ku bw'inama y'umubiri yahama uwavutse ku bw'inama ya mutima ni ko n'ubu bikimeze. None Ivyanditse bivuga iki? Bivuga biti: «Irukana incoreke n'umuhungu wayo, kuko umuhungu w'incoreke atazokwigera atorana hamwe n'umuhungu w'umugore w'ukuri.» Ni uko rero, benewacu, ntituri abana b'umushumba, ariko turi abana b'umugore w'ukuri.

Kristu yaturokoye ngo tube mu mwidegemvyo. Mugumye umutima kandi ntimusubire kwita mu bushumba. Ehe, jewe Pawulo ndababwiye ko nimwigenyeresha, Kristu ata co azoba akibamariye, kandi ndasubiriye kumenyesha umuntu wese yigenyeresha ko ategerezwa gukurikiza Itegeko uko riri. Mwebwe muronderera urukiza mw'Itegeko, mwarikuye kuri Kristu, mutakaza umugisha, nayo twebwe, kubera ukwemera, Mutima ni we atuma turindirana igishika urukiza twizigiye. Nkako muri Kristu Yezu, ukugenyerwa canke ukutagenyerwa si co gihambaye, igihambaye ni ukwemera kurangukira mu rukundo. Mwari mwazindukanye ubwira! Ni nde yabaciye intege z'ugukurikira ukuri? Iyo mpanuro ntiyavuye kuri uwo abahamagara. Umwambiro muke wambira umutsima wose. Ku bwanje, ndabizigiye mu Mukama yuko ata kindi muzokwiyumvira; uwubahagarika umutima uwari we wese, urubanza ruzomusubirako. Ariko jewe ga benewacu, ninaba ncigisha kugenyerwa, ubu mporwa iki? Noneho, wa musaraba utirimutsa uba upfuye ubusa. Icompa ababahagarika umutima bagacibwa ibikonjo! Mweho ga benewacu, mwahamagariwe kwidegemvya, ese gusa uwo mwidegemvyo utobera urwitwazo kamere y'umubiri, ariko mugakoreranira mu rukundo. Nkako Itegeko ryose uko ryakabaye rirangukira muri iri jambo rimwe ngo: «Urakunda mugenzawe nk'uko wikunda wewe nyene.» Ariko nimwaryana canke nimwashikurana, muritegereze mwoye kumarana. Umve rero ico mvuze: nimugenzwe na Mutima, niho mutazokora ivyo kamere y'umubiri yipfuza. Nkako kamere y'umubiri yipfuza ibihushanye na Mutima, kandi Mutima yipfuza ibihushanye na kamere y'umubiri. Ivyo bintu birahushanye, niho mubona mudakora ivyo mwashaka. Ariko nimwaba muyoborwa na Mutima, ntimugengwa n'Itegeko. Erega ibikorwa vya kamere y'umubiri biribonekeza: ni ubuhumbu, uguhumana, ibiterasoni, ugusenga ibigirwamana, uburozi, urwanko, umuryano, ishari, ishavu, impari, amatati, amacakubiri, akayigo, akaborerwe, ubuhumbu burenze urugero, n'ibindi mwene ivyo. Kandi ndababuriye nk'uko nari narababuriye kera, ko abakora ibikorwa mwene ivyo batazotorana Ubwami bw'Imana. Ibiva kuri Mutima na vyo ni urukundo, akanyamuneza, amahoro, ukwiyumanganya, ubukundanyi, ubuntu, ukwemera, ubutekereji n'ukwigumya. Mwene ivyo, nta tegeko ribibuza. None rero, aba Kristu Yezu barabamvye kamere y'umubiri hamwe n'ingeso mbi zayo n'ivyipfuzo vyayo. Ko tubeshwaho na Mutima, nituyoborwe na Mutima nyene. Ntitwibare uko tutari, ntidusomborotsanye, ntitugiriranire ishari.

Benewacu, nihagira umuntu afatirwa mu gicumuro, mwebwe abagenzwa na Mutima muragarurane umutima utekereje. Na wewe nyene wame maso, woye kwoshwa nabi. Nimwakirane imitwaro, niho muzoba muranguye itegeko rya Kristu. Erega, uwigira ngo ari n'ico amaze kandi ata co arimwo, aribesha. Umuntu wese nasuzume ivyo akora, niho azobona ico yiratako muri we nyene atarinze kwigereranya n'abandi. Nkako umuntu wese azokwikorera umutwaro wiwe. Uwigishwa Ijambo ry'Imana nasangire ivyiza vyiwe vyose n'uwumwigisha . Ntimubiyoberwe! Imana ntishinyagurizwa, kuko ico umuntu abiba ari co azokwimbura. Uwubibira kamere yiwe y'umubiri, iyo kamere y'umubiri azoyikuramwo ibore, ariko uwubibira Mutima, uwo Mutima azomukurako ubuzima budahera. Ntiturambirwe n'ugukora ivyiza. Igihe kigeze, tuzokwimbura nitutatezura. Ni uko rero, tugifise uburyo, nitugirire neza bose, canecane abo dusangiye ukwemera. Nimurabe izo ndome ndabandikiye n'iminwe yanje. Abashaka kwikundisha ku vy'umubiri, ni bo babahatira kwigenyeresha, ata kindi kibibatuma atari uko batinya guhamwa kubera umusaraba wa Kristu, kuko abigenyeresha na bo nyene batazigama Itegeko, ariko bagashaka ko mwigenyeresha ngo bininahaze mu mubiri wanyu. Jeho, icompa ntihagire ikindi kininahaza, ndetse umusaraba w'Umukama wacu Yezu Kristu, watumye ivy'isi bimbambirwa nanje nkabibambirwa. Nanone, ukugenyerwa canke ukutagenyerwa, nta kamaro, igishemeye ni ukuba ikiremwa gishasha. Abazokurikira iryo tegeko bose, ndabipfurije amahoro n'ukugirirwa ubuntu, ndavyipfurije kandi Israyeli y'Imana. Kuva ubu ntihagire uwucirirwa arangora, kuko ntwara mu mubiri wanje inkovu za Yezu. Benewacu, nimwamane mu mutima wanyu umugisha w'Umukama wacu Yezu Kristu. Amen!

Jewe Pawulo, umutumwa wa Yezu Kristu ku bw'ugushaka kw'Imana nandikiye aberanda bari muri Efezi bemera Kristu Yezu, ndabipfurije umugisha n'amahoro biva ku Mana Dawe wa twese no ku Mukama Yezu Kristu. Imana, Se w'Umukama wacu Yezu Kristu nihezagirwe, kuko ari yo yaduhezagije imihezagiro y'ubwoko bwose ya Mutima, mu vy'ijuru muri Kristu. Yaratwitoreye muri we isi itararemwa, kugira ngo tube beranda kandi ntitugire amahinyu imbere yiwe mu rukundo, kuko ari yo yatugeneye kumubera abana ku bwa Yezu Kristu kubera icipfuzo c'ugushaka kwayo, ngo yerekane ishimagizwa ry'ubuninahazwa bw'ingabirano yatugabiye mu Mwana wayo nyagukundwa. Muri we, ni ho twaronkeye ubukiriro ku bw'amaraso yiwe, n'ikigongwe c'ibicumuro vyacu kubera itunga ry'ubuntu bwiwe yadusesekajemwo mu kuduha ubwenge n'ubwitonzi bwose. Yaratumenyesheje ibanga ry'ivyo ashaka, imigambi yari yishingiye kuva kera, ngo biranguke aho igihe nyaco kizoba kigeze: ukwegeraniriza vyose mu mutwe umwe ari wo Kristu, ibiri mw'ijuru n'ibiri kw'isi. Twasobanuriwe kandi muri we dutorwa kubera imigambi y'uwugenza vyose, nk'uko yavyishakiye, ngo twerekane ishimagizwa ry'ubuninahazwa bwiwe, twebwe twiteze Kristu kuva kera. Muri we ni ho mwumviye namwe ijambo ry'ukuri, Inkuru nziza y'ubukiriro bwanyu, muri we kandi ni ho mwemeye maze mushigwako ikimenyetso na Mutima w'umuhango, ari we Mutima Mweranda, we ngwati y'iragi ryacu ngo igihugu Imana yironkeye kirokoke bimwe birangutse maze ubuninahazwa bwayo bushimagizwe. Kubera ivyo, nanje aho numviye ukwemera mufise mu Mukama Yezu n'urukundo mufitiye aberanda bose, simpengeshanya gukenguruka ku bwanyu ndabibuka mu bisabisho vyanje. Imana y'Umukama wacu Yezu Kristu ari yo Muvyeyi w'ubuninahazwa, nibahe umutima w'ubwitonzi uyibahishurira ngo muyimenye neza. Nimurikire amaso y'imitima yanyu, kugira ngo murimbure ukuntu ukwo kwizigira yabahamagariye kungana, murimbure ukuntu itunga ry'ubuninahazwa yabaraze mu beranda ringana, murimbure kandi ukuntu ububasha bw'agahebuza ikoresha muri twebwe abemeye bungana, nk'uko ububasha bw'ubukomezi bwayo ata co butarangura, ubwo nyene yakoresheje muri Kristu mu kumuzura mu bapfuye no mu kumuvyagiza iburyo bwayo mw'ijurua, ikamushira hejuru y'ubukuru bwose, ububasha bwose, ubukomezi bwose, ubutegetsi bwose no hejuru y'ikintu cose gishobora kugira izina haba ubu canke muri kazoza, Kandi vyose yabishize munsi y'ibirenge vyiwe , imushira hejuru ya vyose, imugira umutwe w'Ekleziya, ari yo Mubiri wiwe , Musesekara w'uwunengesereza vyose mu buryo bwose.

Bamwe mwari abapfu bishwe n'ibibi be n'ibicumuro vyanyu, kuko mwahora mubigenderamwo kera mu gukurikiza imigenzo y'iyi si, mu gukurikiza uwiharije ubukuru mu kirere, wa mutima ukora ubu mu bantu b'intabarirwa. Muri bo, natwe twarimwo twese kera mu kuba mu vyipfuzo vya kamere yacu y'abantu tugakora ivyo ya kamere n'ivyipfuzo vyayo bishaka, kandi ku bwacu twari twagenewe guhanwa nk'abandi. Ariko Imana, kuko yuzuye ubuntu, kubera rwa rukundo rwinshi yadukunze, aho twari tukiri abapfu bishwe n'ibicumuro, yatugize bazima hamwe na Kristu. Erega mwakijijwe ku buntu gusa. Kandi yatuzuranye na we itwicarika hamwe na yo mw'ijuru muri Kristu Yezu. Kugira ize yerekane ityo mu myaka izoza, itunga ry'agahebuza ry'ubuntu bwayo mu kutugirira imbabazi muri Kristu Yezu. Koko, ubuntu ni bwo bwatumye mukira kubera ukwemera; na vyo nyene ntivyavuye kuri mwebwe, ni ingabirano y'Imana; ntivyavuye ku bikorwa, kugira ngo ntihagire n'umwe yishimagiza. Nanone, turi ibiremwa vyayo, twaremewe muri Kristu Yezu ngo dukore vya bikorwa vyiza Imana yaduteguriye ngo tubigenderemwo. Nimwibuke rero yuko kera mwebwe abanyamahanga ku rukoba, mwebwe mwitwa intagenyerwa n'abitwa abagenyerewe kuko bakebwe ku mubiri bigizwe n'abantu, ko muri ico gihe mutari bwaronke Kristu, mwari mwaraciwe ku bwenegihugu bw'Israyeli kandi ko ata co mwapfana n'amasezerano y'umuhango. Nta mwizero, kandi nta Mana mwari mufise kuri iyi si. Ubu noneho, muri Kristu Yezu, mwebwe abari kure kera, mwabaye abari hafi ku bw'amaraso ya Kristu. Nkako nyene, ni we mahoro yacu, we yatumye iyo migwi ibiri icika umwe, mu gusamburira mu mubiri wiwe rwa ruhome rwayitandukanya, ari rwo rwanko. Yarakuyeho rya Tegeko rigizwe n'amabwirizwa, afatiye ku ngingo zaryo, kugira ngo muri we, iyo migwi ibiri ayirememwo umuntu umwe mushasha mu kuzana amahoro, kugira ngo kandi ayuzurize yompi n'Imana mu mubiri umwe, ku bw'umusaraba, amaze kwicira urwanko kuri wo. Yaraje rero kumenyesha Inkuru nziza y'amahoro mwebwe mwari kure, ayimenyesha n'abari hafi. Nkako twempi ni we adushikana kwa Data muri Mutima umwe. Kukaba nkako, ntimukiri ba kavantara canke abatsi b'indaro, ahubwo mucuditse n'aberanda, mugize umuryango w'Imana, kuko mwubatswe ku mushinge ugizwe n'abatumwa n'abahanuzi, Kristu Yezu akaba ibuye ry'imfuruka . Muri we, ni ho inyubakwa yose iteranira kandi igakuka, ikaba isengero nyeranda mu Mukama. Muri we, namwe murubakwa mwese ngo mucike Ingoro y'Imana muri Mutima.

Ni co gituma jewe Pawulo, imbohe ya Kristu Yezu kubera mwebwe abanyamahanga... Ngira ngo mwarumvise ukuntu, kubera mwebwe, Imana yanshinze umugambi wayo wuzuye ubuntu, muguhishurirwa nkamenya rya Banga nk'uko mpejeje kuvyandika mu ncamake, musomye ivyo nanditse, mwoshobora gutegera bwa bumenyi nahawe muri rya banga rya Kristu ritamenyeshejwe abana b'abantu mu bihe bindi, nk'uko ryahishuriwe ubu abatumwa n'abahanuzi biwe beranda muri Mutima: ko abanyamahanga basangiye natwe iragi rimwe, bagasangira natwe kuba ingingo z'umubiri umwe, bagasangira natwe umuhango umwe muri Kristu Yezu kubera Inkuru nziza, nkaba nashinzwe kuyibera umusuku nk'uko nabiherewe ingabirano n'Imana mu bukomezi bw'ububasha bwayo. Jewe, uwa nyuma mu beranda bose , ni jewe nahawe inema y'ukumenyesha abanyamahanga itunga rihebuje rya Kristu, n'iy'uguserurira bose ubutungane bungana butyo bw'uwo mugambi wahishijwe kuva kera mu Mana Umuremyi wa vyose; none kuva ubu kubera Ekleziya, abakuru n'abaganza bazomenya ubwitonzi ntangere bw'Imana nk'uko yabitegetse kuva kera muri Kristu Yezu Umukama wacu. Muri we twarahawe gutinyuka kwegera Imana ata makenga, kuko ari we twemeye. None rero, ndabibasavye ntimwihebure mu magorwa mbona ku bwanyu kuko ari yo buninahazwa bwanyu. Ni co gituma nkubitira ibipfukamiro imbere ya Data ari we ubuvyeyi bwose bwamukako mw'ijuru no kw'isi, ku ngero y'itunga ry'ubuninahazwa, nabahe gukomera cane kubera Mutima wiwe kugira ngo umuntu w'imbere abakuriremwo. Kristu nabe mu mitima yanyu kubera ukwemera, mushinge imizi ifatiye ku rukundo, kugira ngo mubashe gutegera mwe n'aberanda bose uko ubwaguke, uburebure, ubuhagurutsi n'ubwimbike bingana, mumenye urukundo rwa Kristu rurengeye ubumenyi bwose, muheze mubone kunengesera umusesekara wose w'Imana. Uwushobora gukora ibirengeye rwose ivyo dusaba n'ivyo twiyumvira vyose, ku ngero y'ububasha akoresha muri mwebwe, naninahazwe muri Ekleziya no muri Kristu Yezu mu bantu b'ibihe vyose no mu myaka yose. Amen!

Ni co gituma ndabinginga jewe imbohe ku bw'Umukama, ngo mwigenze nk'uko bikwiranye n'itorwa mwatorewe, mu kwicisha bugufi no mu gutekereza muri vyose, mu kwiyumanganya, mukagiriranira imbabazi zivuye ku rukundo, mugashishikara kuzigama ubumwe bw'umutima mubwungisha amahoro. Hariho Umubiri umwe n'Umutima umwe, nk'uko kandi ivyo muhamagariwe kwizera ari bimwe. Hariho Umukama umwe, ukwemera kumwe n'ibatisimu imwe. Hariho Imana imwe ari yo Se wa bose, isumba vyose, igenza bose kandi iri muri bose. Ariko rero, umwumwe muri twebwe yarahawe ingabirano nk'uko Kristu yaturimbanije ingabirano ziwe. Ni co gituma bavuga bati: «Yaraduze hejuru ajanye imbohe, abantu na bo abahunda ingabirano». Iryo jambo ngo yaraduze, ni ukuvuga iki, ndetse ko ari uko yabanje kumanuka hepfo mu ntara zo kw'isi? Uwamanutse ni we nyene yaduze hejuru y'amajuru yose, kugira ngo anengesere vyose. Ni we kandi yahaye bamwe kuba abatumwa, abandi abahanuzi, abandi abakwiza Inkuru nziza, abandi abungere n'abigisha, kugira ngo aberanda babone gutungana mu gikorwa c'ugukoreranira mu kwubaka umubiri wa Kristu gushika aho twese hamwe tuzoshikira ubumwe bw'ukwemera n'ubw'ukumenya Umwana w'Imana, tugashikira wa muntu abushitse, ku rugero rw'igihagararo kizima c'umusesekara wa Kristu. Gutyo ntituzoba tukiri abana bazungagizwa kandi bahitanwa n'igihuhusi cose c'inyigisho ihagaze ku bubeshi bw'abantu, ku buhinga bwabo bw'ugutwara abandi mu binyoma. Ariko tugumane ukuri mu rukundo, dukure tugana mu buryo bwose uwuri Umutwe, ari we Kristu; umubiri wiwe wose ukura kuri we ubumwe n'ishirahamwe mu ngingo ziwunganira, nk'uko igihimba kimwe cose gikora ibanga cagenewe; kuri we rero ni ho umubiri wose wiringaniriza ibiwukuza ngo wiyubake wo nyene mu rukundo. Ni co gituma ndababwira ivyo, nkabishingira n'intahe mu Mukama. Ntimuzosubire na rimwe kwigenza nk'uko abapagani bigenza mu bitagira akamaro vyo mu bwenge bwabo. Bamana ivyiyumviro bibangamye, batandukanijwe n'ubuzima bw'Imana kubera ubujuju bamanye no kubera ugukomantaza imitima yabo. Kandi kuva aho ata co babaye bacibanga, baciye bisuka mu kabi n'umutima wabo wose, ntihagira n'ibitera isoni na bimwe bagera umutwe. Mweho uko si ko mwamenyeshejwe Kristu, usangwa vy'ukuri mwaramwumvise kandi mukaba muri we mwarigishijwe ukuri nk'uko kuri muri Yezu, mukigishwa mu vyerekeye imigenzo ya mbere ko mutegerezwa kwikurako wa muntu wa kera yama atituka kubera ivyipfuzo vy'uruhendo, ni ukwiyubura mu mutima w'ubwenge bwanyu, mukiyambika wa muntu mushasha yaremanywe agashusho k'Imana mu butungane no mu bweranda buva ku kuri. Nimuhebe rero ikinyoma, umuntu wese avugane ukuri na mugenziwe, kuko turi ingingo za bagenzi bacu. Nimwatwarwa n'ishavu, shavure ariko ntimucumure , iryo shavu rirengane n'izuba. Ntimuhe ikibanza ishetani. Uwahora ari igisuma nahebe kwiba, yihambirire ku gikorwa ciza akoreshe amaboko yiwe, kugira ngo aronke ico gufasha abakene. Ntihagire ijambo na rimwe ribava mu kanwa, ndetse ijambo ryiza ryose rishobora gushika ku nyota hamwe rikenewe, rikagirira ineza abaryumvise. Ntimushavuze Mutima Mweranda w'Imana, we yabashizeko ikimenyetso kizobaranga ku musi w'urukiza. Umwikomo, ubukazi, ishavu, induru, ugutyoza Imana, ivyo vyose nibibavemwo hamwe n'akabi kose. Ariko mugiriranire neza, mugiriranire imbabazi, murekuriranire, nk'uko Imana yabarekuriye muri Kristu.

Ni mwigane Imana rero nk'abana bakundwa, kandi nimugendere mu rukundo nk'uko Kristu yadukunze na we, akihereza Imana ku bwacu nk'ishikanwa n'imbagwa bimoga neza . Nayo ivy'ubuhumbu, ivy'uguhumana uko biri kwose canke ivy'inambu y'ivy'isi, ntihagire n'umwe muri mwebwe abicisha no mu kanwa nk'uko bibereye aberanda. Bisubiye, amajambo ateye isoni, amajambo ataroranye canke ibijajuro bitameze ko, na vyo nyene ntibikwiye na gato; muravuga amajambo y'ugushimira Imana. Nkako, ibi murabizi neza: ko umusambanyi canke uwushira isoni canke uwishinga umwina w'ivy'isi, akaba asenga ibigirwamana, ata ntoranwa azoronka mu Bwami bwa Kristu n'Imana. Ntihagire n'umwe abahendesha amajambo atagira mvura, kuko ivyo ari vyo bizana ishavu ry'Imana ku bantu b'intabarirwa. None rero ntimufatanye na bo. Ko kera mwari umuzimagiza ubu mukaba muri umuco mu Mukama, nimwigenze nk'abana b'umuco. Umuco uzana icitwa ubwiza, ubutungane n'ukuri kwose. Nimumenye ikinezereza Umukama. Ntimwigere muja mu bikorwa vy'umuzimagiza bitagira akamaro, nimuvyagirize riho; kuko ivyo abo bantu bakora mu mpisho biteye isoni no kubivuga; ariko ivyo vyose bimaze kwagirizwa, umuco urabigaragaza; ibigaragaye vyose bikaba umuco. Ni co gituma bavuga bati: «Ikangure, wewe usinziriye, haguruka uve mu bapfuye, Kristu azokumurikira.» Nimwitegereze cane rero ukuntu mwigenza, ntimwigenze nk'ibiburabwenge, ariko mwigenze nk'incabwenge, zitagisha uburyo zifise ubu kuko imisi turimwo ari mibi. Kubera ivyo, ntimwigenze nk'ibijuju, nimutegere riho ico Umukama ashaka. Nimureke kuborerwa umuvinyu kuko uvamwo ubuhumbum , nimurondere riho kwuzurwamwo na Mutima, muvugire hamwe amazaburi, indirimbo n'imvyino bivuye kuri Mutima, muvyine kandi mushemeze Umukama n'umutima wanyu, mukengurukire Imana Data muri vyose na hose kw'izina ry'Umukama wacu Yezu Kristu. Nimugamburukiranire mu cubahiro mufitiye Kristu. Bagore nimugamburukire abagabo banyu nk'uko mugamburukira Umukama. Nkako umugabo ari we mutwe w'umugore wiwe nk'uko Kristu ari we mutwe w'Ekleziya, akaba ari we Mukiza w'uwusanzwe ari umubiri wiwe. None rero, nk'uko Ekleziya igamburukira Kristu, nikube ari ko abagore bagamburukira abagabo babo muri vyose. Namwe bagabo nimukunde abagore banyu nk'uko Kristu yakunze Ekleziya akayihebera, kugira ngo ayigire nyeranda mu kuyityoroza amazi akoresheje ijambo, ayibone ihimbaye, itagira umwanda canke agatosi canke ubundi bubi namba, ibe nyeranda ata mahinyu. Uko ni ko abagabo na bo bategerezwa gukunda abagore babo nk'imibiri yabo bwite. Uwukunda umugore wiwe aba yikunda we nyene. Erega nta n'umwe yigera yanka umubiri wiwe, ariko arawugaburira kandi akawubungabunga, nk'uko Kristu agirira Ekleziya yiwe, kuko turi ingingo z'umubiri umwe. Ni co gituma «umugabo azoheba se na nyina akunga ubumwe n'umugore wiwe, bompi bakaba umubiri umwe.» Iryo banga rirahambaye, ndabivuze kuri Kristu no kuri Ekleziya. Aho rero, namwe nyene, umwe wese nakunde umugore wiwe nk'uko yikunda we nyene, umugore na we niyubahe umugabo wiwe.

Mwa bana nimugamburukire abavyeyi banyu mu Mukama kuko bitunganye. «Sonera so na nyoko» , iryo ni ryo bwirizwa rya mbere ririmwo umuhango ngo: «Kugira ngo ubone amahoro kandi urambe ngaha kw'isi.» Namwe bavyeyi, ntimutere ishavu abana banyu ahubwo nimubarere mu kubamenyereza ivyiza no mu kubahanura nk'uko Umukama ashaka. Mwa basuku, nimugamburukire ba shobuja bo ngaha kw'isi, mubigirane icubahiro n'ubwoba, mu bwitonzi bw'imitima yanyu, nk'uko mwobigirira Kristu. Ntimubakorere ku jisho gusa nk'abanezereza abantu, ariko mubakorere nk'abasuku ba Kristu bakorana umutima ico Imana ishaka. Mubakorere n'ububangutsi nk'abakorera Umukama, ntimube abakorera abantu gusa. Murazi neza ko umuntu wese niyakora ivyiza azobisanga imbere y'Umukama, yaba umusuku canke uwidegemvya. Namwe ba shebuja, nimubagirire gutyo nyene, mureke kubahigira, mumenye neza ko mwebwe na bo mufise shobuja umwe aba mw'ijuru, kandi ko ata n'umwe asobanurwa kuri we. Mu bisigaye, nimugire umutima rugabo mu Mukama no mu bukomezi bw'ububasha bwiwe. Nimwambare ibirwanisho vy'Imana ngo mushobore guhangana n'imitego y'ishetani, kuko tutarwanya amaraso n'umubiri, ariko turwanya abafise inganji, abafise ubutwari, abaganza iyi si y'umwijima na ya mitima y'inabi iyerera mu kirere. Kubera ivyo, nimwakire ibirwanisho vy'Imana, kugira ngo mubashe kurinda ku musi mubi, kandi nimwaheza vyose mubashe kugumya umutima rugabo. Nimugumye umutima rugabo rero mwikenyeje ukuri, mwikwije ubutungane, mwambaye ububangutsi nk'inkweto ngo mukwize hose Inkuru nziza y'amahoro. Hejuru ya vyose, nimwakire n'inkinzo y'ukwemera ngo mubashe kuzimya imyampi irurumba y'umubisha. Nimwakire kandi inkofero y'ubukiriro hamwe n'inkota ya Mutima ari ryo Jambo ry'Imana. Murame musenga mutakamba mu gusenga mu bihe vyose Mutima; mubigirane umutima n'ubwira musabira aberanda bose. Nanje nyene mukansabira ngo mpabwe ububasha bwo gukurako umumwa mvuge, ata nkomanzi mu kumenyesha rya banga ry'Inkuru nziza mbereye intumwa mw'ibohero, kugira ngo mbashe kuryigisha ata nkomanzi nk'uko ndabitegerezwa. Kugira ngo mumenye namwe ivyanje, uko meze, muzobimenyeshwa vyose na Tikiko, mwenewacu nkunda cane, umusuku w'intahemuka mu Mukama. Ndamubarungikiye kubera ivyo nyene, kugira ngo mumenye amakuru yacu kandi ngo abaremeshereze imitima. Amahoro abe muri benewacu, urukundo rufatanije n'ukwemera, biva ku Mana Data no ku Mukama Yezu Kristu. Umugisha nuherekeze abakunda bose Umukama wacu Yezu Kristu mu rukundo rudatituka.

Pawulo na Timote, abasuku ba Kristu Yezu turandikiye aberanda bose muri Kristu Yezu bari i Filipi umwigisha n'abababwiriza bo n'ababakorera, tubipfurije inema n'amahoro biva ku Mana Dawe wa twese no ku Mukama Yezu Kristu. Igihe cose ndabibutse nama nkengurukira Imana; imisi yose, igihe cose ndabasabira, ndabigirana akanyamuneza, kuko mwamye musangira natwe mu gukwiza Inkuru nziza kuva ku musi wa mbere gushika n'ubu. Ndizigiye rwose rero yuko rero nizigiye rwose yuko uwatanguye igikorwa ciza muri mwebwe azogishishikara gushika akinonosore ku musi wa Kristu Yezu. Ivyo birakwiye ko ndabibiyumvirako mwese kuko ndabafise ku mutima, kuko haba mw'ibohero ndimwo, canke mu kurwanira no mugukomeza Inkuru nziza, mwese musangiye nanje ingabirano nahawe. Egome, Imana ni yo cabona c'ukuntu ndabafitiye igishika mwese mu mushaha wa Kristu Yezu. Mbere ng'iki ico nsaba: urukundo rwanyu nirwongerekane ubudahengeshanya mu kumenya no mu kwitegereza muri vyose, kugira ngo mubashe kumenya ikiruta ikindi, mube beranda n'intahinyuka kuri wa musi wa Kristu mwiteguriye, mwuzuremwo na vya vyamwa vy'ubutungane mwamishijwe na Yezu Kristu ngo Imana ininahazwe kandi ishimagizwe. Ndashaka ko mumenya, benewacu, yuko ivyo vyanshikiye vyatumye riho Inkuru nziza iguma itera imbere. Ibohero ndimwo ku bwa Kristu ryaramenyekanye mu bakora mw'iciro ry'imanza no mu bandi bose, kandi benshi muri benewacu mu Mukama bararemeshejwe n'uko ndi mw'ibohero barushirizaho kumenyesha Ijambo ry'Imana ata bwoba. Ni ko bamwe babigirana ishari n'amahane, abandi na bo bakamenyesha Kristu babitumwe n'umutima mwiza. Abo rero babigirana kubera urukundo, bazi neza ko nashinzwe kurwanira Inkuru nziza. Abandi bamenyesha Kristu bari n'ishari. Nta vyiyumviro vyiza bafise, ahubwo barondera kunsonga mu marushwa ndimwo mw'ibohero. Ariko ntaco, uko biri kwose, haba mu bwiyorobetsi canke mu kuri, kazima Kristu amenyeshwa. Ivyo biranezereza kandi bizokwama binezereza kuko nzi ko bizombera urukiza kubera ibisabisho vyanyu na Mutima wa Yezu Kristu anshigikiye. Erega ndizeranye igishika cinshi ko ata kizotuma nteterwa, ahubwo ko, mpfuye canke ndi muzima, Kristu azoninahazwa mu mwidegemvyo, ubu nka mbere mu mubiri wanje. Nkako nyene, Kristu ni we buzima bwanje, kandi ugupfa vyombera akunguko. Ariko ubuzima bwanje bw'aha kw'isi nibwaba bwotuma nkora igikorwa ngira kamaro, sinzi ico nohitamwo. Muri ivyo bibiri numva mburaniwe: numva nipfuza gutaha ngo mbane na Kristu, kuko ari co kiruta ibindi; ariko kuguma hano kw'isi na vyo vyorushirizaho kubagirira akamaro. Ndizigiye ivyo, kandi ndazi neza yuko nzogumaho nkabandanya kubana namwe mwese, kugira ngo mutere imbere mwongere munezerwe n'ukwemera kwanyu, kwanyu, kugira ngo ninagaruka iwanyu murushirizeho guhimbarwa muri Kristu Yezu kubera jewe. Ico mwokora gusa ni ukwigenza nk'uko bibereye ya Nkuru nziza ya Kristu, kugira ngo ninaza kubagendera canke ntaje numve ko mwarindiye hamwe, mugafashanya kurwanira ukwemera kw'Inkuru nziza, kandi ko mutatewe ubwoba n'abansi no mu kantu na gatoyi. Kuri bo, ico kirababera ikimenyamenya c'urupfu, kuri mwebwe na ho ni ic'urukiza, ivyo na vyo bikava ku Mana. Nkako, irabiye Kristu, Imana ntiyabateye gusa iteka ry'ukumwemera, ariko kandi ry'ukubabara kubera we, mukurwana rwa rugamba mwambonamwo kandi nkirimwo n'ubu, nk'uko mubizi.

Ni uko rero, nizaba ari impanuro zigirwa muri Kristu, niyaba ari amajambo y'uruhoza avuye ku rukundo, nibwaba ari ubunywanyi bwa Mutima, nizaba ari impuhwe n'imbabazi zigira akamaro, nimwuzuze akanyamuneza kanje mu kwamana umutima umwe, mugasangira urukundo, mugahuza imitima n'imana. Ntihagire ico mugira mubitumwe n'ishari canke n'ubwishime, ariko mwicishihe bugufi umwe wese akiyumvira yuko mugenziwe amuruta. Umwe wese ntiyiyumvire ivyiwe ariko yiyumvire ivy'abandi. Mwamane muri mwebwe umutima umwe, urya nyene Kristu Yezu yari afise: We, n'aho yamyeho muri kamere y'Imana, atigeze yihambirira ku kungana n'Imana. Ariko yigize ubusa, mu gufata kamere y'abasuku mu kwigira umuntu asa n'abandi. Yigenjeje nk'umuntu asanzwe, aricisha bugufi, aragamburuka gushika apfe kandi apfa urupfu rwo ku musaraba. Ni co catumye Imana imushira hejuru ya vyose, ikamugabira rya zina nyaryo rirengeye amazina yose, kugira ngo, kw'izina rya Yezu, bose bakubite ibipfukamiro hasi abari mw'ijuru, abari kw'isi n'abari mu kuzimu, kandi ngo ururimi rwose rwature yuko Yezu Kristu ari Umukama mu buninahazwa bw'Imana Se. Ni uko rero, bakunzi banje, nk'uko mwamye mugamburuka, nimube ari ko mushishikara kurondera ubukiriro bwanyu, mubigirane icubahiro n'ubwoba, na vyo ntimubigire igihe ndi iwanyu gusa, ariko murushirizeho kubigira ubu ntashobora kuba ari ho ndi; kuko Imana ari yo irangura ku buntu bwayo muri mwebwe ugushaka n'ugukora ku buntu nyene. Vyose nimubikore ata mwidogo, ata n'amakenga, kugira ngo mube intahinyuka n'aberanda, abana b'Imana batagira agatosi hagati y'abantu b'iki gihe b'abahuni kandi batirinda akabi . Muri bo, murasayangana nk'inyenyeri mw'ijuru , mugumye ijambo ry'ubuzima ngo mbone ikizoninahaza ku musi wa Kristu, kuko ntazoba nirukiye ubusa kandi kuko ntazoba niruhishirije ubusa. Ariko, n'aho amaraso yanje yoseswa, akiyongera ku mbagwa no ku migirwa y'ukwemera kwanyu, nonezerwa, nkanezeranwa namwe mwese. Namwe rero nimunezerwe, munezeranwe nanje. Nizigiye mu Mukama Yezu yuko nzobarungikira vuba Timote, kugira ngo ninamara kwumva ivyanyu mbonereho gusubiza umutima mu nda. Nkako nyene, nta wundi w'umutima noronka agira umutima nka we, yobabara ivyanyu vy'ukuri, kuko abandi bose barondera ivyabo ntibarondera ivya Kristu Yezu. Ariko we, akwiye kwemerwa, murabizi yuko nk'uko umwana amereranira na se ari ko yakoranye nanje ivy'ugukwiza Inkuru nziza. Ni we nizigiye yuko ari we nzoca ndabarungikira, ninabona aho ivyanje bigeze. Bisubiye kandi, nizigiye rwose yuko nzoza iwanyu ntatevye. Niyumvira kandi yuko vyobabera vyo ndabarungikiye Epafrodito, mwenewacu dufatanije ibikenurwa n'intambara, ari we intumwa yanyu inkorera ivyo nkeneye; kuko abakumbuye mwese akarandurwa umutima n'uko mwumvise yuko yari arwaye. Kandi koko yari yararwaye ahakwa n'ugupfa, ariko Imana yaramugiriye ubuntu, si we musa yabugiriye, yarabungiriye nanje, kugira ngo sinongere amaganya mu yandi. Ni co gituma rero nihuse kumubarungikira, kugira ngo nimwamubona musubire kunezerwa, nanje nduhuke amaganya. Nimumwakirane akanyamuneza kenshi rero mu Mukama, kandi abameze nk'uwo nimubahe icubahiro, kuko yagarukiye ku cobo ku bw'igikorwa ca Kristu, akishira urupfu ngo aringanize ivyasigaye mutari kungirira mu kuntabara.

Mu guheza, benewacu nimunezerwe mu Mukama. Kubandikira ivyo mwumvise ntibindambira, kandi namwe birabashigikira. Mwirinde imbwa ! Mwirinde abakozi babi! Mwirinde abagenyerewe ukutariko! Nkako ni twebwe twagenyerewe vy'ukuri, twebwe dukorera Imana ku bwa Mutima w'Imana, tukaninahazwa muri Yezu Kristu tutishimira umubiri. Yamara nari mfise imvo z'ukwishimira umubiri. Nihaba hari uwundi agira ngo afise imvo z'ukwishimira umubiri, ndazimurusha: nagenyerewe ku musi ugira umunani, ndi uwo mu bwoko bw'Israyeli, ndi uwo mu gisata ca Benyamini , ndi Umuhebereyi yamuka ku Bahebereyi, mu biraba Itegeko ndi Umufarizayo mu biraba umwete, ndi umwe yahama Ekleziya, mu biraba urukiza ruva kw'Itegeko, ndi intahinyuka. Ariko, ivyo vyose vyari bimfitiye akamaro nabiravye nk'ubusa kubera Kristu. Eka mbere n'ibintu vyose nyene ndabiraba nk'ubusa, kuko ukumenya Kristu Yezu Umukama wanje kundutira vyose. Ku bwiwe, vyose narabihevye ndabiraba nk'umwavu, kugira ngo ndonke Kristu, kandi muri we, biboneke ko urukiza mfise atari urwanje nikurira mw'Itegeko, ahubwo ko ari uruva ku kwemera Kristu, rukaba ruva ku Mana, urukiza rushimikiye ku kwemera. Nshaka ndamumenye, menye kandi ububasha bw'izuka ryiwe, nsangire na we amagorwa yiwe, nshushe na we mu rupfu rwiwe, kugira ngo bishobotse mbashe gushikira izuka ry'abapfuye. Si ukuvuga ko ubu namaze kubishikira canke ko namaze kuba umuntu abushitse, ariko ndaciruka ngo mbashe kubicakamira kuko nanje nyene nacakamiwe na Kristu Yezu. Benewacu, jeho ku bwanje sinibwira yuko namaze kubicakamira. Nibwira kimwe gusa: mu kwibagira ibiri inyuma no mu gushingira ibiri imbere, ndiko ndiruka ngo nshikire rya shimwe Imana yaduhamagariye mw'ijuru muri Kristu Yezu. twese abantu babushitse uko tungana, uko ni ko twokwiyumvira. Namwe, nimwaba hari ico mwiyumvira ukundi, na co nyene Imana izokibahishurira. Mugabo rero, aho tugeze hose, nihabe ari ho tubandaniriza. Benewacu, nimwifatanye n'abanyigana, kandi muhange amaso abigenza neza nk'uko mudufiseko akarorero. Nkako rero, nk'uko nabibabwiye kenshi, ubu nsubiye kubibabarirana amarira, benshi bigenza nk'abansi b'umusaraba wa Kristu. Amaherezo yabo ni ugutakara, imana yabo ni inda yabo, ubuninahazwa bwabo buri mu biteye isoni, bitwararika ivy'isi. Tweho iwacu ni mw'ijuru, aho Umukiza, Umukama Yezu Kristu, turindiranye igishika, azoza ava. Ni we azonagura umubiri wacu nyabworo use n'umubiri wiwe w'ubuninahazwa, nk'uko afise ububasha burangutse bw'ukwiganzira vyose.

None rero, benewacu nkunda cane kandi mporanira igishika, mwebwe gahimbare kanje n'urugori rwanje, nimugumane gutyo umutima rugabo mu Mukama bakunzi banje. Mpanuye Evodiya nk'uko mpanura Sintiko, ngo bahurize imitima mu Mukama. Nawe mugenzi mwiza, ndakwinginze nubunganire, baramfashije kurwanira Inkuru nziza hamwe na Klementi nyene n'abandi twafatanije; amazina yabo yanditswe mu gitabu c'ubuzima. Nimwame muhimbawe mu Mukama. Ndabivuge ndabisubire, nimuhimbarwe. Ubutore bwanyu nibumenyekane mu bantu bose. Umukama ari hafi. Ntihagire ico mwinona, ariko muri vyose, mu gisabisho no mu gutakamba mukenguruka, ivyo musaba nimubimenyeshe Imana. Niho amahoro y'Imana yo asiga ubwenge bwose yobazigamira imitima yanyu n'ivyiyumviro vyanyu muri Kristu Yezu. Ahasigaye ga benewacu, ivy'ukuri vyose, ibikwiye kwubahwa vyose, ibitunganye vyose, ibitagira akanenge vyose, ibikwiye gukundwa vyose, ibikwiye kuratwa vyose, nihaba hari icitwa ubutore, nihaba hari igikwiye gushimwa, muritwararike ivyo. Ivyo mwigishijwe, ivyo mwakiriye, ivyo mwanyumviseko n'ivyo mwambonyeko, abe ari vyo mukora, ni ho Imana y'amahoro izohorana namwe. Ndanezerewe cane mu Mukama kuko mwasubiriye kunyereka ubu ivyiyumviro mumfitiye. Mwahora munyiyumvira neza, ariko ntimwari bwabone uburyo bw'ukubinyereka. Si ubukene bumvugisha, naramenyereye kwigendako aho ndi hose. Ndazi kwifata mu bukene, ndazi n'ukwoga mu vyuzuye, hose no muri vyose, narimenyereje guhaga no gusonza, kugira umurengera no kuba mu bukene. Vyose ndabishobora mu wunkomeza. Ariko rero, mwagize neza mu kuntabara mu marushwa yanje. Murabizi namwe, Banyafilipi, ko ngitangura kwigisha, aho nava muri Masedoniya, ata yindi Ekleziya yantabaye ngo muvyandike mu gitabu c'ivyo ndabafitiye n'ivyo bamfitiye, atari mwebwe gusa, kandi i Tesalonika nyene mwandungikiye ivyo nari nkeneye, si rimwe ni kabiri kose. Si ukuvuga ko ndondera amashikanwa, ariko ico ndondera ni uko inyungu yanyu yongerekana mu gitabu. Ndafise vyose, mfise n'umurengera. Ndikwiye, kuva aho Epafrodito anshikirije ishikanwa ryanyu, ari ryo mubavu umoga neza, imbagwa yemewe, ishimwa n'Imana. Imana yanje na yo izomara ubukene bwanyu bwose ku ngero y'itunga ryayo, ibasagiririze muri Kristu Yezu. Imana Dawe wa twese nininahazwe imyaka n'imyaka. Amen! Muntahirize umweranda wese muri Kristu Yezu; benewacu turi kumwe barabatasha. Aberanda bose barabatasha, canecane abo kwa Sezari. Imigisha y'Umukama Yezu Kristu niyamane n'imitima yanyu.

Jewe Pawulo, umutumwa wa Kristu Yezu ku bw'ugushaka kw'Imana, twe na mwenewacu Timote, turandikiye aberanda b'i Kolosi, benewacu bayobotse Kristu, tubipfurije umugisha n'amahoro y'Imana Dawe wa twese. Ntiduhengeshanya gukengurukira Imana, Se w'Umukama wacu Yezu Kristu mu kubibuka mu bisabisho vyacu, kuko twumvise ukwemera mufise muri Yezu Kristu n'urukundo mufitiye aberanda bose kubera amizero mwabikiwe mw'ijuru, ayo mizero mwumvise kera muri rya jambo ry'ukuri ry'Inkuru nziza, ryashikiye iwanyu nk'uko ryakwiye kw'isi yose rikama kandi rigasagarara. N'iwanyu ni ko kw'uko, kuva aho mwumviye mugategera ingabirano y'Imana mu kuri, nk'uko mwavyigishijwe na Epafrasi, umugenzi wacu nyagukundwa, dufashanya, akatubera umusuku w'intahemuka wa Kristu, kandi ni we yatumenyesheje urukundo mufise muri Mutima. Ni co gituma natwe, kuva aho twumviye ayo makuru, tudahengeshanya kubasabira n'ukubatakambira ku Mana kugira ngo ibuzuzemwo ubumenyi bw'ico ishaka, mugire muri vyose ubwenge n'ubukerebutsi biva kuri Mutima. Niho muzokwigenza nk'uko bibereye Umukama kugira ngo mumunezereze muri vyose. Muzokwama ivyamwa mu bikorwa vyiza vy'ubwoko bwose kandi muzosagarara mu bumenyi bw'Imana. Muzogira ubukomezi bwose ku ngero y'ububasha bw'ubuninahazwa bwayo, kugira ngo mugumye rwose umutima ntimurambirwe. Muzogira akanyamuneza, mu gukengurukira Mana Data yo yaduhaye amagara y'ugusangirira mu muco ivyagenewe aberanda. Ni yo yadukuye mu bubasha bw'umuzimagiza, idushira mu Bwami bw'Umwana wayo ikunda cane. We twaronsemwo urukiza n'ikigongwe c'ibicumuro. Ni we Gashusho k'Imana itaboneka, ni we yaboneye izuba izina kiremwa cose, kuko muri we ari ho vyose vyaremewe, ivyo mw'ijuru n'ivyo kw'isi, ibiboneka n'ibitaboneka, zaba intebe z'ubwami, ubutegetsi, ubukuru canke ububasha, vyose ni we yabiremye, abirema avyiremera. Yamye ariho vyose bitarabaho kandi vyose bibeshwaho muri we. Ni we kandi Mutwe w'umubiri ari wo Ekleziya. Ni we vyose vyamukako, ni we yaboneye izuba abapfuye, kugira ngo abe uwa mbere muri vyose. Nkako Imana yashimye kumuvyagizamwo umusesekara wose kandi ku bwiwe igashima kwuzuza vyose na we ngo birore kuri we, ivyo kw'isi n'ivyo mw'ijuru, mu kubizanira amahoro ku bw'amaraso yasheshe ku musaraba wiwe. Namwe nyene, kera mwari kure y'Imana, mukaba abansi bayo mu vyiyumviro vyanyu kubera ibikorwa bibi mwakoze. Ubuho yarabiyujurije na yo mu mubiri w'Umwana wiwe kubera urupfu yapfuye, ngo mushobore guseruka imbere yayo muri beranda, ata gatosi, ata n'amahinyu. Ariko mukwiye kwigumya mu kwemera, mushimitse kandi mudatirigana, mudaheba ukwizigira mwahawe n'Inkuru nziza mwumvise, yigishijwe ikiremwa cose kiri munsi y'ijuru, kandi ari yo jewe Pawulo nashinzwe gukorera. Ubu ndanezerewe mu kubabara ku bwanyu, kandi ivyasigaye ku magorwa ya Kristu ndabiherahereza mu mubiri wanje, ku bw'Umubiri wiwe ari wo Ekleziya, yo nshinzwe gukorera kubera rya teka natewe n'Imana ku bwanyu ry'ukwigisha bimwe birangutse Ijambo ry'Imana, rya banga nyene ryahishijwe abantu ba kera kuva imyaka, rigaserurirwa ubu aberanda biwe, abo nyene Imana yashatse kumenyesha ukuntu itunga ry'ubuninahazwa bw'iri banga ringana mu banyamahanga, na ryo rikaba ari Kristu muri mwebwe, we muzeyeko ubuninahazwa. Ni we tumenyesha mu guhanura umuntu wese no mu kwigisha umuntu wese, tukabigirana ubwitonzi bwose, kugira ngo umuntu wese tumugire umuntu abushitse muri Kristu. Ico ni co ndondera mu kwiruhisha nkabirwanira ku ngero y'ububasha bwiwe bukora muri jewe bimwe bishemeye.

Ni ko, ndashaka ko mumenya ukuntu ndabarwanira mwe n'ab'i Lahodiseya n'abandi benshi batarigera bankubita ijisho, kugira ngo imitima yabo ireme kandi bafatanijwe n'urukundo bashikire amatungo yose y'ubwenge butomoye, babone kumenya ibanga ry'Imana ari ryo Kristu. Muri we ni ho amatungo yose y'ubwenge n'ubumenyi yihishije. Ivyo ndabibabwiye kugira ngo ntihagire n'umwe abahendesha amajambo atagira aho ahagaze. Nkako nyene, naho ntari kumwe namwe ku mubiri, ndi kumwe namwe ku mutima, ngahimbarwa n'umutekano uhangaye murimwo mu kwemera Kristu. Ni uko rero, nk'uko mwakiriye Kristu Yezu Umukama, nikube ari ko mugendera muri we. Nimushinge imizi kandi muhangame muri we, mu gushimikira ku kwemera nk'uko mwavyigishijwe, no mu kurushirizaho gukenguruka. Nimwirinde, ntihagire uwubatwara mu buja bw'ibinyoma mu kubahendesha ubwenge bw'abantu n'ubuhumvyi bw'ubusa, bumwe bushimikiye kw'iragi no ku mategeko abayabaye y'isi, budashimikiye kuri Kristu. Erega muri we ni ho umusesekara wose wa kamere y'Imana utsimbataye mu buryo bw'umubiri, mugasangira muri we kuri uwo musesekara, kuko ari we aganza ubukuru bwose n'ububasha bwose. Muri we kandi mwaragenyerewe igenyerwa ritagizwe n'iminwe y'abantu, mwiyambura kamere y'umubiri: iryo ni ryo genyerwa muri Kristu. Mwahambanywe na we mw'ibatisimu, muri we ni ho mwazuranywe na we kubera ukwemera mufitiye ububasha bw'Imana yamuzuye mu bapfuye. Mwebwe mwari mwarapfuye kubera ibicumuro vyanyu no kubera wa mubiri utagenyerewe, none Imana yarabagize bazima kumwe na we, mu kubarekurira ibicumuro vyanyu vyose. Yarahanaguye urwandiko rurimwo ingingo zatwagiriza, rumwe nyene rwaturega, iraruzimanganya mu kurubamba ku musaraba, abafise ubukuru n'abafise ububasha irabubambura, ibamaramariza mu maso ya bose, iba ari wo ibatsindirako. Ni uko rero, ntihagire n'umwe abacira urubanza mu biraba imfungurwa canke inyobwa canke mu vy'imisi mikuru iza uko umwaka utashe canke mu vy'imboneko z'ukwezi canke mu vy'Isabato. Ivyo vyose ni nk'icijiji gusa c'ibizoza, ariko ukuri kw'imvaho, ni umubiri wa Kristu. Ntihagire n'umwe abagunga ishimwe ryanyu, mu kwigira ngo akora ivy'ukwicisha bugufi kandi ngo yubaha abamarayika. Uwo muntu yitwararika ivyo yabonye gusa, aba yishimira ubusa mu bwenge bwa kamere yiwe, ntiyiteho wa Mutwe ugaburira kandi ufatanya Umubiri wose mu ngingo zawo no mu mitsi yawo, kugira ngo ushikire ca gikuriro cashatswe n'Imana. Nimwaba mwapfanye na Kristu ku mateka atarangutse y'isi, ni kuki mwigenza nk'abazokwama bari kw'isi nyene mugakunda kuganzwa n'aya mategeko ngo: «Ntiwakire, ntugafungureko, ntugakoreko»? Ivyo vyose ni amategeko n'inyigisho z'abantu bititukana n'umwanya. Ni ibintu bisa n'ibifise ubwitonzi ni ko, mu kwibwiriza mu gusenga, mu kwicisha bugufi no mu kubabaza umubiri, ariko nta kandi kamaro bifise atari ugushimisha ikibiribiri.

None rero, nimwaba mwazuranywe na Kristu, nimurondere ivy'ijuru, aho Kristu yicaye iburyo bw'Imana. Nimwamize agatima ku vy'ijuru, mureke kwumira ku vy'isi; kuko mwapfuye kandi ubuzima bwanyu buhishijwe kumwe na Kristu mu Mana. Aho Kristu azoserukira, we buzima bwacu, ni ho namwe muzorengukana na we mu buninahazwa. Nimwice rero za ngingo zigarukira ku vy'isi: ubuhumbu, uguhumana, umwina, ivyipfuzo bibi n'inambu y'ivy'abandi kuko ari ugusenga ibigirwamana. Ivyo ni vyo bizana ishavu ry'Imana ku bantu b'intabarirwa. Namwe mwabigenderamwo kera, igihe mwaba mu kabi nk'ako. Ubu ho nimuhebe namwe ivyo vyose: ishavu, ubukazi, ubukozi bw'ikibi, ugutyoza Imana, n'amajambo ateye isoni nibibave mu kanwa. Ntimube mugihendana, kuko mwiyambuye wa muntu wa kera n'ibikorwa vyiwe, mukambara wa muntu mushasha, umwe aguma ashaka gushikira ubumenyi nyakuri mu kwishushanya n'Umuremyi wiwe. Aho ntihaba hakivugwa Umugereki canke Umuyuda, uwagenyerewe canke uwutagenyerewe, kavantara canke Umusikuti, umushumba canke uwidegemvya, ariko Kristu ni we vyose akaba kandi muri vyose. Ni uko rero, nk'uko bibereye intore z'Imana, aberanda n'abahanuzi bayo, nimwambare umutima w'ikigongwe, ukunda abandi, wicisha bugufi, utekereza, wiyumanganya. Muramutse mutase, nimwengengane, muheze murekuriranire nk'uko Umukama yabarekuriye, namwe kube ari ko murekuriranira. Hejuru y'ivyo vyose, nimwambare urukundo, kuko ari rwo mukanda upfundikanya ubweranda. Vyongeye, amahoro ya Kristu nahangame mu mitima yanyu, ayo mahoro mwahamagariwe gusangira mu mubiri umwe; maze mwame mukenguruka. Ijambo rya Kristu niribavyagiremwo risasagare, maze mwigishanye kandi muhanurane mu bwitonzi bwuzuye, muririmbire Imana mu mitima yanyu mukenguruka, mu mazaburi, mu ndirimbo no mu mvyino bivuye kuri Mutima. Ivyo muvuga canke ivyo mukora vyose mwame mubigira kw'izina ry'Umukama Yezu, mukengurukira Imana Data ku bwiwe nyene. Mwa bagore, nimugamburukire abagabo banyu nk'uko bibereye mu Mukama. Mwa bagabo, nimukunde abagore banyu kandi ntimubirabuze umutima. Mwa bana, nimugamburukire abavyeyi banyu muri vyose, ni vyo binezereza Umukama. Mwa bavyeyi, ntimuturubike abana banyu kugira ngo ntibaranduke umutima. Mwa basuku, nimugamburukire muri vyose ba shobuja bo ngaha kw'isi, ntimubakorere ku jisho nk'abanezereza abantu, ariko mugamburukane umutima witonda, wubaha Umukama. Ivyo mukora vyose mubikore bivuye ku mutima nk'abakorera Umukama, ntimube nk'abakorera abantu. Mumenye neza ko Umukama ari we azobaronsa impera y'ukuba ba samuragwa. Umukama Kristu ni we mukorera. Nkako nyene ukurenganya azotorana akarenganyo kandi nta n'umwe asobanurwa.

Mwebwe mufise abasuku, nimubahe ibitunganye n'ibibereye, kuko muzi yuko namwe mufise Shobuja mw'ijuru. Nimuhoze agatima ku gisabisho, kibafashe kwama mugavye mu gushimira Imana. Kandi natwe nyene mudusabire, kugira ngo Imana iducire inzira y'Inkuru nziza, dushobore kuyaga ibanga rya Kristu ryatumye nja mw'ibohero, kandi kugira ngo nshobore kurivuga neza nk'uko ndabitegerezwa. Nimugendane ubwitonzi mu batari abakristu, ntimugishe uburyo mufise. Imvugo zanyu zamane ubuntu, zirunzwe umunyu, kugira ngo mumenye ukuntu mutegerezwa kwishura umuntu wese. Amakuru yanje yose muzoyamenyeshwa na Tikiko mwenewanyu nkunda, akaba umukozi adahemuka kandi dusangiye igikorwa mu Mukama. Ni we ndabarungikiye ku bw'ivyo nyene, ngo mumenye amakuru yacu kandi aremeshe imitima yanyu. Ndamurungikanye na Onezimu, mwenewacu w'intahemuka kandi dukunda cane, na we yamuka iwanyu. Bazobiganira ivy'ino vyose. Aristariko, turi kumwe mw'ibohero arabatasha; Mariko mwene sewabo wa Baranaba, arabatasha na we. Ni we bababwira mu nyigisho bati: «Niyaza iwanyu, muramufate neza.» Yezu bataziriye Yusito, arabatasha na we nyene. Mu bagenyerewe, abo ni bo basa dukorana ku bw'Ubwami bw'Imana. Barambereye uruhoza Epafrasi, umwe aturuka iwanyu, umusuku wa Kristu Yezu, arabatasha. Imisi yose arabarwanira mu bisabisho, kugira ngo mugume muri abantu babushitse, kandi mwemere mudakekereza ivyo Imana ishaka vyose. Egome, ndavyemeje ko abitwararitse cane, mwebwe n'ab'i Lahodiseya n'abo muri Hiyerapoli. Luka, wa muganga dukunda, na Demasi barabatasha. Nimuntahirize benewacu bari i Lahodiseya, Numfa be n'Ekleziya ikoranira mu nzu yiwe. Nimwamara gusoma iri kete, muze mwitwararike ngo risomerwe muri Ekleziya y'i Lahodiseya; ikete rizova i Lahodiseya na ryo, nimwitwararike ngo murisome namwe. Murabwira Arikipo muti: «Itegereze igikorwa wahawe mu Mukama, kugira ngo ukirangure neza.» Iyo ni yo ndamutso ya jewe Pawulo yanditswe n'ukuboko kwanje. Nimwibuke ko ndi mw'ibohero! Muragahorane inema!

Pawulo na Silvano na Timote turandikiye Ekleziya y'ab'i Tesalonika iri mu Mana Data no mu Mukama Yezu Kristu, tubipfurije umugisha n'amahoro. Twama dukengurukira Imana kubera mwebwe mwese uko tubibutse mu bisabisho vyacu; ntiduhengeshanya kwibuka umwete mufise mu bikorwa vy'ukwemera, uburuhe bw'ibikorwa murinda kubera urukundo n'ukutadohoka mwerekana mu kwizigira Umukama wacu Yezu Kristu imbere y'Imana Dawe wa twese. Erega benewacu mukundwa n'Imana, turazi yuko ari yo yabitoreye, kuko Inkuru nziza twabashikirije itababereye amajambo gusa, ariko yerekanye rwose ubukomezi bwayo ku bw'igikorwa ca Mutima Mweranda no mu musesekara mwinshi, nk'uko muzi ukuntu twari tumeze iwanyu ku bwanyu nyene. Namwe mwaciye mutwigana twe n'Umukama, mu kwakira Ijambo ry'Imana, mufise akanyamuneza ka Mutima Mweranda n'aho mwari mu marushwa. Gutyo, mwabereye akarorero abemeye bo muri Masedoniya na Akaya. Nkako nyene, Ijambo ry'Umukama ntiryavuye iwanyu ngo risamirane muri Masedoniya no muri Akaya gusa, ariko ukwemera Imana kwanyu kwarakwiye mu ntara zose, ku buryo ata co dukeneye kwongerako. Koko, bose baravuga ikaze mwaduhaye n'ukuntu mwahindukiriye Imana mugaheba ibigirwamana kugira ngo mukorere Imana nzima y'ukuri, kandi kugira ngo murorere Umwana wayo ko azova mw'ijuru, umwe yazuye mu bapfuye, Yezu, wa Mukiza adukiza ishavu ryari riduhanamiye.

Na mwebwe nyene muramenye, benewacu, ikaze mwaduhaye ko ritabaye iry'ubusa. N'aho twaciye mu makuba tugatukirwa i Filipi nk'uko mubizi, twahavuye turema kubera Imana yacu tubigisha Inkuru nziza y'Imana turi mu rugamba ruhambaye . Nkako nanone, ivyo duhanura ntibiva ku buhumvyi canke ku buhumane canke ku bugunge; ariko nk'uko twasuzumwe n'Imana ikadushinga Inkuru nziza, ni ko turiko turavuga tutarondera kunezereza abantu, ariko turondera kunezereza Imana isuzuma imitima yacu . Nta na rimwe twigeze tuvuga amajambo yo kubasasako akarimi nk'uko musanzwe mubizi, canke ijambo ryo guhisha inambu y'amatungo. Imana nitubere icabona. Ntitwigeze kandi turondera kuninahazwa n'abantu, mwaba mwebwe canke abandi, n'aho twari gushobora kubaremera kuko turi abatumwa ba Kristu, ariko twamye twitonda aho twari iwanyu, nka kurya umuvyeyi abungabunga abana biwe. Nkako twari tubafitiye igishika, ku buryo tutari kubigisha Inkuru nziza y'Imana gusa, twari no kubahebera ubuzima bwacu. Ni ukuri, mwari mwadushitse ku nyota. Muribuka benewacu, ibikorwa n'uburuhe twarimwo. Twarabamenyesheje Inkuru nziza y'Imana, tugakora ijoro n'umutaga ngo twoye kuremera n'umwe muri mwebwe. Muratubera ivyabona, n'Imana nyene yotubera icabona ko muri mwebwe abemera, twigenjeje nk'aberanda, nk'intungane, tutagira amahinyu. Murabizi ko umwe wese muri mwebwe twamugiriye ivyo umuvyeyi agirira abana biwe bwite. Twarabahanuye, turabaremesha twongera turabemeza kwigenza nk'uko bibereye Imana nyene ibahamagarira ubwami bwayo n'ubuninahazwa bwayo. Na twebwe, igituma tudahengeshanya gukengurukira Imana, ni uko mu kwakira Ijambo ry'Imana mwumvise kuri twebwe, mutaryakiriye nk'ijambo ry'abantu, ariko mwaryakiriye nk'uko riri nyene nk'Ijambo ry'Imana, ryama rirabaha ingoga mwebwe mwemera. Nkako, benewacu, mwarakurikiye akarorero k'amakleziya yo mu Buyuda muri Kristu Yezu, kuko mwababajwe n'amagorwa mwatewe n'abo musangiye intara nk'uko na bo nyene bababajwe n'Abayuda, bo bishe Umukama Yezu n'abahanuzi, natwe baraduhamye, ntibanezereje Imana, ni abansi b'abantu bose, kuko batubuza kwigisha abanyamahanga ngo bakire, igihe cose bakungura ingero y'ibicumuro vyabo , yamara ishavu ry'Imana ryaratevye rirabagwako. Natwe ga benewacu, kubera ko tumaze igihe dutandukanye namwe ku maso ariko atari ku mutima, twarushirijeho kurondera uburyo bw'ukubabona imbonankubone, tubafitiye inkumbu nyinshi. Ni co gituma twashatse kuza iwanyu, mbere jewe Pawulo kubishaka si rimwe ni kabiri kose, ishetani ikatubuza. None amizero yacu ni ayahe, akanyamuneza kacu ni akahe, urugori ruzotuninahaza imbere y'Umukama Yezu umusi azogarukira ni uruhe, atari mwebwe nyene? Egome, ni mwebwe ninahazwa ryacu ni mwebwe gahimbare kacu.

Ni uko rero, kuko tutagishobora kurindira, twarashimye gusigara twenyene i Atene, tubarungikira Timote, mwenewacu, wa mukozi w'Imana mu vy'Inkuru nziza ya Kristu, ngo abakomeze kandi abaremeshe mu kwemera kwanyu, kugira ngo ntihagire n'umwe atirimuka muri ayo marushwa, kuko muzi ko ari co twagenewe. Nkako nyene aho twari iwanyu, twari twababuriye amarushwa tuzobona, kandi ni ko vyabaye, murabizi. Ni co gituma nanje naciye ndamurungika kubaza ivy'ukwemera kwanyu, eka ntinya ko umwosha mubi yoba yaraboheje nabi kandi ibikorwa vyacu bikaba vyapfuye ubusa. Ariko ubu nyene Timote arashitse iwacu avuye iwanyu, atuzaniye ya makuru meza araba ukwemera kwanyu n'urukundo rwanyu, atubwira kandi yuko mutwibuka neza imisi yose, mugakumbura kubonana natwe nk'uko natwe tubakumbuye. Ni co gituma benewacu, muri ya marushwa yacu no mu bitugora vyose, mwaturemesheje kubera ukwemera kwanyu kandi ubu turi bazima kuko mugumya umutima rugabo mu Mukama. Twoshobora gukengurukira Imana dute kubera mwebwe, kubera ako kanyamuneza mwaduteye imbere y'Imana yacu? Ijoro n'umutaga, turayizamba rwose ngo twibonanire namwe imbonankubone, tunonosore ivyasigaye ku kwemera kwanyu. Imana yo nyene Dawe wa twese n'Umukama wacu Yezu nituringanirize inzira idushikana iwanyu. Namwe Umukama nabagwirize urukundo mufitaniye kandi mufitiye bose, nk'uko tubakunda na twebwe nyene, kugira ngo aremeshe imitima yanyu mu bweranda butagira amahinyu imbere y'Imana Dawe wa twese umusi Umukama wacu Yezu azoseruka azananye n'aberanda biwe bose. Amen!

Mu guheza, benewacu, turabinginga tubahanura mu Mukama Yezu, kugira ngo nk'uko mwigishijwe na twebwe ukuntu mutegerezwa kwigenza no kunezereza Imana, kandi noneho ni ko mwigenza, murushirizeho cane. Ni ko, musanzwe muzi ya mabwirizwa twabahaye ku bw'Umukama Yezu uko ameze. Ico Imana ishaka ni uko mwoba beranda, mukirinda ubuhumbu, umwe wese muri mwebwe akamenye kuzigama umubiri wiwe mu bweranda no mu cubahiro, ntawuzigame mu gutwarwa n'ivyipfuzo bibi nk'uko abapagani batazi Imana babigira. Muri ivyo rero, ntihagire ugirira nabi mwenewabo, ntihagire n'uwumugunga, kuko Imana igera ingere ku yindi kuri ivyo vyose, nk'uko twamaze kubibabwira n'ukubibemeza. Nkako, Imana ntiyaduhamagariye guhumana, ariko yaduhamagariye kuba beranda. None rero, uwugaya iyo nyigisho ntaba agaya umuntu gusa, ariko aba agaye Imana nyene, yo yama ibaha Mutima Mweranda wayo. Na vyo ivy'urukundo rw'abavandimwe, ntimukeneye kuvyandikirwa; kuko ubwanyu nyene mwigishijwe n'Imana gukundana, kandi kuko ari co muhora mugirira benewacu bose bo muri Masedoniya hose. Ariko, turabahanura, benewacu, ngo murushirizeho cane. Kandi nimwitwararike kwama mutekanye, mukore ivyanyu bwite kandi mukoreshe amaboko yanyu nk'uko twabibategetse, kugira ngo mwigenze rupfasoni mu maso y'abo hanze kandi ntimugire ico mukena. Ntidushaka, benewacu, ko muyoberwa ivyerekeye abasinziriye itiro ry'urupfu, kugira ngo ntimwicwe n'intuntu nka ba bandi badafise ukwizigira. Nkako nyene, kuko twemeye yuko Yezu yapfuye hanyuma akazuka, turemera ko abasinziriye muri Kristu Imana izobagarukana hamwe na we. Ng'iki rero ico tubabwira twishimikije ivyo Umukama yavuze: twebwe abazoba bakiriho, gushika aho Umukama azogarukira, ntituzotanga na gatoyi abazoba basinziriye, kuko ijwi ry'umumarayika mukuru n'inzamba z'Imana bimaze gutanga ikimenyetso, Umukama we nyene azomanuka ava mw'ijuru kandi abapfuye muri Kristu bazotanga abandi kuzuka, hanyuma twebwe, abazoba bakiriho, abazoba basigaye, tuzoterurwa hamwe na bo mu bicu ngo dusanganire Umukama mu kirere . Gutyo rero tuzoheza twamane n'Umukama mu myaka yose . Ni uko rero, nimuremeshanye muri ayo majambo.

Na vyo ivy'ibihe n'imisi ga benewacu, ntimukeneye kuvyandikirwa. Namwe nyene murazi neza ko Umusi w'Umukama uzoza nk'igisuma mw'ijoro . Igihe bazoba bavuga bati: «Hari amahoro nta nkomanzi», ni ho ya makuba azobagwako giturumbuka nk'uko ububabare bufata umugore akuriwe, kandi ntibazoyikiza na gatoyi. Ariko mweho benewacu, ntimuri mu muzimagiza ngo uyo musi ububire nk'igisuma. Nkako mwese muri abana b'umuco n'abana b'umutaga. Ntituri ab'ijoro canke ab'umwijima. None rero, ntidusinzire nka ba bandi, ariko nitwame tugavye kandi twigerere. Nakare abasinzira basinzira mw'ijoro n'ababorerwa bakaborerwa mw'ijoro. Ariko tweho, ko turi ab'umutaga, nitwigerere, twambare inkinzo y'ukwemera n'urukundo, kandi twambare nk'inkofero ukwizigira ubukiriro. Erega Imana ntiyatugeneye gutwarwa n'ishavu, ariko yatugeneye gushikira ubukiriro ku bw'Umukama wacu Yezu Kristu, we yadupfiriye kugira ngo tube bazima hamwe na we turi maso canke dusinziriye. Ni uko rero, nimuhumurizanye kandi mukomezanye nk'uko mwama mubigira. Turabinginga benewacu, kwemera abigora babakorera, bakabarongora mu Mukama bakongera bakabahanura. Nimurushirizeho kububahana urukundo ku bw'igikorwa bashinzwe. Nimubane mu mahoro. Turabinginze benewacu ngo muhanure ibinebwe, muremeshe abarandutse umutima, muramire abatagira amagara, mubane neza na bose. Muragabe, ntihagire uwugera ikibi ku kindi, ariko mwame murondera kugiriranira iciza kandi mukigirire n'abandi bose. Nimwame muhimbawe, ntimuhengeshanye gusaba, muri vyose na hose, nimwame mukenguruka, kuko ari co Imana ibashakako muri Kristu Yezu. Ntimuzimye Mutima, ntimukengere ivy'abahanuzi, ariko, mwitegereze vyose muheze iciza mukizigame; mwirinde icitwa ikibi cose. Imana y'amahoro yo nyene ubwayo nibagire beranda muri vyose; umwe wese uko ari kwose, ubwenge, umutima n'umubiri, yizigame, ku musi w'uguhindukira kw'Umukama wacu Yezu Kristu ntaze agire amahinyu. Uwabahamagaye ni intatanamundagano, ni we rero azobibagirira. Benewacu, mudusabire natwe. Mudutahirize benewacu bose, muramukanye mu guhoberana nk'aberanda. Ndabihanije w'Umukama, iri kete murarisomere benewacu bose. Umugisha w'Umukama wacu Yezu Kristu niwamane namwe.

Pawulo na Silvano na Timote, turandikiye Ekleziya y'ab'i Tesalonika iri mu Mana Dawe wa twese no mu Mukama Yezu Kristu. Tubipfurije umugisha n'amahoro biva ku Mana Data no ku Mukama Yezu Kristu. Turategerezwa kwama dukengurukira Imana kubera mwebwe benewacu, nk'uko bikwiye, kuko ukwemera kwanyu gutera imbere kandi kuko urukundo umwe wese afitiye abandi bose rwama rwongerekana. Ni co gituma mu yandi makleziya y'Imana dushimagizwa muri mwebwe kubera umutima rugabo n'ukwemera mufise mu ruhamo no mu marushwa murinda. Ivyo ni vyo vyerekana urubanza rutunganye rw'Imana, mukaberwa no gushika muri bwa bwami bw'Imana mubabara ari bwo muhorwa. Erega birabereye ko Imana yokwishura amarushwa abayabatera, kandi yuko mwebwe abayaterwa yobishura uburuhuko hamwe natwe umusi Umukama Yezu azokwihishurira ava mw'ijuru azananye n'abamarayika berekana inganji yiwe, hagati y'imbeya z'umuriro, kugira ngo acire urubanza rw'uguhanwa abatazi Imana n'abatumviye Inkuru nziza y'Umukama wacu Yezu .
